extends Node2D

@onready var _restart_button: Button = $CanvasLayer/Control/Restart_Button
@onready var _player: CharacterBody2D = $player
@onready var _npc: Node2D = $NPC


func _ready() -> void:
	# Player dies → show restart button
	var health_comp: HealthComponent = _player.get_node("HEALTH_COMPONENT") as HealthComponent
	if health_comp:
		health_comp.died.connect(_on_show_restart)
	
	# Player gives last key to NPC → show restart button
	if _npc.has_signal("all_keys_donated"):
		_npc.all_keys_donated.connect(_on_show_restart)


func _on_show_restart() -> void:
	_restart_button.show()


extends Node2D

## When the player walks into this area, the NPC can receive items from them.
## Press the "interact" key (E) while standing in the zone to give the key.

## Emitted when the player gives their last key to this NPC.
signal all_keys_donated

@onready var inventory: InventoryComponent = $INVENTORY_COMPONENT
@onready var interaction_area: Area2D = $InteractionArea
@onready var prompt_label: Label = $PromptLabel

## The player currently inside the interaction zone (null if none)
var _player_in_range: Node2D = null


func _ready() -> void:
	interaction_area.body_entered.connect(_on_body_entered)
	interaction_area.body_exited.connect(_on_body_exited)
	prompt_label.hide()


func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	# Only react if the player is standing in the interaction zone
	if not _player_in_range:
		return
	if event.is_action_pressed("interact"):
		_try_transfer_key()


## Called when any body enters the interaction zone
func _on_body_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
	if body.is_in_group(&"player"):
		_player_in_range = body
		_update_prompt()


## Called when any body leaves the interaction zone
func _on_body_exited(body: Node2D) -> void:
	if body == _player_in_range:
		_player_in_range = null
		prompt_label.hide()


## Try to take the key from the player and give it to the NPC
func _try_transfer_key() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(_player_in_range):
		return
	
	var player_inv: InventoryComponent = _player_in_range.get_node_or_null("INVENTORY_COMPONENT") as InventoryComponent
	if not player_inv:
		return
	
	# Only transfer if the player actually has a key
	if player_inv.has_item("key"):
		player_inv.remove_item("key", 1)
		inventory.add_item("key", 1)
		_update_prompt()
		
		# If the player has no more keys, let the world know
		if not player_inv.has_item("key"):
			all_keys_donated.emit()


## Show or hide the interaction prompt based on whether the player has a key
func _update_prompt() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(_player_in_range):
		prompt_label.hide()
		return
	
	var player_inv: InventoryComponent = _player_in_range.get_node_or_null("INVENTORY_COMPONENT") as InventoryComponent
	if player_inv and player_inv.has_item("key"):
		prompt_label.text = "Press E to give key"
		prompt_label.show()
	else:
		prompt_label.text = "No key to give"
		prompt_label.show()


extends CharacterBody2D

const SPEED = 300.0
const JUMP_VELOCITY = -400.0

@onready var abilities: AbilityComponent = $ABILITY_COMPONENT
@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = $Sprite2D

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	# Add the gravity.
	if not is_on_floor():
		velocity += get_gravity() * delta

	# Handle jump.
	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_accept") and is_on_floor():
		velocity.y = JUMP_VELOCITY

	# Get the input direction and handle the movement/deceleration.
	var direction := Input.get_axis("ui_left", "ui_right")
	velocity.x = direction * SPEED if direction else move_toward(velocity.x, 0, SPEED)
	# Flip the sprite to face the movement direction.
	# abs() keeps the scale magnitude positive; sign() returns 1 or -1 to set the facing.
	if direction: sprite.scale.x = abs(sprite.scale.x) * sign(direction)

	move_and_slide()

func _input(_event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("shoot"):
		abilities.activate_ability("SHOT_ABILITY")


extends Button


# Called when the node enters the scene tree for the first time.
func _ready() -> void:
	self.hide()


func _on_pressed() -> void:
	get_tree().reload_current_scene()


class_name Shot
extends Area2D

## How fast the shot travels in pixels per second
var speed: float = 400.0

## Direction the shot is moving (normalized)
var direction: Vector2 = Vector2.RIGHT

## How much damage this shot deals on hit
var damage: int = 10


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	# Move the shot in its direction each frame
	position += direction * speed * delta


## Call this right after spawning to configure the shot.
## shot_direction should be normalized (length of 1).
func _ready() -> void:
	area_entered.connect(_on_area_entered)


func _on_area_entered(_area: Area2D) -> void:
	queue_free()


func setup(shot_direction: Vector2, shot_speed: float = 400.0, shot_damage: int = 10) -> void:
	direction = shot_direction.normalized()
	speed = shot_speed
	damage = shot_damage

extends CanvasLayer

## A required signal that should be emitted when the Dialogue UI completes
## all its user interactions. This informs Orchestrator that it is then
## safe to proceed to the next node/step in the visual script workflow.
signal show_message_finished()

## The speed that the text will be rendered, i.e. typewriter
const TEXT_SPEED = 0.03

## Holds data passed by Orchestrator the Dialogue UI
##
## By default attributes are passed into this dictionary as:
##		"character_name" -> the name of the character speaking
##		"message" -> the text to be shown
##		"options" -> an array of text to be shown as choices
##
var dialogue_data : Dictionary

## Requirede by Orchestrator, passes the selected choice from
## the Dialogue UI back to the OrchestratorScript.
var selection : int

var _current_tween : Tween
var _current_choices : Dictionary
var _mouse_mode : Input.MouseMode

@onready var speaker 	  = $MarginContainer/PanelContainer/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/Speaker
@onready var speaker_text = $MarginContainer/PanelContainer/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/SpeakerText
@onready var response_tpl = $MarginContainer/PanelContainer/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/ResponseTemplate
@onready var next_button  = $MarginContainer/PanelContainer/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/NextButton

func _ready() -> void:
	response_tpl.visible = false
	next_button.visible = false
	visible = false
	
	## If the mouse is currently hidden, make it visible until the
	## player makes a selection in the dialog scene
	_mouse_mode = Input.mouse_mode
	if _mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_HIDDEN:
		Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE		
	
	## Setup what to do if there are no options and the next button
	## is shown, which is "Continue". In this case the selection is
	## set as -1 and the signal gets emitted.
	var button_handler := func():
		selection = -1
		_dialogue_finished()		
	next_button.pressed.connect(button_handler)
	
	## Grab data from Orchestrator dictionary to present the UI
	var character_name = dialogue_data["character_name"]
	var message = dialogue_data["message"]	
	var options = dialogue_data["options"]	
	show_message(character_name, message, options)
	
	
func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventKey:
		if event.is_pressed() and _should_end_typing(event.keycode):	
			if _current_tween.is_running():
				_current_tween.stop()
				speaker_text.visible_characters = speaker_text.text.length()
				_on_tween_finished(_current_choices)
		
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
			 				
		# ShowMessage is only allowed to process input when visible
		_disable_player_movement()
			

func show_message(speaker_name: String, message: String, choices: Dictionary) -> void:
	speaker.text = speaker_name
	speaker_text.text = message
	_current_choices = choices
	await get_tree().process_frame
	
	var duration = speaker_text.text.length() * TEXT_SPEED
	_current_tween = get_tree().create_tween()
	_current_tween.tween_property(speaker_text, "visible_characters", speaker_text.text.length(), duration)
	_current_tween.finished.connect(Callable(_on_tween_finished).bind(choices))
	show()
	
## Callback when the tween typing has finished.
## This allows presenting the user choice options or Continue button.
func _on_tween_finished(choices: Dictionary) -> void:
	if choices.size() > 0:		
		for key in choices.keys():
			var button = response_tpl.duplicate()
			button.text = choices[key]
			button.visible = true
			speaker_text.get_parent().add_child(button)
			var button_handler := func():
				selection = key
				_dialogue_finished()
			button.pressed.connect(button_handler)
	else:
		next_button.show()
		

## Handles canceling the typing effect based on key codes
func _should_end_typing(keycode:int) -> bool:
	return keycode == KEY_ESCAPE or keycode == KEY_SPACE
	

## Prevent user movement when the dialogue UI is shown
func _disable_player_movement() -> void:	
	var actions = InputMap.get_actions()
	for action in actions:
		Input.action_release(action)

func _dialogue_finished():
	## If the mouse was previously hidden, restore state
	if _mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_HIDDEN:
		Input.mouse_mode = _mouse_mode
	show_message_finished.emit()	
	queue_free()

# res://ai/states/patrol_state.gd
@tool
class_name PatrolState
extends BaseState

@export var patrol_tree: BehaviorTree

# Distance threshold to consider a waypoint as "reached" and skip to the next one.
@export var skip_wp_distance: float = 5.0


func _enter() -> void:
	print("--- PATROL STATE ENTERED! ---")
	
	_check_and_skip_close_waypoint()
	
	npc.bt_player.behavior_tree = patrol_tree
	npc.bt_player.active = true
	npc.bt_player.blackboard.set_var("current_state", "Patrolling")
	print("NPC: Entering Patrol State")


func _update(_delta: float) -> void:
	if npc.vision.can_see_player:
		print("Player Found!")
		fsm.change_active_state($"../Combat")


func _exit() -> void:
	npc.bt_player.active = false
	print("NPC: Exiting Patrol State")


func _check_and_skip_close_waypoint() -> void:
	var blackboard = npc.bt_player.blackboard
	var current_index = blackboard.get_var("patrol_index", -1)
	
	# Let the behavior tree handle initial patrol point assignment on spawn.
	if current_index == -1:
		return
		
	var points = npc.get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("patrol_point")
	if points.is_empty():
		return
		
	# Sort to ensure consistent order (must match logic used in npc.gd for debug drawing).
	points.sort_custom(func(a, b): return str(a.name).naturalnocasecmp_to(str(b.name)) < 0)
	
	# Prevent out-of-bounds index.
	current_index = current_index % points.size()
	var target_wp_pos = points[current_index].global_position
	
	# Use 2D distance (ignore Y) to avoid issues on stairs/slopes.
	var npc_pos_2d = Vector2(npc.global_position.x, npc.global_position.z)
	var target_pos_2d = Vector2(target_wp_pos.x, target_wp_pos.z)
	var distance = npc_pos_2d.distance_to(target_pos_2d)
	
	if distance < skip_wp_distance:
		var next_index = (current_index + 1) % points.size()
		blackboard.set_var("patrol_index", next_index)
		print("[Patrol] Too close to WP %d (%.1fm). Skipping it and moving to WP %d." % [current_index + 1, distance, next_index + 1])


# res://ai/states/search_state.gd
@tool
class_name SearchState
extends BaseState

@export var search_tree: BehaviorTree

# Whether to clear previous search memory when entering the state.
@export var clear_memory_on_enter: bool = true

# Number of most recent points to preserve when clearing search memory.
@export var keep_last_points: int = 1


func _enter() -> void:
	npc.bt_player.behavior_tree = search_tree
	npc.bt_player.active = true
	npc.bt_player.blackboard.set_var("current_state", "Searching")
	print("NPC: Entering Search State")

	var bb := npc.bt_player.blackboard

	# Handle search memory retention
	var searched: Array = bb.get_var("searched_locations", [])
	if clear_memory_on_enter:
		if searched.size() > keep_last_points:
			searched = searched.slice(-keep_last_points)
			bb.set_var("searched_locations", searched)

		# Keep direction history consistent with searched locations
		var dir_history: Array = bb.get_var("search_dir_history", [])
		if dir_history.size() > keep_last_points:
			dir_history = dir_history.slice(-keep_last_points)
			bb.set_var("search_dir_history", dir_history)
	
	# Initialize exploration starting point if not set
	if not bb.has_var("last_search_pos") or bb.get_var("last_search_pos") == null:
		bb.set_var("last_search_pos", npc.global_position)

	# Connect to behavior tree completion signal
	_connect_bt_finished_signal()


func _update(_delta: float) -> void:
	if npc.vision.can_see_player:
		fsm.change_active_state($"../Combat")


func _exit() -> void:
	npc.bt_player.active = false

	if clear_memory_on_enter:
		var bb := npc.bt_player.blackboard
		bb.set_var("searched_locations", [])
		bb.set_var("search_dir_history", [])
		bb.set_var("last_search_pos", null)

	_disconnect_bt_finished_signal()

	print("NPC: Exiting Search State")


func _on_bt_finished(status: int) -> void:
	if status == BT.Status.SUCCESS and fsm.get_active_state() == self:
		fsm.change_active_state($"../Patrol")


# Helper methods to avoid duplicating signal connection logic
func _connect_bt_finished_signal() -> void:
	if npc.bt_player.has_signal("updated"):
		if not npc.bt_player.updated.is_connected(_on_bt_finished):
			npc.bt_player.updated.connect(_on_bt_finished)
	elif npc.bt_player.has_signal("behavior_tree_finished"):
		if not npc.bt_player.behavior_tree_finished.is_connected(_on_bt_finished):
			npc.bt_player.behavior_tree_finished.connect(_on_bt_finished)


func _disconnect_bt_finished_signal() -> void:
	if npc.bt_player.has_signal("updated") and npc.bt_player.updated.is_connected(_on_bt_finished):
		npc.bt_player.updated.disconnect(_on_bt_finished)
	if npc.bt_player.has_signal("behavior_tree_finished") and npc.bt_player.behavior_tree_finished.is_connected(_on_bt_finished):
		npc.bt_player.behavior_tree_finished.disconnect(_on_bt_finished)


@tool
extends BTAction
class_name BTAdvancePatrolIndex

func _tick(_delta: float) -> Status:
	var points = agent.get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("patrol_point")
	if points.is_empty():
		return FAILURE
	
	var index = blackboard.get_var("patrol_index", 0)
	index = (index + 1) % points.size()
	blackboard.set_var("patrol_index", index)
	
	return SUCCESS


# res://ai/actions/bt_attack.gd
@tool
extends BTAction
class_name BTAttack

## Maximum distance from which the agent can attack.
## Should be slightly larger than BTMoveToTarget's arrive_dist.
@export var attack_range: float = 6.0

## Time between consecutive attacks.
@export var attack_cooldown: float = 0.5

@export var turn_speed: float = 10.0


func _enter() -> void:
	# Initialize attack cooldown timer on the blackboard
	blackboard.set_var("attack_cooldown_timer", 0.0)


func _tick(delta: float) -> Status:
	var character: CharacterBody3D = agent as CharacterBody3D
	var target_pos = blackboard.get_var("target_pos", Vector3.ZERO)

	var dist = character.global_position.distance_to(target_pos)
	
	# If target moves out of attack range, fail this action so the behavior tree 
	# returns to chasing (MoveToTarget).
	if dist > attack_range:
		return FAILURE

	# Attack cooldown stored in blackboard to persist across ticks
	var timer = blackboard.get_var("attack_cooldown_timer", 0.0)
	timer -= delta

	if timer <= 0.0:
		timer = attack_cooldown
		print("【Combat】💥 Attacking player! Distance: %.1f" % dist)

	blackboard.set_var("attack_cooldown_timer", timer)

	# Continuously face the target while attacking
	var direction = character.global_position.direction_to(target_pos)
	direction.y = 0.0
	direction = direction.normalized()
	
	if direction != Vector3.ZERO:
		var look_target = character.global_position + direction
		var target_transform = character.transform.looking_at(look_target, Vector3.UP)
		character.transform = character.transform.interpolate_with(target_transform, turn_speed * delta)

	# Keep running to maintain control while target is in range
	return RUNNING


@tool
extends BTCondition
class_name BTCheckForThreat

func _tick(_delta: float) -> Status:
	var vision = agent.get_node_or_null("VisionComponent")
	if not vision:
		return FAILURE
	
	if vision.can_see_player:
		blackboard.set_var("current_state", &"Alert")
		blackboard.set_var("target_pos", vision.last_seen_position)
		return SUCCESS
	
	blackboard.set_var("current_state", &"Patrolling")
	return FAILURE


# res://ai/tasks/bt_find_search_location.gd
@tool
extends BTAction
class_name BTFindSearchLocation

@export_group("Sampling")
@export var sample_count: int = 90
@export var sample_radius: float = 24.0
@export var min_distance_from_npc: float = 6.0
@export var nav_snap_tolerance: float = 1.5

@export_group("Collision Layers")
@export_flags_3d_physics var wall_layer: int = 1
@export_flags_3d_physics var player_layer: int = 2
@export_flags_3d_physics var npc_layer: int = 4

@export_group("Scoring Weights")
@export var w_enclosure: float      = 35.0
@export var w_corner: float         = 25.0
@export var w_ideal_distance: float = 20.0
@export var w_progress: float       = 32.0
@export var w_memory_penalty: float = 40.0
@export var ideal_distance_range: Vector2 = Vector2(7.0, 16.0)

@export_group("Enclosure")
@export var enclosure_rays: int         = 16
@export var enclosure_ray_length: float = 8.0
@export var corner_rays: int            = 16

@export_group("Memory")
@export var max_visited: int        = 16
@export var max_directions: int     = 8
@export var visited_radius: float   = 7.0
@export var decay_half_life: float  = 25.0
@export var min_record_displacement: float = 2.0

@export_group("Debug")
@export var show_debug: bool      = true
@export var debug_duration: float = 8.0
@export var debug_top_n: int      = 5
@export var debug_show_history: bool = true


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  ExplorationMemory
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
## Stores and retrieves the AI's recent search history to guide future exploration.
class ExplorationMemory:
	var visited:           Array[Vector3] = []
	var visit_times:       Array[float]   = []
	var direction_history: Array[Vector3] = []

	var _visited_radius:          float = 7.0
	var _max_visited:             int   = 16
	var _max_directions:          int   = 8
	var _decay_half_life:         float = 25.0
	var _min_record_displacement: float = 2.0

	## Returns the preferred direction for continued exploration.
	## This is a heuristic that encourages the AI to move away from its recent path (anti-momentum),
	## preventing it from getting stuck in loops. It's a bias for scoring, not a final destination.
	func get_exploration_direction() -> Vector3:
		var raw_momentum := _get_raw_momentum_direction()
		return -raw_momentum

	## Calculates the recent movement momentum.
	## Uses a squared weight to give more emphasis to the most recent directions.
	func _get_raw_momentum_direction() -> Vector3:
		if direction_history.is_empty():
			return Vector3.ZERO
			
		var weighted := Vector3.ZERO
		var total := 0.0
		for i in direction_history.size():
			var w := float(i + 1) * float(i + 1)
			weighted += direction_history[i] * w
			total += w
			
		if total < 0.001:
			return Vector3.ZERO
			
		var result := weighted / total
		result.y = 0.0
		return result.normalized() if result.length() > 0.001 else Vector3.ZERO

	## Calculates a penalty for positions near recently visited spots.
	## The penalty is stronger for closer proximity and fades over time based on a half-life decay.
	func get_visit_penalty(pos: Vector3, penalty_weight: float) -> float:
		var penalty := 0.0
		var now := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
		for i in visited.size():
			var dist := pos.distance_to(visited[i])
			if dist < _visited_radius:
				var proximity := (_visited_radius - dist) / _visited_radius
				var age := now - visit_times[i]
				var time_decay := pow(0.5, age / _decay_half_life)
				penalty += proximity * penalty_weight * time_decay
		return penalty

	func record_destination(dest_pos: Vector3, npc_pos_at_selection: Vector3) -> void:
		var intent := dest_pos - npc_pos_at_selection
		intent.y = 0.0
		if intent.length() > _min_record_displacement:
			direction_history.append(intent.normalized())
			if direction_history.size() > _max_directions:
				direction_history = direction_history.slice(-_max_directions)

		visited.append(dest_pos)
		visit_times.append(Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0)
		if visited.size() > _max_visited:
			visited = visited.slice(-_max_visited)
			visit_times = visit_times.slice(-_max_visited)

	func to_blackboard(bb: Blackboard) -> void:
		bb.set_var("searched_locations", visited)
		bb.set_var("search_dir_history", direction_history)
		bb.set_var("search_visit_times", visit_times)

	static func from_blackboard(
			bb:        Blackboard,
			radius:    float = 7.0,
			max_vis:   int   = 16,
			max_dirs:  int   = 8,
			half_life: float = 25.0,
			min_disp:  float = 2.0) -> ExplorationMemory:

		var m := ExplorationMemory.new()
		m._visited_radius          = radius
		m._max_visited             = max_vis
		m._max_directions          = max_dirs
		m._decay_half_life         = half_life
		m._min_record_displacement = min_disp

		for v in bb.get_var("searched_locations", []):
			if v is Vector3: m.visited.append(v)
		for d in bb.get_var("search_dir_history", []):
			if d is Vector3: m.direction_history.append(d)
		for t in bb.get_var("search_visit_times", []):
			if t is float: m.visit_times.append(t)
		
		# Ensure visit_times array is not out of sync if loading old data.
		while m.visit_times.size() < m.visited.size():
			m.visit_times.append(0.0)

		return m


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  Per-tick state
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var _space_state: PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D
var _nav_map:     RID
var _npc_pos:     Vector3
var _ray_mask:    int

var _debug_dir_sample_count: int = 0


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  _tick
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _tick(_delta: float) -> int:
	var character := agent as CharacterBody3D
	if not is_instance_valid(character):
		return FAILURE

	_space_state = character.get_world_3d().direct_space_state
	_nav_map     = character.get_world_3d().navigation_map
	_npc_pos     = character.global_position
	_ray_mask    = wall_layer

	var memory := ExplorationMemory.from_blackboard(
		blackboard,
		visited_radius,
		max_visited,
		max_directions,
		decay_half_life,
		min_record_displacement)

	var explore_dir: Vector3 = memory.get_exploration_direction()
	_debug_dir_sample_count = memory.direction_history.size()

	var candidates := _generate_samples()
	if candidates.is_empty():
		memory.to_blackboard(blackboard)
		return FAILURE

	_score_candidates(candidates, explore_dir, memory)
	candidates.sort_custom(func(a, b): return a.score > b.score)

	var best: Dictionary = candidates[0]

	blackboard.set_var("target_pos", best.pos)

	memory.record_destination(best.pos, _npc_pos)
	memory.to_blackboard(blackboard)

	if show_debug:
		_draw_debug(candidates, best, explore_dir, memory)

	return SUCCESS


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  Sampling / Scoring / Enclosure / Corner / Sub-score
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## Generates candidate points in three concentric rings around the NPC
## to ensure a good distribution of samples at various distances.
## The remainder of the sample count is added to the last ring to ensure the total is always met.
func _generate_samples() -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var samples: Array[Dictionary] = []
	
	# Calculate the base number of samples for the first two rings.
	# Integer division is intentional here.
	@warning_ignore("integer_division")
	var ring_1_count := sample_count / 3
	@warning_ignore("integer_division")
	var ring_2_count := sample_count / 3
	# The last ring gets the remainder to ensure the total count is accurate.
	var ring_3_count := sample_count - (ring_1_count + ring_2_count)

	var ring_definitions := [
		{"min": min_distance_from_npc, "max": sample_radius * 0.4,  "count": ring_1_count},
		{"min": sample_radius * 0.4,   "max": sample_radius * 0.75, "count": ring_2_count},
		{"min": sample_radius * 0.75,  "max": sample_radius,        "count": ring_3_count},
	]

	for ring_def in ring_definitions:
		var r_min: float = ring_def.min
		var r_max: float = ring_def.max
		var target_count: int = ring_def.count
		
		if target_count == 0:
			continue

		var got := 0
		var tries := 0
		# Increase max_tries to ensure we find points even in difficult geometry.
		var max_tries := target_count * 10 

		while got < target_count and tries < max_tries:
			tries += 1
			var angle := randf() * TAU
			var dist := r_min + randf() * (r_max - r_min)
			var world_pt := _npc_pos + Vector3(cos(angle) * dist, 0.0, sin(angle) * dist)
			var nav_pt := NavigationServer3D.map_get_closest_point(_nav_map, world_pt)

			if world_pt.distance_to(nav_pt) > nav_snap_tolerance:
				continue
			var actual_dist := _npc_pos.distance_to(nav_pt)
			if actual_dist < min_distance_from_npc or actual_dist > sample_radius:
				continue

			samples.append({
				"pos": nav_pt, "score": 0.0, "enclosure": 0.0, "is_corner": false,
				"distance": actual_dist, "s_enc": 0.0, "s_cor": 0.0, "s_dst": 0.0,
				"s_prg": 0.0, "s_pen": 0.0, "raw_pen": 0.0
			})
			got += 1
	return samples

func _score_candidates(candidates: Array[Dictionary], explore_dir: Vector3, memory: ExplorationMemory) -> void:
	for c in candidates:
		c.enclosure = _calculate_enclosure(c.pos)
		c.is_corner = _is_corner(c.pos)
		c.raw_pen   = memory.get_visit_penalty(c.pos, 1.0)
		c.s_enc     = c.enclosure
		c.s_cor     = 1.0 if c.is_corner else 0.0
		c.s_dst     = _distance_score(c.distance)
		c.s_prg     = (_progress_score(c.pos, explore_dir) + 1.0) / 2.0

	var max_pen := 0.0
	for c in candidates:
		if c.raw_pen > max_pen: max_pen = c.raw_pen
	var pen_norm := max_pen if max_pen > 0.001 else 1.0

	for c in candidates:
		# Normalize penalty so its weight has a consistent effect regardless of absolute values.
		c.s_pen = c.raw_pen / pen_norm
		c.score = (
			  c.s_enc * w_enclosure
			+ c.s_cor * w_corner
			+ c.s_dst * w_ideal_distance
			+ c.s_prg * w_progress
			- c.s_pen * w_memory_penalty
		)

## Calculates how "enclosed" a point is by casting rays outwards.
func _calculate_enclosure(pos: Vector3) -> float:
	var origin := pos + Vector3.UP * 0.6
	var distances: Array[float] = []
	var params := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.new()
	params.collision_mask = _ray_mask
	params.exclude = [agent.get_rid()]

	for i in enclosure_rays:
		var angle := float(i) * TAU / enclosure_rays
		params.from = origin
		params.to = origin + Vector3(cos(angle), 0.0, sin(angle)) * enclosure_ray_length
		var hit = _space_state.intersect_ray(params)
		distances.append(hit.position.distance_to(origin) if not hit.is_empty() else enclosure_ray_length)

	var avg := 0.0
	for d in distances: avg += d
	avg /= enclosure_rays

	var enclosure_ratio := clampf(1.0 - avg / enclosure_ray_length, 0.0, 1.0)
	var variance := 0.0
	for d in distances:
		variance += (d - avg) * (d - avg)
	variance /= enclosure_rays

	var max_variance := (enclosure_ray_length * 0.5) * (enclosure_ray_length * 0.5)
	var uniformity := clampf(1.0 - variance / max_variance, 0.0, 1.0)
	
	# The final score favors both high enclosure (small spaces) and high uniformity
	# (evenly spaced walls), preventing long, narrow corridors from scoring as highly
	# as a small, squarish room.
	return clampf(enclosure_ratio * (0.6 + 0.4 * uniformity), 0.0, 1.0)

## Detects if a point is in a corner.
## It works by raycasting in a circle and looking for two distinct,
## roughly perpendicular segments of wall hits.
func _is_corner(pos: Vector3) -> bool:
	var origin := pos + Vector3.UP * 0.6
	var ray_len := 5.0
	var flags: Array[bool] = []
	var params := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.new()
	params.collision_mask = _ray_mask
	params.exclude = [agent.get_rid()]

	for i in corner_rays:
		var angle := float(i) * TAU / corner_rays
		params.from = origin
		params.to = origin + Vector3(cos(angle), 0.0, sin(angle)) * ray_len
		flags.append(not _space_state.intersect_ray(params).is_empty())

	var segments := _find_hit_segments(flags)
	if segments.size() < 2: return false

	for i in segments.size():
		for j in range(i + 1, segments.size()):
			var ca := _segment_center_angle(segments[i], corner_rays)
			var cb := _segment_center_angle(segments[j], corner_rays)
			var diff := absf(ca - cb)
			# Get the shortest angle difference on a circle (e.g., 270 deg is 90 deg the other way).
			if diff > PI: diff = TAU - diff
			# Check if the angle between wall segments is approximately 90 degrees.
			if diff > deg_to_rad(70.0) and diff < deg_to_rad(110.0):
				return true
	return false

## Given a circular array of boolean raycast hit flags, finds contiguous segments of 'true' values.
## This is used to identify continuous wall surfaces from the raycast results. Handles wraparound.
func _find_hit_segments(flags: Array[bool]) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var segments: Array[Dictionary] = []
	var n := flags.size()
	var start := 0
	for k in n:
		if not flags[k]:
			start = k
			break
	var i := 0
	while i < n:
		var idx := (start + i) % n
		if flags[idx]:
			var length := 0
			while length < n and flags[(start + i + length) % n]:
				length += 1
			if length >= 2:
				segments.append({"start_idx": idx, "length": length})
			i += length
		else:
			i += 1
	return segments

func _segment_center_angle(segment: Dictionary, total: int) -> float:
	var start_idx: int = segment.start_idx
	var half_len: float = float(segment.length) * 0.5
	return fmod(float(start_idx) + half_len, float(total)) / float(total) * TAU

## Scores how ideal a candidate's distance is from the NPC.
## The score peaks in the middle of the ideal_distance_range and falls off towards
## the edges, using a sine curve for a smooth transition.
func _distance_score(dist: float) -> float:
	if dist < ideal_distance_range.x: return 0.4
	if dist > ideal_distance_range.y: return 0.5
	var t := (dist - ideal_distance_range.x) / (ideal_distance_range.y - ideal_distance_range.x)
	return lerpf(0.4, 1.0, sin(t * PI))

## Scores how well a candidate's direction aligns with the preferred exploration direction.
func _progress_score(pos: Vector3, explore_dir: Vector3) -> float:
	if explore_dir.length() < 0.1:
		return 0.5 # Neutral score if there's no exploration bias.
	return clampf((pos - _npc_pos).normalized().dot(explore_dir), -1.0, 1.0)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  Debug drawing
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _draw_debug(candidates: Array[Dictionary], best: Dictionary, explore_dir: Vector3, memory: ExplorationMemory) -> void:
	var top_others: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for c in candidates:
		if not (c.pos as Vector3).is_equal_approx(best.pos as Vector3):
			top_others.append(c)
		if top_others.size() >= debug_top_n:
			break

	# Candidate points
	for c in candidates:
		var pos: Vector3 = c.pos
		var is_best: bool = pos.is_equal_approx(best.pos as Vector3)
		var col: Color
		var radius: float

		if is_best:
			col = Color(0.0, 1.0, 0.2); radius = 0.45
		elif c.is_corner and c.enclosure > 0.5:
			col = Color(1.0, 0.3, 1.0); radius = 0.32
		elif c.is_corner:
			col = Color(0.9, 0.5, 1.0); radius = 0.28
		elif c.enclosure > 0.65:
			col = Color(0.0, 0.85, 1.0); radius = 0.28
		elif c.enclosure > 0.35:
			col = Color(0.4, 0.6, 1.0); radius = 0.22
		else:
			col = Color(0.45, 0.45, 0.45); radius = 0.16

		DebugDraw3D.draw_sphere(pos + Vector3.UP * 0.05, radius, col, debug_duration)

	# Candidate score labels
	for c in top_others:
		var pos: Vector3 = c.pos
		var label := "sc:%.1f enc:%.2f cor:%s\nprg:%.2f pen:%.2f" % [
			c.score, c.s_enc, "Y" if c.is_corner else "N", c.s_prg, c.s_pen
		]
		DebugDraw3D.draw_text(pos + Vector3.UP * 0.75, label, 12, Color(0.9, 0.9, 0.7), debug_duration)

	# Best point
	var best_pos: Vector3 = best.pos
	DebugDraw3D.draw_text(best_pos + Vector3.UP * 1.6, "★ BEST", 16, Color(0.0, 1.0, 0.3), debug_duration)
	DebugDraw3D.draw_line(_npc_pos + Vector3.UP * 1.0, best_pos + Vector3.UP * 0.2, Color(0.0, 1.0, 0.3), debug_duration)

	# Direction history
	var history_colors: Array[Color] = [
		Color(0.65, 0.25, 1.0),  # Purple
		Color(0.2, 0.5, 1.0),    # Blue
		Color(0.0, 0.85, 0.9),   # Cyan
		Color(0.15, 0.85, 0.3),  # Green
		Color(0.95, 0.85, 0.1),  # Yellow
		Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.0),   # Orange
		Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.65)   # Pink
	]

	if debug_show_history and not memory.direction_history.is_empty():
		for i in memory.direction_history.size():
			var dir := memory.direction_history[i]
			var color: Color = history_colors[i % history_colors.size()]
			var start_pos := _npc_pos + Vector3.UP * (2.4 + float(i) * 0.2)
			var end_pos := start_pos + dir * 4.2
			
			DebugDraw3D.draw_arrow(start_pos, end_pos, color, 0.18, true, debug_duration)
			DebugDraw3D.draw_text(end_pos + Vector3.UP * 0.25, "H%d" % i, 14, color.lightened(0.3), debug_duration)

	# Exploration bias direction
	if explore_dir.length() > 0.1:
		var arrow_start := _npc_pos + Vector3.UP * 1.4
		var arrow_end   := arrow_start + explore_dir * 5.0
		DebugDraw3D.draw_arrow(arrow_start, arrow_end, Color(1.0, 0.92, 0.0), 0.65, true, debug_duration)
		DebugDraw3D.draw_text(arrow_end + Vector3.UP * 0.55, "Exploration Bias", 15, Color(1.0, 0.92, 0.0), debug_duration)

	# Legend
	var legend := _npc_pos + Vector3.UP * 6.2
	DebugDraw3D.draw_text(legend, "── BTFindSearchLocation Debug ──", 16, Color.WHITE, debug_duration)
	DebugDraw3D.draw_text(legend + Vector3.DOWN * 0.45, "★ Bright Green = Best Position", 14, Color(0.0, 1.0, 0.25), debug_duration)
	DebugDraw3D.draw_text(legend + Vector3.DOWN * 0.9,  "→ Yellow Arrow = Exploration Bias (direction preference)", 14, Color(1.0, 0.92, 0.0), debug_duration)
	DebugDraw3D.draw_text(legend + Vector3.DOWN * 1.35, "H0 H1 H2... = History Directions (H0 = oldest)", 14, Color(0.85, 0.85, 0.85), debug_duration)
	DebugDraw3D.draw_text(legend + Vector3.DOWN * 1.8,  "Colored Spheres = Candidate Points", 14, Color(0.7, 0.7, 0.7), debug_duration)


# res://ai/tasks/bt_look_around.gd
@tool
class_name BtLookAround
extends BTAction

## Duration of the scanning behavior when target is lost.
@export var scan_duration: float = 2.0

var _timer: float = 0.0
var _start_rotation: Quaternion


func _enter() -> void:
	_timer = scan_duration
	_start_rotation = agent.global_transform.basis.get_rotation_quaternion()
	print("【Search】Target lost. Scanning environment...")


func _tick(delta: float) -> Status:
	_timer -= delta
	if _timer <= 0:
		print("【Search】Scan complete.")
		return SUCCESS

	var npc: NPC = agent as NPC
	
	# Simulate realistic left-right scanning using sine wave
	var angle_offset = sin(_timer * PI * 2) * 1.5
	var target_quat = _start_rotation * Quaternion(Vector3.UP, angle_offset)
	
	npc.global_transform.basis = Basis(
		npc.global_transform.basis.get_rotation_quaternion().slerp(target_quat, 5.0 * delta)
	)
	
	return RUNNING


# res://ai/actions/bt_move_to_target.gd
@tool
extends BTAction
class_name BTMoveToTarget

@export var move_speed: float = 3.5
@export var turn_speed: float = 8.0

## Enable if the target can move (e.g. player). 
## Significantly reduces path recalculation jitter.
@export var dynamic_target: bool = false

## Distance threshold to consider the agent has reached the target.
## Prevents jittering when very close to the destination.
@export var arrive_dist: float = 1.0

var nav_agent: NavigationAgent3D
var character: CharacterBody3D


func _setup() -> void:
	character = agent as CharacterBody3D
	nav_agent = character.get_node("NavigationAgent3D")


func _enter() -> void:
	blackboard.set_var("patrol_action_state", "moving")
	nav_agent.target_position = blackboard.get_var("target_pos", Vector3.ZERO)


func _exit() -> void:
	blackboard.set_var("patrol_action_state", "idle")


func _tick(delta: float) -> Status:
	var target_pos = blackboard.get_var("target_pos", Vector3.ZERO)

	# Only update target position when it has moved significantly.
	# Critical for preventing constant path recalculation and jitter on dynamic targets.
	if dynamic_target and nav_agent.target_position.distance_squared_to(target_pos) > 0.25:
		nav_agent.target_position = target_pos

	var dist_to_target = character.global_position.distance_to(target_pos)

	# Success: either navigation is finished (static target) 
	# or agent is close enough to a moving target.
	if nav_agent.is_navigation_finished() or (dynamic_target and dist_to_target <= arrive_dist):
		character.velocity.x = 0.0
		character.velocity.z = 0.0
		return SUCCESS

	# Apply gravity
	if not character.is_on_floor():
		character.velocity.y -= 9.8 * delta

	var next_path_pos = nav_agent.get_next_path_position()
	var direction = character.global_position.direction_to(next_path_pos)
	direction.y = 0.0
	direction = direction.normalized()

	# Slow down when pushing against rigid bodies
	var current_speed = move_speed
	if _has_rigidbody_collision():
		current_speed = move_speed * 0.3

	character.velocity.x = direction.x * current_speed
	character.velocity.z = direction.z * current_speed

	# Smooth turning
	if direction != Vector3.ZERO:
		var look_target = character.global_position + direction
		if character.global_position.distance_squared_to(look_target) > 0.001:
			var target_transform = character.transform.looking_at(look_target, Vector3.UP)
			character.transform = character.transform.interpolate_with(target_transform, turn_speed * delta)

	character.move_and_slide()

	# Clamp upward velocity to prevent launching
	if character.velocity.y > 3.0:
		character.velocity.y = 3.0

	# Debug visuals (runtime only)
	if not Engine.is_editor_hint():
		DebugDraw3D.draw_sphere(target_pos, 0.5, Color.GREEN)
		var path = nav_agent.get_current_navigation_path()
		if path.size() > 1:
			for i in range(path.size() - 1):
				DebugDraw3D.draw_line(path[i], path[i + 1], Color.RED)

	return RUNNING


## Returns true if currently colliding with any RigidBody3D
func _has_rigidbody_collision() -> bool:
	for i in character.get_slide_collision_count():
		if character.get_slide_collision(i).get_collider() is RigidBody3D:
			return true
	return false


# res://ai/actions/bt_select_patrol_point.gd
@tool
extends BTAction
class_name BTSelectPatrolPoint

## Selects the next patrol point for the agent.
## On first execution, starts from the closest point; then follows a consistent looping route.
func _tick(_delta: float) -> Status:
	var points = agent.get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("patrol_point")
	if points.is_empty():
		push_error("No nodes found in the 'patrol_point' group!")
		return FAILURE
	
	# Sort by name to ensure consistent patrol order
	points.sort_custom(func(a, b): return str(a.name).naturalnocasecmp_to(str(b.name)) < 0)
	
	var index = blackboard.get_var("patrol_index", -1)
	
	# First run: start from the nearest patrol point
	if index == -1:
		var closest_dist = INF
		var closest_index = 0
		var npc_pos = agent.global_position
		
		for i in points.size():
			var dist = npc_pos.distance_to(points[i].global_position)
			if dist < closest_dist:
				closest_dist = dist
				closest_index = i
		
		index = closest_index
		print("[Patrol Init] Starting from the nearest point: WP ", index + 1)
	
	# Wrap index to make the patrol loop
	index = wrapi(index, 0, points.size())
	
	blackboard.set_var("patrol_index", index)
	blackboard.set_var("current_state", &"Patrolling") # StringName for performance
	blackboard.set_var("target_pos", points[index].global_position)
	
	return SUCCESS

# res://ai/character/npc.gd
extends CharacterBody3D
class_name NPC

## AI character that combines Behavior Tree and Hierarchical State Machine (LimboHSM)
## to handle patrolling, player detection and pursuit.

@onready var bt_player: BTPlayer = $BTPlayer
@onready var nav_agent: NavigationAgent3D = $NavigationAgent3D
@onready var vision: VisionComponent = $VisionComponent
@onready var state_machine: LimboHSM = $StateMachine


const MAX_UPWARD_VELOCITY: float = 2.0
const MOVE_SPEED: float = 3.5


func _ready() -> void:
	nav_agent.avoidance_enabled = true
	nav_agent.radius = 0.6
	nav_agent.avoidance_layers = 1
	nav_agent.avoidance_mask = 1
	nav_agent.keep_y_velocity = false
	nav_agent.velocity_computed.connect(_on_velocity_computed)
	
	bt_player.blackboard.set_var("patrol_index", -1)

	# LimboHSM requires this specific initialization order:
	# 1. Set initial state 2. Initialize (calls _setup on all states) 3. Activate
	state_machine.set_initial_state($StateMachine/Patrol)
	state_machine.initialize(self)
	state_machine.set_active(true)


func _on_velocity_computed(safe_velocity: Vector3) -> void:
	velocity.x = safe_velocity.x
	velocity.z = safe_velocity.z


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	_draw_waypoint_labels()
	_draw_status()


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	# LimboHSM is set to PHYSICS update mode and updates itself automatically.
	if not is_on_floor():
		velocity.y -= 9.8 * delta

	# Push away from rigid bodies when stuck
	var is_stuck = false
	for i in get_slide_collision_count():
		var collision = get_slide_collision(i)
		var collider = collision.get_collider()
		
		if collider is RigidBody3D:
			is_stuck = true
			var push_dir = -collision.get_normal()
			push_dir.y = 0.0
			
			if push_dir.length_squared() < 0.001:
				push_dir = Vector3(randf_range(-1, 1), 0, randf_range(-1, 1)).normalized()
			
			var hit_offset = collision.get_position() - collider.global_position
			collider.apply_impulse(push_dir * 3.0, hit_offset)

	if is_stuck and velocity.length() < 0.2:
		velocity.x += randf_range(-2.0, 2.0)
		velocity.z += randf_range(-2.0, 2.0)

	move_and_slide()

	if velocity.y > MAX_UPWARD_VELOCITY:
		velocity.y = MAX_UPWARD_VELOCITY


func _draw_waypoint_labels() -> void:
	var points = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("patrol_point")
	points.sort_custom(func(a, b): return str(a.name).naturalnocasecmp_to(str(b.name)) < 0)
	
	for i in points.size():
		var wp_pos = points[i].global_position + Vector3(0, 1.0, 0)
		DebugDraw3D.draw_text(wp_pos, "WP " + str(i + 1), 22, Color.WHITE)


func _draw_status() -> void:
	var head_pos = global_position + Vector3(0, 2.3, 0)
	var state = bt_player.blackboard.get_var("current_state", &"Idle")
	var index = bt_player.blackboard.get_var("patrol_index", -1)
	
	var action_text := ""
	var color := Color.WHITE
	
	match state:
		&"Alert":
			action_text = "!!! PLAYER DETECTED !!!"
			color = Color.RED
			
		&"Searching":
			action_text = "Searching for player..."
			color = Color.ORANGE
			
		&"Patrolling":
			color = Color.AQUA
			var action_state = bt_player.blackboard.get_var("patrol_action_state", "idle")
			
			match action_state:
				"moving":
					action_text = "Moving to WP " + str(index + 1)
				"waiting":
					action_text = "Waiting at WP " + str(index + 1)
				_:
					action_text = "Finding nearest WP..." if index == -1 else "At WP " + str(index + 1)
					
		_:
			action_text = "State: Idle"
			color = Color.GRAY

	var display_text = "[State: %s]\n%s" % [state, action_text]
	DebugDraw3D.draw_text(head_pos, display_text, 32, color)


# res://character/vision_component.gd
@tool
class_name VisionComponent
extends Node3D

@export_group("Cylinder Vision Parameters")
@export var view_radius: float = 30.0
@export_range(0, 180) var view_angle: float = 65.0
@export var view_height: float = 4.0
@export var view_depth: float = 2.0
@export var check_interval: float = 0.25

@export_group("Raycast Settings")
@export var eye_offset_y: float = 0.8
@export var target_offset_y: float = 0.8
@export_flags_3d_physics var collision_mask: int = (1 << 0) | (1 << 1)

var can_see_player: bool = false
var last_seen_position: Vector3 = Vector3.ZERO

var _timer: float = 0.0

@onready var npc: CharacterBody3D = owner as CharacterBody3D


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if Engine.is_editor_hint():
		return

	_timer += delta
	if _timer >= check_interval:
		_timer = 0.0
		_check_vision_cylinder()


func _check_vision_cylinder() -> void:
	var player = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player")
	if not is_instance_valid(player):
		can_see_player = false
		return

	var origin = global_position
	var target = player.global_position

	var height_diff = target.y - origin.y
	if height_diff > view_height or height_diff < -view_depth:
		can_see_player = false
		return

	# Ignore vertical axis for radius and angle checks
	var to_target_xz = Vector2(target.x - origin.x, target.z - origin.z)
	if to_target_xz.length() > view_radius:
		can_see_player = false
		return

	var forward_xz = Vector2(-global_transform.basis.z.x, -global_transform.basis.z.z).normalized()
	if abs(forward_xz.angle_to(to_target_xz.normalized())) > deg_to_rad(view_angle / 2.0):
		can_see_player = false
		return

	var ray_origin = origin + Vector3(0, eye_offset_y, 0)
	var ray_target = target + Vector3(0, target_offset_y, 0)

	var query = PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(ray_origin, ray_target, collision_mask)

	if is_instance_valid(npc):
		query.exclude = [npc.get_rid()]

	var result = get_world_3d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(query)

	if result and (result.collider == player or result.collider.is_in_group("player")):
		can_see_player = true
		last_seen_position = target
		_draw_debug(ray_origin, result.position, Color.GREEN)
	else:
		can_see_player = false
		_draw_debug(ray_origin, result.position if result else ray_target, Color.RED)


func _draw_debug(start: Vector3, end: Vector3, color: Color) -> void:
	if Engine.is_editor_hint():
		return

	DebugDraw3D.draw_line(start, end, color)
	# Use yellow for blocked hits to distinguish from a clean miss
	DebugDraw3D.draw_sphere(end, 0.2, color if color == Color.GREEN else Color.YELLOW)


# res://character/vision_debug_draw_3d.gd
@tool
class_name VisionDraw3D
extends MeshInstance3D

@export var vision_component: VisionComponent
@export var resolution: int = 30

@export_group("Draw Settings")
@export var draw_ray_height: float = 1.0 

@export_group("Colors")
@export var color_clear: Color = Color(0.2, 1.0, 0.2, 0.1)
@export var color_wall: Color = Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.2, 0.3)
@export var color_alert: Color = Color(1.0, 0.1, 0.1, 0.6)


var mesh_material := StandardMaterial3D.new()


func _ready() -> void:
	mesh_material.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	mesh_material.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	mesh_material.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	mesh_material.vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true
	material_override = mesh_material


# Using _process instead of _physics_process for smoother updates in the editor.
func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree() or not is_instance_valid(vision_component):
		return
		
	_update_draw_mesh()


func _update_draw_mesh() -> void:
	var world = get_world_3d()
	if not world:
		return
		
	var space = world.direct_space_state
	if not space:
		return

	var origin = global_position
	var forward_3d = -global_transform.basis.z
	var forward_flat = Vector3(forward_3d.x, 0, forward_3d.z).normalized()
	
	var max_dist = vision_component.view_radius
	var v_height = vision_component.view_height
	var v_depth = vision_component.view_depth
	var angle_rad = deg_to_rad(vision_component.view_angle)
	
	var mask = (1 << 0)
	var start_angle = -angle_rad / 2.0
	var step = angle_rad / float(resolution)
	
	var pts_top: Array[Vector3] = []
	var pts_bot: Array[Vector3] = []
	var colors_edge: Array[Color] = []
	
	for i in range(resolution + 1):
		var current_angle = start_angle + i * step
		var dir_global_flat = forward_flat.rotated(Vector3.UP, current_angle)
		
		var ray_origin = origin + Vector3(0, draw_ray_height, 0)
		var ray_target = ray_origin + dir_global_flat * max_dist
		
		var query = PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(ray_origin, ray_target, mask)
		
		# Exclude the NPC itself from ray casts.
		if is_instance_valid(vision_component.npc):
			query.exclude = [vision_component.npc.get_rid()]
			
		var result = space.intersect_ray(query)
		
		var hit_dist = max_dist
		var point_color = color_clear
		
		if result:
			var hit_flat = Vector2(result.position.x, result.position.z)
			var ori_flat = Vector2(ray_origin.x, ray_origin.z)
			hit_dist = ori_flat.distance_to(hit_flat)
			point_color = color_wall
			
		var edge_global_pos = origin + dir_global_flat * hit_dist
		var pt_global_top = edge_global_pos + Vector3(0, v_height, 0)
		var pt_global_bot = edge_global_pos + Vector3(0, -v_depth, 0)
		
		pts_top.append(to_local(pt_global_top))
		pts_bot.append(to_local(pt_global_bot))
		colors_edge.append(point_color)

	var st = SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	
	var center_top = to_local(origin + Vector3(0, v_height, 0))
	var center_bot = to_local(origin + Vector3(0, -v_depth, 0))
	
	var is_alert = vision_component.can_see_player
	var c_center = color_alert if is_alert else color_clear

	for i in range(resolution):
		var c1 = color_alert if is_alert else colors_edge[i]
		var c2 = color_alert if is_alert else colors_edge[i + 1]
		
		_add_tri(st, center_top, pts_top[i], pts_top[i + 1], c_center, c1, c2)
		_add_tri(st, center_bot, pts_bot[i + 1], pts_bot[i], c_center, c2, c1)
		_add_quad(st, pts_top[i], pts_bot[i], pts_bot[i + 1], pts_top[i + 1], c1, c1, c2, c2)

	var c_left = color_alert if is_alert else colors_edge[0]
	_add_quad(st, center_top, center_bot, pts_bot[0], pts_top[0], c_center, c_center, c_left, c_left)

	var c_right = color_alert if is_alert else colors_edge[resolution]
	_add_quad(st, center_top, pts_top[resolution], pts_bot[resolution], center_bot, c_center, c_right, c_right, c_center)

	mesh = st.commit()


# Helper functions for procedural mesh generation
func _add_tri(st: SurfaceTool, v1: Vector3, v2: Vector3, v3: Vector3, c1: Color, c2: Color, c3: Color) -> void:
	st.set_normal(Vector3.UP)
	st.set_color(c1); st.add_vertex(v1)
	st.set_color(c2); st.add_vertex(v2)
	st.set_color(c3); st.add_vertex(v3)


func _add_quad(st: SurfaceTool, v1: Vector3, v2: Vector3, v3: Vector3, v4: Vector3, c1: Color, c2: Color, c3: Color, c4: Color) -> void:
	_add_tri(st, v1, v2, v3, c1, c2, c3)
	_add_tri(st, v1, v3, v4, c1, c3, c4)


## A dynamic runtime obstacle that automatically carves into the NavigationRegion3D
## and triggers asynchronous rebaking of the navigation mesh.
@tool
extends NavigationObstacle3D
class_name RuntimeObstacle

@export var size: Vector3 = Vector3(4, 3, 4)
@export var extra_margin: float = 0.3
@export var bake_delay: float = 0.2
@export var debug_draw: bool = true

func _ready() -> void:
	height = size.y + 1.2
	affect_navigation_mesh = true
	carve_navigation_mesh = true
	avoidance_enabled = true
	
	_create_vertices()
	
	# Delay baking to prevent initialization failures during the ready phase.
	var timer = Timer.new()
	timer.wait_time = bake_delay
	timer.one_shot = true
	timer.timeout.connect(_bake_now)
	add_child(timer)
	timer.start()

	print("RuntimeObstacle created | Position: ", global_position, " | Size: ", size)

func _create_vertices() -> void:
	var half = (size * 0.5) + Vector3(extra_margin, 0, extra_margin)
	vertices = PackedVector3Array([
		Vector3(-half.x, 0, -half.z),
		Vector3( half.x, 0, -half.z),
		Vector3( half.x, 0,  half.z),
		Vector3(-half.x, 0,  half.z)
	])

func _bake_now() -> void:
	var nav_region = _find_navigation_region()
	if nav_region:
		print("RuntimeObstacle: Carving and baking navigation mesh...")
		# true enables asynchronous baking on a background thread to prevent frame stutters.
		nav_region.bake_navigation_mesh(true)
	else:
		push_warning("RuntimeObstacle: NavigationRegion3D not found.")

func _find_navigation_region() -> NavigationRegion3D:
	var root = get_tree().current_scene
	return _recursive_find(root) as NavigationRegion3D

func _recursive_find(node: Node) -> Node:
	if node is NavigationRegion3D:
		return node
	for child in node.get_children():
		var found = _recursive_find(child)
		if found:
			return found
	return null

# --- Debug Visualization ---

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not debug_draw or not is_inside_tree():
		return

	# Calculate actual height including the offset added in _ready.
	var actual_height = size.y + 1.2
	
	# Calculate center point using local Y-axis to account for rotation and tilt.
	var center = global_position + (global_transform.basis.y * actual_height * 0.5)

	# Calculate the final bounding box size including margins.
	var draw_size = Vector3(
		size.x + (extra_margin * 2), 
		actual_height, 
		size.z + (extra_margin * 2)
	)
	
	# Retrieve the actual rotation quaternion.
	var real_rotation = global_transform.basis.get_rotation_quaternion()

	# --- Draw Calls ---
	
	# Draw translucent cyan bounding box and solid yellow wireframe (explicitly centered).
	DebugDraw3D.draw_box(center, real_rotation, draw_size, Color(0.0, 0.75, 1.0, 0.5), true)
	DebugDraw3D.draw_box(center, real_rotation, draw_size, Color.YELLOW, true)

	# Draw white text label slightly above the actual height.
	var text_pos = center + (global_transform.basis.y * (actual_height * 0.5 + 0.5))
	DebugDraw3D.draw_text(text_pos, "OBSTACLE\nSize: " + str(size), 24, Color.WHITE)


extends Camera3D

@export_category("Camera Movement")
@export var base_speed := 8.0
@export var sprint_multiplier := 2.5
@export var accel := 15.0
@export var mouse_sensitivity := 0.25
@export var mouse_smoothing := 18.0
@export var move_damping := 6.0

@export_category("Interaction")
@export var target_object: Node3D
@export var ray_length: float = 1000.0
@export var rupture_scene: Node3D

var velocity := Vector3.ZERO
var target_rotation := Vector3.ZERO
var current_aim_position := Vector3.ZERO
var is_aiming_at_ground := false
var current_collider: Node3D = null

func _ready() -> void:
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED
	target_rotation = rotation
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if is_instance_valid(rupture_scene):
		rupture_scene.call("SetCamera", self)

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseMotion and Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
		var sens = mouse_sensitivity * 0.01
		target_rotation.y -= event.relative.x * sens
		target_rotation.x -= event.relative.y * sens
		target_rotation.x = clamp(target_rotation.x, -PI/2 + 0.01, PI/2 - 0.01)
	
	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
		Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE \
			if Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED \
			else Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED
	
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
		if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
			if Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED: base_speed *= 1.18
			elif is_instance_valid(rupture_scene): rupture_scene.call("AdjustImpulse", 1.0)
		elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
			if Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED: base_speed /= 1.18
			elif is_instance_valid(rupture_scene): rupture_scene.call("AdjustImpulse", -1.0)
		
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		var target_pos := Vector2.ZERO

		if Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
			# 如果鼠标被锁定隐藏，用屏幕正中心
			target_pos = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size * 0.5
		else:
			# 【关键修改】如果鼠标解绑了，直接用事件里自带的鼠标真实位置
			target_pos = event.position 
		
		if is_instance_valid(rupture_scene):
			rupture_scene.call("ApplyImpact", target_pos)

func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	_update_raycast()

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	rotation.x = lerp_angle(rotation.x, target_rotation.x, 1.0 - exp(-mouse_smoothing * delta))
	rotation.y = lerp_angle(rotation.y, target_rotation.y, 1.0 - exp(-mouse_smoothing * delta))
	
	if Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
		var input_dir := Vector3.ZERO
		if Input.is_action_pressed("forward"):  input_dir.z -= 1
		if Input.is_action_pressed("backward"): input_dir.z += 1
		if Input.is_action_pressed("left"):     input_dir.x -= 1
		if Input.is_action_pressed("right"):    input_dir.x += 1
		if Input.is_action_pressed("fly_up"):   input_dir.y += 1
		if Input.is_action_pressed("fly_down"): input_dir.y -= 1
		
		input_dir = input_dir.normalized()
		var direction = (transform.basis * input_dir).normalized()
		var current_speed = base_speed * (sprint_multiplier if Input.is_action_pressed("sprint") else 1.0)
		velocity = velocity.lerp(direction * current_speed, accel * delta)
		if input_dir.length() < 0.1: velocity = velocity.lerp(Vector3.ZERO, move_damping * delta)
		position += velocity * delta
	else:
		velocity = velocity.lerp(Vector3.ZERO, move_damping * delta)
		position += velocity * delta

func _update_raycast() -> void:
	if Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
		is_aiming_at_ground = false
		current_collider = null
		return
	var viewport = get_viewport()
	var mouse_pos = viewport.get_mouse_position()
	var ray_origin = project_ray_origin(mouse_pos)
	var ray_target = ray_origin + project_ray_normal(mouse_pos) * ray_length
	var query = PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(ray_origin, ray_target)
	var result = get_world_3d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(query)
	if result:
		is_aiming_at_ground = true
		current_aim_position = result.position
		current_collider = result.collider
	else:
		is_aiming_at_ground = false
		current_collider = null


class_name CamRig
extends Node3D

# --- Camera Control Parameters ---
@export var max_pitch_deg: float = 45
@export var min_pitch_deg: float = -45
@export var max_zoom: float = 20
@export var min_zoom: float = 4
@export var zoom_step: float = 2
@export var zoom_y_step: float = 0.15
@export var vertical_sensitivity: float = 0.002
@export var horizontal_sensitivity: float = 0.002
@export var cam_y_offset: float = 4.0
@export var cam_lerp_speed: float = 16.0
@export var cam_target: Node3D

@onready var _spring_arm: SpringArm3D = get_node("SpringArm3D")
@onready var _current_zoom: float = 8

var _current_y_offset: float = cam_y_offset

func _ready() -> void:
	# Decouples the camera rig's transform from its parent, allowing independent movement.
	self.top_level = true
	# Capture the mouse cursor on startup.
	Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED)
	var pause_menu = get_tree().root.get_node("GlobalUI/PauseMenu")
	pause_menu.visibility_changed.connect(_on_pause_menu_visibility_changed)

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	# Toggle mouse capture mode when the ESC key is pressed.
	#if event is InputEventKey and event.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE and event.pressed:
		#if Input.get_mouse_mode() == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
			#Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE)
		#else:
			#Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED)
		#return # Prevent further input processing this frame after toggling.

	# Ignore mouse input if the cursor is not captured.
	if Input.get_mouse_mode() != Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
		return

	if event is InputEventMouseMotion:
		# Rotate the camera based on mouse movement.
		rotation.y -= event.relative.x * horizontal_sensitivity
		rotation.y = wrapf(rotation.y, 0.0, TAU)

		rotation.x -= event.relative.y * vertical_sensitivity
		rotation.x = clamp(rotation.x, deg_to_rad(min_pitch_deg), deg_to_rad(max_pitch_deg))

	if event is InputEventMouseButton:
		# Adjust zoom level with the mouse wheel.
		if event.is_pressed():
			if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP and _current_zoom > min_zoom:
				_current_zoom -= zoom_step
				cam_y_offset -= zoom_y_step
			if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN and _current_zoom < max_zoom:
				_current_zoom += zoom_step
				cam_y_offset += zoom_y_step

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	# Smoothly interpolate to the target zoom level.
	_spring_arm.spring_length = lerp(_spring_arm.spring_length, _current_zoom, delta * cam_lerp_speed)

	# Smoothly follow the target's position with a vertical offset.
	_current_y_offset = lerp(_current_y_offset, cam_y_offset, delta * cam_lerp_speed)
	self.global_position = cam_target.global_position + Vector3(0, _current_y_offset, 0)

	# Handle camera rotation with a gamepad joystick.
	var joy_stick_input: Vector2 = Input.get_vector("cam_rotate_down", "cam_rotate_up", "cam_rotate_left", "cam_rotate_right")
	self.rotation.y -= joy_stick_input.y * horizontal_sensitivity * 1000 * delta
	self.rotation.y = wrapf(self.rotation.y, 0.0, TAU)
	self.rotation.x -= joy_stick_input.x * vertical_sensitivity * 1000 * delta
	self.rotation.x = clamp(self.rotation.x, deg_to_rad(min_pitch_deg), deg_to_rad(max_pitch_deg))
	
func _on_pause_menu_visibility_changed():
	var pause_menu = get_tree().root.get_node("GlobalUI/PauseMenu")
	if pause_menu.visible:
		Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE)
	else:
		Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED)


extends Node3D

@export var object_scenes: Array[PackedScene] = []  # Recommended: 2~4 different scenes

@export_category("Spawn Settings")
@export_range(0.05, 20.0) var spawn_interval: float = 0.45

@export var enable_max_limit: bool = true
@export var max_active_bodies: int = 500

@export var enable_total_limit: bool = false
@export var max_total_spawns: int = 5000

@export_category("Pool Settings")
# Lower default value for better safety and performance.
@export var pool_size_per_type: int = 250
@export var auto_despawn_time: float = 120.0


const MAX_POOL_SIZE: int = 2100
# Recommended value for Project Settings → Physics → Jolt → Max Bodies
const RECOMMENDED_MAX_BODIES: int = 20000


var pools: Array = []           # Array[Array[RigidBody3D]] - one pool per scene type
var pool_sets: Array = []       # Array[Dictionary] - fast lookup per pool

var active_count: int = 0
var total_spawned: int = 0

var _timer: Timer


func _ready() -> void:
	if object_scenes.is_empty():
		push_error("Spawner: Please assign at least one PackedScene to object_scenes.")
		return

	var total_initial_bodies = object_scenes.size() * pool_size_per_type
	print("Creating initial object pools... Estimated %d RigidBody3D instances." % total_initial_bodies)
	
	if total_initial_bodies > 8000:
		push_warning("Large initial pool size detected. Consider increasing Physics → Jolt → Max Bodies in Project Settings.")

	# Initialize pools
	pools.resize(object_scenes.size())
	pool_sets.resize(object_scenes.size())
	
	for i in object_scenes.size():
		pools[i] = [] as Array[RigidBody3D]
		pool_sets[i] = {}
		_create_pool(object_scenes[i], pools[i], pool_sets[i], i)

	# Setup spawn timer
	_timer = Timer.new()
	add_child(_timer)
	_timer.wait_time = spawn_interval
	_timer.timeout.connect(_spawn_one)
	_timer.start()

	print("Multi-type Spawner initialized | Types: %d | Pool size: %d per type | Active limit: %d" % 
		[object_scenes.size(), pool_size_per_type, max_active_bodies])


func _create_pool(scene: PackedScene, pool: Array[RigidBody3D], pool_set: Dictionary, type_index: int) -> void:
	for i in pool_size_per_type:
		var body: RigidBody3D = scene.instantiate()
		body.freeze = true
		body.visible = false
		add_child(body)
		body.set_meta("type_index", type_index)
		pool.append(body)
		pool_set[body] = true


func _spawn_one() -> void:
	if enable_max_limit and active_count >= max_active_bodies:
		return
	if enable_total_limit and total_spawned >= max_total_spawns:
		return

	var type_index = randi() % object_scenes.size()
	var pool = pools[type_index]
	var pool_set = pool_sets[type_index]
	var scene = object_scenes[type_index]

	var body: RigidBody3D
	
	# Get from pool or instantiate new
	if not pool.is_empty():
		body = pool.pop_back()
		pool_set.erase(body)
	else:
		body = scene.instantiate()
		add_child(body)
		body.set_meta("type_index", type_index)

	_clear_cleanup_timer(body)

	# Activate body with random rotation for natural behavior
	body.freeze = false
	body.visible = true
	body.linear_velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	body.basis = Basis.from_euler(Vector3(
		randf_range(-PI, PI),
		randf_range(-PI, PI),
		randf_range(-PI, PI)
	))
	body.angular_velocity = Vector3(
		randf_range(-5.0, 5.0),
		randf_range(-5.0, 5.0),
		randf_range(-5.0, 5.0)
	)

	body.position = Vector3(
		randf_range(-1.0, 1.0),
		randf_range(0.2, 0.8),
		randf_range(-1.0, 1.0)
	)

	active_count += 1
	total_spawned += 1

	# Auto-despawn timer
	var cleanup := Timer.new()
	cleanup.wait_time = auto_despawn_time
	cleanup.one_shot = true
	cleanup.timeout.connect(_return_to_pool.bind(body))
	body.add_child(cleanup)
	body.set_meta("cleanup_timer", cleanup)
	cleanup.start()


func _return_to_pool(body: RigidBody3D) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(body):
		return

	_clear_cleanup_timer(body)
	active_count = max(active_count - 1, 0)

	body.freeze = true
	body.visible = false
	body.linear_velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	body.angular_velocity = Vector3.ZERO

	var type_index: int = body.get_meta("type_index", 0)
	var pool = pools[type_index]
	var pool_set = pool_sets[type_index]

	if not pool_set.has(body) and pool.size() < MAX_POOL_SIZE:
		pool.append(body)
		pool_set[body] = true
	else:
		body.queue_free()


func _clear_cleanup_timer(body: RigidBody3D) -> void:
	if not body.has_meta("cleanup_timer"):
		return
		
	var timer = body.get_meta("cleanup_timer") as Timer
	if is_instance_valid(timer):
		timer.stop()
		timer.queue_free()
		
	body.remove_meta("cleanup_timer")


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	DebugDraw2D.set_text("Scene Types", object_scenes.size())
	DebugDraw2D.set_text("Total Spawned", "%d%s" % [total_spawned, " / " + str(max_total_spawns) if enable_total_limit else ""])
	DebugDraw2D.set_text("Active", "%d / %d" % [active_count, max_active_bodies if enable_max_limit else 99999])
	
	for i in object_scenes.size():
		DebugDraw2D.set_text("Type %d Pool" % i, pools[i].size())


shader_type spatial;
render_mode blend_mix, depth_draw_opaque, cull_back, diffuse_lambert, specular_schlick_ggx;

uniform sampler2D checker_tex;
uniform vec4 color : source_color = vec4(1.0);

uniform float c1_contrast : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.8;
uniform float c2_contrast : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.75;

varying vec3 v_pos_ws;
varying vec3 v_normal_ws;


void vertex() {
    v_pos_ws = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz;
    v_normal_ws = normalize((MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(NORMAL, 0.0)).xyz);
}


void fragment() {
    vec3 abs_n = abs(v_normal_ws);
    vec2 uv = vec2(0.0);

    // Single-sample triplanar mapping: choose dominant axis to avoid three texture samples
    if (abs_n.y > abs_n.x && abs_n.y > abs_n.z) {
        uv = vec2(v_pos_ws.x * sign(v_normal_ws.y), v_pos_ws.z);           // prevent mirroring on bottom faces
    } else if (abs_n.x > abs_n.y && abs_n.x > abs_n.z) {
        uv = vec2(-v_pos_ws.z * sign(v_normal_ws.x), -v_pos_ws.y);         // correct orientation
    } else {
        uv = vec2(v_pos_ws.x * sign(v_normal_ws.z), -v_pos_ws.y);
    }

    vec4 tex = texture(checker_tex, uv);

    // Apply contrast variation per channel (R = strong, G/B/A = stronger)
    float intensity_c1 = c1_contrast;
    float intensity_c2 = intensity_c1 * c2_contrast;

    float multiplier = mix(1.0, intensity_c1, tex.r);
    multiplier = mix(multiplier, intensity_c2, tex.g);
    multiplier = mix(multiplier, intensity_c2, tex.b);
    multiplier = mix(multiplier, intensity_c2, tex.a);

    ALBEDO = color.rgb * multiplier;
}

// res://water/core/WaterField.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Core;
using Godot;

/// <summary>
/// Interface for water surface field modifiers.
/// </summary>
public interface WaterField
{
	/// <summary>
	/// Indicates whether the water field is currently active.
	/// </summary>
	bool IsActive { get; set; }

	/// <summary>
	/// General evaluation used in rendering frames, or as a fallback if not overridden in physics frames.
	/// </summary>
	void Evaluate(Vector3 worldPos, double time, ref WaterSample sample);

	/// <summary>
	/// Specific evaluation for physics frames (optional override).
	/// Default behavior calls Evaluate(). Pure visual fields (e.g., high-frequency noise) 
	/// can override this with an empty implementation to save physics frame performance overhead.
	/// </summary>
	void EvaluatePhysics(Vector3 worldPos, double physicsTime, ref WaterSample sample)
	{
		Evaluate(worldPos, physicsTime, ref sample);
	}
}


// res://water/core/WaterImpulse.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Core;
using Godot;

/// <summary>
/// Brush mode determining how the GPU processes the impulse.
/// Velocity     = Injects impulse into the velocity field, creating diffusing ripples.
/// Displacement = Constrains the water surface to a target height, creating a steady depression (e.g., rotor downwash).
/// SurfaceFlow  = Injects horizontal momentum into the surface flow field (velocity_tex.ba), driving foam advection outwards without triggering vertical waves.
/// </summary>
public enum BrushMode : int
{
    Velocity     = 0,
    Displacement = 1,
    SurfaceFlow  = 2
}

/// <summary>
/// Water surface interaction impulse (value type, zero GC).
/// InnerRadius > 0 indicates an annular brush.
/// BrushMode determines how this impulse is processed by the GPU.
/// FlowVelocityXZ represents the horizontal velocity direction (in UV space) for the SurfaceFlow mode.
/// Vector2.Zero indicates the shader will automatically calculate the radial outward direction.
/// </summary>
public struct WaterImpulse
{
    public Vector3   WorldPosition;
    public float     WorldRadius;
    public float     InnerRadius;
    public float     Strength;
    public int       SourceId;
    public BrushMode BrushMode;
    public Vector2   FlowVelocityXZ;

    public WaterImpulse(
        Vector3 worldPos, float worldRadius, float strength,
        int sourceId = 0, float innerRadius = 0f,
        BrushMode brushMode = BrushMode.Velocity,
        Vector2 flowVelocityXZ = default)
    {
        WorldPosition  = worldPos;
        WorldRadius    = worldRadius;
        InnerRadius    = innerRadius;
        Strength       = strength;
        SourceId       = sourceId;
        BrushMode      = brushMode;
        FlowVelocityXZ = flowVelocityXZ;
    }
}

}

// res://water/core/WaterSample.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Core;
using Godot;

/// <summary>
/// Water surface sampling result (value type, zero GC).
/// </summary>
public struct WaterSample
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Water surface height (world Y coordinate).
    /// </summary>
    public float Height;

    /// <summary>
    /// Water surface normal (world space).
    /// </summary>
    public Vector3 Normal;

    /// <summary>
    /// Water surface movement velocity (world space, filled by GerstnerField).
    /// Y = dH/dt, vertical velocity (analytical derivative).
    /// XZ = Horizontal surge velocity driven by Steepness (analytical derivative).
    /// When Steepness=0, XZ is zero; when Steepness>0, it is valid and affects buoyancy/drag calculations.
    /// </summary>
    public Vector3 Velocity;

    /// <summary>
    /// Water flow velocity (filled by TextureFlowField, river/ocean currents).
    /// </summary>
    public Vector3 FlowVelocity;

    /// <summary>
    /// Water surface XZ slope (analytical gradient, filled by GerstnerField).
    /// X = dH/d(worldX), Y = dH/d(worldZ).
    /// </summary>
    public Vector2 WaveGradientXZ;

    /// <summary>
    /// Current disturbance energy [0,1].
    /// </summary>
    public float Energy;

    /// <summary>
    /// Current foam intensity [0,1].
    /// </summary>
    public float Foam;

    /// <summary>
    /// Indicates whether the sample is valid.
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsValid;

    public static readonly WaterSample Invalid = new WaterSample
    {
        Height         = 0f,
        Normal         = Vector3.Up,
        Velocity       = Vector3.Zero,
        FlowVelocity   = Vector3.Zero,
        WaveGradientXZ = Vector2.Zero,
        Energy         = 0f,
        Foam           = 0f,
        IsValid        = false
    };
}

// res://water/core/WaterSampleMask.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Core;
using System;

/// <summary>
/// Water surface sampling layer control.
/// </summary>
[Flags]
public enum WaterSampleMask
{
	/// <summary>
	/// Sample only Gerstner and FlowField (used for physics logic).
	/// </summary>
	BaseWavesAndFlow = 1 << 0,

	/// <summary>
	/// Overlay RippleField (used for visual alignment).
	/// </summary>
	Ripples          = 1 << 1,

	/// <summary>
	/// Sample all layers.
	/// </summary>
	All              = BaseWavesAndFlow | Ripples
}


// res://water/core/WaterZoneShape.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Core;
using Godot;

/// <summary>
/// Defines the physical boundaries of the water body and handles the mapping 
/// from world coordinates to the ripple simulation UV space.
/// </summary>
public interface WaterZoneShape
{
	// --- Queries ---

	/// <summary>
	/// Checks if a world coordinate point is within the water body boundary.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="worldPos">The world coordinate to check.</param>
	/// <param name="waterY">The real world Y coordinate of the water surface.</param>
	bool ContainsWorldPoint(Vector3 worldPos, float waterY);

	/// <summary>
	/// Converts world coordinates to ripple simulation UV [0,1]² (used in rendering frames).
	/// Used for shader alignment and reading rendering frame cache.
	/// </summary>
	Vector2 WorldToUV(Vector3 worldPos);

	/// <summary>
	/// Converts world coordinates to ripple simulation UV [0,1]² (used in physics frames).
	/// Used for interaction injection and physics sampling, reading physics frame cache.
	/// Static zones share the same logic as WorldToUV, while dynamic zones calculate separately.
	/// </summary>
	Vector2 WorldToUV_Physics(Vector3 worldPos);

	/// <summary>
	/// The representative visual size (the larger value between X and Z).
	/// Used as a scalar reference for operations like brush radius conversion and foam distance attenuation.
	/// For non-square zones, do not use this value for ripple UV calculations.
	/// </summary>
	float GetVisualSize();

	/// <summary>
	/// The world space XZ dimensions corresponding to the ripple texture (X = Width, Y = Depth along the Z axis).
	/// Non-square zones (e.g., elongated boxes) must return their actual dual-axis dimensions.
	/// Shaders use this value for dual-axis ripple UV division to prevent normal texture distortion.
	/// </summary>
	Vector2 GetVisualSizeXZ()
	{
		float s = GetVisualSize();
		// Default: Square (applicable for InfinitePlane / Spline)
		return new Vector2(s, s);
	}
	
	/// <summary>
	/// World XZ coordinates of the ripple texture center (rendering frame version, for shader alignment).
	/// </summary>
	Vector2 GetRippleCenterWorld_Render();

	/// <summary>
	/// World XZ coordinates of the ripple texture center (physics frame version, for interaction injection).
	/// </summary>
	Vector2 GetRippleCenterWorld_Physics();

	/// <summary>
	/// Retrieves the bounds of the water zone on the XZ plane.
	/// Dynamic zones update this value every frame; static zones calculate it once during _Ready.
	/// InfinitePlane returns a massive value covering the entire scene.
	/// </summary>
	Rect2 GetBoundsXZ();

	// --- Frame Updates ---

	/// <summary>
	/// Rendering frame update.
	/// Updates the center cache used by the shaders.
	/// Static zones can have an empty implementation.
	/// </summary>
	void UpdateRenderFrame(Vector3 followerWorldPos);

	/// <summary>
	/// Updates the center cache used for physics sampling and interaction injection.
	/// Static zones can have an empty implementation.
	/// </summary>
	void UpdatePhysicsFrame(Vector3 followerWorldPos);
}
