// res://water/debug/WaterDebugHub.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Debug;

using Godot;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Profile;
using IWS.Water.Rendering;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;
using IWS.Water.Zone;

/// <summary>
/// UI rendering and diagnostic hub for the IWS water system.
/// Executes strict configuration and physics assertions at a specified frequency (e.g., 1Hz), 
/// diagnosing issues such as budget saturation, optical absorption anomalies, 
/// and nonlinear wave parameter inconsistencies, displaying warnings on the in-game debug panel.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class WaterDebugHub : Node
{
	public static WaterDebugHub Instance { get; private set; }

	[Export] public bool Enabled = true;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "1,30")]  public float PanelRefreshHz = 10f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.2,5")] public float ValidationHz   = 1f;
	[Export] public int MaxIssues = 64;

	public WaterDebugFlags Flags { get; } = new WaterDebugFlags();

	public WaterRenderSnapshot  RenderSnap  { get; } = new WaterRenderSnapshot();
	public WaterPhysicsSnapshot PhysicsSnap { get; } = new WaterPhysicsSnapshot();

	private readonly List<WaterDebugIssue> _issues    = new(64);
	private readonly object                _issueLock = new();

	private double _panelTimer      = 0.0;
	private double _validationTimer = 0.0;

	private CanvasLayer    _canvasLayer;
	private PanelContainer _panel;
	private VBoxContainer  _rootVBox;

	private Label _lblGlobal;
	private Label _lblBodies;
	private Label _lblInteraction;
	private Label _lblRipple;
	private Label _lblUnderwater;
	private Label _lblIssues;

	private readonly Dictionary<string, bool> _sectionFolded = new()
	{
		["Global"]      = false,
		["Bodies"]      = false,
		["Interaction"] = false,
		["Ripple"]      = false,
		["Underwater"]  = false,
		["Issues"]      = false,
	};

	// --- Lifecycle ---

	public override void _EnterTree()
	{
		if (Instance != null && Instance != this)
			Instance.QueueFree();
		Instance = this;
	}

	public override void _Ready()
	{
		if (!Enabled) return;
		BuildUI();
	}

	public override void _ExitTree()
	{
		if (Instance == this) Instance = null;
	}

	// --- Main Loop ---

	public override void _Process(double delta)
	{
		if (!Enabled) return;

		TakeRenderSnapshot();

		_panelTimer += delta;
		if (_panelTimer >= 1.0 / PanelRefreshHz)
		{
			_panelTimer = 0.0;
			RefreshPanel();
		}

		_validationTimer += delta;
		if (_validationTimer >= 1.0 / ValidationHz)
		{
			_validationTimer = 0.0;
			RunValidation();
		}

		DrawZoneDrift();
	}

	public override void _PhysicsProcess(double delta)
	{
		if (!Enabled) return;
		TakePhysicsSnapshot();
	}

	// --- Facade API: Draw ---

	public static void DrawSphere(
		Vector3 pos, float radius, Color color,
		float duration = 0f, DebugCategory cat = DebugCategory.General)
	{
		if (Instance == null || !Instance.Enabled) return;
		if (!Instance.IsCategoryEnabled(cat)) return;
		DebugDraw3D.DrawSphere(pos, radius, color, duration);
	}

	public static void DrawLine(
		Vector3 from, Vector3 to, Color color,
		DebugCategory cat = DebugCategory.General)
	{
		if (Instance == null || !Instance.Enabled) return;
		if (!Instance.IsCategoryEnabled(cat)) return;
		DebugDraw3D.DrawLine(from, to, color);
	}

	public static void DrawBox(
		Vector3 pos, Vector3 size, Color color,
		DebugCategory cat = DebugCategory.General)
	{
		if (Instance == null || !Instance.Enabled) return;
		if (!Instance.IsCategoryEnabled(cat)) return;
		DebugDraw3D.DrawBox(pos, Quaternion.Identity, size, color);
	}

	public static void DrawArrow(
		Vector3 from, Vector3 to, Color color,
		DebugCategory cat = DebugCategory.General)
	{
		if (Instance == null || !Instance.Enabled) return;
		if (!Instance.IsCategoryEnabled(cat)) return;
		DebugDraw3D.DrawArrow(from, to, color, 0.15f, false, 0f);
	}

	// --- Facade API: ReportIssue / TogglePanel ---

	public static void ReportIssue(
		DebugSeverity severity, string code, string message,
		string source = "", Vector3? worldPos = null)
	{
		if (Instance == null || !Instance.Enabled) return;
		Instance.AddOrUpdateIssue(severity, code, message, source, worldPos);
	}

	public static void TogglePanel()
	{
		if (Instance == null) return;
		Instance.Flags.ShowPanel = !Instance.Flags.ShowPanel;
		if (Instance._panel != null)
			Instance._panel.Visible = Instance.Flags.ShowPanel;
	}

	// --- Category Check ---

	private bool IsCategoryEnabled(DebugCategory cat) => cat switch
	{
		DebugCategory.Buoyancy     => Flags.Buoyancy,
		DebugCategory.Impulses     => Flags.Impulses,
		DebugCategory.Disturbances => Flags.Disturbances,
		DebugCategory.Zones        => Flags.Zones,
		DebugCategory.ClipLOD      => Flags.ClipLOD,
		DebugCategory.Underwater   => Flags.Underwater,
		_                          => true,
	};

	// --- Snapshot Capture ---

	private void TakeRenderSnapshot()
	{
		var ws = IWSWaterManager.Instance;
		if (ws == null) return;

		var s = RenderSnap;

		// --- Global ---
		s.WaterTime   = ws.WaterTime;
		s.PhysicsTime = ws.PhysicsTime;
		s.TimeDelta   = ws.WaterTime - ws.PhysicsTime;
		s.PhysicsTicksPerSec = (int)ProjectSettings
			.GetSetting("physics/common/physics_ticks_per_second");

		// --- Camera ---
		Vector3 camPos = ws.FollowerPosRender;
		s.CameraPos = camPos;

		// --- Camera Water State ---
		var camCtrl = FindCameraController();
		if (camCtrl != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(camCtrl))
		{
			s.UnderwaterState         = camCtrl.State;
			s.SignedDistance          = camCtrl.SignedDistance;
			s.SmoothBlend             = camCtrl.SmoothBlend;
			s.ComputeBackendAvailable = camCtrl.IsComputeAvailable;
			s.UsingCanvasFallback     = camCtrl.IsUsingCanvasFallback;
		}
		else
		{
			s.UnderwaterState         = IWSCameraWaterState.Above;
			s.SignedDistance          = float.MaxValue;
			s.SmoothBlend             = 0f;
			s.ComputeBackendAvailable = false;
			s.UsingCanvasFallback     = true;
		}

		// --- Water Bodies List ---
		s.AllBodies.Clear();
		var bodies = ws.Bodies;
		if (bodies != null)
		{
			foreach (var q in bodies)
			{
				if (q == null) continue;
				if (q is Node qNode && !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(qNode)) continue;

				bool hits = false;
				try { hits = q.ContainsWorldPoint(camPos); } catch { hits = false; }

				string name = (q as Node)?.Name ?? q.GetType().Name;
				string zone = GetZoneTypeName(q);
				s.AllBodies.Add((name, q.Priority, zone, hits));
			}
		}

		// --- Hit Body ---
		var hitQuery = ws.FindWaterAt(camPos);
		if (hitQuery == null)
		{
			IWSWaterBody candidate  = null;
			float     bestPriority = float.MinValue;
			foreach (var q in ws.Bodies)
			{
				if (q == null) continue;
				if (q is Node qn && !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(qn)) continue;
				Rect2 bounds = q.GetBoundsXZ();
				bool inXZ = camPos.X >= bounds.Position.X &&
							camPos.X <= bounds.Position.X + bounds.Size.X &&
							camPos.Z >= bounds.Position.Y &&
							camPos.Z <= bounds.Position.Y + bounds.Size.Y;
				if (!inXZ || q.Priority <= bestPriority) continue;
				bestPriority = q.Priority;
				candidate    = q as IWSWaterBody;
			}
			hitQuery = candidate;
		}

		var hitBody = hitQuery as IWSWaterBody;

		if (hitBody == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(hitBody))
		{
			s.CurrentBodyName              = string.Empty;
			s.CurrentBodyPriority          = 0f;
			s.CurrentBodyZoneType          = string.Empty;
			s.CurrentBodyVisualSize        = 0f;
			s.WaterSurfaceHeight           = 0f;
			s.RippleResolution             = 0;
			s.CpuCacheResolution           = 0;
			s.Damping                      = 0f;
			s.HalfLifeSec                  = 0f;
			s.WaveSpeed                    = 0f;
			s.FoamPassEnabled              = false;
			s.RippleTexturesValid          = false;
			s.RippleCacheLagFrames         = 0;
			s.GatherPassEnabled            = false;
			s.UsePhysicalOptics            = false;
			s.AbsorptionCoeffEffective     = Vector3.Zero;
			s.SubsurfaceStrength           = 0f;
			s.GlintStrength                = 0f;
			
			s.Turbidity                    = 0f;
			s.RoughnessBoost               = 0f;
			s.RadianceBlend                = 0f;
			s.OpacityBias                  = 0f;
			s.RefDepth                     = 0f;
			return;
		}

		s.CurrentBodyName     = hitBody.Name;
		s.CurrentBodyPriority = hitBody.Priority;
		s.CurrentBodyZoneType = GetZoneTypeName(hitBody);

		var zoneShape = hitBody.ZoneNode as WaterZoneShape;
		s.CurrentBodyVisualSize = zoneShape?.GetVisualSize() ?? 0f;
		s.CurrentBodyRippleCenterRender =
			zoneShape?.GetRippleCenterWorld_Render()
			?? new Vector2(hitBody.GlobalPosition.X, hitBody.GlobalPosition.Z);

		s.WaterSurfaceHeight = hitBody.GlobalPosition.Y + hitBody.BaseWaterLevel;

		// --- Profile ---
		var profile = hitBody.GetProfile();
		s.ProfileWaveNonlinearExp = profile?.WaveNonlinearExp    ?? 1.3f;
		s.RippleVisualStrength    = profile?.RippleVisualStrength ?? 1.5f;
		s.RipplePhysicsScale      = profile?.RipplePhysicsScale   ?? 0.06f;

		// --- Ripple Simulator ---
		var sim = hitBody.RippleManager;
		if (sim != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(sim))
		{
			s.RippleResolution     = sim.Resolution;
			s.CpuCacheResolution   = sim.CpuCacheResolution;
			
			// The debug panel uses DampingLow as the primary UI indicator.
			s.Damping              = sim.DampingLow;
			s.HalfLifeSec          = (sim.DampingLow > 0f && sim.DampingLow < 1f)
				? (float)(Math.Log(0.5) / Math.Log(sim.DampingLow) / 60.0)
				: float.PositiveInfinity;
				
			s.WaveSpeed            = sim.WaveSpeed;
			s.FoamPassEnabled      = sim.IsFoamPassEnabled;
			s.RippleTexturesValid  = sim.AreTexturesValid;
			s.RippleCacheLagFrames = sim.CacheLagFrames;
			s.GatherPassEnabled    = sim.GatherPipelineRid.IsValid;
			s.AutoInteractionActive        = hitBody.IsAutoInteractionActive;
			s.AutoInteractionStrengthValue = hitBody.SimSettings?.AutoInteractionStrength ?? 0f;
		}
		else
		{
			s.RippleResolution     = 0;
			s.CpuCacheResolution   = 0;
			s.Damping              = 0f;
			s.HalfLifeSec          = 0f;
			s.WaveSpeed            = 0f;
			s.FoamPassEnabled      = false;
			s.RippleTexturesValid  = false;
			s.RippleCacheLagFrames = 0;
			s.GatherPassEnabled    = false;
		}

		// --- Physical Optics Snapshot ---
		// Values are derived using GetDerivedOptics to ensure the debug panel shows
		// the exact values uploaded to the shader, keeping consistency with rendering.
		s.UsePhysicalOptics = profile?.UsePhysicalOptics ?? false;

		if (profile != null)
		{
			DerivedOptics derived = profile.GetDerivedOptics();

			s.AbsorptionCoeffEffective = derived.AbsorptionRGB;
			s.SubsurfaceStrength       = profile.SubsurfaceStrength;
			s.GlintStrength            = profile.GlintStrength;

			s.Turbidity      = profile.Turbidity;
			s.RoughnessBoost = derived.RoughnessBoost;
			s.RadianceBlend  = derived.RadianceBlend;
			s.OpacityBias    = derived.OpacityBias;
			s.RefDepth       = profile.RefDepth;

			s.ReflectionAttenuation  = derived.ReflectionAttenuation;
			s.NormalMipBias          = derived.NormalMipBias;
			s.EffectiveFoamThreshold = derived.EffectiveFoamThreshold;
			s.EffectiveFoamMultiplier = derived.EffectiveFoamMultiplier;

			s.UsePhysicalGlint = profile.UsePhysicalGlint;
			var (gd, gs, gstr)     = profile.GetEffectiveGlintParams();
			s.GlintEffectiveDensity   = gd;
			s.GlintEffectiveSharpness = gs;
			s.GlintEffectiveStrength  = gstr;
		}
		else
		{
			s.AbsorptionCoeffEffective  = Vector3.Zero;
			s.SubsurfaceStrength        = 0f;
			s.GlintStrength             = 0f;
			s.Turbidity                 = 0f;
			s.RoughnessBoost            = 0f;
			s.RadianceBlend             = 0f;
			s.OpacityBias               = 0f;
			s.RefDepth                  = 0f;
			s.ReflectionAttenuation     = 1f;
			s.NormalMipBias             = 0f;
			s.EffectiveFoamThreshold    = 0.08f;
			s.EffectiveFoamMultiplier   = 1f;
		}

		// --- Sun Illumination Diagnostics ---
		s.SunElevationDeg = hitBody.GetSunElevationRad() * Mathf.RadToDeg(1f);
		s.SunDirectionL   = Vector3.Up;
	}

	private void TakePhysicsSnapshot()
	{
		var ws = IWSWaterManager.Instance;
		if (ws == null) return;

		var s = PhysicsSnap;

		s.CollectedCount             = ws.LastCollectedCount;
		s.ValidCommandCount          = ws.LastValidCommandCount;
		s.CompiledCount              = ws.LastCompiledCount;
		s.GpuBrushCount              = ws.LastGpuBrushCount;
		s.DroppedCommandCount        = ws.LastDroppedCount;
		s.BudgetRemaining            = ws.LastBudgetRemaining;
		s.BudgetSaturatedThisFrame   = ws.WasBudgetSaturated;
		s.TotalBudgetSaturationCount = ws.TotalSaturationCount;

		s.PerBodyBudgetDetails.Clear();
		foreach (var (name, compiled, budget) in ws.LastPerBodyStats)
			s.PerBodyBudgetDetails.Add((name, compiled, budget));

		var hitBody = ws.FindWaterAt(RenderSnap.CameraPos) as IWSWaterBody;
		var zone    = hitBody?.ZoneNode as WaterZoneShape;

		if (zone != null)
		{
			Vector2 physicsCenter = zone.GetRippleCenterWorld_Physics();
			Vector2 renderCenter  = RenderSnap.CurrentBodyRippleCenterRender;
			RenderSnap.CurrentBodyRippleCenterPhysics = physicsCenter;

			float visualSize = Mathf.Max(zone.GetVisualSize(), 0.001f);
			s.RippleCenterDriftUV = physicsCenter.DistanceTo(renderCenter) / visualSize;
			s.RippleCenterDriftM  = physicsCenter.DistanceTo(renderCenter);
		}
		else
		{
			s.RippleCenterDriftUV = 0f;
			s.RippleCenterDriftM  = 0f;
		}
	}

	// --- Zone Drift 3D Visualization ---

	private void DrawZoneDrift()
	{
		if (!Flags.ZoneDrift) return;
		if (PhysicsSnap.RippleCenterDriftM < 0.05f) return;

		var ws      = IWSWaterManager.Instance;
		var hitBody = ws?.FindWaterAt(RenderSnap.CameraPos) as IWSWaterBody;
		if (hitBody?.ZoneNode is IWSWaterZoneBox) return;

		float waterY = hitBody?.GlobalPosition.Y + hitBody?.BaseWaterLevel ?? 0f;

		Vector2 r = RenderSnap.CurrentBodyRippleCenterRender;
		Vector2 p = RenderSnap.CurrentBodyRippleCenterPhysics;

		Vector3 renderPos  = new Vector3(r.X, waterY + 0.1f, r.Y);
		Vector3 physicsPos = new Vector3(p.X, waterY + 0.1f, p.Y);

		DebugDraw3D.DrawSphere(renderPos,  0.4f, new Color(0f, 1f, 0f, 0.8f));
		DebugDraw3D.DrawSphere(physicsPos, 0.4f, new Color(1f, 0.9f, 0f, 0.8f));
		DebugDraw3D.DrawLine(renderPos, physicsPos, new Color(1f, 0.5f, 0f, 0.9f));
	}

	// --- Validation Rules (1 Hz) ---

	private void RunValidation()
	{
		if (!Flags.Validation) return;

		ValidateNonlinearExpConsistency();
		ValidateRippleTextureRefs();
		ValidateBudgetSaturation();
		ValidateZoneDrift();
		ValidatePhysicsTickRate();
		ValidateUnderwaterBackend();
		ValidateRipplePhysicsScaleRatio();
		ValidatePhysicalOptics();
	}

	private void ValidateNonlinearExpConsistency()
	{
		float profile = RenderSnap.ProfileWaveNonlinearExp;
		float inFrame = RenderSnap.UnderwaterFrameNonlinearExp;
		if (inFrame < 0.5f) return;

		if (Mathf.Abs(profile - inFrame) > 0.01f)
		{
			ReportIssue(DebugSeverity.Warning, "NONLINEAR_EXP_MISMATCH",
				$"WaveNonlinearExp mismatch: Profile={profile:F3} UnderwaterFrame={inFrame:F3}\n" +
				"Waterline mask may exhibit periodic deviation or flickering.",
				RenderSnap.CurrentBodyName ?? "");
		}
		else
		{
			ClearIssue("NONLINEAR_EXP_MISMATCH");
		}
	}

	private void ValidateRippleTextureRefs()
	{
		var ws      = IWSWaterManager.Instance;
		var hitBody = ws?.FindWaterAt(RenderSnap.CameraPos) as IWSWaterBody;
		if (hitBody?.RippleManager == null) return;

		if (!hitBody.RippleManager.AreTexturesValid)
		{
			ReportIssue(DebugSeverity.Error, "RIPPLE_TEX_INVALID",
				"RippleSimulator GPU textures are invalid.", hitBody.Name);
		}
		else
		{
			ClearIssue("RIPPLE_TEX_INVALID");
		}

		if (hitBody.Renderer?.WaterMaterial == null)
		{
			ReportIssue(DebugSeverity.Error, "WATER_MATERIAL_NULL",
				"WaterSurfaceRenderer.WaterMaterial is null.", hitBody.Name);
		}
		else
		{
			ClearIssue("WATER_MATERIAL_NULL");
		}
	}

	private void ValidateBudgetSaturation()
	{
		if (PhysicsSnap.BudgetSaturatedThisFrame)
		{
			ReportIssue(DebugSeverity.Warning, "BUDGET_SATURATED",
				$"Interaction budget saturated: collected={PhysicsSnap.CollectedCount}  " +
				$"compiled={PhysicsSnap.CompiledCount}  " +
				$"dropped~={PhysicsSnap.DroppedCommandCount}  " +
				$"total_saturation={PhysicsSnap.TotalBudgetSaturationCount}",
				"WaterInteractionSystem");
		}
		else
		{
			ClearIssue("BUDGET_SATURATED");
		}
	}

	private void ValidateZoneDrift()
	{
		var ws      = IWSWaterManager.Instance;
		var hitBody = ws?.FindWaterAt(RenderSnap.CameraPos) as IWSWaterBody;
		if (hitBody?.ZoneNode is IWSWaterZoneBox) { ClearIssue("ZONE_FOLLOWER_DRIFT"); return; }

		const float thresholdM = 0.5f;
		if (PhysicsSnap.RippleCenterDriftM > thresholdM)
		{
			ReportIssue(DebugSeverity.Warning, "ZONE_FOLLOWER_DRIFT",
				$"Zone render/physics center drift {PhysicsSnap.RippleCenterDriftM:F2} m > {thresholdM} m\n" +
				$"(UV diff {PhysicsSnap.RippleCenterDriftUV:F4})",
				hitBody?.Name ?? "");
		}
		else
		{
			ClearIssue("ZONE_FOLLOWER_DRIFT");
		}
	}

	private void ValidatePhysicsTickRate()
	{
		int ticks = RenderSnap.PhysicsTicksPerSec;
		if (ticks < 60)
		{
			ReportIssue(DebugSeverity.Warning, "LOW_PHYSICS_TICKS",
				$"physics_ticks_per_second = {ticks} (Recommended >= 60)",
				"ProjectSettings");
		}
		else
		{
			ClearIssue("LOW_PHYSICS_TICKS");
		}
	}

	private void ValidateUnderwaterBackend()
	{
		if (!RenderSnap.ComputeBackendAvailable && RenderSnap.UsingCanvasFallback)
		{
			ReportIssue(DebugSeverity.Info, "UNDERWATER_CANVAS_FALLBACK",
				"Underwater Compute Shader unavailable, degraded to Canvas Shader.",
				"IWSWaterCameraController");
		}
		else
		{
			ClearIssue("UNDERWATER_CANVAS_FALLBACK");
		}
	}

	private void ValidateRipplePhysicsScaleRatio()
	{
		float visual  = RenderSnap.RippleVisualStrength;
		float physics = RenderSnap.RipplePhysicsScale;
		if (visual > 0.001f && physics / visual > 0.5f)
		{
			ReportIssue(DebugSeverity.Warning, "RIPPLE_PHYSICS_SCALE_HIGH",
				$"RipplePhysicsScale ({physics:F3}) / RippleVisualStrength ({visual:F3}) = " +
				$"{physics / visual:F2} > 0.5\nPhysics buoyancy is too sensitive to ripple depressions.",
				RenderSnap.CurrentBodyName ?? "");
		}
		else
		{
			ClearIssue("RIPPLE_PHYSICS_SCALE_HIGH");
		}
	}

	// --- Physical Optics Parameters Validation ---
	private void ValidatePhysicalOptics()
	{
		var s = RenderSnap;
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(s.CurrentBodyName)) return;

		if (!s.UsePhysicalOptics)
		{
			ReportIssue(DebugSeverity.Info, "PHYSICAL_OPTICS_OFF",
				"UsePhysicalOptics disabled, color is driven by ColorShallow/ColorDeep.\n" +
				"Enable physical optics for realistic rendering.",
				s.CurrentBodyName);
			ClearIssue("ABSORPTION_ZERO");
			ClearIssue("ABSORPTION_CHANNEL_INVERTED");
			return;
		}
		ClearIssue("PHYSICAL_OPTICS_OFF");

		// Use values derived from DerivedOptics (Beer-Lambert inverse) for validation to avoid false positives.
		var ab = s.AbsorptionCoeffEffective;

		if (ab.X < 0.001f && ab.Y < 0.001f && ab.Z < 0.001f)
		{
			ReportIssue(DebugSeverity.Warning, "ABSORPTION_ZERO",
				$"DerivedOptics.AbsorptionRGB is near zero, water will be completely transparent.\n" +
				$"Check if RefDepth ({s.RefDepth:F1}m) is too high, or if TransmittanceColor/ColorDeep is close to white.",
				s.CurrentBodyName);
		}
		else
		{
			ClearIssue("ABSORPTION_ZERO");
		}

		// Physically, R attenuation > B attenuation (red light attenuates faster in water).
		// If R < B, the resulting water will appear red.
		if (ab.X < ab.Z - 0.01f)
		{
			ReportIssue(DebugSeverity.Warning, "ABSORPTION_CHANNEL_INVERTED",
				$"Absorption R({ab.X:F3}) < B({ab.Z:F3}) is physically implausible (red should attenuate faster than blue).\n" +
				$"Usually caused by high R channel in TransmittanceColor/ColorDeep (warm water target color).\n" +
				$"Current Turbidity={s.Turbidity:F2}, RefDepth={s.RefDepth:F1}m.",
				s.CurrentBodyName);
		}
		else
		{
			ClearIssue("ABSORPTION_CHANNEL_INVERTED");
		}

		// Warn if Turbidity > 0 but RadianceBlend is near zero (usually caused by black SedimentTint).
		if (s.Turbidity > 0.1f && s.RadianceBlend < 0.01f)
		{
			ReportIssue(DebugSeverity.Info, "TURBIDITY_NO_RADIANCE",
				$"Turbidity={s.Turbidity:F2} but RadianceBlend~0.\n" +
				"Turbidity will not tint reflections, edges will still appear blue.\n" +
				"Check SedimentTint (should not be pure black).",
				s.CurrentBodyName);
		}
		else
		{
			ClearIssue("TURBIDITY_NO_RADIANCE");
		}
	}

	// --- Issue Management ---

	private void AddOrUpdateIssue(
		DebugSeverity severity, string code, string message,
		string source, Vector3? worldPos)
	{
		double now = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.WaterTime ?? 0.0;
		lock (_issueLock)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _issues.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_issues[i].Code != code) continue;
				var existing         = _issues[i];
				existing.Count++;
				existing.LastSeenTime = now;
				existing.Message      = message;
				return;
			}
			if (_issues.Count >= MaxIssues)
				_issues.RemoveAt(0);
			_issues.Add(new WaterDebugIssue
			{
				Severity      = severity,
				Code          = code,
				Message       = message,
				Source        = source,
				WorldPos      = worldPos,
				FirstSeenTime = now,
				LastSeenTime  = now,
				Count         = 1,
			});
		}
	}

	private void ClearIssue(string code)
	{
		lock (_issueLock)
		{
			for (int i = _issues.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
				if (_issues[i].Code == code)
					_issues.RemoveAt(i);
		}
	}

	// --- UI Construction ---

	private void BuildUI()
	{
		_canvasLayer      = new CanvasLayer { Layer = 100, Name = "WaterDebugCanvasLayer" };
		AddChild(_canvasLayer);

		_panel                   = new PanelContainer { Name = "WaterDebugPanel" };
		_panel.Visible           = Flags.ShowPanel;
		_panel.CustomMinimumSize = new Vector2(400f, 0f);
		_panel.SetAnchorsPreset(Control.LayoutPreset.TopLeft);
		_panel.OffsetLeft        = 8f;
		_panel.OffsetTop         = 8f;

		var styleBox = new StyleBoxFlat
		{
			BgColor                 = new Color(0.05f, 0.05f, 0.1f, 0.88f),
			CornerRadiusTopLeft     = 6,
			CornerRadiusTopRight    = 6,
			CornerRadiusBottomLeft  = 6,
			CornerRadiusBottomRight = 6,
		};
		_panel.AddThemeStyleboxOverride("panel", styleBox);
		_canvasLayer.AddChild(_panel);

		var scroll = new ScrollContainer
		{
			CustomMinimumSize    = new Vector2(0f, 600f),
			HorizontalScrollMode = ScrollContainer.ScrollMode.Disabled,
		};
		_panel.AddChild(scroll);

		_rootVBox = new VBoxContainer { CustomMinimumSize = new Vector2(390f, 0f) };
		scroll.AddChild(_rootVBox);

		var title = MakeLabel("🌊  Water Debug Hub", new Color(0.4f, 0.85f, 1f), 14, true);
		var hint  = MakeLabel("F12 = Toggle Panel", new Color(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.6f), 10);
		_rootVBox.AddChild(title);
		_rootVBox.AddChild(hint);
		_rootVBox.AddChild(MakeSeparator());

		_lblGlobal      = BuildSection("Global",      "⏱ Global Time / Camera");
		_lblBodies      = BuildSection("Bodies",      "💧 Water Bodies");
		_lblInteraction = BuildSection("Interaction", "🌀 Interaction Budget");
		_lblRipple      = BuildSection("Ripple",      "〰 Ripple Sim / Optics");
		_lblUnderwater  = BuildSection("Underwater",  "🔵 Underwater Post-process");
		_lblIssues      = BuildSection("Issues",      "⚠ Validation");
	}

	private Label BuildSection(string key, string header)
	{
		var btn = new Button { Text = $"▼  {header}", Flat = true };
		btn.AddThemeColorOverride("font_color",       new Color(0.8f, 0.95f, 1f));
		btn.AddThemeColorOverride("font_hover_color", new Color(1f, 1f, 1f));
		btn.AddThemeColorOverride("font_focus_color", new Color(1f, 1f, 1f));
		var btnStyle = new StyleBoxFlat
		{
			BgColor           = new Color(0.1f, 0.15f, 0.25f, 0.6f),
			ContentMarginLeft = 6f,
		};
		btn.AddThemeStyleboxOverride("normal", btnStyle);
		_rootVBox.AddChild(btn);

		var lbl = new Label
		{
			AutowrapMode      = TextServer.AutowrapMode.WordSmart,
			CustomMinimumSize = new Vector2(380f, 0f),
		};
		lbl.AddThemeColorOverride("font_color",   new Color(0.85f, 0.9f, 0.9f));
		lbl.AddThemeFontSizeOverride("font_size", 11);

		var margin = new MarginContainer();
		margin.AddThemeConstantOverride("margin_left",   8);
		margin.AddThemeConstantOverride("margin_right",  8);
		margin.AddThemeConstantOverride("margin_top",    2);
		margin.AddThemeConstantOverride("margin_bottom", 4);
		margin.AddChild(lbl);

		_rootVBox.AddChild(margin);
		_rootVBox.AddChild(MakeSeparator());

		string capturedKey    = key;
		string capturedHeader = header;
		btn.Pressed += () =>
		{
			_sectionFolded[capturedKey] = !_sectionFolded[capturedKey];
			margin.Visible = !_sectionFolded[capturedKey];
			btn.Text = (_sectionFolded[capturedKey] ? "▶  " : "▼  ") + capturedHeader;
		};

		return lbl;
	}

	// --- Input Handling ---

	public override void _Input(InputEvent ev)
	{
		if (ev is InputEventKey k && k.Pressed && !k.Echo && k.Keycode == Key.F12)
			TogglePanel();
	}

	// --- Panel Refresh ---

	private void RefreshPanel()
	{
		if (_panel == null || !_panel.Visible) return;

		RefreshGlobal();
		RefreshBodies();
		RefreshInteraction();
		RefreshRipple();
		RefreshUnderwater();
		RefreshIssues();
	}

	private void RefreshGlobal()
	{
		if (_sectionFolded["Global"]) return;
		var s  = RenderSnap;
		var sb = new StringBuilder();
		sb.AppendLine($"WaterTime   : {s.WaterTime:F2} s");
		sb.AppendLine($"PhysicsTime : {s.PhysicsTime:F2} s");
		sb.AppendLine($"Δ (R-P)     : {s.TimeDelta * 1000:F1} ms");
		sb.AppendLine($"PhysicsTicks: {s.PhysicsTicksPerSec} Hz");
		sb.AppendLine($"Camera Pos  : {s.CameraPos:F2}");
		_lblGlobal.Text = sb.ToString();
	}

	private void RefreshBodies()
	{
		if (_sectionFolded["Bodies"]) return;
		var s  = RenderSnap;
		var sb = new StringBuilder();

		if (s.AllBodies.Count == 0)
		{
			sb.AppendLine("(No registered water bodies)");
		}
		else
		{
			foreach (var (name, pri, zone, hits) in s.AllBodies)
				sb.AppendLine($"[{pri}] {name}  ({zone}){(hits ? " ◀" : "")}");
		}

		if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(s.CurrentBodyName))
		{
			sb.AppendLine();
			sb.AppendLine($"Hit Body    : {s.CurrentBodyName}");
			sb.AppendLine($"Zone Size   : {s.CurrentBodyVisualSize:F1} m");
			sb.AppendLine($"Center (Ren): {s.CurrentBodyRippleCenterRender:F1}");
			sb.AppendLine($"Center (Phy): {s.CurrentBodyRippleCenterPhysics:F1}");

			float drift    = PhysicsSnap.RippleCenterDriftM;
			string driftStr = drift > 0.05f ? $"{drift:F2} m  ⚠" : $"{drift:F2} m  ✓";
			sb.AppendLine($"Center Drift: {driftStr}");
			sb.AppendLine($"Surface Alt : {s.WaterSurfaceHeight:F3} m");
			sb.AppendLine($"NLinearExp  : {s.ProfileWaveNonlinearExp:F3}");
		}

		_lblBodies.Text = sb.ToString();
	}

	private void RefreshInteraction()
	{
		if (_sectionFolded["Interaction"]) return;
		var s  = PhysicsSnap;
		var sb = new StringBuilder();

		sb.AppendLine($"Collected   : {s.CollectedCount}");
		sb.AppendLine($"Valid(clip) : {s.ValidCommandCount}");
		sb.AppendLine($"Compiled    : {s.CompiledCount}");
		sb.AppendLine($"Dropped~    : {s.DroppedCommandCount}");
		sb.AppendLine($"GPU Brushes : {s.GpuBrushCount}");

		int budget = IWSWaterManager.INTERACTION_BUDGET;
		sb.AppendLine($"Budget Left : {s.BudgetRemaining}/{budget}");

		if (s.BudgetSaturatedThisFrame)
			sb.AppendLine("⚠ Budget SATURATED this frame");

		sb.AppendLine($"Saturation# : {s.TotalBudgetSaturationCount}");

		if (Flags.PerBodyBudget && s.PerBodyBudgetDetails.Count > 0)
		{
			sb.AppendLine();
			sb.AppendLine("--- Per-Body Budget ---");
			foreach (var (bodyName, compiled, budget2) in s.PerBodyBudgetDetails)
				sb.AppendLine($"  {bodyName}: compiled={compiled}/{budget2}");
		}

		_lblInteraction.Text = sb.ToString();
	}

	private void RefreshRipple()
	{
		if (_sectionFolded["Ripple"]) return;
		var s  = RenderSnap;
		var sb = new StringBuilder();

		// --- Ripple Simulation ---
		sb.AppendLine($"Resolution  : {s.RippleResolution}²  CPU:{s.CpuCacheResolution}²");
		sb.AppendLine($"Damping     : {s.Damping:F4}  (t½≈{s.HalfLifeSec:F1}s)");
		sb.AppendLine($"WaveSpeed   : {s.WaveSpeed:F3}");
		sb.AppendLine($"VisualStr   : {s.RippleVisualStrength:F3}  [Profile]");
		sb.AppendLine($"PhysicsScale: {s.RipplePhysicsScale:F3}  [Profile]");

		float ratio    = s.RippleVisualStrength > 0.001f
			? s.RipplePhysicsScale / s.RippleVisualStrength : 0f;
		string ratioStr = ratio > 0.5f ? $"{ratio:F2}  ⚠ High" : $"{ratio:F2}  ✓";
		sb.AppendLine($"Phys/Visual : {ratioStr}");

		sb.AppendLine($"Foam Pass   : {(s.FoamPassEnabled    ? "✓" : "✗")}");
		sb.AppendLine($"Textures    : {(s.RippleTexturesValid ? "✓ valid" : "✗ INVALID")}");
		sb.AppendLine($"Cache Lag   : {s.RippleCacheLagFrames} frames");
		sb.AppendLine($"Gather Pass : {(s.GatherPassEnabled ? "✓" : "✗ N/A")}");

		string captureStr = s.AutoInteractionActive
			? $"✓  str={s.AutoInteractionStrengthValue:F3}"
			: "✗ off";
		sb.AppendLine($"AutoCapture : {captureStr}");

		// --- Physical Optics Parameters ---
		sb.AppendLine();
		sb.AppendLine("--- Physical Optics ---");
		sb.AppendLine($"PhysOptics  : {(s.UsePhysicalOptics ? "✓ Enabled" : "✗ Artistic Mode")}");

		if (s.UsePhysicalOptics)
		{
			var ab    = s.AbsorptionCoeffEffective;
			bool abZero = ab.X < 0.001f && ab.Y < 0.001f && ab.Z < 0.001f;
			string abStr = abZero
				? "⚠ All zero (Check if TransColor/ColorDeep is near white)"
				: $"R={ab.X:F3} G={ab.Y:F3} B={ab.Z:F3}";
			sb.AppendLine($"Absorption  : {abStr}");

			if (!abZero && ab.X < ab.Z)
				sb.AppendLine("  ⚠ R < B (Inverted channels, causes red water)");
		}

		sb.AppendLine($"SSS Strength: {s.SubsurfaceStrength:F3}");
		sb.AppendLine($"Glint Str   : {s.GlintStrength:F3}");

		// --- Turbidity Derived Optic Results ---
		sb.AppendLine();
		sb.AppendLine("--- Turbidity Derived ---");
		sb.AppendLine($"Turbidity   : {s.Turbidity:F2}");
		sb.AppendLine($"RefDepth    : {s.RefDepth:F1} m");
		sb.AppendLine($"RoughBoost  : +{s.RoughnessBoost:F3}");

		string radianceStr = s.RadianceBlend < 0.001f
			? "0 (Clear, no reflection tint)"
			: $"{s.RadianceBlend:F3}  → Reflection tint active";
		sb.AppendLine($"RadianceBl  : {radianceStr}");
		sb.AppendLine($"OpacityBias : {s.OpacityBias:F3}");

		// Tuning hints
		if (s.Turbidity > 0.1f && s.RadianceBlend < 0.01f)
			sb.AppendLine("  ⚠ Turbidity>0 but reflection untinted, check SedimentTint");
		if (s.Turbidity > 0.5f && s.OpacityBias < 0.1f)
			sb.AppendLine("  ⚠ High turbidity but low OpacityBias, lower Turbidity threshold?");

		sb.AppendLine();
		sb.AppendLine("--- Reflection / Normal Control ---");
		sb.AppendLine($"ReflAtten   : {s.ReflectionAttenuation:F3}  (f0 atten, 0.2=turbid)");
		sb.AppendLine($"NormalMip   : +{s.NormalMipBias:F2}  (Normal mip bias, 0=full res)");
		sb.AppendLine();
		sb.AppendLine("--- Foam Linkage ---");
		sb.AppendLine($"FoamThr(eff): {s.EffectiveFoamThreshold:F3}  (Lower = more foam)");
		sb.AppendLine($"FoamMul(eff): ×{s.EffectiveFoamMultiplier:F2}");

		// Tuning hints
		if (s.Turbidity > 0.3f && s.ReflectionAttenuation > 0.7f)
			sb.AppendLine("  ⚠ Turbidity>0.3 but reflection atten insufficient, check DerivedOptics");
		if (s.NormalMipBias < 0.5f && s.Turbidity > 0.5f)
			sb.AppendLine("  ⚠ Turbidity>0.5 but normal not down-sampled, highlights may persist");

		_lblRipple.Text = sb.ToString();
	}

	private void RefreshUnderwater()
	{
		if (_sectionFolded["Underwater"]) return;
		var s  = RenderSnap;
		var sb = new StringBuilder();

		sb.AppendLine($"Compute     : {(s.ComputeBackendAvailable ? "✓ Available" : "✗ N/A")}");
		sb.AppendLine($"Backend     : {(s.UsingCanvasFallback     ? "Canvas (Degraded)" : "Compute")}");
		sb.AppendLine($"State       : {s.UnderwaterState}");
		sb.AppendLine($"SignedDist  : {s.SignedDistance:F3} m");
		sb.AppendLine($"SmoothBlend : {s.SmoothBlend:F3}");
		sb.AppendLine($"NLinearExp  : {s.UnderwaterFrameNonlinearExp:F3}  (frame)");

		bool consistent = Mathf.Abs(s.ProfileWaveNonlinearExp - s.UnderwaterFrameNonlinearExp) < 0.01f
						  || s.UnderwaterFrameNonlinearExp < 0.5f;
		sb.AppendLine($"Exp Match   : {(consistent ? "✓" : "✗ MISMATCH")}");

		_lblUnderwater.Text = sb.ToString();
	}

	private void RefreshIssues()
	{
		if (_sectionFolded["Issues"]) return;
		var sb = new StringBuilder();

		lock (_issueLock)
		{
			if (_issues.Count == 0)
			{
				sb.AppendLine("✓ No issues");
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (var issue in _issues)
				{
					sb.AppendLine($"{issue.SeverityLabel} [{issue.Code}]  ×{issue.Count}");
					sb.AppendLine($"   {issue.Message}");
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(issue.Source))
						sb.AppendLine($"   → {issue.Source}");
				}
			}
		}

		_lblIssues.Text = sb.ToString();
	}

	// --- Utilities ---

	private static Label MakeLabel(string text, Color col, int size = 11, bool bold = false)
	{
		var lbl = new Label { Text = text };
		lbl.AddThemeColorOverride("font_color",   col);
		lbl.AddThemeFontSizeOverride("font_size", size);
		return lbl;
	}

	private static HSeparator MakeSeparator()
	{
		var sep   = new HSeparator();
		var style = new StyleBoxLine { Color = new Color(0.2f, 0.3f, 0.4f, 0.5f) };
		sep.AddThemeStyleboxOverride("separator", style);
		return sep;
	}

	private static string GetZoneTypeName(WaterQuery q)
	{
		if (q is not IWSWaterBody wb) return "?";
		return wb.ZoneNode switch
		{
			IWSWaterZoneBox           => "Box",
			IWSWaterZoneInfinitePlane => "Infinite",
			IWSWaterZoneSpline        => "Spline",
			_                         => wb.ZoneNode?.GetType().Name ?? "?",
		};
	}

	private IWSWaterCameraController FindCameraController()
		=> FindCameraControllerRecursive(GetTree().Root);

	private static IWSWaterCameraController FindCameraControllerRecursive(Node root)
	{
		if (root is IWSWaterCameraController ctrl) return ctrl;
		foreach (Node child in root.GetChildren())
		{
			var result = FindCameraControllerRecursive(child);
			if (result != null) return result;
		}
		return null;
	}
}

/// <summary>

	// --- Water Bodies ---

	public string  CurrentBodyZoneType;

	public float   CurrentBodyVisualSize;
	public Vector2 CurrentBodyRippleCenterRender;
	public Vector2 CurrentBodyRippleCenterPhysics;

	public List<(string Name, float Priority, string Zone, bool HitsCamera)>
		AllBodies = new();

	// --- Underwater Backend ---
	public bool ComputeBackendAvailable;
	public bool UsingCanvasFallback;

	// --- Ripple Simulator ---
	public int   RippleResolution;
	public int   CpuCacheResolution;
	public float Damping;
	public float HalfLifeSec;
	public float WaveSpeed;
	public float RippleVisualStrength;
	public float RipplePhysicsScale;

	public bool  RippleTexturesValid;
	public int   RippleCacheLagFrames;
	public bool  GatherPassEnabled;

	// --- Auto Interaction ---

	// --- Wave Nonlinear Consistency ---

/// <summary>

using Godot;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;
using IWS.Water.Rendering;

/// <summary>
/// Diagnostic tool for IWS multiple water body instances.
/// Validates the system's "Clone and Anti-Pollution" principles by checking for 
/// accidentally shared Materials, Renderers, and RippleManagers across instances,
/// and detects zombie mesh nodes within MeshStrategies to prevent data race and visual artifacts.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class WaterDuplicationDiagnostic : Node
{
	public override void _Ready()
	{
		// Delay execution by one frame to ensure all water bodies have completed _Ready and registration.
		CallDeferred(MethodName.RunDiagnostic);
	}

	private void RunDiagnostic()
	{
		GD.Print("\n=== IWS Water Duplication Diagnostic Report ===");
		var bodies = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.Bodies;
		if (bodies == null || bodies.Count == 0)
		{
			GD.Print("No water bodies found registered.");
			return;
		}

		HashSet<ulong> materialIds = new HashSet<ulong>();
		HashSet<ulong> rendererIds = new HashSet<ulong>();
		HashSet<ulong> simIds = new HashSet<ulong>();

		int index = 0;
		foreach (var query in bodies)
		{
			if (query is not IWSWaterBody wb) continue;
			GD.Print($"\n--- WaterBody [{index}]: '{wb.Name}' ---");
			
			// 1. Check if the Renderer and material are accidentally shared.
			if (wb.Renderer != null)
			{
				ulong renId = wb.Renderer.GetInstanceId();
				if (!rendererIds.Add(renId))
					GD.PushError($"[Critical Error: Renderer Shared] '{wb.Name}' is sharing the same Renderer '{wb.Renderer.Name}' with another water body! Ensure the Renderer is a child node of the water body.");
				
				if (wb.Renderer.OwnedMaterial != null)
				{
					ulong matId = wb.Renderer.OwnedMaterial.GetInstanceId();
					if (!materialIds.Add(matId))
						GD.PushError($"[Critical Error: Material Shared] '{wb.Name}' is writing to the same OwnedMaterial instance as another water body!");
					else
						GD.Print($"Independent material instance verified (ID: {matId}).");
				}
			}

			// 2. Check if the RippleManager simulator is independent.
			if (wb.RippleManager != null)
			{
				ulong simId = wb.RippleManager.GetInstanceId();
				if (!simIds.Add(simId))
					GD.PushError($"[Critical Error: Simulator Shared] '{wb.Name}' is sharing the RippleManager with another water body!");
			}

			// 3. Check for zombie mesh nodes generated within the MeshStrategy.
			if (wb.MeshStrategyNode != null)
			{
				int meshCount = 0;
				foreach (Node child in wb.MeshStrategyNode.GetChildren())
				{
					if (child is MeshInstance3D) meshCount++;
				}

				if (wb.MeshStrategyNode is IWSWaterMeshClimap climap)
				{
					GD.Print($"MeshStrategy (Climap): Expected meshes = {climap.LodLevels}, Actual found = {meshCount}");
					if (meshCount > climap.LodLevels)
						GD.PushError($"[Zombie Node Detected] Found {meshCount - climap.LodLevels} redundant overlapping meshes! This is the root cause of overlapping normals and z-fighting/flickering.");
				}
				else if (wb.MeshStrategyNode is IWSWaterMeshRibbon)
				{
					GD.Print($"MeshStrategy (Ribbon): Expected meshes = 1, Actual found = {meshCount}");
					if (meshCount > 1)
						GD.PushError($"[Zombie Node Detected] Found {meshCount - 1} redundant overlapping meshes!");
				}
			}
			index++;
		}
		GD.Print("\n=== Diagnostic Complete ===\n");
	}
}


## A 3D interactable button script attached to a parent Node3D.
## Detects mouse clicks on its child StaticBody3D and triggers the assigned spawner.
extends Node3D

@export var spawner: Node3D 
@export var button_body: StaticBody3D # Child collision body

@export_group("Animation")
@export var press_depth: float = 0.1
@export var press_duration: float = 0.2

var _body_initial_y: float
var _tween: Tween

func _ready() -> void:
	if button_body:
		_body_initial_y = button_body.position.y
		button_body.input_ray_pickable = true
		button_body.input_event.connect(_on_child_input_event)

func _on_child_input_event(_camera, event, _position, _normal, _shape_idx):
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and event.is_pressed():
		_execute_trigger()

func _execute_trigger():
	if not spawner or (_tween and _tween.is_running()):
		return

	# --- Spawner Logic Delegation ---
	if spawner.has_method("reset_and_spawn"):
		spawner.reset_and_spawn()
	
	# --- Internal Visual Animation ---
	_play_animation()

func _play_animation():
	_tween = create_tween()
	_tween.set_parallel(false) 
	_tween.tween_property(button_body, "position:y", _body_initial_y - press_depth, press_duration / 2.0).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	_tween.tween_property(button_body, "position:y", _body_initial_y, press_duration / 2.0).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)


extends CharacterBody3D

@export_category("Oscillation Parameters")
@export var move_speed: float = 8.0
@export var move_range: float = 12.0
@export var move_axis: Vector3 = Vector3(0, 0, 1)

@export_category("Physics Parameters")
@export var push_strength: float = 3.0
@export var max_impulse: float = 5.0
@export var gravity_multiplier: float = 1.0

var start_position: Vector3
var time: float = 0.0
var gravity: float

func _ready() -> void:
	start_position = global_position
	move_axis = move_axis.normalized()
	gravity = ProjectSettings.get_setting("physics/3d/default_gravity") * gravity_multiplier

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	time += delta

	# Apply standard gravity
	if not is_on_floor():
		velocity.y -= gravity * delta

	# Calculate target kinematic horizontal velocity based on harmonic oscillation
	var omega = move_speed / move_range
	var target_horizontal: Vector3 = move_axis * (move_speed * cos(time * omega))

	velocity.x = target_horizontal.x
	velocity.z = target_horizontal.z

	# Store pre-kinematic state to resolve buoyancy-induced positional anomalies
	var pre_y_velocity = velocity.y
	var pre_y_position = global_position.y

	move_and_slide()

	# Restore target horizontal velocity to prevent kinematic deceleration 
	# when colliding with rigid bodies.
	velocity.x = target_horizontal.x
	velocity.z = target_horizontal.z

	# Prevent extreme vertical displacement caused by high-velocity buoyant objects.
	# Clamps the character back to the ground if upward delta exceeds a safe threshold within a single frame.
	if global_position.y - pre_y_position > 0.2:
		global_position.y = pre_y_position
		velocity.y = pre_y_velocity

	_push_rigid_bodies()

func _push_rigid_bodies() -> void:
	for i in get_slide_collision_count():
		var collision = get_slide_collision(i)
		var collider = collision.get_collider()

		if not collider is RigidBody3D:
			continue

		var rigid := collider as RigidBody3D

		# Invert collision normal to calculate the outward pushing direction
		var raw_normal := collision.get_normal()
		var push_dir := Vector3(-raw_normal.x, 0.0, -raw_normal.z)

		if push_dir.length_squared() < 0.01:
			continue

		push_dir = push_dir.normalized()
		
		# Blend the outward normal with the kinematic movement direction 
		# for a more natural displacement trajectory.
		var move_dir = Vector3(velocity.x, 0, velocity.z).normalized()
		push_dir = (push_dir + move_dir * 0.5).normalized()

		# Calculate mass-scaled impulse to effectively overcome IWS hydrodynamic drag
		var raw_impulse: float = push_strength * rigid.mass
		var clamped_impulse: float = clamp(raw_impulse, 0.0, max_impulse)

		rigid.apply_central_impulse(push_dir * clamped_impulse)
		
		# Apply a downward corrective impulse to rigid bodies below the character
		# to counter excessive buoyancy and prevent the character from being launched.
		if rigid.global_position.y < global_position.y:
			rigid.apply_central_impulse(Vector3.DOWN * clamped_impulse * 0.5)


## Simulates realistic helicopter hovering, including smooth S-curve random drifting 
## and dynamic airframe tilting based on translational velocity.
extends Node3D
class_name HelicopterPilotScurve

@export_group("Hover (Up & Down)")
@export var hover_amplitude := 0.05
@export var hover_speed := 1.5

@export_group("Rotor Vibration")
@export var vibe_amplitude := 0.005
@export var vibe_speed := 12.0

@export_group("Pilot Movement (S-Curve)")
## Delay time (in seconds) between maneuvers.
@export var rest_min_time := 0.2
@export var rest_max_time := 1.0
## Range of drift distance per maneuver (in meters).
@export var min_drift_distance := 0.2
@export var max_drift_distance := 0.7
## Duration of a single maneuver (in seconds). Higher values yield softer movements.
@export var move_duration_min := 1.5
@export var move_duration_max := 3.0
## Maximum tilt amplitude (in radians, 0.1 is approx 5.7 degrees).
@export var tilt_amount := 0.1
## Tilt response speed. Lower values simulate a softer input on the cyclic stick.
@export var tilt_smoothness := 4.0

# --- Internal State ---
var _base_position: Vector3
var _base_rotation: Vector3

var _time: float = 0.0
var _phase_y1: float
var _phase_y2: float

# S-curve movement state machine
enum State { RESTING, MOVING }
var _state: State = State.RESTING

var _rest_timer: float = 0.0
var _next_rest_time: float = 0.5

var _move_start := Vector3.ZERO
var _move_target := Vector3.ZERO
var _move_duration: float = 2.0
var _move_timer: float = 0.0

var _current_offset := Vector3.ZERO
var _prev_offset := Vector3.ZERO

var _current_tilt := Vector3.ZERO

func _ready() -> void:
	_init_base()
	_randomize_phases()

func _enter_tree() -> void:
	_init_base()

func _init_base() -> void:
	_base_position = position
	_base_rotation = rotation

func _randomize_phases() -> void:
	_phase_y1 = randf() * TAU
	_phase_y2 = randf() * TAU

# Smootherstep easing function.
# Guarantees zero starting and ending velocities, avoiding any sudden jumps.
func smootherstep(t: float) -> float:
	t = clampf(t, 0.0, 1.0)
	return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	_time += delta
	
	# --- 1. State Machine: Resting -> Moving ---
	match _state:
		State.RESTING:
			_rest_timer += delta
			if _rest_timer >= _next_rest_time:
				# Plan a new movement maneuver
				var dir = Vector3(randf_range(-1.0, 1.0), 0.0, randf_range(-1.0, 1.0)).normalized()
				var dist = randf_range(min_drift_distance, max_drift_distance)
				
				_move_start = _current_offset
				_move_target = _current_offset + dir * dist
				_move_duration = randf_range(move_duration_min, move_duration_max)
				_move_timer = 0.0
				
				_state = State.MOVING
		
		State.MOVING:
			_move_timer += delta
			var progress = _move_timer / _move_duration
			
			if progress >= 1.0:
				# Movement complete, snap precisely to the target
				_current_offset = _move_target
				_state = State.RESTING
				_rest_timer = 0.0
				_next_rest_time = randf_range(rest_min_time, rest_max_time)
			else:
				# Move along the S-curve
				var curved_progress = smootherstep(progress)
				_current_offset = _move_start.lerp(_move_target, curved_progress)
	
	# --- 2. Calculate Physical Velocity (for tilting) ---
	# Since displacement follows an S-curve, velocity naturally forms a smooth bell curve.
	var velocity = (_current_offset - _prev_offset) / max(delta, 0.001)
	_prev_offset = _current_offset
	
	# Calculate target tilt based on the velocity vector.
	var target_tilt_x = -velocity.z * tilt_amount
	var target_tilt_z = velocity.x * tilt_amount
	
	# Smooth the tilt to simulate the pilot gently operating the cyclic stick.
	var tilt_weight = 1.0 - exp(-tilt_smoothness * delta)
	_current_tilt = _current_tilt.lerp(Vector3(target_tilt_x, 0, target_tilt_z), tilt_weight)
	
	# --- 3. Hovering & High-Frequency Vibration ---
	var y_offset = sin(_time * hover_speed + _phase_y1) * hover_amplitude
	y_offset += sin(_time * hover_speed * 1.7 + _phase_y2) * hover_amplitude * 0.4
	
	var vibe_x = sin(_time * vibe_speed) * vibe_amplitude
	var vibe_z = cos(_time * vibe_speed * 1.3) * vibe_amplitude
	
	# --- 4. Apply Transformations ---
	position.x = _base_position.x + _current_offset.x
	position.y = _base_position.y + y_offset
	position.z = _base_position.z + _current_offset.z
	
	rotation.x = _base_rotation.x + _current_tilt.x + vibe_x
	rotation.z = _base_rotation.z + _current_tilt.z + vibe_z


## A lightweight script for continuous rotation around a specific axis.
## Optimized for performance by using angle accumulation and direct Basis construction.
extends Node3D

enum RotationDirection { CLOCKWISE = 1, COUNTER_CLOCKWISE = -1 }

@export var rotation_speed: float = 36.6
@export var rotation_axis: Vector3 = Vector3.UP
@export var direction: RotationDirection = RotationDirection.CLOCKWISE

# Internal state: Accumulating the angle is computationally lighter than continuously modifying the Transform matrix.
var _current_angle: float = 0.0

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	# 1. Accumulate angle (wrapped between 0 and 2PI to prevent floating-point precision loss over time)
	_current_angle = wrapf(_current_angle + (direction * rotation_speed * delta), 0.0, TAU)
	
	# 2. Construct the rotation Basis directly.
	# The Basis(axis, angle) constructor is highly efficient and performs better than continuous rotate() calls.
	# Assigning it to transform.basis updates the node's local rotation.
	transform.basis = Basis(rotation_axis.normalized(), _current_angle)


## A spawner tool for instantiating physical objects. 
## Supports Area and Jet spawning modes, with built-in object pooling and editor previews.
@tool
extends Node3D

# --- Exported Variables ---

enum SpawnMode { AREA, JET }

@export var spawn_mode: SpawnMode = SpawnMode.AREA:
	set(value):
		spawn_mode = value
		if Engine.is_editor_hint(): _update_preview()

@export var object_scenes: Array[PackedScene] = []

@export_group("Area Settings", "area_")
@export var area_spawn_area_size: Vector3 = Vector3(5, 2, 5):
	set(value):
		area_spawn_area_size = value
		if Engine.is_editor_hint(): _update_preview()

@export_group("Jet Settings", "jet_")
@export var jet_quantity: int = 50
@export var jet_frequency: float = 10.0
@export var jet_speed: float = 20.0
@export var jet_spread_angle: float = 15.0
@export var jet_direction: Vector3 = Vector3.FORWARD:
	set(value):
		if value.is_zero_approx(): value = Vector3.FORWARD
		jet_direction = value.normalized()
		if Engine.is_editor_hint(): _update_preview()

@export_group("Spawn Limits")
@export var enable_max_limit: bool = true
@export var max_active_bodies: int = 500

@export_group("Pool Settings")
@export var use_pooling: bool = true
@export var pool_size_per_type: int = 50
@export var auto_despawn_time: float = 120.0

const MAX_POOL_SIZE: int = 2100

# --- Internal State ---
var pools: Array = []
var pool_sets: Array = []
var active_count: int = 0
var total_spawned: int = 0

var jet_timer: Timer
var jet_spawn_count: int = 0

# --- Editor Preview Variables ---
var _preview_node: MeshInstance3D
var _im_mesh: ImmediateMesh

# --- Initialization ---
func _ready() -> void:
	if Engine.is_editor_hint():
		_update_preview()
		return
		
	if is_instance_valid(_preview_node):
		_preview_node.queue_free()
		
	if object_scenes.is_empty():
		push_error("Spawner: Please assign at least one PackedScene.")
		return

	if use_pooling:
		_initialize_pools()
	
	jet_timer = Timer.new()
	add_child(jet_timer)
	jet_timer.timeout.connect(_on_jet_timer_timeout)


# --- Editor Preview Drawing ---
func _update_preview() -> void:
	if not Engine.is_editor_hint(): return
	
	if not is_instance_valid(_preview_node):
		_preview_node = MeshInstance3D.new()
		_im_mesh = ImmediateMesh.new()
		_preview_node.mesh = _im_mesh
		var mat = StandardMaterial3D.new()
		mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
		_preview_node.material_override = mat
		add_child(_preview_node)
	
	_im_mesh.clear_surfaces()
	_im_mesh.surface_begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_LINES)
	
	if spawn_mode == SpawnMode.JET:
		_preview_node.material_override.albedo_color = Color.ORANGE_RED
		var arrow_length = 2.5
		var p_from = Vector3.ZERO
		var p_to = jet_direction * arrow_length
		
		_im_mesh.surface_add_vertex(p_from)
		_im_mesh.surface_add_vertex(p_to)
		
		var up = Vector3.UP if abs(jet_direction.y) < 0.99 else Vector3.RIGHT
		var arrow_basis = Basis.looking_at(jet_direction, up)
		var tip_size = 0.4
		
		_im_mesh.surface_add_vertex(p_to)
		_im_mesh.surface_add_vertex(p_to + arrow_basis.x * tip_size - arrow_basis.z * tip_size)
		_im_mesh.surface_add_vertex(p_to)
		_im_mesh.surface_add_vertex(p_to - arrow_basis.x * tip_size - arrow_basis.z * tip_size)
		_im_mesh.surface_add_vertex(p_to)
		_im_mesh.surface_add_vertex(p_to + arrow_basis.y * tip_size - arrow_basis.z * tip_size)
		_im_mesh.surface_add_vertex(p_to)
		_im_mesh.surface_add_vertex(p_to - arrow_basis.y * tip_size - arrow_basis.z * tip_size)
		
	elif spawn_mode == SpawnMode.AREA:
		_preview_node.material_override.albedo_color = Color.GREEN_YELLOW
		var h = area_spawn_area_size / 2.0
		var corners = [
			Vector3(-h.x, -h.y, -h.z), Vector3(h.x, -h.y, -h.z), Vector3(h.x, -h.y, h.z), Vector3(-h.x, -h.y, h.z),
			Vector3(-h.x, h.y, -h.z),  Vector3(h.x, h.y, -h.z),  Vector3(h.x, h.y, h.z),  Vector3(-h.x, h.y, h.z)
		]
		var lines = [ 0,1, 1,2, 2,3, 3,0, 4,5, 5,6, 6,7, 7,4, 0,4, 1,5, 2,6, 3,7 ]
		for idx in lines: _im_mesh.surface_add_vertex(corners[idx])
			
	_im_mesh.surface_end()


# --- Core Logic Interface ---

func reset_and_spawn() -> void:
	clear_all_spawned()
	match spawn_mode:
		SpawnMode.AREA: _spawn_in_area()
		SpawnMode.JET: _start_jet_spray()

func clear_all_spawned() -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(jet_timer): jet_timer.stop()
	jet_spawn_count = 0
	
	var bodies = get_children().filter(func(c): return c.has_meta("type_index"))
	
	for body in bodies:
		if use_pooling: _return_to_pool(body)
		else:
			if is_instance_valid(body):
				active_count = max(active_count - 1, 0)
				body.queue_free()
	total_spawned = 0
	if not use_pooling: active_count = 0
	print("Spawner: All spawned objects cleared.")


# --- Spawning Logic ---

func _spawn_in_area() -> void:
	for type_index in object_scenes.size():
		if enable_max_limit and active_count >= max_active_bodies: break
		_spawn_one_object(type_index, _setup_area_body)

func _start_jet_spray() -> void:
	if jet_frequency <= 0: return
	jet_spawn_count = 0
	jet_timer.wait_time = 1.0 / jet_frequency
	jet_timer.start()

func _on_jet_timer_timeout() -> void:
	if jet_spawn_count >= jet_quantity or object_scenes.is_empty():
		jet_timer.stop()
		print("Spawner: Jet spray complete. Total objects spawned: ", jet_spawn_count)
		return
	var random_type_index = randi() % object_scenes.size()
	_spawn_one_object(random_type_index, _setup_jet_body)
	jet_spawn_count += 1

func _spawn_one_object(type_index: int, setup_func: Callable) -> void:
	if enable_max_limit and active_count >= max_active_bodies:
		if spawn_mode == SpawnMode.JET and is_instance_valid(jet_timer) and not jet_timer.is_stopped():
			jet_timer.stop()
			push_warning("Spawner: Jet spray terminated early due to max_active_bodies limit (%d)." % max_active_bodies)
		return

	var body: RigidBody3D = _get_body_from_pool(type_index)
	setup_func.call(body)
	active_count += 1
	total_spawned += 1

	var cleanup := Timer.new()
	cleanup.wait_time = auto_despawn_time
	cleanup.one_shot = true
	cleanup.timeout.connect(_on_cleanup_timeout.bind(body))
	body.add_child(cleanup)
	body.set_meta("cleanup_timer", cleanup)
	cleanup.start()

func _setup_area_body(body: RigidBody3D) -> void:
	var half_size = area_spawn_area_size / 2.0
	body.global_position = global_position + Vector3(
		randf_range(-half_size.x, half_size.x),
		randf_range(-half_size.y, half_size.y),
		randf_range(-half_size.z, half_size.z)
	)
	body.linear_velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	body.basis = Basis.from_euler(Vector3(randf_range(-PI, PI), randf_range(-PI, PI), randf_range(-PI, PI)))

func _setup_jet_body(body: RigidBody3D) -> void:
	body.global_position = global_position
	var base_dir = (global_transform.basis * jet_direction).normalized()
	var spread_rad = deg_to_rad(jet_spread_angle)
	
	var random_axis = Vector3(randf_range(-1, 1), randf_range(-1, 1), randf_range(-1, 1)).normalized()
	if random_axis.is_zero_approx(): random_axis = Vector3.UP
	var final_dir = base_dir.rotated(random_axis, randf_range(0, spread_rad))

	body.linear_velocity = final_dir * jet_speed
	body.basis = Basis()


# --- Object Pool Management ---

func _initialize_pools() -> void:
	pools.resize(object_scenes.size())
	pool_sets.resize(object_scenes.size())
	for i in object_scenes.size():
		pools[i] = [] as Array[RigidBody3D]
		pool_sets[i] = {}
		_create_pool(object_scenes[i], pools[i], pool_sets[i], i)

func _get_body_from_pool(type_index: int) -> RigidBody3D:
	var scene = object_scenes[type_index]
	var body: RigidBody3D

	if use_pooling:
		var pool = pools[type_index]
		var pool_set = pool_sets[type_index]
		if not pool.is_empty():
			body = pool.pop_back()
			pool_set.erase(body)
		else:
			body = scene.instantiate()
			add_child(body)
			body.set_meta("type_index", type_index)
		_clear_cleanup_timer(body)
	else:
		body = scene.instantiate()
		add_child(body)
		body.set_meta("type_index", type_index)

	body.freeze = false
	body.visible = true
	return body

func _on_cleanup_timeout(body: RigidBody3D) -> void:
	if use_pooling: 
		_return_to_pool(body)
	else:
		if is_instance_valid(body):
			active_count = max(active_count - 1, 0)
			body.queue_free()

func _create_pool(scene: PackedScene, pool: Array[RigidBody3D], pool_set: Dictionary, type_index: int) -> void:
	for i in pool_size_per_type:
		var body: RigidBody3D = scene.instantiate()
		body.freeze = true
		body.visible = false
		add_child(body)
		body.set_meta("type_index", type_index)
		pool.append(body)
		pool_set[body] = true

func _return_to_pool(body: RigidBody3D) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(body): return
	_clear_cleanup_timer(body)
	active_count = max(active_count - 1, 0)
	body.freeze = true
	body.visible = false
	body.linear_velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	
	var type_index: int = body.get_meta("type_index", 0)
	if pools[type_index].size() < MAX_POOL_SIZE:
		pools[type_index].append(body)
		pool_sets[type_index][body] = true
	else:
		body.queue_free()

func _clear_cleanup_timer(body: RigidBody3D) -> void:
	if body.has_meta("cleanup_timer"):
		var timer = body.get_meta("cleanup_timer")
		if is_instance_valid(timer): timer.queue_free()
		body.remove_meta("cleanup_timer")


// res://water/events/IWSWaterVFXManager.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Event;

using Godot;
using System;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Profile;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;

/// <summary>
/// Subscribes to the WaterEventBus to handle decoupled visual effects (VFX).
/// Utilizes the Flyweight/Object Pool pattern to maintain performance and prevent GC allocation spikes.
/// Integrates with the simulation layer by dynamically spawning surface followers and injecting secondary impulses.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterVFXManager : Node
{
    [ExportGroup("VFX Scenes")]
    [Export] public PackedScene SplashScene;
    [Export] public PackedScene WakeScene;

    [ExportGroup("Pool Settings")]
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "4,32")]  public int SplashPoolSize = 12;
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "4,32")]  public int WakePoolSize   = 8;

    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.5,10.0")]
    public float ParticleTimeoutSec = 4.0f;

    [ExportGroup("Spawn Thresholds")]
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,0.5")] public float SplashMinStrength     = 0.05f;
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,0.5")] public float WakeMinSubmergedRatio = 0.1f;

    [ExportGroup("Advanced")]
    [Export] public bool EnableSecondaryRipples = true;
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,1.0")]
    public float SecondaryRippleStrengthScale = 0.20f;
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.05,1.0")]
    public float SecondaryRippleDelaySec = 0.18f;

    private GpuParticles3D[] _splashPool;
    private GpuParticles3D[] _wakePool;
    private bool[]           _splashInUse;
    private bool[]           _wakeInUse;

    private double[] _splashActivatedAt;
    private double[] _wakeActivatedAt;

    private int _splashMissed;
    private int _wakeMissed;

    private bool _splashPoolReady = false;
    private bool _wakePoolReady   = false;

    private bool _loggedFirstSplash = false;
    private bool _loggedFirstWake   = false;

    public override void _Ready()
    {
        WaterEventBus.Clear();

        WaterEventBus.OnSplash += HandleSplash;
        WaterEventBus.OnWake   += HandleWake;

        if (SplashScene != null)
        {
            _splashPool        = new GpuParticles3D[SplashPoolSize];
            _splashInUse       = new bool[SplashPoolSize];
            _splashActivatedAt = new double[SplashPoolSize];
            BuildPool(_splashPool, _splashInUse, _splashActivatedAt, SplashScene, "SplashPool");
            _splashPoolReady = true;
            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterVFXManager] Splash pool initialized | size={SplashPoolSize}");
        }
        else
        {
            GD.PushWarning("[IWSWaterVFXManager] SplashScene is not assigned. Splash VFX is disabled.");
        }

        if (WakeScene != null)
        {
            _wakePool        = new GpuParticles3D[WakePoolSize];
            _wakeInUse       = new bool[WakePoolSize];
            _wakeActivatedAt = new double[WakePoolSize];
            BuildPool(_wakePool, _wakeInUse, _wakeActivatedAt, WakeScene, "WakePool");
            _wakePoolReady = true;
            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterVFXManager] Wake pool initialized | size={WakePoolSize}");
        }
        else
        {
            GD.PushWarning("[IWSWaterVFXManager] WakeScene is not assigned. Wake VFX is disabled.");
        }
    }

    public override void _ExitTree()
    {
        WaterEventBus.OnSplash -= HandleSplash;
        WaterEventBus.OnWake   -= HandleWake;
        WaterEventBus.Clear();
    }

    public override void _Process(double delta)
    {
        double now = Time.GetTicksMsec() * 0.001;
        CheckPoolTimeout(_splashPool, _splashInUse, _splashActivatedAt, now);
        CheckPoolTimeout(_wakePool,   _wakeInUse,   _wakeActivatedAt,   now);
    }

    private void CheckPoolTimeout(GpuParticles3D[] pool, bool[] inUse, double[] activatedAt, double now)
    {
        if (pool == null) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < pool.Length; i++)
        {
            if (!inUse[i]) continue;
            if (now - activatedAt[i] > ParticleTimeoutSec)
                inUse[i] = false;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Injects water profile properties into GPUParticles3D instance parameters.
    /// Note: Per-instance uniforms are strictly supported in Spatial Shaders in Godot 4.x.
    /// </summary>
    private static void ApplyWaterInstanceParams(GpuParticles3D p, IWSWaterProfile profile)
    {
        if (p == null || profile == null) return;

        DerivedOptics d = profile.GetDerivedOptics();

        p.SetInstanceShaderParameter("water_color_shallow", profile.ColorShallow);
        p.SetInstanceShaderParameter("water_foam_color",    profile.FoamColor);
        p.SetInstanceShaderParameter("water_turbidity",     profile.Turbidity);
        p.SetInstanceShaderParameter("water_absorption_rgb", d.AbsorptionRGB);
        p.SetInstanceShaderParameter("water_scattering",     d.ScatteringIntensity);
    }

    private void HandleSplash(WaterSplashEvent e)
    {
        if (e.Strength < SplashMinStrength) return;
        if (!_splashPoolReady) return;

        int slot = FindFreeSlot(_splashInUse);
        if (slot < 0)
        {
            _splashMissed++;
            if (_splashMissed % 30 == 1)
                GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterVFXManager] Splash pool exhausted, discarding effect (Total missed: {_splashMissed}). Consider increasing SplashPoolSize.");
            return;
        }

        var particles = _splashPool[slot];
        _splashInUse[slot]       = true;
        _splashActivatedAt[slot] = Time.GetTicksMsec() * 0.001;

        IWSWaterProfile profile = e.Profile ?? e.Body?.GetProfile();
        if (profile != null)
            ApplyWaterInstanceParams(particles, profile);

        particles.GlobalPosition = e.WorldPos;

        float scale = Mathf.Clamp(0.35f + e.Strength * 1.8f, 0.25f, 3.0f);
        particles.Scale = Vector3.One * scale;

        particles.Restart();
        particles.Emitting = true;

        if (!_loggedFirstSplash)
        {
            _loggedFirstSplash = true;
            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterVFXManager] First Splash received | body='{e.Body?.Name ?? "null"}' str={e.Strength:F2} r={e.WorldRadius:F2}");
        }

        // Generate secondary ripples on the GPU simulation layer when the splash droplets hit the surface.
        if (EnableSecondaryRipples && e.Body != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(e.Body))
        {
            if (e.Strength > 0.12f)
            {
                float secStr = Mathf.Clamp(e.Strength * SecondaryRippleStrengthScale, 0f, 0.25f);
                float secRad = Mathf.Clamp(e.WorldRadius * 0.65f, 0.15f, 2.0f);

                Vector3 pos = e.WorldPos;
                IWSWaterBody body = e.Body;

                var timer = GetTree().CreateTimer(SecondaryRippleDelaySec);
                timer.Timeout += () =>
                {
                    if (body == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(body)) return;
                    body.AddImpulse(new WaterImpulse(pos, secRad, secStr, e.SourceId));
                };
            }
        }
    }

    private void HandleWake(WaterWakeEvent e)
    {
        if (e.SubmergedRatio < WakeMinSubmergedRatio) return;
        if (!_wakePoolReady) return;

        int slot = FindFreeSlot(_wakeInUse);
        if (slot < 0)
        {
            _wakeMissed++;
            return;
        }

        var particles = _wakePool[slot];
        _wakeInUse[slot]       = true;
        _wakeActivatedAt[slot] = Time.GetTicksMsec() * 0.001;

        IWSWaterProfile profile = e.Profile ?? e.Body?.GetProfile();
        if (profile != null)
            ApplyWaterInstanceParams(particles, profile);

        particles.GlobalPosition = e.WorldPos;

        Vector3 velXZ = new Vector3(e.Velocity.X, 0f, e.Velocity.Z);
        if (velXZ.LengthSquared() > 0.01f)
            particles.LookAt(e.WorldPos + velXZ, Vector3.Up);

        float scale = Mathf.Clamp(e.SubmergedRatio * 1.2f, 0.2f, 1.8f);
        particles.Scale = Vector3.One * scale;

        // Dynamically attach a surface follower to ensure the wake adheres to the simulated waves.
        if (e.Body != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(e.Body))
        {
            var follower = particles.GetNodeOrNull<IWSWaterVFXSurfaceFollower>("SurfaceFollower");
            if (follower == null)
            {
                follower = new IWSWaterVFXSurfaceFollower { Name = "SurfaceFollower" };
                particles.AddChild(follower);
            }
            
            follower.Mode = IWSWaterVFXSurfaceFollower.FollowMode.HeightNormalAndFlowDrift;
            follower.UpdateHz = 30f;
            follower.NormalAlign = 0.18f;
            follower.FlowDriftScale = 1.0f;
            follower.Configure(e.Body, new Vector2(e.WorldPos.X, e.WorldPos.Z));
        }

        particles.Restart();
        particles.Emitting = true;

        if (!_loggedFirstWake)
        {
            _loggedFirstWake = true;
            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterVFXManager] First Wake received | body='{e.Body?.Name ?? "null"}' sub={e.SubmergedRatio:F2} r={e.WorldRadius:F2}");
        }
    }

    private void BuildPool(
        GpuParticles3D[] pool, bool[] inUse, double[] activatedAt,
        PackedScene scene, string groupName)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < pool.Length; i++)
        {
            var instance = scene.Instantiate();
            if (instance is not GpuParticles3D particles)
            {
                GD.PushError($"[IWSWaterVFXManager] {groupName}[{i}]: The root node of the PackedScene must be of type GpuParticles3D.");
                instance.QueueFree();
                continue;
            }

            particles.OneShot  = true;
            particles.Emitting = false;
            AddChild(particles);
            
            pool[i]        = particles;
            activatedAt[i] = 0.0;

            int    capturedIndex = i;
            bool[] capturedUse   = inUse;
            particles.Finished += () => capturedUse[capturedIndex] = false;
        }
    }

    private static int FindFreeSlot(bool[] inUse)
    {
        if (inUse == null) return -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < inUse.Length; i++)
            if (!inUse[i]) return i;
        return -1;
    }
}

// res://water/events/IWSWaterVFXSurfaceFollower.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Event;

using Godot;
using System;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;

/// <summary>
/// Attaches a parent Node3D (typically a GPUParticles3D) to the surface of a specified IWSWaterBody.
/// Utilizes SampleWaterRender (Render Time Domain) to avoid 60Hz physics jitter, ensuring visual smoothness.
/// Optionally drifts with the flow velocity for realistic foam or wake advection behavior.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterVFXSurfaceFollower : Node
{
    public enum FollowMode
    {
        HeightOnly,
        HeightAndNormal,
        HeightNormalAndFlowDrift,
    }

    [Export] public FollowMode Mode = FollowMode.HeightAndNormal;

    /// <summary>
    /// Update frequency in Hz. 30Hz is generally smooth enough and saves sampling overhead.
    /// </summary>
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "5,120")]
    public float UpdateHz = 30f;

    /// <summary>
    /// Normal alignment strength (0 = no alignment, 1 = instant alignment).
    /// </summary>
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0,1")]
    public float NormalAlign = 0.25f;

    /// <summary>
    /// Scale multiplier for drifting with the flow velocity.
    /// </summary>
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0,2")]
    public float FlowDriftScale = 1.0f;

    private IWSWaterBody _body;
    private Vector2      _xz;
    private double       _accum;
    private Node3D       _target;

    private bool _logged = false;

    public void Configure(IWSWaterBody body, Vector2 initialXZ)
    {
        _body = body;
        _xz   = initialXZ;
    }

    public override void _Ready()
    {
        _target = GetParentOrNull<Node3D>();
        if (_target == null)
        {
            GD.PushWarning("[IWSWaterVFXSurfaceFollower] Must be used as a child of a Node3D.");
            SetProcess(false);
        }
    }

    public override void _ExitTree()
    {
        _body   = null;
        _target = null;
    }

    public override void _Process(double delta)
    {
        if (_target == null) return;
        
        if (_body == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_body))
        {
            SetProcess(false);
            return;
        }

        float step = 1.0f / Mathf.Max(UpdateHz, 1f);
        _accum += delta;
        if (_accum < step) return;
        _accum = 0.0;

        Vector3 query = new Vector3(_xz.X, _target.GlobalPosition.Y, _xz.Y);
        WaterSample s = _body.SampleWaterRender(query);
        if (!s.IsValid) return;

        Vector3 pos = _target.GlobalPosition;
        pos.Y = s.Height;
        _target.GlobalPosition = pos;

        if (Mode == FollowMode.HeightNormalAndFlowDrift)
        {
            Vector3 fv = s.FlowVelocity;
            _xz += new Vector2(fv.X, fv.Z) * (float)step * FlowDriftScale;
        }

        if (Mode != FollowMode.HeightOnly && NormalAlign > 0.001f)
        {
            Vector3 up = s.Normal.LengthSquared() > 0.0001f ? s.Normal.Normalized() : Vector3.Up;

            Vector3 fwd = -_target.GlobalTransform.Basis.Z;
            if (fwd.LengthSquared() < 0.0001f) fwd = Vector3.Forward;

            Vector3 right = fwd.Cross(up);
            if (right.LengthSquared() < 1e-6f)
                right = Vector3.Right.Cross(up);
            right = right.Normalized();

            fwd = up.Cross(right).Normalized();
            Basis targetBasis = new Basis(right, up, -fwd);

            Quaternion qa = _target.GlobalBasis.GetRotationQuaternion();
            Quaternion qb = targetBasis.GetRotationQuaternion();
            Quaternion q  = qa.Slerp(qb, NormalAlign);
            _target.GlobalBasis = new Basis(q);
        }

        if (!_logged)
        {
            _logged = true;
            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterVFXSurfaceFollower] Enabled | target='{_target.Name}' body='{_body.Name}' mode={Mode} hz={UpdateHz}");
        }
    }
}

// res://water/events/WaterEventBus.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Event;

using Godot;
using IWS.Water.Profile;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;

// ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Context-aware event structures for decoupled VFX, Audio, and Decal systems.
// Zero GC structures to comply with the high-frequency physics cycle.
// ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public struct WaterSplashEvent
{
    // Recommended: Already snapped to the water surface (Y = SurfaceHeight).
    public Vector3 WorldPos;        
    // Radius of influence (used for VFX scaling and secondary ripples).
    public float   WorldRadius;     
    // Range: [0, 1].
    public float   Strength;        
    // Range: [0, 1] (Optional: Extracted from buoyancy/collision energy).
    public float   Energy;          
    public int     SourceId;

    // Context Context
    // The water body associated with the event (can be null; requires validation).
    public IWSWaterBody    Body;           
    // Quick access to the water profile (typically Body.Profile).
    public IWSWaterProfile Profile;        
    // World Y coordinate.
    public float           SurfaceHeight;  
    // Normalized world normal.
    public Vector3         SurfaceNormal;  
    // Velocity of the triggering object (useful for splash direction).
    public Vector3         SourceVelocity; 
}

public struct WaterWakeEvent
{
    // Recommended: Already snapped to the water surface.
    public Vector3 WorldPos;        
    // Reference width for the wake.
    public float   WorldRadius;     
    // Range: [0, 1] (Optional: Wake strength).
    public float   Strength;        
    // Velocity of the triggering object.
    public Vector3 Velocity;        
    // Range: [0, 1].
    public float   SubmergedRatio;  
    public int     SourceId;

    // Context
    public IWSWaterBody    Body;
    public IWSWaterProfile Profile;
    public float           SurfaceHeight;
    public Vector3         SurfaceNormal;
}

/// <summary>
/// A thread-safe, lock-free thin wrapper that delegates to the queues on the globally unique IWSWaterManager singleton.
/// Acts as the primary decoupled subscription point for the Events Layer, separating physics logic from visual manifestation.
/// </summary>
public static class WaterEventBus
{
    public static void EnqueueSplash(in WaterSplashEvent e)
        => IWSWaterManager.Instance?.EnqueueSplash(e);

    public static void EnqueueWake(in WaterWakeEvent e)
        => IWSWaterManager.Instance?.EnqueueWake(e);

    /// <summary>
    /// Legacy compatibility: Cleanup is now managed internally by the IWSWaterManager instance.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Clear() { }

    public static event System.Action<WaterSplashEvent> OnSplash
    {
        add    => IWSWaterManager.SubscribeOnSplash(value);
        remove => IWSWaterManager.UnsubscribeOnSplash(value);
    }

    public static event System.Action<WaterWakeEvent> OnWake
    {
        add    => IWSWaterManager.SubscribeOnWake(value);
        remove => IWSWaterManager.UnsubscribeOnWake(value);
    }

    public static int TotalSplashEnqueued
        => IWSWaterManager.Instance?._totalSplashEnqueued ?? 0;
        
    public static int TotalWakeEnqueued
        => IWSWaterManager.Instance?._totalWakeEnqueued ?? 0;
}

// res://water/fields/IWSGerstnerField.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Field;

using Godot;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;

/// <summary>
/// Analytical wave field implementation using Gerstner waves.
/// Utilizes finite Newton iteration for inverse root finding to accurately calculate horizontal displacement (Choppy effect).
/// </summary>
public class IWSGerstnerField : WaterField
{
    public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;
    private readonly IWSWaterBody _owner;

    // Divergence protection: Maximum correction distance per iteration (in meters).
    private const float MAX_ITER_CORRECTION = 2.0f;
    // Convergence threshold: Early exit if the squared error falls below this value.
    private const float CONVERGE_THRESHOLD_SQ = 0.0001f * 0.0001f;

    public IWSGerstnerField(IWSWaterBody owner) => _owner = owner;

    /// <summary>
    /// Rendering frame path. Utilizes the rendering time with physics interpolation for visual smoothness.
    /// </summary>
    public void Evaluate(Vector3 worldPos, double time, ref WaterSample sample)
        => EvaluateInternal(worldPos, time, ref sample);

    /// <summary>
    /// Physics frame path. Utilizes the physics time (strictly matching the physics tick rate).
    /// Overrides the default interface implementation to strictly separate physics and rendering time domains.
    /// </summary>
    public void EvaluatePhysics(Vector3 worldPos, double physicsTime, ref WaterSample sample)
        => EvaluateInternal(worldPos, physicsTime, ref sample);

    /// <summary>
    /// Shared core computation for evaluating the Gerstner wave field at a given time.
    /// </summary>
    private void EvaluateInternal(Vector3 worldPos, double time, ref WaterSample sample)
    {
        if (_owner.Waves == null || _owner.Waves.Count == 0) return;

        float t = (float)time;

        // Inverse root finding: Determine the origin coordinates before horizontal displacement occurs.
        Vector2 targetXZ = new Vector2(worldPos.X, worldPos.Z);
        Vector2 guessXZ  = targetXZ;

        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        {
            Vector2 disp  = CalculateHorizontalDisplacement(guessXZ, t);
            Vector2 error = (guessXZ + disp) - targetXZ;

            // Divergence protection: Limit the correction amplitude of a single step.
            float errLen = error.Length();
            if (errLen > MAX_ITER_CORRECTION)
                error = error / errLen * MAX_ITER_CORRECTION;

            guessXZ -= error;

            // Early exit upon reaching convergence.
            if (error.LengthSquared() < CONVERGE_THRESHOLD_SQ) break;
        }

        // Calculate height, normal, and velocity at the resolved origin coordinates.
        float   h   = 0f;
        float   vX  = 0f, vY = 0f, vZ = 0f;
        Vector2 dxz = Vector2.Zero;

        float nexp = _owner.GetProfile()?.WaveNonlinearExp ?? 1.3f;
        nexp = Mathf.Max(nexp, 1.0f);

        foreach (var wave in _owner.Waves)
        {
            if (wave == null) continue;
            if (wave.Amplitude < 0.0001f || wave.Wavelength < 0.0001f) continue;

            float   k     = Mathf.Tau / wave.Wavelength;
