            Vector2 d     = wave.GetNormalizedDirection();
            float   phase = k * (d.X * guessXZ.X + d.Y * guessXZ.Y) - wave.Speed * t;
            float   sp    = Mathf.Sin(phase);
            float   cp    = Mathf.Cos(phase);
            float   absSp = Mathf.Abs(sp);

            h += wave.Amplitude * Mathf.Pow(absSp, nexp) * Mathf.Sign(sp);

            float powTerm = (absSp < 1e-5f)
                ? 0f
                : wave.Amplitude * nexp * Mathf.Pow(absSp, nexp - 1f) * cp;

            dxz += d * (powTerm * k);

            vY += -powTerm * wave.Speed;

            float horizVel = wave.Steepness * wave.Amplitude * sp * wave.Speed;
            vX += d.X * horizVel;
            vZ += d.Y * horizVel;
        }

        sample.Height += h;
        Vector3 waveNormal = new Vector3(-dxz.X, 1.0f, -dxz.Y).Normalized();
        sample.Normal          = (sample.Normal + waveNormal).Normalized();
        sample.WaveGradientXZ += dxz;
        sample.Velocity       += new Vector3(vX, vY, vZ);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates only the horizontal displacement (Used specifically for inverse root finding).
    /// </summary>
    private Vector2 CalculateHorizontalDisplacement(Vector2 posXZ, float time)
    {
        Vector2 disp = Vector2.Zero;
        foreach (var wave in _owner.Waves)
        {
            if (wave == null) continue;
            float   k     = Mathf.Tau / wave.Wavelength;
            Vector2 d     = wave.GetNormalizedDirection();
            float   phase = k * (d.X * posXZ.X + d.Y * posXZ.Y) - wave.Speed * time;
            disp += d * (wave.Steepness * wave.Amplitude * Mathf.Cos(phase));
        }
        return disp;
    }
}

// res://water/fields/IWSRippleField.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Field;

using Godot;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;
using IWS.Water.Simulation;

/// <summary>
/// Interactive wave field.
/// Retrieves GPU Compute Shader interaction ripple data via the simulation manager.
/// </summary>
public class IWSRippleField : WaterField
{
	public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;

	private readonly IWSRippleSimMgr  _simulator;
	private readonly WaterZoneShape   _shape;
	private readonly IWSWaterBody     _owner;

	public IWSRippleField(IWSRippleSimMgr simulator, WaterZoneShape shape, IWSWaterBody owner)
	{
		_simulator = simulator;
		_shape     = shape;
		_owner     = owner;
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Rendering frame path: Uses the rendering frame UV mapping to align visuals.
	/// </summary>
	public void Evaluate(Vector3 worldPos, double time, ref WaterSample sample)
	{
		if (_simulator == null || _shape == null) return;

		Vector2 uv = _shape.WorldToUV(worldPos);
		ApplySample(uv, ref sample);
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Physics frame overload: Uses the physics frame UV mapping to maintain temporal consistency with interaction injection.
	/// </summary>
	public void EvaluatePhysics(Vector3 worldPos, double physicsTime, ref WaterSample sample)
	{
		if (_simulator == null || _shape == null) return;

		Vector2 uv = _shape.WorldToUV_Physics(worldPos);
		ApplySample(uv, ref sample);
	}

	private void ApplySample(Vector2 uv, ref WaterSample sample)
	{
		if (uv.X < 0f || uv.X > 1f || uv.Y < 0f || uv.Y > 1f) return;

		// Read RipplePhysicsScale from Profile to ensure a single source of truth.
		float physicsScale = _owner.GetProfile()?.RipplePhysicsScale ?? 0.06f;

		sample.Height += _simulator.SampleHeightAtUV(uv) * physicsScale;
		sample.Energy  = Mathf.Max(sample.Energy, _simulator.SampleEnergyAtUV(uv));
		sample.Foam    = Mathf.Max(sample.Foam,   _simulator.SampleFoamAtUV(uv));
	}
}


// res://water/fields/IWSTextureFlowField.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Field;

using Godot;
using IWS.Water.Core;

/// <summary>
/// Texture-based flow field.
/// Reads a baked 2D FlowMap to drive water surface advection and static river/ocean currents.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSTextureFlowField : Resource, WaterField
{
	public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;

	[Export] public Texture2D FlowMap;
	[Export] public float FlowStrength = 5.0f;

	private Vector2[] _cpuFlowData;
	private int _width, _height;
	private WaterZoneShape _shape;

	public void Initialize(WaterZoneShape shape)
	{
		_shape = shape;
		if (FlowMap == null) return;

		Image img = FlowMap.GetImage();
		if (img == null) return;

		img.Resize(64, 64, Image.Interpolation.Bilinear);
		_width  = img.GetWidth();
		_height = img.GetHeight();
		_cpuFlowData = new Vector2[_width * _height];

		for (int y = 0; y < _height; y++)
		for (int x = 0; x < _width;  x++)
		{
			Color c = img.GetPixel(x, y);
			_cpuFlowData[y * _width + x] = new Vector2(c.R * 2f - 1f, c.G * 2f - 1f);
		}
		GD.Print($"[IWSTextureFlowField] Baked flow field {_width}x{_height}");
	}

	public void Evaluate(Vector3 worldPos, double time, ref WaterSample sample)
	{
		if (_cpuFlowData == null || _shape == null) return;

		// Both rendering and physics paths use WorldToUV as the texture flow field is static.
		Vector2 uv = _shape.WorldToUV(worldPos);
		ApplyFlow(uv, ref sample);
	}

	private void ApplyFlow(Vector2 uv, ref WaterSample sample)
	{
		if (uv.X < 0f || uv.X > 1f || uv.Y < 0f || uv.Y > 1f) return;

		int x = Mathf.Clamp((int)(uv.X * _width),  0, _width  - 1);
		int y = Mathf.Clamp((int)(uv.Y * _height), 0, _height - 1);

		Vector2 flowXZ = _cpuFlowData[y * _width + x] * FlowStrength;
		sample.FlowVelocity += new Vector3(flowXZ.X, 0f, flowXZ.Y);
	}
}


// res://water/fields/IWSWaterFieldComposite.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Field;

using Godot;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using IWS.Water.Core;

/// <summary>
/// Composite pattern implementation for water fields.
/// Unifies multiple distinct fields (e.g., Gerstner, Ripple, TextureFlow) into a single queryable WaterField object,
/// facilitating a centralized evaluation of the total water surface state.
/// </summary>
public sealed class IWSWaterFieldComposite : WaterField
{
    public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;

    private readonly List<WaterField> _fields = new List<WaterField>(4);

    public void AddField(WaterField field)
    {
        if (field != null) _fields.Add(field);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Rendering frame path. Evaluates all active sub-fields and accumulates the sample results.
    /// </summary>
    public void Evaluate(Vector3 worldPos, double time, ref WaterSample sample)
    {
        if (!IsActive) return;
        foreach (var field in _fields)
        {
            if (field.IsActive) 
                field.Evaluate(worldPos, time, ref sample);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Physics frame path.
    /// Calls EvaluatePhysics() on each active sub-field. Specific fields can override this 
    /// for optimized or domain-accurate physics evaluations.
    /// </summary>
    public void EvaluatePhysics(Vector3 worldPos, double physicsTime, ref WaterSample sample)
    {
        if (!IsActive) return;
        foreach (var field in _fields)
        {
            if (field.IsActive) 
                field.EvaluatePhysics(worldPos, physicsTime, ref sample);
        }
    }
}

// res://water/interaction/IWSCharacterWaterInteraction.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Interaction;

using Godot;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;
using IWS.Water.Event;

/// <summary>
/// Water interaction component specifically designed for CharacterBody3D.
///
/// Responsibilities:
///   1. Sensor: Calculates the character's current submerged depth (SubmergedRatio) 
///      for the character controller to implement wading deceleration, swimming buoyancy, etc. 
///      The water system does not reversely control character movement.
///   2. Emitter: Implements IWSWaterDisturbanceEmitter, centrally scheduled by IWSWaterManager,
///      submitting three types of disturbance commands per physics frame:
///        - Splash (Entry impact, BrushMode.Velocity)
///        - Wake (Wading trail, LineShear / Impact)
///        - SurfaceFlow (Foam transport flow field, BrushMode.SurfaceFlow)
///
/// Hierarchy Setup:
///   Player (CharacterBody3D)
///     └ IWSCharacterWaterInteraction   <- This component
///
/// Design Principles:
///   - Non-intrusive: Injects into the main pipeline via interfaces without modifying existing systems.
///   - Prioritizes automatic character shape estimation, with Inspector overrides as a fallback.
///   - SubmergedRatio is output via a low-pass filter to prevent jitter caused by minor water surface perturbations.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSCharacterWaterInteraction : Node, IWSWaterDisturbanceEmitter
{
	// --- References ---
	[ExportGroup("References")]
	[Export] public CharacterBody3D  TargetCharacter;
	[Export] public CollisionShape3D BodyShape;

	// --- Shape Override (0 = auto-estimate from CollisionShape3D) ---
	[ExportGroup("Character Shape Override (0 = auto)")]
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,5.0")]
	public float HeightOverride    = 0f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,2.0")]
	public float RadiusOverride    = 0f;
	/// <summary>
	/// The Y offset of the feet relative to the character's origin. Positive values shift upwards 
	/// (if origin is at the center, use -halfHeight).
	/// 0 indicates automatic calculation (inferred from CollisionShape, supporting origins at feet or center).
	/// </summary>
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "-3.0,3.0")]
	public float FootOffsetOverride = 0f;

	// --- Filtering ---
	[ExportGroup("Filter")]
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.5,15.0")]
	public float SignedDistFilterHz = 5.0f;

	// --- Splash (Entry Impact) ---
	[ExportGroup("Splash (Entry Impact)")]
	[Export] public float SplashMinEntrySpeed  = 0.8f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.5,20.0")]
	public float ImpactStrengthK               = 4.0f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,0.5")]
	public float MinSplashStrength             = 0.04f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.1,2.0")]
	public float SplashCooldownSec             = 0.5f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "1.0,4.0")]
	public float SplashRadiusScale             = 1.5f;

	// --- Wake (Wading Trail) ---
	[ExportGroup("Wake (Wading Trail)")]
	[Export] public float WakeMinSpeed          = 0.2f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.01,0.3")]
	public float WakeIntensityScale             = 0.06f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,0.5")]
	public float WakeMaxStrength                = 0.18f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.3,2.0")]
	public float WakeRadiusScale                = 2.0f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.05,1.0")]
	public float WakeEventInterval              = 0.15f;
	/// <summary>
	/// Injection trigger threshold for swept interactions: Uses LineShear when the displacement 
	/// exceeds (radius * this factor); otherwise, falls back to a point Impact.
	/// </summary>
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.1,1.0")]
	public float SweptThresholdFactor           = 0.4f;

	// --- Surface Flow (Foam Transport) ---
	[ExportGroup("Surface Flow (Foam Transport)")]
	[Export] public bool  EnableSurfaceFlow          = true;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,2.0")]
	public float SurfaceFlowStrengthScale            = 0.6f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "1.0,4.0")]
	public float SurfaceFlowRadiusScale              = 2.5f;
	[Export] public float SurfaceFlowMinSpeed        = 0.15f;

	// --- Global Settings ---
	[ExportGroup("Settings")]
	[Export] public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;

	// --- Public State (Read-only for character controller) ---
	/// <summary>Submerged ratio [0,1], low-pass filtered. 0 = fully above water, 1 = submerged over the head.</summary>
	public float SubmergedRatio        { get; private set; } = 0f;
	/// <summary>Indicates if currently in contact with the water volume (SubmergedRatio > 0.01).</summary>
	public bool  IsInWater             => SubmergedRatio > 0.01f;
	/// <summary>The currently associated water body. Null if outside the water bounds.</summary>
	public IWSWaterBody CurrentWaterBody { get; private set; }
	/// <summary>Current water surface world Y height (unfiltered, used for VFX/Camera logic).</summary>
	public float SurfaceHeight         { get; private set; }

	// --- Internal State ---
	private float   _cachedEffectiveHeight = -1f;
	private float   _cachedEffectiveRadius = -1f;
	private float   _cachedFootOffsetY     = float.NaN;

	private float   _smoothedSignedDist    = float.MaxValue;
	private float   _prevSignedDist        = float.MaxValue;
	private float   _splashCooldown        = 0f;

	private float   _wakeEventTimer        = 0f;
	private Vector3 _lastSurfacePos;
	private bool    _lastSurfacePosValid   = false;

	private WaterQuery _cachedWaterQuery;

	// --- Debug Flags ---
	private bool _debugShapeLogged       = false;
	private bool _debugFirstWaterLogged  = false;
	private bool _debugFirstSplashLogged = false;
	private bool _debugFirstWakeLogged   = false;
	private bool _debugFirstFlowLogged   = false;

	// -------------------------------------------------------------
	// Lifecycle
	// -------------------------------------------------------------
	public override void _Ready()
	{
		// Automatically find the parent node reference if not assigned.
		if (TargetCharacter == null)
			TargetCharacter = GetParentOrNull<CharacterBody3D>();

		if (TargetCharacter == null)
		{
			GD.PushError($"[IWSCharacterWaterInteraction] '{Name}' CharacterBody3D not found. " +
						 "Please assign TargetCharacter manually or attach this as a child of a CharacterBody3D.");
			return;
		}

		// Automatically find the CollisionShape3D (searches for the first match under the parent).
		if (BodyShape == null)
			foreach (var child in TargetCharacter.GetChildren())
				if (child is CollisionShape3D cs) { BodyShape = cs; break; }

		// Pre-parse and cache shape parameters to avoid per-frame calculations.
		_ = GetEffectiveHeight();
		_ = GetEffectiveRadius();
		_ = GetEffectiveFootOffsetY();

		IWSWaterManager.Instance?.RegisterEmitter(this);
	}

	public override void _EnterTree()
	{
		// Ensure registration during hot-reloads.
		if (TargetCharacter != null)
			IWSWaterManager.Instance?.RegisterEmitter(this);
	}

	public override void _ExitTree()
	{
		IWSWaterManager.Instance?.UnregisterEmitter(this);
		base._ExitTree();
	}

	// -------------------------------------------------------------
	// IWSWaterDisturbanceEmitter Implementation
	// -------------------------------------------------------------
	public void CollectDisturbances(
		double physicsTime,
		float  delta,
		List<IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand> output)
	{
		if (!IsActive || TargetCharacter == null) return;

		// Decrement splash cooldown.
		if (_splashCooldown > 0f) _splashCooldown -= delta;

		// --- 1. Fetch character shape parameters ---
		float height      = GetEffectiveHeight();
		float radius      = GetEffectiveRadius();
		float footOffsetY = GetEffectiveFootOffsetY();
		float footY       = TargetCharacter.GlobalPosition.Y + footOffsetY;

		// --- 2. Select water body (cache + bounds fast check) ---
		Vector3 footPos = new Vector3(TargetCharacter.GlobalPosition.X, footY,
									  TargetCharacter.GlobalPosition.Z);

		IWSWaterBody wb = FindWaterCached(footPos);
		CurrentWaterBody = wb;

		if (wb == null)
		{
			// Reset state upon exiting the water body.
			if (_smoothedSignedDist < float.MaxValue)
			{
				_smoothedSignedDist  = float.MaxValue;
				_prevSignedDist      = float.MaxValue;
				_lastSurfacePosValid = false;
				SubmergedRatio       = 0f;
				GD.Print($"[IWSCharacterWaterInteraction] '{TargetCharacter.Name}' left the water body.");
			}
			return;
		}

		WaterSample sample = wb.SampleWater(footPos);
		if (!sample.IsValid) return;

		SurfaceHeight = sample.Height;
		float signedDist = footY - SurfaceHeight; // >0 is above water, <0 is underwater

		// --- 3. Low-pass filter for signedDist ---
		if (_smoothedSignedDist > 1e5f)
		{
			_smoothedSignedDist = signedDist; // First initialization, no interpolation.
			GD.Print($"[IWSCharacterWaterInteraction] '{TargetCharacter.Name}' entered water body " +
					 $"'{wb.Name}' | footY={footY:F3}m surfaceH={SurfaceHeight:F3}m signedDist={signedDist:F3}m");
			_debugFirstWaterLogged = true;
		}
		_smoothedSignedDist = Mathf.Lerp(_smoothedSignedDist, signedDist, delta * SignedDistFilterHz);

		// --- 4. SubmergedRatio Calculation (Non-linear depth weighting) ---
		// Divide water depth (negative signedDist) by character height to get a linear ratio,
		// then apply smoothstep to suppress perceived intensity when fully submerged (swimming contributes less to surface disturbance).
		float rawRatio     = Mathf.Clamp(-_smoothedSignedDist / Mathf.Max(height, 0.01f), 0f, 1f);
		SubmergedRatio     = rawRatio;

		// Depth weight for "disturbance intensity": Strongest at waist depth (0.4~0.6), attenuated when fully submerged (>0.85).
		float subWeight = Mathf.SmoothStep(0.05f, 0.55f, rawRatio)
						* (1f - Mathf.SmoothStep(0.80f, 1.0f, rawRatio));

		Vector3 vel          = TargetCharacter.Velocity;
		float   speedXZ      = new Vector2(vel.X, vel.Z).Length();
		Vector3 surfaceCenter = new Vector3(
			TargetCharacter.GlobalPosition.X, SurfaceHeight, TargetCharacter.GlobalPosition.Z);

		int srcId = TargetCharacter.GetInstanceId().GetHashCode();

		// --- 5. Splash: Entry Impact (Crossing down detection) ---
		bool validPrev    = _prevSignedDist < float.MaxValue;
		bool crossingDown = validPrev && _prevSignedDist > 0f && _smoothedSignedDist <= 0f;

		if (crossingDown && _splashCooldown <= 0f)
		{
			float entrySpeed = Mathf.Max(-vel.Y, 0f);
			if (entrySpeed >= SplashMinEntrySpeed)
			{
				float crossArea  = Mathf.Pi * radius * radius;
				float visualSize = Mathf.Max(wb.ZoneShape?.GetVisualSize() ?? 50f, 1f);

				float splashStr = (crossArea * entrySpeed / visualSize) * ImpactStrengthK;
				splashStr = Mathf.Tanh(splashStr * 1.5f) * 0.8f;
				splashStr = Mathf.Max(splashStr, MinSplashStrength);

				float splashRadius = radius * SplashRadiusScale;

				output.Add(IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.MakeImpact(
					surfaceCenter, splashRadius, splashStr, srcId));

				WaterEventBus.EnqueueSplash(new WaterSplashEvent
				{
					WorldPos       = surfaceCenter,
					WorldRadius    = splashRadius,
					Strength       = splashStr,
					SourceId       = srcId,
					SourceVelocity = vel,
					Body           = wb,
					Profile        = wb.GetProfile(),
					SurfaceHeight  = SurfaceHeight,
					SurfaceNormal  = sample.Normal,
				});

				_splashCooldown = SplashCooldownSec;

				// Critical path log: Validate parameter sanity on the first splash.
				if (!_debugFirstSplashLogged)
				{
					_debugFirstSplashLogged = true;
					float uvR = splashRadius / visualSize;
					GD.Print($"[IWSCharacterWaterInteraction] '{TargetCharacter.Name}' First Splash impact | " +
							 $"entrySpeed={entrySpeed:F2}m/s splashStr={splashStr:F4} " +
							 $"radius={splashRadius:F3}m uvR={uvR:F3} visualSize={visualSize:F1}m");
					if (uvR > 0.20f)
						GD.PushWarning($"[IWSCharacterWaterInteraction] '{TargetCharacter.Name}' " +
									   $"uvRadius={uvR:F3} is large (>0.20). Consider decreasing SplashRadiusScale or increasing the water zone size.");
				}
			}
		}
		_prevSignedDist = _smoothedSignedDist;

		// --- 6. Wake + SurfaceFlow: Wading Trail & Foam Transport ---
		if (!IsInWater)
		{
			_wakeEventTimer      = 0f;
			_lastSurfacePosValid = false;
			return;
		}

		if (speedXZ > WakeMinSpeed)
		{
			float wakeRadius = radius * WakeRadiusScale;
			float wakeStr    = Mathf.Clamp(
				speedXZ * WakeIntensityScale * subWeight, 0f, WakeMaxStrength);

			if (wakeStr > 0.001f)
			{
				float displacement = _lastSurfacePosValid
					? _lastSurfacePos.DistanceTo(surfaceCenter) : 0f;

				// Utilize LineShear if the displacement is significant (better physical match for legs sweeping through water), otherwise fallback to Impact.
				if (_lastSurfacePosValid && displacement > wakeRadius * SweptThresholdFactor)
				{
					output.Add(IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.MakeLineShear(
						_lastSurfacePos, surfaceCenter, wakeRadius, wakeStr, srcId));
				}
				else
				{
					output.Add(IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.MakeImpact(
						surfaceCenter, wakeRadius, wakeStr, srcId));
				}
			}

			// Wake VFX Event (Throttled)
			_wakeEventTimer += delta;
			if (_wakeEventTimer >= WakeEventInterval)
			{
				_wakeEventTimer = 0f;
				WaterEventBus.EnqueueWake(new WaterWakeEvent
				{
					WorldPos       = surfaceCenter,
					WorldRadius    = radius * WakeRadiusScale,
					Strength       = wakeStr,
					Velocity       = vel,
					SubmergedRatio = SubmergedRatio,
					SourceId       = srcId,
					Body           = wb,
					Profile        = wb.GetProfile(),
					SurfaceHeight  = SurfaceHeight,
					SurfaceNormal  = sample.Normal,
				});

				if (!_debugFirstWakeLogged)
				{
					_debugFirstWakeLogged = true;
					GD.Print($"[IWSCharacterWaterInteraction] '{TargetCharacter.Name}' First Wake | " +
							 $"speedXZ={speedXZ:F2}m/s subWeight={subWeight:F3} wakeStr={wakeStr:F4}");
				}
			}

			// --- 6b. SurfaceFlow: Foam Transport Flow Field ---
			// Injects momentum along the character's horizontal velocity vector to drive velocity_tex.ba, pushing foam away.
			// Naturally decays via FLOW_DAMPING in the Compute Shader when the character stops (approx. 0.5s half-life).
			if (EnableSurfaceFlow && speedXZ > SurfaceFlowMinSpeed)
			{
				float flowStr    = speedXZ * SurfaceFlowStrengthScale * subWeight;
				float flowRadius = radius * SurfaceFlowRadiusScale;

				// FlowVelocityXZ passes the world XZ directional vector, IWSWaterBody.AddImpulse converts it to UV space.
				Vector2 flowDir = new Vector2(vel.X, vel.Z);

				output.Add(IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.MakeImpact(
					surfaceCenter, flowRadius, flowStr, srcId,
					innerRadius:    0f,
					mode:           BrushMode.SurfaceFlow,
					flowVelocityXZ: flowDir));

				if (!_debugFirstFlowLogged)
				{
					_debugFirstFlowLogged = true;
					GD.Print($"[IWSCharacterWaterInteraction] '{TargetCharacter.Name}' First SurfaceFlow | " +
							 $"flowStr={flowStr:F4} flowRadius={flowRadius:F3}m dir=({flowDir.X:F2},{flowDir.Y:F2})");
				}
			}
		}
		else
		{
			_wakeEventTimer = 0f;
		}

		_lastSurfacePos      = surfaceCenter;
		_lastSurfacePosValid = true;
	}

	// -------------------------------------------------------------
	// Shape Parameter Estimation (Auto + Override)
	// -------------------------------------------------------------

	private float GetEffectiveHeight()
	{
		if (_cachedEffectiveHeight > 0f) return _cachedEffectiveHeight;

		if (HeightOverride > 0.001f)
		{
			_cachedEffectiveHeight = HeightOverride;
		}
		else if (BodyShape?.Shape != null)
		{
			_cachedEffectiveHeight = BodyShape.Shape switch
			{
				// Godot CapsuleShape3D.Height represents the cylinder part height (excluding the end hemispheres).
				// Total height = Height + 2 * Radius.
				CapsuleShape3D cap  => cap.Height + cap.Radius * 2f,
				BoxShape3D     box  => box.Size.Y,
				CylinderShape3D cyl => cyl.Height,
				SphereShape3D  sph  => sph.Radius * 2f,
				_                   => 1.8f,
			};
		}
		else
		{
			_cachedEffectiveHeight = 1.8f;
		}

		if (!_debugShapeLogged) LogShapeParams();
		return _cachedEffectiveHeight;
	}

	private float GetEffectiveRadius()
	{
		if (_cachedEffectiveRadius > 0f) return _cachedEffectiveRadius;

		float r = 0.35f; // Default fallback

		if (RadiusOverride > 0.001f)
		{
			r = RadiusOverride;
		}
		else if (BodyShape?.Shape != null)
		{
			float raw = BodyShape.Shape switch
			{
				CapsuleShape3D  cap => cap.Radius,
				BoxShape3D      box => Mathf.Sqrt(box.Size.X * box.Size.Z) * 0.5f,
				CylinderShape3D cyl => cyl.Radius,
				SphereShape3D   sph => sph.Radius,
				_                   => 0.35f,
			};

			if (raw <= 0f || float.IsNaN(raw))
			{
				GD.PushWarning($"[IWSCharacterWaterInteraction] '{TargetCharacter?.Name}' " +
							   $"Estimated radius={raw:F3} from {BodyShape.Shape.GetType().Name} is invalid, " +
							   "falling back to 0.35m. Please ensure the Shape parameter of CollisionShape3D is correctly configured.");
			}
			else
			{
				r = raw;
			}
		}

		_cachedEffectiveRadius = Mathf.Max(r, 0.05f);
		if (!_debugShapeLogged) LogShapeParams();
		return _cachedEffectiveRadius;
	}

	private float GetEffectiveFootOffsetY()
	{
		if (!float.IsNaN(_cachedFootOffsetY)) return _cachedFootOffsetY;

		if (!Mathf.IsZeroApprox(FootOffsetOverride))
		{
			_cachedFootOffsetY = FootOffsetOverride;
			if (!_debugShapeLogged) LogShapeParams();
			return _cachedFootOffsetY;
		}

		if (BodyShape?.Shape != null)
		{
			float halfH;
			switch (BodyShape.Shape)
			{
				case CapsuleShape3D cap:
					float capRadius = Mathf.Max(cap.Radius, 0f);
					float capHeight = Mathf.Max(cap.Height, 0f);
					halfH = (capHeight + capRadius * 2f) * 0.5f;
					break;
				case BoxShape3D box:
					halfH = box.Size.Y * 0.5f;
					break;
				case CylinderShape3D cyl:
					halfH = cyl.Height * 0.5f;
					break;
				case SphereShape3D sph:
					halfH = sph.Radius;
					break;
				default:
					halfH = 0.9f;
					break;
			}

			float candidate = BodyShape.Position.Y - halfH;
			if (float.IsNaN(candidate) || float.IsInfinity(candidate))
			{
				GD.PushWarning($"[IWSCharacterWaterInteraction] '{TargetCharacter?.Name}' " +
							   $"Estimated footOffsetY is {candidate}, falling back to -0.9m.");
				_cachedFootOffsetY = -0.9f;
			}
			else
			{
				_cachedFootOffsetY = candidate;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			_cachedFootOffsetY = -0.9f;
		}

		if (!_debugShapeLogged) LogShapeParams();
		return _cachedFootOffsetY;
	}

	private void LogShapeParams()
	{
		_debugShapeLogged = true;
		GD.Print($"[IWSCharacterWaterInteraction] '{TargetCharacter?.Name}' Shape parameters | " +
				 $"height={_cachedEffectiveHeight:F3}m radius={_cachedEffectiveRadius:F3}m " +
				 $"footOffsetY={_cachedFootOffsetY:F3}m | shape={BodyShape?.Shape?.GetType().Name ?? "none"}");
	}

	// -------------------------------------------------------------
	// Water Body Caching & Selection
	// -------------------------------------------------------------
	private IWSWaterBody FindWaterCached(Vector3 worldPos)
	{
		// Prioritize cache reuse with fast bounds checking to avoid global searches every frame.
		if (_cachedWaterQuery != null)
		{
			Rect2 b = _cachedWaterQuery.GetBoundsXZ();
			if (worldPos.X >= b.Position.X && worldPos.X <= b.Position.X + b.Size.X &&
				worldPos.Z >= b.Position.Y && worldPos.Z <= b.Position.Y + b.Size.Y)
				return _cachedWaterQuery as IWSWaterBody;
		}

		_cachedWaterQuery = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.FindWaterAtXZ(worldPos);
		return _cachedWaterQuery as IWSWaterBody;
	}
}


// res://water/interaction/IWSDiscPressureEmitter.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Interaction;

using Godot;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;
using IWS.Water.Debug;

/// <summary>
/// Emits three-layered disturbances (Displacement, Velocity, SurfaceFlow) to simulate 
/// complex localized pressure effects, such as helicopter rotor downwash.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSDiscPressureEmitter : Node, IWSWaterDisturbanceEmitter
{
    [ExportGroup("References")]
    [Export] public Node3D CenterNode;

    [ExportGroup("Rotor Geometry")]
    [Export] public float DiscRadius          = 6.0f;
    [Export] public float MaxEffectiveHeight  = 15.0f;
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "1.0,4.0")]
    public float HeightFalloffExponent = 2.0f;

    [ExportGroup("Layer A – Bowl Depression (Displacement)")]
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,2.0")]
    public float BowlDepth = 0.08f;

    [ExportGroup("Layer B – Ring Wave Source (Velocity)")]
    /// <summary>
    /// Ripple frequency (Hz). Recommended: 4.0 - 8.0 Hz.
    /// </summary>
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "1.0,10.0")]
    public float RippleFrequencyHz = 5.0f;

    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.3,0.95")]
    public float RingSourceRadiusRatio = 0.70f;

    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.05,0.4")]
    public float RingSourceWidthRatio = 0.22f;

    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,1.0")]
    public float CorePulseStrength = 0.35f;

    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,1.0")]
    public float CorePulseJitter = 0.08f;

    [ExportGroup("Layer C – Surface Flow (SurfaceFlow)")]
    /// <summary>
    /// Radial outward surface flow strength. Directly drives foam advection outwards.
    /// Recommended: 0.3 - 1.5. Increase this value to push foam away faster.
    /// </summary>
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,2.0")]
    public float SurfaceFlowStrength = 0.8f;

    /// <summary>
    /// Surface flow influence radius relative to DiscRadius.
    /// A value of 1.2 means the flow field slightly exceeds the bowl depression edge, 
    /// ensuring foam is swept away at the rim.
    /// </summary>
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.5,2.0")]
    public float SurfaceFlowRadiusScale = 1.2f;

    [ExportGroup("Settings")]
    [Export] public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,1.0")]
    public float ThrustFactor { get; set; } = 1.0f;

    // --- Internal State ---
    private Node3D _effectiveCenter;
    private double _corePulsePhase = 0.0;
    private double _lifeTime       = 0.0;

    // --- Debug Flags ---
    private bool _scaleWarnLogged       = false;
    private bool _debugFirstBowlLogged  = false;
    private bool _debugFirstCoreLogged  = false;
    private bool _debugFirstFlowLogged  = false;
    private bool _debugFirstNegCarrier  = false;
    private int  _debugFrameCounter     = 0;

    public override void _Ready()
    {
        _effectiveCenter = CenterNode ?? GetParentOrNull<Node3D>();
        if (_effectiveCenter == null)
            GD.PushWarning($"[IWSDiscPressureEmitter] '{Name}' CenterNode or parent Node3D not found.");

        float ringR = DiscRadius * RingSourceRadiusRatio;
        float ringW = DiscRadius * RingSourceWidthRatio;
        float flowR = DiscRadius * SurfaceFlowRadiusScale;

        GD.Print($"[IWSDiscPressureEmitter] '{Name}' Initialized | " +
                 $"RippleFreqHz={RippleFrequencyHz:F1}Hz | " +
                 $"DiscRadius={DiscRadius:F1}m ringR={ringR:F2}m ringW={ringW:F2}m | " +
                 $"SurfaceFlow: strength={SurfaceFlowStrength:F2} flowR={flowR:F2}m | " +
                 $"[Layer A=Bowl B=Ripples C=SurfaceFlow Advection]");

        IWSWaterManager.Instance?.RegisterEmitter(this);
    }

    public override void _EnterTree()  => IWSWaterManager.Instance?.RegisterEmitter(this);
    public override void _ExitTree()
    {
        IWSWaterManager.Instance?.UnregisterEmitter(this);
        base._ExitTree();
    }

    public void CollectDisturbances(
        double physicsTime,
        float  delta,
        List<IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand> output)
    {
        if (!IsActive || _effectiveCenter == null || ThrustFactor < 0.001f) return;

        Vector3 center = _effectiveCenter.GlobalPosition;
        var water = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.FindWaterAtXZ(center);
        if (water == null) return;

        WaterSample sample = water.SampleWater(center);
        if (!sample.IsValid) return;

        float discHeight  = Mathf.Max(center.Y - sample.Height, 0f);
        if (discHeight >= MaxEffectiveHeight) return;

        float heightRatio  = discHeight / Mathf.Max(MaxEffectiveHeight, 0.1f);
        float heightFactor = Mathf.Pow(1f - heightRatio, HeightFalloffExponent);

        Vector3 surfaceCenter = new Vector3(center.X, sample.Height, center.Z);
        int     srcId         = GetInstanceId().GetHashCode();

        // --- Scale Verification (First time only) ---
        if (!_scaleWarnLogged)
        {
            _scaleWarnLogged = true;
            float visualSize     = (water as IWSWaterBody)?.ZoneShape?.GetVisualSize() ?? 50f;
            float minRecommended = DiscRadius * 3f;
            float ringR_check    = DiscRadius * RingSourceRadiusRatio;
            float uvRingR        = ringR_check / Mathf.Max(visualSize, 0.1f);

            if (visualSize < minRecommended)
                GD.PushWarning($"[IWSDiscPressureEmitter] '{Name}' ⚠ Water zone size ({visualSize:F1}m) < " +
                               $"DiscRadius×3 ({minRecommended:F1}m). Ring waves may not fully propagate.");
            else
                GD.Print($"[IWSDiscPressureEmitter] '{Name}' Scale OK | " +
                         $"DiscRadius={DiscRadius:F1}m visualSize={visualSize:F1}m | " +
                         $"uvRingRadius={uvRingR:F3} (Recommended < 0.20)");
        }

        _lifeTime += delta;

        // ====================================================================
        // Layer A: Steady Bowl Depression (Displacement)
        // Responsibilities ("Form"): Steadily depresses the water surface to 
        // form a persistent downwash bowl.
        // ====================================================================
        float bowlStrength = -BowlDepth * ThrustFactor * heightFactor;

        output.Add(IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.MakeImpact(
            surfaceCenter,
            DiscRadius,
            bowlStrength,
            srcId,
            innerRadius: 0f,
            mode: BrushMode.Displacement));

        if (!_debugFirstBowlLogged)
        {
            _debugFirstBowlLogged = true;
            GD.Print($"[IWSDiscPressureEmitter] '{Name}' ★ Layer A First Submission | " +
                     $"bowlStr={bowlStrength:F4} discH={discHeight:F2}m hFactor={heightFactor:F3}");
        }

        // ====================================================================
        // Layer B: Ring Edge Full-Wave Alternating Velocity Pulse (Ripple Source)
        // Responsibilities ("Rhythm"): Physically propagating traveling waves/fine ripples.
        // Uses a full-wave sine to ensure bidirectional push/pull, forming 
        // genuine traveling waves instead of standing waves.
        // ====================================================================
        {
            float coreHz = Mathf.Clamp(RippleFrequencyHz, 1.0f, 10.0f);
            _corePulsePhase += coreHz * Mathf.Tau * delta;

            float carrier = (float)System.Math.Sin(_corePulsePhase);
            if (CorePulseJitter > 0.001f)
            {
                float jitter = (float)System.Math.Sin(_corePulsePhase * 0.37f + 1.2f)
                             * CorePulseJitter * 0.3f;
                carrier += jitter;
            }

            float ringR  = DiscRadius * RingSourceRadiusRatio;
            float ringW  = DiscRadius * RingSourceWidthRatio;
            float innerR = Mathf.Max(ringR - ringW * 0.5f, 0f);
            float outerR = ringR + ringW * 0.5f;
            float ringStr = CorePulseStrength * ThrustFactor * heightFactor * carrier;

            if (Mathf.Abs(ringStr) > 0.0001f)
            {
                output.Add(IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.MakeImpact(
                    surfaceCenter,
                    outerR,
                    ringStr,
                    srcId,
                    innerRadius: innerR,
                    mode: BrushMode.Velocity));
            }

            if (!_debugFirstCoreLogged)
            {
                _debugFirstCoreLogged = true;
                GD.Print($"[IWSDiscPressureEmitter] '{Name}' ★ Layer B First Submission | " +
                         $"coreHz={coreHz:F1}Hz carrier={carrier:F3} ringStr={ringStr:F4} | " +
                         $"ringR={ringR:F2}m innerR={innerR:F2}m outerR={outerR:F2}m");
            }

            if (!_debugFirstNegCarrier && carrier < -0.1f)
            {
                _debugFirstNegCarrier = true;
                GD.Print($"[IWSDiscPressureEmitter] '{Name}' ✓ Layer B carrier first negative crossing -> Traveling wave alternation confirmed");
            }
        }

        // ====================================================================
        // Layer C: Radial Outward Surface Flow (SurfaceFlow)
        // Responsibilities ("Transport"): Drives the surface flow field outward, 
        // pushing foam away from the bowl area until it decays.
        // Directly writes to the horizontal flow field (velocity_tex.ba). FoamCompute 
        // reads this to offset foam UV coordinates outward.
        // FlowVelocityXZ = Vector2.Zero -> Shader automatically calculates 
        // the radial outward direction based on the fragment's position.
        // ====================================================================
        {
            float flowR   = DiscRadius * SurfaceFlowRadiusScale;
            float flowStr = SurfaceFlowStrength * ThrustFactor * heightFactor;

            if (flowStr > 0.001f)
            {
                output.Add(IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.MakeImpact(
                    surfaceCenter,
                    flowR,
                    flowStr,
                    srcId,
                    innerRadius:    0f,
                    mode:           BrushMode.SurfaceFlow,
                    flowVelocityXZ: Vector2.Zero));  // Automatic radial direction

                if (!_debugFirstFlowLogged)
                {
                    _debugFirstFlowLogged = true;
                    float visualSize = (water as IWSWaterBody)?.ZoneShape?.GetVisualSize() ?? 50f;
                    float uvR        = flowR / Mathf.Max(visualSize, 0.1f);
                    GD.Print($"[IWSDiscPressureEmitter] '{Name}' ★ Layer C First Submission (SurfaceFlow) | " +
                             $"flowStr={flowStr:F4} flowR={flowR:F2}m uvR={uvR:F3} | " +
                             $"[Radial advection, foam will be swept away and decay]");
                }
            }
        }

        if (WaterDebugHub.Instance?.Flags.Disturbances ?? false)
            DrawDebug(surfaceCenter, center, heightFactor, bowlStrength);

        _debugFrameCounter++;
        if (_debugFrameCounter >= 300)
        {
            _debugFrameCounter = 0;
            GD.Print($"[IWSDiscPressureEmitter] '{Name}' Status | " +
                     $"thrust={ThrustFactor:F2} discH={discHeight:F2}m hFactor={heightFactor:F3} | " +
                     $"bowlStr={bowlStrength:F4} rippleHz={RippleFrequencyHz:F1}Hz " +
                     $"flowStr={SurfaceFlowStrength * ThrustFactor * heightFactor:F4}");
        }
    }

    private void DrawDebug(Vector3 surfaceCenter, Vector3 emitterCenter,
                           float heightFactor, float bowlStrength)
    {
        const int SEGS = 48;
        float ringR  = DiscRadius * RingSourceRadiusRatio;
        float ringW  = DiscRadius * RingSourceWidthRatio;
        float flowR  = DiscRadius * SurfaceFlowRadiusScale;

        DrawCircleXZ(surfaceCenter, DiscRadius, new Color(0.2f, 0.5f, 1.0f, 0.85f), SEGS);
        DrawCircleXZ(surfaceCenter, ringR - ringW * 0.5f, new Color(0.2f, 1.0f, 0.4f, 0.7f), 32);
        DrawCircleXZ(surfaceCenter, ringR + ringW * 0.5f, new Color(0.2f, 1.0f, 0.4f, 0.7f), 32);
        // Green dashed line: SurfaceFlow influence range
        DrawCircleXZDashed(surfaceCenter, flowR, new Color(0.1f, 1.0f, 0.6f, 0.7f), SEGS);

        Color heightColor = new Color(1f - heightFactor, heightFactor, 0.15f, 0.9f);
        WaterDebugHub.DrawLine(surfaceCenter, emitterCenter, heightColor, DebugCategory.Disturbances);
        WaterDebugHub.DrawSphere(surfaceCenter,
            Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.Abs(bowlStrength) * 0.5f, 0.04f, 0.3f),
            new Color(0.3f, 0.5f, 1.0f, 0.5f * heightFactor),
            0f, DebugCategory.Disturbances);
    }

    private static void DrawCircleXZ(Vector3 center, float radius, Color color, int segs)
    {
        if (radius < 0.01f) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < segs; i++)
        {
            float a0 = i       * Mathf.Tau / segs;
            float a1 = (i + 1) * Mathf.Tau / segs;
            WaterDebugHub.DrawLine(
                center + new Vector3(Mathf.Cos(a0) * radius, 0f, Mathf.Sin(a0) * radius),
                center + new Vector3(Mathf.Cos(a1) * radius, 0f, Mathf.Sin(a1) * radius),
                color, DebugCategory.Disturbances);
        }
    }

    private static void DrawCircleXZDashed(Vector3 center, float radius, Color color, int segs)
    {
        if (radius < 0.01f) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < segs; i += 2)
        {
            float a0 = i       * Mathf.Tau / segs;
            float a1 = (i + 1) * Mathf.Tau / segs;
            WaterDebugHub.DrawLine(
                center + new Vector3(Mathf.Cos(a0) * radius, 0f, Mathf.Sin(a0) * radius),
                center + new Vector3(Mathf.Cos(a1) * radius, 0f, Mathf.Sin(a1) * radius),
                color, DebugCategory.Disturbances);
        }
    }
}

// res://water/interaction/IWSDisturbanceCompiler.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Interaction;

using Godot;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Debug;

/// <summary>
/// Compiles, sorts, and truncates disturbance commands submitted by various emitters.
/// Employs a budget saturation algorithm to prevent excessive GPU brush invocations.
/// Utilizes a pre-allocated sort buffer to maintain zero GC during high-frequency physics cycles.
/// </summary>
public static class IWSDisturbanceCompiler
{
	public const float DEFAULT_DISTANCE_ATTENUATION = 0.05f;

	private const float DISPLACEMENT_PRIORITY_BONUS = 1000f;
	
	// SurfaceFlow priority: Higher than standard Velocity but lower than Displacement,
	// ensuring that outward foam advection commands are not easily truncated by the budget limit.
	private const float SURFACE_FLOW_PRIORITY_BONUS = 10f;

	private static bool _obsoleteTypeWarned  = false;
	private static bool _priorityBonusLogged = false;

	public static void Compile(
		IReadOnlyList<IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand> commands,
		int                                       budgetRemaining,
		List<WaterImpulse>                        output,
		List<IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand>          sortBuffer,
		Vector3                                   cameraWorldPos,
		float                                     distanceAttenuation = DEFAULT_DISTANCE_ATTENUATION,
		double                                    physicsTime         = 0.0,
		bool                                      drawDebug           = false)
	{
		if (commands == null || commands.Count == 0) return;

		sortBuffer.Clear();
		sortBuffer.AddRange(commands);

		sortBuffer.Sort((a, b) =>
		{
			// Apply priority bonuses to critical command types to favor them during budget saturation.
			float typeBonusA = a.BrushMode switch
			{
				BrushMode.Displacement => DISPLACEMENT_PRIORITY_BONUS,
				BrushMode.SurfaceFlow  => SURFACE_FLOW_PRIORITY_BONUS,
				_                      => 1f,
			};
			float typeBonusB = b.BrushMode switch
			{
				BrushMode.Displacement => DISPLACEMENT_PRIORITY_BONUS,
				BrushMode.SurfaceFlow  => SURFACE_FLOW_PRIORITY_BONUS,
				_                      => 1f,
			};

			// Calculate final score based on magnitude and distance attenuation from the camera.
			float magA   = Mathf.Abs(a.Strength) * typeBonusA;
			float magB   = Mathf.Abs(b.Strength) * typeBonusB;
			float scoreA = magA / (1f + a.Center.DistanceTo(cameraWorldPos) * distanceAttenuation);
			float scoreB = magB / (1f + b.Center.DistanceTo(cameraWorldPos) * distanceAttenuation);
			return scoreB.CompareTo(scoreA);
		});

		if (!_priorityBonusLogged && commands.Count > 0)
		{
			_priorityBonusLogged = true;
			int dispCount = 0, flowCount = 0;
			foreach (var cmd in commands)
			{
				if (cmd.BrushMode == BrushMode.Displacement) dispCount++;
				if (cmd.BrushMode == BrushMode.SurfaceFlow)  flowCount++;
			}
			GD.Print($"[IWSDisturbanceCompiler] First Compile | total={commands.Count} " +
					 $"displacement={dispCount} surfaceFlow={flowCount} budget={budgetRemaining}");
		}

		foreach (var cmd in sortBuffer)
		{
			if (budgetRemaining <= 0) break;

			switch (cmd.Type)
			{
				case DisturbanceType.Impact:
					CompileImpact(cmd, ref budgetRemaining, output, drawDebug);
					break;
				case DisturbanceType.LineShear:
					CompileLine(cmd, ref budgetRemaining, output, drawDebug);
					break;
#pragma warning disable CS0618
				case DisturbanceType.PointImpact:
					// Convert obsolete PointImpact to standard Impact command.
					var compat = IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.MakeImpact(
						cmd.Center, cmd.WorldRadius, cmd.Strength, cmd.SourceId);
					CompileImpact(compat, ref budgetRemaining, output, drawDebug);
					break;
				case DisturbanceType.DiscPressure:
					if (!_obsoleteTypeWarned)
					{
						_obsoleteTypeWarned = true;
						GD.PushWarning("[IWSDisturbanceCompiler] The DiscPressure disturbance type is obsolete.");
					}
					break;
#pragma warning restore CS0618
			}
		}
	}

	private static void CompileImpact(
		in IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand cmd,
		ref int budget,
		List<WaterImpulse> output,
		bool drawDebug)
	{
		if (budget <= 0) return;

		float rawRadius = Mathf.Max(cmd.WorldRadius, 0.05f);
		output.Add(new WaterImpulse(
			cmd.Center, rawRadius, cmd.Strength, cmd.SourceId,
			innerRadius:    cmd.InnerRadius,
			brushMode:      cmd.BrushMode,
			flowVelocityXZ: cmd.FlowVelocityXZ)); // Pass-through flow velocity
		budget--;

		if (drawDebug)
		{
			Color col = cmd.BrushMode switch
			{
				BrushMode.Displacement => new Color(0.2f, 0.5f, 1.0f, 0.7f),
				BrushMode.SurfaceFlow  => new Color(0.1f, 1.0f, 0.5f, 0.7f),
				_                      => new Color(1.0f, 0.6f, 0.1f, 0.6f),
			};
			float debugRadius = rawRadius * (cmd.BrushMode == BrushMode.Displacement ? 0.15f : 0.2f);
			WaterDebugHub.DrawSphere(cmd.Center, debugRadius, col, 0.02f, DebugCategory.Disturbances);
		}
	}

	private static void CompileLine(
		in IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand cmd,
		ref int budget,
		List<WaterImpulse> output,
		bool drawDebug)
	{
		if (budget <= 0) return;

		float lineLength = cmd.LineStart.DistanceTo(cmd.LineEnd);
		
		// Downgrade to a single point impact if the line segment is too short,
		// or if the remaining budget is insufficient for at least 2 points.
		if (lineLength < 0.001f || budget < 2)
		{
			var point = IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.MakeImpact(
				cmd.Center, cmd.LineWidth, cmd.Strength, cmd.SourceId);
			CompileImpact(point, ref budget, output, drawDebug);
			return;
		}

		float spacing     = Mathf.Max(cmd.LineWidth * 0.8f, 0.1f);
		int   rawCount    = Mathf.Max(2, Mathf.CeilToInt(lineLength / spacing));
		
		// Clamp the actual sampling point count based on the available budget limit.
		int   count       = Mathf.Clamp(rawCount, 2, budget);
		
		// Compensate disturbance strength for the reduced point count.
		float compensated = cmd.Strength * ((float)rawCount / count);

		for (int i = 0; i < count && budget > 0; i++)
		{
			// Calculate linear interpolation parameter.
			// Since count is clamped to at least 2, division by zero is safely avoided.
			float   t   = (float)i / (count - 1);
			Vector3 pos = cmd.LineStart.Lerp(cmd.LineEnd, t);
			
			output.Add(new WaterImpulse(
				pos, Mathf.Max(cmd.LineWidth, 0.1f), compensated, cmd.SourceId,
				brushMode: BrushMode.Velocity));
			budget--;
		}

		if (drawDebug)
			WaterDebugHub.DrawLine(cmd.LineStart, cmd.LineEnd,
				new Color(0f, 1f, 1f, 0.6f), DebugCategory.Disturbances);
	}
}

// res://water/interaction/IWSLineShearEmitter.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Interaction;

using Godot;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using IWS.Water.Physics;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;
using IWS.Water.Event;

/// <summary>
/// Emits a continuous swept line disturbance across the water surface.
/// Ideal for simulating boat waterline wakes or large physical bodies cutting through the fluid.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSLineShearEmitter : Node, IWSWaterDisturbanceEmitter
{
    [ExportGroup("References")]
    [Export] public Node3D       LineStartNode;
    [Export] public Node3D       LineEndNode;
    [Export] public RigidBody3D  TargetBody;
    [Export] public IWSBuoyancyBody BuoyancyComponent;

    [ExportGroup("Shear Parameters")]
    [Export] public float LineWidth      = 0.5f;
    [Export] public float MinSpeed       = 0.2f;
    [Export] public float IntensityScale = 0.03f;
    [Export] public float MaxStrength    = 0.1f;

    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.05,1.0")]
    public float WakeEventInterval = 0.15f;

    [ExportGroup("Settings")]
    [Export] public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;

    private float _wakeEventTimer = 0f;

    public override void _Ready()
    {
        if (TargetBody == null)
            TargetBody = GetParent<RigidBody3D>();

        IWSWaterManager.Instance?.RegisterEmitter(this);
    }

    public void CollectDisturbances(
        double physicsTime,
        float  delta,
        List<IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand> output)
    {
        if (!IsActive || TargetBody == null) return;
        if (LineStartNode == null || LineEndNode == null) return;

        float subRatio = BuoyancyComponent?.SubmergedRatio ?? 0f;
        if (subRatio < 0.01f)
        {
            _wakeEventTimer = 0f;
            return;
        }

        Vector3 vel     = TargetBody.LinearVelocity;
        float   speedXZ = new Godot.Vector2(vel.X, vel.Z).Length();
        if (speedXZ < MinSpeed)
        {
            _wakeEventTimer = 0f;
            return;
        }

        Vector3 startWorld = LineStartNode.GlobalPosition;
        Vector3 endWorld   = LineEndNode.GlobalPosition;

        var waterStart = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.FindWaterAt(startWorld);
        var waterEnd   = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.FindWaterAt(endWorld);
        if (waterStart == null && waterEnd == null) return;

        // Resolve context body, prioritizing the start point.
        IWSWaterBody wb = (waterStart as IWSWaterBody) ?? (waterEnd as IWSWaterBody);

        float surfaceYStart = waterStart?.SampleWater(startWorld).Height
                        ?? waterEnd!.SampleWater(startWorld).Height;
        float surfaceYEnd   = waterEnd?.SampleWater(endWorld).Height
                        ?? waterStart!.SampleWater(endWorld).Height;

        Vector3 start = new Vector3(startWorld.X, surfaceYStart, startWorld.Z);
        Vector3 end   = new Vector3(endWorld.X,   surfaceYEnd,   endWorld.Z);

        Vector3 lineDir = end - start;
        float   lineLen = lineDir.Length();
        if (lineLen < 0.001f) return;
        lineDir /= lineLen;

        Vector3 velDirXZ   = new Vector3(vel.X, 0f, vel.Z).Normalized();
        Vector3 linePerpXZ = new Vector3(-lineDir.Z, 0f, lineDir.X).Normalized();
        float   cuttingFactor = Mathf.Abs(velDirXZ.Dot(linePerpXZ));

        float strength = Mathf.Clamp(
            speedXZ * cuttingFactor * subRatio * IntensityScale,
            0f, MaxStrength);

        if (strength < 0.001f) return;

        output.Add(IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.MakeLineShear(
            start, end, LineWidth, strength,
            TargetBody.GetInstanceId().GetHashCode()));

        // Throttle and enqueue wake VFX event for decoupled rendering systems.
        _wakeEventTimer += delta;
        if (_wakeEventTimer >= WakeEventInterval)
        {
            _wakeEventTimer = 0f;

            Vector3 mid = (start + end) * 0.5f;

            WaterSample sample = wb != null
                ? wb.SampleWaterFull(mid)
                : (waterStart ?? waterEnd)!.SampleWater(mid);

            Vector3 onSurface = new Vector3(mid.X, sample.Height, mid.Z);

            WaterEventBus.EnqueueWake(new WaterWakeEvent
            {
                WorldPos       = onSurface,
                WorldRadius    = LineWidth,
                Strength       = strength,
                Velocity       = vel,
                SubmergedRatio = subRatio,
                SourceId       = TargetBody.GetInstanceId().GetHashCode(),

                Body           = wb,
                Profile        = wb?.GetProfile(),
                SurfaceHeight  = sample.Height,
                SurfaceNormal  = sample.Normal,
            });
        }
    }

    public override void _EnterTree()
    {
        IWSWaterManager.Instance?.RegisterEmitter(this);
    }

    public override void _ExitTree()
    {
        IWSWaterManager.Instance?.UnregisterEmitter(this);
        base._ExitTree();
    }
}

// res://water/interaction/IWSPointImpactEmitter.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Interaction;

using Godot;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using IWS.Water.Physics;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;
using IWS.Water.Event;

/// <summary>
/// Emits single-point disturbances for rigid body interactions, such as objects falling into the water.
/// Supports both splashing impacts (crossing the surface downward) and directional wakes while moving through the water.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSPointImpactEmitter : Node, IWSWaterDisturbanceEmitter
{
    [ExportGroup("References")]
    [Export] public RigidBody3D      TargetBody;
    [Export] public IWSBuoyancyBody  IWSBuoyancyBody;
    [Export] public CollisionShape3D BodyShape;

    [ExportGroup("Splash (Entry Impact)")]
    [Export] public float SplashMinEntrySpeed = 0.5f;

    /// <summary>
    /// Effective brush radius override (0 = auto-estimate from CollisionShape).
    /// </summary>
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,5.0")]
    public float RadiusOverride = 0f;

    /// <summary>
    /// Impact strength coefficient K (Unit: 1/m).
    /// splashStr = crossArea * normalSpeed / visualSize * K
    /// Example: 0.25m radius, 4m/s speed, 7m pool -> 0.196 * 4 / 7 * K.
    /// Increase K -> more violent impact; decrease K -> softer impact.
    /// </summary>
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.5,50.0")]
    public float ImpactStrengthK = 3.0f;

    /// <summary>
    /// Minimum splash strength fallback.
    /// Prevents the low-speed entry of small-section objects from being completely invisible.
    /// </summary>
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,0.5")]
    public float MinSplashStrength = 0.05f;

    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.1,2.0")]
    public float SplashCooldownSec = 0.4f;

    [ExportGroup("Wake (Directional Trail)")]
    [Export] public float WakeMinSpeed       = 0.3f;
    [Export] public float WakeIntensityScale = 0.015f;
    [Export] public float WakeMaxStrength    = 0.06f;
    [Export] public float WakeWorldRadius    = 0.5f;

    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.05,1.0")]
    public float WakeEventInterval = 0.1f;

    [ExportGroup("Swept Injection")]
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.3,2.0")]
    public float SweptThresholdFactor = 0.5f;

    [ExportGroup("Settings")]
    [Export] public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;

    [Signal] public delegate void OnEnterWaterEventHandler(Vector3 worldPos, float speed);
    [Signal] public delegate void OnExitWaterEventHandler(Vector3 worldPos);
    [Signal] public delegate void OnSplashEventHandler(Vector3 worldPos, float strength, float energy);

    // --- State ---
    private float   _prevSignedDist      = float.MaxValue;
    private float   _splashCooldown      = 0f;
    private bool    _wasInWater          = false;
    private float   _wakeEventTimer      = 0f;
    private Vector3 _lastSurfacePos;
    private bool    _lastSurfacePosValid = false;
    private float   _cachedEffectiveRadius = -1f;

    // --- Debug Flags ---
    private bool _debugRadiusLogged  = false;
    private bool _debugFirstSplash   = false;
    private bool _debugUvWarnLogged  = false;

    public override void _Ready()
    {
        if (TargetBody == null)
            TargetBody = GetParent<RigidBody3D>();

        if (IWSBuoyancyBody == null)
            IWSBuoyancyBody = GetParentOrNull<Node>()
                              ?.GetNodeOrNull<IWSBuoyancyBody>("IWSBuoyancyBody");

        if (BodyShape == null && TargetBody != null)
            foreach (var child in TargetBody.GetChildren())
                if (child is CollisionShape3D cs) { BodyShape = cs; break; }

        IWSWaterManager.Instance?.RegisterEmitter(this);
    }

    private float GetEffectiveRadius()
    {
        if (_cachedEffectiveRadius > 0f) return _cachedEffectiveRadius;

        if (RadiusOverride > 0.001f)
        {
            _cachedEffectiveRadius = RadiusOverride;
            if (!_debugRadiusLogged)
            {
                _debugRadiusLogged = true;
                GD.Print($"[IWSPointImpactEmitter] '{Name}' radius = {_cachedEffectiveRadius:F3}m (override)");
            }
            return _cachedEffectiveRadius;
        }

        float r = 0.5f; // Default fallback
        if (BodyShape?.Shape != null)
        {
            r = BodyShape.Shape switch
            {
                BoxShape3D box       => Mathf.Sqrt(box.Size.X * box.Size.Z) * 0.5f,
                SphereShape3D sphere => sphere.Radius,
                CapsuleShape3D cap   => cap.Radius,
                CylinderShape3D cyl  => cyl.Radius,
                _                    => 0.5f,
            };
        }

        _cachedEffectiveRadius = Mathf.Max(r, 0.05f);

        if (!_debugRadiusLogged)
        {
            _debugRadiusLogged = true;
            GD.Print($"[IWSPointImpactEmitter] '{Name}' effective radius estimated: {_cachedEffectiveRadius:F3}m");
        }
        return _cachedEffectiveRadius;
    }

    public void CollectDisturbances(
        double physicsTime,
        float  delta,
        List<IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand> output)
    {
        if (!IsActive || TargetBody == null) return;

        if (_splashCooldown > 0f) _splashCooldown -= delta;

        float subRatio = IWSBuoyancyBody?.SubmergedRatio ?? 0f;
        bool  inWater  = subRatio > 0.01f;

        if (!inWater && _wasInWater)
        {
            EmitSignal(SignalName.OnExitWater, TargetBody.GlobalPosition);
            _prevSignedDist      = float.MaxValue;
            _lastSurfacePosValid = false;
        }
        _wasInWater = inWater;

        var waterQ = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.FindWaterAt(TargetBody.GlobalPosition);
        if (waterQ == null)
        {
            _prevSignedDist = float.MaxValue;
            return;
        }

        IWSWaterBody wb = waterQ as IWSWaterBody;

        WaterSample baseSample = waterQ.SampleWater(TargetBody.GlobalPosition);
        if (!baseSample.IsValid) return;

        float surfaceH   = baseSample.Height;
        float signedDist = TargetBody.GlobalPosition.Y - surfaceH;

        Vector3 surfaceCenter = new Vector3(
            TargetBody.GlobalPosition.X, surfaceH, TargetBody.GlobalPosition.Z);

        Vector3 vel     = TargetBody.LinearVelocity;
        float   speedXZ = new Godot.Vector2(vel.X, vel.Z).Length();

        // --- Splash: Entry crossing down detection ---
        bool validPrev    = _prevSignedDist < float.MaxValue;
        bool crossingDown = validPrev && _prevSignedDist > 0f && signedDist <= 0f;

        if (crossingDown && _splashCooldown <= 0f)
        {
            float normalSpeed = Mathf.Max(-vel.Y, 0f);

            if (normalSpeed >= SplashMinEntrySpeed)
            {
                float effectiveRadius = GetEffectiveRadius();
                float crossArea       = Mathf.Pi * effectiveRadius * effectiveRadius;

                // Get the visual size of the water zone
                float visualSize = Mathf.Max(wb?.ZoneShape?.GetVisualSize() ?? 50f, 1f);

                // Strength formula: crossArea * normalSpeed / visualSize * K
                // Recommended K=2.0~4.0 for realistic simulation
                float splashStr = (crossArea * normalSpeed / visualSize) * ImpactStrengthK;
                
                // Soft cap: Uses Godot's Mathf.Tanh for smooth saturation instead of a hard clamp
                splashStr = Mathf.Tanh(splashStr * 1.5f) * 0.8f;
                
                // Minimum visible strength fallback
                splashStr = Mathf.Max(splashStr, MinSplashStrength);

                _splashCooldown = SplashCooldownSec;

                // --- Debug diagnostics (First trigger) ---
                if (!_debugFirstSplash)
                {
                    _debugFirstSplash = true;
                    float uvRadius = effectiveRadius / visualSize;
                    GD.Print($"[IWSPointImpactEmitter] '{Name}' First splash | " +
                            $"effectiveRadius={effectiveRadius:F3}m " +
                            $"visualSize={visualSize:F1}m " +
                            $"uvRadius={uvRadius:F3} " +
                            $"crossArea={crossArea:F4}m² " +
                            $"normalSpeed={normalSpeed:F2}m/s " +
                            $"splashStr={splashStr:F4} " +
                            $"K={ImpactStrengthK:F1} minStr={MinSplashStrength:F3}");

                    // UV radius excessive warning (coupled with AddImpulse clamp logic)
                    if (uvRadius > 0.15f && !_debugUvWarnLogged)
                    {
                        _debugUvWarnLogged = true;
                        GD.PushWarning($"[IWSPointImpactEmitter] '{Name}' uvRadius={uvRadius:F3} > 0.15 — " +
                                    $"Brush is still too large. Consider decreasing RadiusOverride or increasing the water pool size.");
                    }
                }

                output.Add(IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.MakeImpact(
                    surfaceCenter, effectiveRadius, splashStr,
                    TargetBody.GetInstanceId().GetHashCode()));

                WaterSample fullSample = wb != null
                    ? wb.SampleWaterFull(TargetBody.GlobalPosition)
                    : baseSample;

                EmitSignal(SignalName.OnEnterWater, surfaceCenter, normalSpeed);
                EmitSignal(SignalName.OnSplash, surfaceCenter, splashStr, fullSample.Energy);

                WaterEventBus.EnqueueSplash(new WaterSplashEvent
                {
                    WorldPos       = surfaceCenter,
                    WorldRadius    = effectiveRadius,
                    Strength       = splashStr,
                    Energy         = fullSample.Energy,
                    SourceId       = TargetBody.GetInstanceId().GetHashCode(),
                    SourceVelocity = vel,
                    Body           = wb,
                    Profile        = wb?.GetProfile(),
                    SurfaceHeight  = surfaceH,
                    SurfaceNormal  = baseSample.Normal,
                });
            }
        }

        _prevSignedDist = signedDist;

        // --- Wake ---
        if (!inWater)
        {
            _wakeEventTimer = 0f;
            return;
        }

        if (speedXZ > WakeMinSpeed)
        {
            float wakeStr = Mathf.Clamp(
                speedXZ * WakeIntensityScale * subRatio,
                0f, WakeMaxStrength);

            float displacement = _lastSurfacePosValid
                ? _lastSurfacePos.DistanceTo(surfaceCenter)
                : 0f;

            if (_lastSurfacePosValid && displacement > WakeWorldRadius * SweptThresholdFactor)
            {
                output.Add(IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.MakeLineShear(
                    _lastSurfacePos, surfaceCenter,
                    WakeWorldRadius, wakeStr,
                    TargetBody.GetInstanceId().GetHashCode()));
            }
            else
            {
                output.Add(IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.MakeImpact(
                    surfaceCenter, WakeWorldRadius, wakeStr,
                    TargetBody.GetInstanceId().GetHashCode()));
            }

            _wakeEventTimer += delta;
            if (_wakeEventTimer >= WakeEventInterval)
            {
                _wakeEventTimer = 0f;
                WaterEventBus.EnqueueWake(new WaterWakeEvent
                {
                    WorldPos       = surfaceCenter,
                    WorldRadius    = WakeWorldRadius,
                    Strength       = wakeStr,
                    Velocity       = vel,
                    SubmergedRatio = subRatio,
                    SourceId       = TargetBody.GetInstanceId().GetHashCode(),
                    Body           = wb,
                    Profile        = wb?.GetProfile(),
                    SurfaceHeight  = surfaceH,
                    SurfaceNormal  = baseSample.Normal,
                });
            }
        }
        else
        {
            _wakeEventTimer = 0f;
        }

        _lastSurfacePos      = surfaceCenter;
        _lastSurfacePosValid = true;
    }

    public override void _EnterTree()
        => IWSWaterManager.Instance?.RegisterEmitter(this);

    public override void _ExitTree()
    {
        IWSWaterManager.Instance?.UnregisterEmitter(this);
        base._ExitTree();
    }
}

// res://water/interaction/IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Interaction;

using Godot;
using System;
using IWS.Water.Core;

public struct IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand
{
    public DisturbanceType Type;
    public Vector3   Center;
    public float     Strength;
    public int       SourceId;

    // ── Impact Parameters ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    public float     WorldRadius;
    public float     InnerRadius;
    public BrushMode BrushMode;

    /// <summary>
    /// Horizontal velocity direction in UV space under SurfaceFlow mode.
    /// Vector2.Zero = Automatically calculate radially outward direction in Shader.
    /// </summary>
    public Vector2   FlowVelocityXZ;

    // ── LineShear Parameters ───────────────────────────────────────────
    public Vector3   LineStart;
    public Vector3   LineEnd;
    public float     LineWidth;
    public int       DesiredSampleCount;

    // ── Factory Methods ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /// <summary>
    /// General impact brush.
    /// mode = Velocity       -> Diffusion ripple.
    /// mode = Displacement   -> Steady-state height constraint (e.g. pressure displacement).
    /// mode = SurfaceFlow    -> Horizontal surface flow injection (drives foam advection).
    ///   flowVelocityXZ = Zero -> Automatically calculate radially outward direction in Shader.
    /// </summary>
    public static IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand MakeImpact(
        Vector3 center, float worldRadius, float strength, int sourceId = 0,
        float innerRadius = 0f, BrushMode mode = BrushMode.Velocity,
        Vector2 flowVelocityXZ = default)
        => new IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand
        {
            Type           = DisturbanceType.Impact,
            Center         = center,
            WorldRadius    = worldRadius,
            InnerRadius    = innerRadius,
            BrushMode      = mode,
            Strength       = strength,
            SourceId       = sourceId,
            FlowVelocityXZ = flowVelocityXZ,
        };

    public static IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand MakeLineShear(
        Vector3 start, Vector3 end, float lineWidth, float strength,
        int sourceId = 0, int desiredSampleCount = -1)
        => new IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand
        {
            Type               = DisturbanceType.LineShear,
            Center             = (start + end) * 0.5f,
            LineStart          = start,
            LineEnd            = end,
            LineWidth          = lineWidth,
            Strength           = strength,
            SourceId           = sourceId,
            DesiredSampleCount = desiredSampleCount,
        };

    [Obsolete("Use MakeImpact instead.")]
    public static IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand MakePointImpact(
        Vector3 center, float worldRadius, float strength, int sourceId = 0)
        => MakeImpact(center, worldRadius, strength, sourceId);

    [Obsolete("DiscPressure is obsolete. Use MakeImpact with BrushMode.Displacement instead.")]
    public static IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand MakeDiscPressure(
        Vector3 center, float discRadius, float discHeight,
        float strength, int sourceId = 0,
        float maxEffectiveHeight = 15f,
        float ringFrequency      = 1.5f,
        float ringExpansionSpeed = 4.0f)
        => MakeImpact(center, discRadius, strength, sourceId,
                      innerRadius: 0f, mode: BrushMode.Displacement);
}

public enum DisturbanceType
{
    Impact,
    LineShear,

    [Obsolete("Use Impact with BrushMode.Displacement instead.")]
    DiscPressure,

    [Obsolete("Use Impact instead.")]
    PointImpact,
}

// res://water/interaction/IWSWaterDisturbanceEmitter.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Interaction;

using Godot;
using System.Collections.Generic;

/// <summary>
/// Interface for water disturbance emitters (component-side interface attached to objects).
///
/// Design Principles:
///   The water system does not need to identify the specific type of disturbance source.
///   Object components implement this interface to translate their motion states into IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.
///   The IWSWaterManager uniformly collects these commands, which are then compiled by the IWSDisturbanceCompiler.
///
/// Built-in implementations:
///   IWSPointImpactEmitter   -> Point impact (RigidBody entering water).
///   IWSLineShearEmitter     -> Line segment shear (Hull waterline).
///   IWSDiscPressureEmitter  -> Disc pressure (Rotor downwash).
/// </summary>
public interface IWSWaterDisturbanceEmitter
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Indicates whether the emitter is active.
    /// If false, the IWSWaterManager will skip processing this emitter.
    /// </summary>
    bool IsActive { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Collects all disturbance commands generated in the current physics frame and appends them to the output list.
    ///
    /// Note:
    ///   Commands are not submitted directly; they are centrally handled by the IWSWaterManager.
    ///   Multiple commands can be appended in a single call (e.g., multi-segment hull waterlines).
    /// </summary>
    void CollectDisturbances(
        double physicsTime,
        float  delta,
        List<IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand> output);
}

// res://water/physics/IWSBuoyancyBody.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Physics;

using Godot;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;
using IWS.Water.Simulation;
using IWS.Water.Debug;

/// <summary>
/// Voxel-based Buoyancy Generator.
/// Features:
/// 1. Manual pontoon overrides via Marker3D.
/// 2. Adaptive resolution downscaling for small objects.
/// 3. Monte Carlo pruning to eliminate ghost buoyancy points outside the collision shape.
/// 4. Mass-weighted EMA filtering for GPU Ripple vertical velocities.
/// 5. Auto/Manual Center of Mass shift for righting moment stability.
/// 6. Implicit quadratic drag and angular damping to prevent instability.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSBuoyancyBody : Node
{
	[ExportCategory("Buoyancy - Simple")]
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "10,1100,or_greater")]
	public float Density = 600f;

	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.1,3.0")]
	public float WaterDamping = 0.35f;

	public enum HorizontalDragPreset { Low, Normal, High }
	[Export]
	public HorizontalDragPreset HorizontalDrag = HorizontalDragPreset.Normal;

	[ExportCategory("Advanced (Override)")]
	[Export] public bool UseAdvancedMode = false;

	/// <summary>Water density (kg/m³). Only used when UseAdvancedMode = true.</summary>
	[Export] public float WaterDensity = 1000f;

	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.1,5.0")]  public float DragCoefficientOverride   = 1.2f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,5.0")]  public float AngularDragOverride       = 0.5f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,1.0")]  public float DynamicPressureScale      = 0.02f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "1,4")]      public int   VoxelResolution           = 2;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,2.0")]  public float PontoonRadiusOverride     = 0f;

	public enum RightingMode
	{
		Off,
		Auto,
		ManualBias
	}

	[ExportCategory("Stability & Righting")]

	/// <summary>
	/// Off: Does not adjust Center of Mass.
	/// Auto: Derives BottomHeavyBias automatically based on buoyancy (Density / WaterDensity).
	/// ManualBias: Uses a fixed BottomHeavyBias offset.
	/// </summary>
	[Export] public RightingMode Righting = RightingMode.Auto;

	/// <summary>
	/// Manual offset (effective when Righting = ManualBias):
	/// 0 = No shift; 1 = Shifted to the bottom of the bounding box.
	/// </summary>
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,1.0")]
	public float BottomHeavyBias = 0.4f;

	/// <summary>
	/// Maximum allowed bias in Auto mode to prevent excessive bottom-heavy behavior.
	/// </summary>
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,1.0")]
	public float AutoBiasMax = 0.6f;

	/// <summary>
	/// Proportion of quadratic angular drag (0 = linear angular drag only).
	/// </summary>
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,2.0")]
	public float QuadraticAngularDragFactor = 0.6f;

	/// <summary>
	/// Maximum angular drag torque per kilogram (N·m/kg) to prevent reverse rotation explosions at extreme angular velocities.
	/// </summary>
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,200.0")]
	public float MaxAngularDragTorquePerKg = 18.0f;

	[ExportCategory("Surface Tension / Waterline Adhesion")]

	/// <summary>
	/// Width factor for the waterline adhesion band relative to submersionRadius.
	/// E.g., 1.5 applies adhesion within a ±1.5 * submersionRadius range of the waterline.
	/// </summary>
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,4.0")]
	public float AdhesionBandScale = 1.5f;

	/// <summary>
	/// Vertical damping strength at the waterline to prevent bouncing.
	/// Automatically scaled by the buoyancy ratio (ρ_water / ρ_object).
	/// </summary>
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,5.0")]
	public float AdhesionDamping = 1.2f;

	/// <summary>
	/// Downward meniscus pull applied when the object is just above the water surface.
	/// Simulates the surface tension holding the object. 0 = disabled.
	/// </summary>
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,2.0")]
	public float SurfaceTensionPull = 0.3f;

	[ExportCategory("References")]
	[Export] public RigidBody3D       TargetBody;
	[Export] public CollisionShape3D  Shape;

	[ExportCategory("Automation")]
	/// <summary>
	/// If no explicit Shape is assigned, automatically merges all CollisionShape3D nodes under the TargetBody.
	/// Ensures accurate buoyancy bounds for composite objects.
	/// </summary>
	[Export] public bool UseAllCollisionShapesIfShapeNull = true;

	[ExportCategory("Debug")]
	[Export] public bool DrawDebug = true;

	private const float ADDED_MASS_COEFF       = 0.5f;

	/// <summary>
	/// Forces low pontoon resolution if the object's minimum edge is below this threshold, preventing sharp impulse changes.
	/// </summary>
	private const float SMALL_OBJECT_THRESHOLD = 0.35f;

	// ── Resolved Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────
	private float _effectiveWaterDensity;
	private float _effectiveDragCoeff;
	private float _effectiveAngularDrag;
	private float _effectiveDynPressureScale;
	private float _gravity;

	private float _totalVolume;        // m³
	private float _volumePerPontoon;   // m³

	private float _hydroRadius;
	private float _submersionRadius;

	private Vector3[] _pontoons      = Array.Empty<Vector3>();
	private WaterQuery _cachedWater;

	public float       SubmergedRatio { get; private set; }
	public int         SubmergedCount { get; private set; }
	public WaterSample LastSample     { get; private set; } = WaterSample.Invalid;

	// ── GPU Gather ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	private static int _globalGatherIdCounter = 1;
	private int _gatherBaseId = -1;

	// ── Monte Carlo / Manual Pontoons State ────────────────────────────────
	private bool _pontoonsValidated = false;
	private bool _markerOverride    = false;

	// ── EMA Filter State ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
	private float _smoothedWaterVelY = 0f;

	// ── Debug Flags ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	private bool _debugFirstWaterFound      = false;
	private bool _debugPhysicsLogged        = false;
	private bool _debugRippleLogged         = false;
	private bool _debugFirstRippleVelLogged = false;
	private int  _debugNullFrames           = 0;
	private int  _debugGatherMissFrames     = 0;
	private bool _debugRightingLogged       = false;

	public override void _Ready()
	{
		if (TargetBody == null)
			TargetBody = GetParentOrNull<RigidBody3D>();

		if (TargetBody == null)
		{
			GD.PushError($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' no RigidBody3D found.");
			SetPhysicsProcess(false);
			return;
		}

		if (Shape == null)
		{
			var parent = GetParent();
			if (parent != null)
			{
				foreach (var child in parent.GetChildren())
				{
					if (child is CollisionShape3D cs)
					{
						Shape = cs;
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			if (Shape == null && UseAllCollisionShapesIfShapeNull)
			{
				foreach (var child in TargetBody.GetChildren())
				{
					if (child is CollisionShape3D cs)
					{
						Shape = cs;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		if (Shape == null)
			GD.PushWarning($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' no CollisionShape3D found (buoyancy still works but bounds may be inaccurate).");

		_gravity = Mathf.Abs((float)ProjectSettings.GetSetting("physics/3d/default_gravity"));

		// --- Step 1: Detect Manual Marker3D Pontoons ---
		var markers = new List<Vector3>();
		foreach (Node child in GetChildren())
			if (child is Marker3D m) markers.Add(m.Position);

		ResolveParametersCommon();

		if (markers.Count > 0)
		{
			_markerOverride    = true;
			_pontoonsValidated = true;
			_pontoons          = markers.ToArray();

			RecomputePontoonDerivedParams();

			GD.Print($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' Manual Marker3D mode | pontoons={markers.Count} " +
					 $"V_total={_totalVolume:F5}m³ V_each={_volumePerPontoon:F6}m³ " +
					 $"hydroR={_hydroRadius:F3}m subR={_submersionRadius:F3}m");
		}
		else
		{
			// --- Step 2: Adaptive Resolution & Monte Carlo Prep ---
			GeneratePontoons();
			if (_pontoons.Length > 0)
				RecomputePontoonDerivedParams();
		}

		if (_pontoons.Length == 0)
		{
			GD.PushError($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' no pontoons generated.");
			SetPhysicsProcess(false);
			return;
		}

		int start = Interlocked.Add(ref _globalGatherIdCounter, _pontoons.Length) - _pontoons.Length;
		_gatherBaseId = start;
