		if (_gatherBaseId + _pontoons.Length >= 16_000_000)
			GD.PushWarning($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' gather ID approaching float precision limit.");

		float subRatioEq    = Density / Mathf.Max(_effectiveWaterDensity, 1f);
		float depthEqApprox = (subRatioEq - 0.5f) * _submersionRadius * 2f;

		GD.Print($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' init | body={TargetBody.Name} mass={TargetBody.Mass:F2}kg | " +
				 $"density={Density:F0}kg/m³ waterRho={_effectiveWaterDensity:F0}kg/m³ " +
				 $"V_total={_totalVolume:F5}m³ pontoons={_pontoons.Length} V_each={_volumePerPontoon:F6}m³ | " +
				 $"hydroR={_hydroRadius:F3}m subR={_submersionRadius:F3}m | " +
				 $"drag={_effectiveDragCoeff:F2} angDrag={_effectiveAngularDrag:F2} | " +
				 $"eqSub≈{subRatioEq:F3} eqDepth≈{depthEqApprox:F3}m | gatherBaseId={_gatherBaseId} | markerOverride={_markerOverride}");

		if (subRatioEq >= 1.0f)
			GD.PushWarning($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' subRatio≥1 (will sink). Density={Density:F0} ≥ WaterDensity={_effectiveWaterDensity:F0}.");

		// --- Auto/Manual CoM Shift (Righting Moment) ---
		AutoAdjustCenterOfMassIfNeeded();
	}

	private void ResolveParametersCommon()
	{
		_effectiveWaterDensity = UseAdvancedMode ? Mathf.Max(WaterDensity, 1f) : 1000f;

		if (UseAdvancedMode)
		{
			_effectiveDragCoeff        = DragCoefficientOverride;
			_effectiveAngularDrag      = AngularDragOverride;
			_effectiveDynPressureScale = DynamicPressureScale;
		}
		else
		{
			(_effectiveDragCoeff, _effectiveAngularDrag) = HorizontalDrag switch
			{
				HorizontalDragPreset.Low  => (0.5f, 0.2f),
				HorizontalDragPreset.High => (2.8f, 1.8f),
				_                         => (1.2f, 0.5f),
			};
			_effectiveDynPressureScale = 0.02f;
		}

		float safeDensity = Mathf.Max(Density, 1f);
		_totalVolume = TargetBody.Mass / safeDensity;
	}

	// ── Righting / Center of Mass Auto-Correction ─────────────────────────────

	private void AutoAdjustCenterOfMassIfNeeded()
	{
		if (Righting == RightingMode.Off) return;
		if (TargetBody == null) return;

		if (TargetBody.CenterOfMassMode == RigidBody3D.CenterOfMassModeEnum.Custom)
		{
			if (!_debugRightingLogged)
			{
				_debugRightingLogged = true;
				GD.Print($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' Righting skipped: TargetBody.CenterOfMassMode is already Custom.");
			}
			return;
		}

		if (Density >= _effectiveWaterDensity * 0.999f && Righting == RightingMode.Auto)
			return;

		float bias = Righting switch
		{
			RightingMode.ManualBias => Mathf.Clamp(BottomHeavyBias, 0f, 1f),
			RightingMode.Auto => ComputeAutoBias(),
			_ => 0f
		};

		if (bias <= 0.001f) return;

		Aabb bounds = GetCompositeAabbLocal();
		float h = Mathf.Max(bounds.Size.Y, 0.001f);

		Vector3 center = bounds.Position + bounds.Size * 0.5f;

		float bottomY = bounds.Position.Y;
		float targetY = Mathf.Lerp(center.Y, bottomY + h * 0.05f, bias);
		Vector3 newComLocal = new Vector3(center.X, targetY, center.Z);

		TargetBody.CenterOfMassMode = RigidBody3D.CenterOfMassModeEnum.Custom;
		TargetBody.CenterOfMass     = newComLocal;

		if (!_debugRightingLogged)
		{
			_debugRightingLogged = true;
			GD.Print($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' Righting applied | mode={Righting} bias={bias:F2} | " +
					 $"CoM(local)={newComLocal:F3} boundsY=[{bottomY:F3}..{(bounds.Position.Y + bounds.Size.Y):F3}]");
		}
	}

	private float ComputeAutoBias()
	{
		float buoy = Mathf.Clamp(1f - (Density / Mathf.Max(_effectiveWaterDensity, 1f)), 0f, 1f);
		float bias = 0.15f * Mathf.Pow(buoy, 0.35f) + 0.55f * Mathf.Pow(buoy, 0.85f);
		return Mathf.Clamp(bias, 0f, Mathf.Clamp(AutoBiasMax, 0f, 1f));
	}

	// ── Shape AABB Helpers (Composite) ───────────────────────────────────────

	private Aabb GetCompositeAabbLocal()
	{
		if (!UseAllCollisionShapesIfShapeNull || Shape != null)
		{
			if (Shape != null || !UseAllCollisionShapesIfShapeNull)
				return GetCollisionShapeAabbLocal(Shape);
		}

		bool any = false;
		Vector3 min = Vector3.Zero, max = Vector3.Zero;

		foreach (Node child in TargetBody.GetChildren())
		{
			if (child is not CollisionShape3D cs) continue;
			if (cs.Shape == null) continue;
			if (!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(cs)) continue;

			Aabb aabb = GetCollisionShapeAabbLocal(cs);
			Vector3 aMin = aabb.Position;
			Vector3 aMax = aabb.Position + aabb.Size;

			if (!any)
			{
				any = true;
				min = aMin;
				max = aMax;
			}
			else
			{
				min = min.Min(aMin);
				max = max.Max(aMax);
			}
		}

		if (any)
			return new Aabb(min, max - min);

		return GetCollisionShapeAabbLocal(Shape);
	}

	private Aabb GetCollisionShapeAabbLocal(CollisionShape3D cs)
	{
		if (cs?.Shape == null)
			return new Aabb(new Vector3(-0.5f, -0.5f, -0.5f), Vector3.One);

		Aabb localAabb = GetShapeAabbLocal(cs.Shape);
		Transform3D t = cs.Transform;

		Vector3 min = new Vector3(float.MaxValue, float.MaxValue, float.MaxValue);
		Vector3 max = new Vector3(float.MinValue, float.MinValue, float.MinValue);

		Vector3 p0 = localAabb.Position;
		Vector3 p1 = localAabb.Position + new Vector3(localAabb.Size.X, 0, 0);
		Vector3 p2 = localAabb.Position + new Vector3(0, localAabb.Size.Y, 0);
		Vector3 p3 = localAabb.Position + new Vector3(0, 0, localAabb.Size.Z);
		Vector3 p4 = localAabb.Position + new Vector3(localAabb.Size.X, localAabb.Size.Y, 0);
		Vector3 p5 = localAabb.Position + new Vector3(localAabb.Size.X, 0, localAabb.Size.Z);
		Vector3 p6 = localAabb.Position + new Vector3(0, localAabb.Size.Y, localAabb.Size.Z);
		Vector3 p7 = localAabb.Position + localAabb.Size;

		Span<Vector3> corners = stackalloc Vector3[8] { p0, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7 };

		for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
		{
			Vector3 v = t * corners[i];
			min = min.Min(v);
			max = max.Max(v);
		}

		return new Aabb(min, max - min);
	}

	private static Aabb GetShapeAabbLocal(Shape3D s)
	{
		if (s == null) return new Aabb(Vector3.Zero, Vector3.One);

		if (s is BoxShape3D box)
			return new Aabb(-box.Size * 0.5f, box.Size);

		if (s is SphereShape3D sphere)
			return new Aabb(new Vector3(-sphere.Radius, -sphere.Radius, -sphere.Radius),
							new Vector3(sphere.Radius * 2f, sphere.Radius * 2f, sphere.Radius * 2f));

		if (s is CapsuleShape3D cap)
			return new Aabb(new Vector3(-cap.Radius, -cap.Height * 0.5f - cap.Radius, -cap.Radius),
							new Vector3(cap.Radius * 2f, cap.Height + cap.Radius * 2f, cap.Radius * 2f));

		if (s is CylinderShape3D cyl)
			return new Aabb(new Vector3(-cyl.Radius, -cyl.Height * 0.5f, -cyl.Radius),
							new Vector3(cyl.Radius * 2f, cyl.Height, cyl.Radius * 2f));

		if (s is ConvexPolygonShape3D convex)
		{
			Vector3[] pts = convex.Points;
			if (pts == null || pts.Length == 0) return new Aabb(Vector3.Zero, Vector3.One);
			Vector3 min = pts[0], max = pts[0];
			foreach (var p in pts) { min = min.Min(p); max = max.Max(p); }
			return new Aabb(min, max - min);
		}

		if (s is ConcavePolygonShape3D concave)
		{
			Vector3[] faces = concave.GetFaces();
			if (faces == null || faces.Length == 0) return new Aabb(Vector3.Zero, Vector3.One);
			Vector3 min = faces[0], max = faces[0];
			foreach (var f in faces) { min = min.Min(f); max = max.Max(f); }
			return new Aabb(min, max - min);
		}

		return new Aabb(new Vector3(-0.5f, -0.5f, -0.5f), Vector3.One);
	}

	// ── Pontoon Generation & Derived Params ───────────────────────────────────────

	private void GeneratePontoons()
	{
		int res = UseAdvancedMode ? Mathf.Clamp(VoxelResolution, 1, 4) : 2;

		if (!UseAdvancedMode)
		{
			float minEdge = GetCompositeAabbLocal().Size.MinAxis();
			if (minEdge < SMALL_OBJECT_THRESHOLD)
			{
				res = 1;
				GD.Print($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' Small object detected (minEdge={minEdge:F3}m < {SMALL_OBJECT_THRESHOLD}m) -> low pontoon count mode");
			}
		}

		Aabb bounds = GetCompositeAabbLocal();
		var list = new List<Vector3>(res * res * res);
		
		for (int x = 0; x < res; x++)
		for (int y = 0; y < res; y++)
		for (int z = 0; z < res; z++)
		{
			// Apply a 5% inward margin to prevent pontoons from sitting exactly on the mathematical boundary of the AABB,
			// which could cause Godot's IntersectPoint to incorrectly report them as outside the physics shape.
			float margin = 0.05f;
			float tx = res > 1 ? Mathf.Lerp(margin, 1f - margin, x / (float)(res - 1)) : 0.5f;
			float ty = res > 1 ? Mathf.Lerp(margin, 1f - margin, y / (float)(res - 1)) : 0.5f;
			float tz = res > 1 ? Mathf.Lerp(margin, 1f - margin, z / (float)(res - 1)) : 0.5f;

			list.Add(bounds.Position + new Vector3(
				bounds.Size.X * tx, bounds.Size.Y * ty, bounds.Size.Z * tz));
		}

		_pontoons = list.ToArray();
		GD.Print($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' pontoons generated | count={_pontoons.Length} res={res} | boundsSize={bounds.Size:F3}");
	}

	private void RecomputePontoonDerivedParams()
	{
		int count = Mathf.Max(_pontoons.Length, 1);
		_volumePerPontoon = _totalVolume / count;

		_hydroRadius = Mathf.Pow(_volumePerPontoon * 3f / (4f * Mathf.Pi), 1f / 3f);
		_hydroRadius = Mathf.Clamp(_hydroRadius, 0.01f, 10f);

		if (PontoonRadiusOverride > 0.001f)
		{
			_submersionRadius = PontoonRadiusOverride;
		}
		else
		{
			Aabb b = GetCompositeAabbLocal();
			float minEdge = Mathf.Min(b.Size.X, Mathf.Min(b.Size.Y, b.Size.Z));
			int resApprox = Mathf.Clamp((UseAdvancedMode ? VoxelResolution : 2), 1, 4);
			float cell = minEdge / Mathf.Max(resApprox, 1);
			float smoothR = Mathf.Max(cell * 0.5f, _hydroRadius);

			if (!UseAdvancedMode && minEdge < SMALL_OBJECT_THRESHOLD)
				smoothR = Mathf.Max(smoothR, Mathf.Max(b.Size.X, Mathf.Max(b.Size.Y, b.Size.Z)) * 0.5f);

			_submersionRadius = Mathf.Clamp(smoothR, 0.01f, 10f);
		}
	}

	// ── Monte Carlo Pruning (Deferred Execution) ──────────────────────────

	private void ValidatePontoonsMonteCarloDeferred()
	{
		_pontoonsValidated = true;

		if (_markerOverride || TargetBody == null) return;

		if (Shape?.Shape is ConcavePolygonShape3D)
		{
			GD.Print($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' Monte Carlo skipped for ConcavePolygon (trimesh).");
			return;
		}

		var world = TargetBody.GetWorld3D();
		if (world == null) return;
		var space = world.DirectSpaceState;
		if (space == null) return;

		if (TargetBody.CollisionLayer == 0)
		{
			GD.PushWarning($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' Monte Carlo skipped: TargetBody.CollisionLayer == 0.");
			return;
		}

		var validList = new List<Vector3>(_pontoons.Length);

		var query = new PhysicsPointQueryParameters3D
		{
			CollideWithBodies = true,
			CollideWithAreas  = false,
			CollisionMask     = TargetBody.CollisionLayer,
		};

		foreach (var localPt in _pontoons)
		{
			query.Position = TargetBody.ToGlobal(localPt);
			var results    = space.IntersectPoint(query, 8);

			bool inside = false;
			foreach (var r in results)
			{
				if (r.TryGetValue("collider", out var col) &&
					col.AsGodotObject() == TargetBody)
				{ inside = true; break; }
			}
			if (inside) validList.Add(localPt);
		}

		if (validList.Count == 0)
		{
			GD.PushWarning($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' Monte Carlo: all {_pontoons.Length} points outside shape. Keeping original pontoons.");
			return;
		}

		float retainRatio = (float)validList.Count / _pontoons.Length;
		GD.Print($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' Monte Carlo: {validList.Count}/{_pontoons.Length} retained ({retainRatio:P0}) | pruned {_pontoons.Length - validList.Count}");

		_pontoons = validList.ToArray();
		RecomputePontoonDerivedParams();
	}

	// ── Physics Loop ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	public override void _PhysicsProcess(double delta)
	{
		if (IWSWaterManager.Instance == null || TargetBody == null || _pontoons.Length == 0) return;

		if (!_pontoonsValidated)
		{
			ValidatePontoonsMonteCarloDeferred();
			if (_pontoons.Length == 0)
			{
				GD.PushError($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{Name}' No valid pontoons after Monte Carlo pruning.");
				SetPhysicsProcess(false);
				return;
			}
		}

		float fDelta         = (float)delta;
		float massPerPontoon = TargetBody.Mass / _pontoons.Length;

		if (TargetBody.CanSleep && TargetBody.Sleeping && SubmergedRatio > 0.01f)
			TargetBody.Sleeping = false;

		Vector3 comLocal = (TargetBody.CenterOfMassMode == RigidBody3D.CenterOfMassModeEnum.Custom)
			? TargetBody.CenterOfMass
			: Vector3.Zero;

		Vector3 comWorld = TargetBody.GlobalPosition + (TargetBody.GlobalBasis * comLocal);

		int   subCount      = 0;
		float totalSubRatio = 0f;
		float maxEnergy     = 0f;
		float maxFoam       = 0f;
		bool  anySample     = false;

		float   buoyancyTotal = 0f;
		Vector3 buoyancyMoment = Vector3.Zero; 

		float accumRippleVelY = 0f;
		int   accumCount      = 0;

		for (int pi = 0; pi < _pontoons.Length; pi++)
		{
			Vector3 globalPoint = TargetBody.ToGlobal(_pontoons[pi]);

			WaterQuery water = FindWaterCached(globalPoint);
			if (water == null)
			{
				_debugNullFrames++;
				continue;
			}

			if (!_debugFirstWaterFound)
			{
				_debugFirstWaterFound = true;
				GD.Print($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{TargetBody.Name}' entered water '{(water as Node)?.Name}' | nullFrames={_debugNullFrames}");
				_debugNullFrames = 0;
			}

			WaterSample sample = water.SampleWater(globalPoint);
			if (!sample.IsValid) continue;

			// ── GPU Gather Pipeline ────────────────────────────────────
			float rippleVelY_raw = 0f;

			if (water is IWSWaterBody wb)
			{
				IWSWaterQuerySampler sampler = wb.PhysicsSampler;
				if (sampler != null && sampler.IsEnabled && _gatherBaseId >= 0)
				{
					int pontoonId = _gatherBaseId + pi;
					sampler.RequestSample(pontoonId, globalPoint);

					if (sampler.GetResult(pontoonId, out float rippleH_raw,
							out float rippleVelYStep_raw, out float rippleF_raw))
					{
						var profile = wb.GetProfile();

						float absH    = Mathf.Abs(rippleH_raw);
						float signH   = Mathf.Sign(rippleH_raw);
						float boosted = Mathf.Pow(Mathf.Min(absH, 1.0f), 0.65f) * signH;

						float dispScale  = profile?.RippleDisplacementScale ?? 0.12f;
						float physMul    = profile?.RipplePhysicsScale ?? 1.0f;
						float worldScale = dispScale * physMul;

						float rippleH_world = boosted * worldScale;
						float dt            = Mathf.Max(fDelta, 0.0001f);
						rippleVelY_raw      = (rippleVelYStep_raw * worldScale) / dt;

						sample.Height += rippleH_world;
						sample.Foam    = Mathf.Max(sample.Foam, rippleF_raw);
						sample.Energy  = Mathf.Max(sample.Energy, Mathf.Abs(rippleH_world));

						accumRippleVelY += rippleVelY_raw;
						accumCount++;

						if (!_debugRippleLogged && Mathf.Abs(rippleH_world) > 0.001f)
						{
							_debugRippleLogged = true;
							GD.Print($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{TargetBody.Name}' first ripple via Gather | h={rippleH_world:F4}m vY_raw≈{rippleVelY_raw:F3}m/s scale={worldScale:F3}");
						}

						if (TargetBody.CanSleep && TargetBody.Sleeping &&
							(Mathf.Abs(rippleVelY_raw) > 0.005f || Mathf.Abs(rippleH_world) > 0.001f))
							TargetBody.Sleeping = false;

						// Reset the miss counter upon successful gather.
						_debugGatherMissFrames = 0; 
					}
					else
					{
						_debugGatherMissFrames++;
						// Relax the warning threshold based on pontoon count to account for GPU latency or LOD skipping.
						int warnThreshold = 60 * Mathf.Max(_pontoons.Length, 1);
						if (_debugGatherMissFrames == warnThreshold)
						{
							GD.PushWarning($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{TargetBody.Name}' Gather results missing for 60 frames. " + 
										   "This is normal if Water LOD is skipping frames, otherwise check IWSWaterQuerySampler.");
						}
					}
				}
			}

			maxEnergy = Mathf.Max(maxEnergy, sample.Energy);
			maxFoam   = Mathf.Max(maxFoam,   sample.Foam);
			anySample = true;

			float depth = sample.Height - globalPoint.Y;

			if (DrawDebug)
			{
				WaterDebugHub.DrawSphere(globalPoint, _submersionRadius,
					depth > 0 ? new Color(0f, 1f, 0.4f, 0.5f) : new Color(0f, 0.4f, 1f, 0.3f),
					0f, DebugCategory.Buoyancy);
			}

			if (depth <= -_submersionRadius) continue;

			float h = Mathf.Clamp(depth + _submersionRadius, 0f, _submersionRadius * 2f);
			float subRatio = (h * h * (3f * _submersionRadius - h))
						   / (4f * _submersionRadius * _submersionRadius * _submersionRadius);
			subRatio = Mathf.Clamp(subRatio, 0f, 1f);

			if (subRatio <= 0.001f) continue;

			subCount      += 1;
			totalSubRatio += subRatio;

			Vector3 originToPoint = globalPoint - TargetBody.GlobalPosition;
			Vector3 comToPoint    = globalPoint - comWorld;

			float addedMass   = subRatio * massPerPontoon * ADDED_MASS_COEFF;
			float inertiaMass = massPerPontoon + addedMass;
			float waveAttenuation = Mathf.Exp(-Mathf.Max(0f, depth) * 0.4f);

			// Note: Wave height is already applied to sample.Height.
			// We cap the vertical orbital velocity to prevent high-energy waves from causing extreme vertical launches.
			Vector3 waterVel = sample.FlowVelocity;

			if (sample.Velocity.LengthSquared() > 0.00001f)
			{
				Vector3 gerstnerOrbital = sample.Velocity * waveAttenuation;

				waterVel.X += gerstnerOrbital.X;
				waterVel.Z += gerstnerOrbital.Z;

				float gerstnerVelYCap = _submersionRadius * _gravity;
				waterVel.Y += Mathf.Clamp(gerstnerOrbital.Y, -gerstnerVelYCap, gerstnerVelYCap);
			}

			Vector3 safeAngVel = TargetBody.AngularVelocity;
			
			// Anti-jitter: Cap the angular velocity contribution to the local relative velocity 
			// to prevent positive feedback loops during extreme collisions.
			if (safeAngVel.LengthSquared() > 64f)
				safeAngVel = safeAngVel.Normalized() * 8f;

			Vector3 pointVel = TargetBody.LinearVelocity + safeAngVel.Cross(comToPoint);
			Vector3 relVel   = pointVel - waterVel;

			// ── Archimedes Buoyancy (volume-driven) ────────────────────
			float buoyancyForce = _effectiveWaterDensity * _gravity * (_volumePerPontoon * subRatio);

			// Buoyancy acceleration limit for highly buoyant objects (e.g., low density) 
			// to prevent unrealistic explosive popping from the water due to sudden submersion.
			float buoyLimitRatio = _effectiveWaterDensity / Mathf.Max(Density, 1f);
			if (buoyLimitRatio > 3f)
			{
				float maxAccelFactor = 1f + 2f * (buoyLimitRatio - 1f) / buoyLimitRatio;
				float maxBuoyForce   = massPerPontoon * _gravity * maxAccelFactor;
				buoyancyForce        = Mathf.Min(buoyancyForce, maxBuoyForce);
			}

			buoyancyTotal  += buoyancyForce;
			buoyancyMoment += globalPoint * buoyancyForce;

			if (!_debugPhysicsLogged && subRatio > 0.05f)
			{
				_debugPhysicsLogged = true;
				float bodyWeight    = TargetBody.Mass * _gravity;
				GD.Print($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{TargetBody.Name}' first buoyancy | depth={depth:F3}m subRatio={subRatio:F3} | " +
						 $"buoyF_i={buoyancyForce:F2}N buoyF_total≈{buoyancyTotal:F2}N weight={bodyWeight:F2}N " +
						 $"ratio≈{buoyancyTotal / Mathf.Max(bodyWeight, 0.001f):F3}");
			}

			// ── Implicit Quadratic Vertical Drag ──────────────────────
			float crossArea = Mathf.Pi * _hydroRadius * _hydroRadius * subRatio;
			float k_heave   = 0.5f * _effectiveWaterDensity
							* (_effectiveDragCoeff * WaterDamping * 2f)
							* crossArea;

			float vy    = relVel.Y;
			float absVy = Mathf.Abs(vy);

			if (absVy > 0.001f)
			{
				float denomHeave = inertiaMass + k_heave * absVy * fDelta;
				float vy_next    = vy * inertiaMass / denomHeave;
				float heaveDampF = inertiaMass * (vy_next - vy) / fDelta;

				// Clamp vertical drag force to prevent high-frequency jitter.
				float maxHeaveF = massPerPontoon * _gravity * 6.0f;
				heaveDampF = Mathf.Clamp(heaveDampF, -maxHeaveF, maxHeaveF);

				if (!float.IsNaN(heaveDampF) && !float.IsInfinity(heaveDampF))
				{
					TargetBody.ApplyForce(Vector3.Up * heaveDampF, originToPoint);
				}
			}

			// ── Implicit Quadratic Horizontal Drag ────────────────────
			float   k_lateral  = 0.5f * _effectiveWaterDensity * _effectiveDragCoeff * crossArea;
			Vector3 relVelXZ   = new Vector3(relVel.X, 0f, relVel.Z);
			float   speedXZ    = relVelXZ.Length();
			if (speedXZ > 0.001f)
			{
				float   denomLateral = inertiaMass + k_lateral * speedXZ * fDelta;
				float   speed_next   = speedXZ * inertiaMass / denomLateral;
				float   lateralDragF = inertiaMass * (speed_next - speedXZ) / fDelta;

				// Clamp horizontal drag force to prevent small mass/inertia objects from 
				// experiencing extreme torque and angular explosions when pushed.
				float maxLatF = massPerPontoon * _gravity * 4.0f;
				lateralDragF = Mathf.Clamp(lateralDragF, -maxLatF, maxLatF);

				Vector3 dragForce    = relVelXZ.Normalized() * lateralDragF;
				if (!float.IsNaN(dragForce.X) && !float.IsInfinity(dragForce.X))
					TargetBody.ApplyForce(dragForce, originToPoint);
			}

			// ── Dynamic Pressure ──────────────────────────────────────
			float downVel = -relVel.Y;
			if (downVel > 3.0f && depth > _submersionRadius * 0.5f)
			{
				float pressure    = 0.5f * _effectiveWaterDensity * crossArea
								  * downVel * downVel * _effectiveDynPressureScale;
				float maxPressure = inertiaMass * downVel / Mathf.Max(fDelta, 0.0001f);
				pressure = Mathf.Min(pressure, maxPressure * 0.5f);
				
				// Clamp dynamic pressure to avoid extreme bounce when dropping from high altitudes.
				float maxDynF = massPerPontoon * _gravity * 10.0f;
				pressure = Mathf.Min(pressure, maxDynF);

				TargetBody.ApplyForce(Vector3.Up * pressure, originToPoint);
			}

			// ── Surface Tension / Waterline Adhesion ─────────────────
			if (AdhesionDamping > 0.001f || SurfaceTensionPull > 0.001f)
			{
				float adhesionBand = _submersionRadius * Mathf.Max(AdhesionBandScale, 0f);
				if (adhesionBand > 0.0001f)
				{
					float distToWaterline = Mathf.Abs(depth);

					if (distToWaterline < adhesionBand)
					{
						float t = 1f - distToWaterline / adhesionBand;
						float adhesionBlend = t * t;

						float buoyRatio = Mathf.Clamp(
							_effectiveWaterDensity / Mathf.Max(Density, 1f), 1f, 8f);
						float autoScale = Mathf.Sqrt(buoyRatio);

						float adhesionForceTotal = 0f;

						if (AdhesionDamping > 0.001f)
						{
							float dampF = -relVel.Y
										* AdhesionDamping
										* autoScale
										* adhesionBlend
										* massPerPontoon;

							float maxF = massPerPontoon * _gravity * 3f;
							dampF = Mathf.Clamp(dampF, -maxF, maxF);

							adhesionForceTotal += dampF;
						}

						if (SurfaceTensionPull > 0.001f && depth < 0f)
						{
							float pullBlend = 1f + (depth / adhesionBand);
							pullBlend = Mathf.Clamp(pullBlend, 0f, 1f);

							float pullF = -massPerPontoon * _gravity
										* SurfaceTensionPull
										* autoScale
										* pullBlend;

							adhesionForceTotal += pullF;
						}

						if (!float.IsNaN(adhesionForceTotal) && !float.IsInfinity(adhesionForceTotal))
							TargetBody.ApplyForce(
								Vector3.Up * adhesionForceTotal, originToPoint);
					}
				}
			}
		} 

		if (buoyancyTotal > 0.001f)
		{
			Vector3 cobWorld = buoyancyMoment / buoyancyTotal;
			Vector3 cobOffsetFromOrigin = cobWorld - TargetBody.GlobalPosition;

			TargetBody.ApplyForce(Vector3.Up * buoyancyTotal, cobOffsetFromOrigin);

			if (DrawDebug)
			{
				WaterDebugHub.DrawSphere(cobWorld, 0.04f, new Color(1f, 0.8f, 0.2f, 0.85f), 0f, DebugCategory.Buoyancy);
				WaterDebugHub.DrawSphere(comWorld, 0.04f, new Color(1f, 0.2f, 0.6f, 0.85f), 0f, DebugCategory.Buoyancy);
				WaterDebugHub.DrawLine(comWorld, cobWorld, new Color(1f, 0.4f, 0.2f, 0.7f), DebugCategory.Buoyancy);
			}
		}

		// --- End-of-frame EMA Update (Diagnostic Only) ---
		if (accumCount > 0)
		{
			float rawAvg     = accumRippleVelY / accumCount;
			float mass       = TargetBody.Mass;
			float massFactor = Mathf.Clamp(mass / 50f, 0.05f, 1.0f);

			float tau      = Mathf.Lerp(0.10f, 0.01f, massFactor);
			float emaAlpha = 1f - Mathf.Exp(-fDelta / Mathf.Max(tau, 0.001f));

			_smoothedWaterVelY = Mathf.Lerp(_smoothedWaterVelY, rawAvg, emaAlpha);

			if (!_debugFirstRippleVelLogged && Mathf.Abs(_smoothedWaterVelY) > 0.02f)
			{
				_debugFirstRippleVelLogged = true;
				GD.Print($"[IWSBuoyancyBody] '{TargetBody.Name}' ripple surface velocity tracked | " +
						$"smoothed={_smoothedWaterVelY:F3}m/s rawAvg={rawAvg:F3}m/s " +
						$"tau={tau:F3}s alpha={emaAlpha:F3} [diagnostic only, not injected into drag]");
			}
		}
		else
		{
			_smoothedWaterVelY = Mathf.Lerp(_smoothedWaterVelY, 0f, fDelta * 5f);
		}

		SubmergedCount = subCount;
		SubmergedRatio = _pontoons.Length > 0 ? totalSubRatio / _pontoons.Length : 0f;

		if (anySample)
		{
			WaterSample center = IWSWaterManager.Instance.SampleWater(TargetBody.GlobalPosition);
			LastSample = new WaterSample
			{
				Height       = center.Height,
				Normal       = center.Normal,
				Velocity     = center.Velocity,
				FlowVelocity = center.FlowVelocity,
				Energy       = maxEnergy,
				Foam         = maxFoam,
				IsValid      = true,
			};
		}
		else
		{
			LastSample = WaterSample.Invalid;
		}

		// ── Quadratic Angular Drag (water only) ───────────────────────────
		if (subCount > 0 && _effectiveAngularDrag > 0.0001f)
		{
			Vector3 angVel = TargetBody.AngularVelocity;
			float speed = angVel.Length();

			if (speed > 0.001f)
			{
				float lin  = _effectiveAngularDrag * SubmergedRatio;
				float quad = lin * Mathf.Max(QuadraticAngularDragFactor, 0f);

				float torqueMag = lin * speed + quad * speed * speed;

				float maxTorque = Mathf.Max(0f, MaxAngularDragTorquePerKg) * TargetBody.Mass;
				if (maxTorque > 0f) torqueMag = Mathf.Min(torqueMag, maxTorque);

				// Anti-jitter: Implicit angular damping limit. 
				// Caps the torque to prevent small inertia objects from overshooting and reversing rotation within a single frame.
				float approxInertia = TargetBody.Mass * _hydroRadius * _hydroRadius * 0.4f;
				float maxStopTorque = (approxInertia * speed) / Mathf.Max(fDelta, 0.0001f);
				
				torqueMag = Mathf.Min(torqueMag, maxStopTorque);

				TargetBody.ApplyTorque(-angVel.Normalized() * torqueMag);
			}
		}
	}

	// ── Water Lookup Cache ────────────────────────────────────────────────

	private WaterQuery FindWaterCached(Vector3 worldPos)
	{
		if (_cachedWater != null)
		{
			Rect2 b = _cachedWater.GetBoundsXZ();
			float x = worldPos.X, z = worldPos.Z;
			if (x >= b.Position.X && x <= b.Position.X + b.Size.X &&
				z >= b.Position.Y && z <= b.Position.Y + b.Size.Y)
				return _cachedWater;
		}
		_cachedWater = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.FindWaterAtXZ(worldPos);
		return _cachedWater;
	}
}

internal static class Vector3Ext
{
	public static float MinAxis(this Vector3 v) => Mathf.Min(v.X, Mathf.Min(v.Y, v.Z));
}


// res://water/profiles/IWSWaterProfile.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Profile;

using Godot;
using System;

/// <summary>
/// Summary of all derived optical properties. Value type, Zero GC overhead.
/// Reverses intuitive colors/turbidity into physically correct Beer-Lambert absorption coefficients.
/// </summary>
public readonly struct DerivedOptics
{
	/// <summary>RGB absorption coefficient (linear space, passed directly to shader absorption_coeff).</summary>
	public readonly Vector3 AbsorptionRGB;

	/// <summary>Scattering intensity.</summary>
	public readonly float ScatteringIntensity;

	/// <summary>Roughness increment (0 when turbidity is 0).</summary>
	public readonly float RoughnessBoost;

	/// <summary>Target color for RADIANCE tinting.</summary>
	public readonly Vector3 RadianceTint;

	/// <summary>RADIANCE blend weight [0,1].</summary>
	public readonly float RadianceBlend;

	/// <summary>Effective refraction strength (includes turbidity attenuation).</summary>
	public readonly float RefractionStrengthEffective;

	/// <summary>Near-opacity bias [0,1].</summary>
	public readonly float OpacityBias;

	/// <summary>Reflection energy attenuation [0,1].</summary>
	public readonly float ReflectionAttenuation;

	/// <summary>Normal map mip bias [0, 4].</summary>
	public readonly float NormalMipBias;

	/// <summary>Derived foam injection threshold.</summary>
	public readonly float EffectiveFoamThreshold;

	/// <summary>Derived foam strength multiplier.</summary>
	public readonly float EffectiveFoamMultiplier;

	public DerivedOptics(
		Vector3 absorptionRGB,
		float   scatteringIntensity,
		float   roughnessBoost,
		Vector3 radianceTint,
		float   radianceBlend,
		float   refractionStrengthEffective,
		float   opacityBias,
		float   reflectionAttenuation,
		float   normalMipBias,
		float   effectiveFoamThreshold,
		float   effectiveFoamMultiplier)
	{
		AbsorptionRGB               = absorptionRGB;
		ScatteringIntensity         = scatteringIntensity;
		RoughnessBoost              = roughnessBoost;
		RadianceTint                = radianceTint;
		RadianceBlend               = radianceBlend;
		RefractionStrengthEffective = refractionStrengthEffective;
		OpacityBias                 = opacityBias;
		ReflectionAttenuation       = reflectionAttenuation;
		NormalMipBias               = normalMipBias;
		EffectiveFoamThreshold      = effectiveFoamThreshold;
		EffectiveFoamMultiplier     = effectiveFoamMultiplier;
	}
}

	[Export] public float WaterDensity               = 1000.0f;

	public DerivedOptics GetDerivedOptics()
	{
		Color targetColor = UseTransmittanceOverride ? TransmittanceColor : ColorDeep;
		float tr = Mathf.Max(targetColor.R, 0.001f);
		float tg = Mathf.Max(targetColor.G, 0.001f);
		float tb = Mathf.Max(targetColor.B, 0.001f);

		float safeRefDepth = Mathf.Max(RefDepth, 0.01f);
		Vector3 derivedAbsorption;

		if (UsePhysicalOptics && !UseManualAbsorption)
		{
			derivedAbsorption = new Vector3(
				-Mathf.Log(tr) / safeRefDepth,
				-Mathf.Log(tg) / safeRefDepth,
				-Mathf.Log(tb) / safeRefDepth);
		}
		else if (UseManualAbsorption)
		{
			float scale = 10.0f / Mathf.Max(WaterClarity, 0.1f);
			derivedAbsorption = AbsorptionCoefficient * scale;
		}
		else
		{
			derivedAbsorption = Vector3.Zero;
		}

		float turbidityMult   = Mathf.Exp(Turbidity * Mathf.Log(8.0f));
		Vector3 finalAbsorption = new Vector3(
			Mathf.Max(derivedAbsorption.X * turbidityMult, 0.001f),
			Mathf.Max(derivedAbsorption.Y * turbidityMult, 0.001f),
			Mathf.Max(derivedAbsorption.Z * turbidityMult, 0.001f));

		float effectiveScattering = ScatteringCoefficient
								  * Mathf.Lerp(1.0f, 4.0f, Turbidity);

		float roughnessBoost = Mathf.Pow(Turbidity, 0.6f) * 0.55f;

		float radianceBlend = Mathf.Pow(Turbidity, 0.7f) * 0.75f;
		Vector3 radianceTint = new Vector3(
			SedimentTint.R, SedimentTint.G, SedimentTint.B);

		float refractionEffective = RefractionStrength
								  * Mathf.Lerp(1.0f, 0.05f, Turbidity);

		float opacityBias = Mathf.SmoothStep(0.4f, 1.0f, Turbidity);

		float reflectionAttenuation = Mathf.Lerp(1.0f, 0.2f,
			Mathf.SmoothStep(0.0f, 1.0f, Turbidity));

		float normalMipBias = Turbidity * 3.0f;

		float effectiveFoamThreshold  = Mathf.Lerp(FoamSlopeThreshold, 0.02f, Turbidity);
		float effectiveFoamMultiplier = Mathf.Lerp(1.0f, 2.0f, Turbidity);

		return new DerivedOptics(
			absorptionRGB:               finalAbsorption,
			scatteringIntensity:         effectiveScattering,
			roughnessBoost:              roughnessBoost,
			radianceTint:                radianceTint,
			radianceBlend:               radianceBlend,
			refractionStrengthEffective: refractionEffective,
			opacityBias:                 opacityBias,
			reflectionAttenuation:       reflectionAttenuation,
			normalMipBias:               normalMipBias,
			effectiveFoamThreshold:      effectiveFoamThreshold,
			effectiveFoamMultiplier:     effectiveFoamMultiplier);
	}

	public Vector3 GetEffectiveAbsorptionCoeff()
		=> GetDerivedOptics().AbsorptionRGB;

	public (float density, float sharpness, float strength) GetEffectiveGlintParams()
	{
		float sharpness;
		if (UsePhysicalGlint)
		{
			sharpness = Mathf.Max(GlintSharpness, 4.0f);
		}
		else
		{
			float t = Mathf.Clamp(GlintSharpness, 0f, 1f);
			sharpness = Mathf.Exp(Mathf.Lerp(Mathf.Log(4f), Mathf.Log(512f), t));
		}
		float roughnessFactor   = Mathf.Clamp(SurfaceRoughness * 8.0f, 0f, 1f);
		float effectiveDensity  = GlintDensity  * (1.0f + roughnessFactor * 2.0f);
		float effectiveStrength = GlintStrength * (1.0f - roughnessFactor * 0.6f);
		return (effectiveDensity, sharpness, effectiveStrength);
	}

	public void NotifyChanged() => EmitSignal(SignalName.ProfileChanged);
}

// res://water/profiles/IWSWaveSettings.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Profile;

using Godot;

/// <summary>
/// Parameters for a single Gerstner wave.
/// Integrated into both the GPU shader for visual rendering and the CPU IWSGerstnerField for physical simulation.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaveSettings : Resource
{
	[Export] public Vector2 Direction  = new Vector2(1.0f, 0.0f);
	[Export] public float   Wavelength = 10.0f;
	[Export] public float   Amplitude  = 0.5f;
	
	/// <summary>
	/// Angular frequency (omega) in rad/s, not phase speed (m/s).
	/// Mapped this way to ensure stable partial derivatives during phase calculation.
	/// </summary>
	[Export] public float   Speed      = 2.0f;

	/// <summary>
	/// Horizontal displacement coefficient for wave crests (Gerstner choppy effect).
	///
	/// Participates in both physics and visuals with the following specific effects:
	/// 1. Visuals (Vertex Shader): Applies horizontal displacement to vertices to form sharp choppy wave crests.
	/// 2. Physics (IWSGerstnerField):
	///    - Used in XZ inverse mapping (up to 4 Newton iterations) to align physics sampling points with visual wave crests.
	///    - Multiplied into the horizontal velocity (vX/vZ) calculation, affecting the fluid flow thrust applied to buoyancy components.
	///
	/// Recommended ranges:
	///   0.0  -> Pure sine wave (no horizontal displacement, physics and visuals are perfectly aligned natively).
	///   0.3  -> Slightly choppy (default, physics deviation is seamlessly corrected by inverse mapping).
	///   >0.6 -> Highly choppy, resulting in a severe XZ offset. The heavily increased horizontal velocity impact may exacerbate buoyancy jitter.
	/// </summary>
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,1.0")]
	public float Steepness = 0.3f;

	public Vector2 GetNormalizedDirection() => Direction.Normalized();
}

// res://water/profiles/WaveSpectrumGenerator.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Profile;

using Godot;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;

/// <summary>
/// A procedural wave spectrum generator based on simplified JONSWAP / Pierson-Moskowitz models.
/// Automatically generates a statistically accurate list of IWSWaveSettings for an IWSWaterBody based on 
/// physical environmental parameters (wind speed, direction, fetch length), replacing arbitrary manual tuning.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class WaveSpectrumGenerator : Node
{
	[ExportGroup("Wind & Sea State")]
	
	/// <summary>
	/// Sustained wind speed in meters per second (m/s).
	/// Drives the primary energy of the wave spectrum.
	/// </summary>
	[Export] public float   WindSpeed       = 8.0f;
	
	[Export] public Vector2 WindDirection   = new Vector2(1f, 0f);

	/// <summary>
	/// Fetch distance in kilometers.
	/// Represents the uninterrupted distance over which the wind blows, limiting wave growth.
	/// </summary>
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "1.0,1000.0")]
	public float FetchKm = 200.0f;

	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "4,16")]
	public int WaveCount = 12;

	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,90.0")]
	public float DirectionalSpread = 30.0f;

	[Export] public int Seed = 42;

	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.5,3.0")]
	public float PeakWavelengthScale = 1.0f;

	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.01,10.0")]
	public float MaxAmplitude = 3.0f;

	[Export] public bool AutoApplyOnReady = true;

	private IWSWaterBody _owner;

	public override void _Ready()
	{
		_owner = GetParent<IWSWaterBody>();
		if (_owner == null)
		{
			GD.PushWarning("[WaveSpectrumGenerator] Must be a direct child of an IWSWaterBody node.");
			return;
		}

		if (AutoApplyOnReady)
			Regenerate();
	}

	public void Regenerate()
	{
		if (_owner == null) return;

		var waves = GenerateWaves();

		_owner.Waves.Clear();
		foreach (var w in waves)
			_owner.Waves.Add(w);

		GD.Print($"[WaveSpectrumGenerator] Generated {waves.Count} waves | wind={WindSpeed:F1}m/s dir={WindDirection} fetch={FetchKm:F0}km spread={DirectionalSpread:F0}°");
	}

	private List<IWSWaveSettings> GenerateWaves()
	{
		var rng = new Random(Seed);
		var result = new List<IWSWaveSettings>(WaveCount);

		const float g = 9.81f;

		float fetch_m = FetchKm * 1000f;
		float U       = Mathf.Max(WindSpeed, 0.1f);

		// Peak angular frequency (wp) approximation in rad/s based on the fetch-limited model.
		float wp = 22f * Mathf.Pow(g * g / (U * U * U * Mathf.Max(fetch_m, 1f)), 1f / 3f);
		wp = Mathf.Max(wp, 0.05f);

		float wind_angle = Mathf.Atan2(WindDirection.Y, WindDirection.X);
		float spread_rad = Mathf.DegToRad(DirectionalSpread);

		// Omega range limits (rad/s): spanning from 0.5 * wp to 4.0 * wp.
		float wMin = wp * 0.5f;
		float wMax = wp * 4.0f;
		float logRange = Mathf.Log(wMax / wMin);

		// Sample omegas, sort them, and estimate delta omega via adjacent differences 
		// for a more natural distribution compared to rigid linear stepping.
		float[] omegas = new float[WaveCount];
		for (int i = 0; i < WaveCount; i++)
		{
			float t      = (WaveCount <= 1) ? 0.5f : (float)i / (WaveCount - 1);
			float jitter = (float)(rng.NextDouble() - 0.5) * logRange / Mathf.Max(WaveCount, 1);
			float omega  = wMin * Mathf.Exp(logRange * t + jitter);
			omegas[i] = Mathf.Clamp(omega, wMin, wMax);
		}
		Array.Sort(omegas);

		for (int i = 0; i < WaveCount; i++)
		{
			float omega = omegas[i];

			// Calculate delta omega using adjacent differences (one-sided at endpoints) for energy integration.
			float dw = (i == 0)
				? (omegas[Math.Min(1, WaveCount - 1)] - omegas[0])
				: (i == WaveCount - 1)
					? (omegas[WaveCount - 1] - omegas[Math.Max(WaveCount - 2, 0)])
					: (omegas[i + 1] - omegas[i - 1]) * 0.5f;
			dw = Mathf.Max(dw, 1e-3f);

			// Deep water dispersion relation: k = w^2 / g, lambda = 2pi / k.
			float k          = omega * omega / g;
			float wavelength = Mathf.Tau / Mathf.Max(k, 1e-5f);
			wavelength *= PeakWavelengthScale;
			wavelength = Mathf.Clamp(wavelength, 0.5f, 500f);

			// Simplified JONSWAP spectrum shape mapping for statistical generation.
			float gamma = 3.3f;
			float sigma = omega <= wp ? 0.07f : 0.09f;
			float r     = Mathf.Exp(-0.5f * Mathf.Pow((omega - wp) / (sigma * wp), 2f));
			float s_omega = Mathf.Pow(omega, -5f)
						  * Mathf.Exp(-1.25f * Mathf.Pow(wp / omega, 4f))
						  * Mathf.Pow(gamma, r);

			// Amplitude approximation: a = sqrt(2 * S(w) * dw) * scale factor.
			float amplitude = Mathf.Sqrt(2f * s_omega * dw) * U * 0.05f;
			amplitude = Mathf.Clamp(amplitude, 0.001f, MaxAmplitude);

			float dir_offset = (float)(rng.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 2f * spread_rad;
			float dir_angle  = wind_angle + dir_offset;
			var dir = new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(dir_angle), Mathf.Sin(dir_angle));

			float tNorm     = (WaveCount <= 1) ? 0.5f : (float)i / (WaveCount - 1);
			float steepness = Mathf.Clamp(0.3f * (1f - tNorm * 0.4f), 0.05f, 0.3f);

			// Note: In the CPU IWSGerstnerField implementation, the 'Speed' parameter strictly maps 
			// to the angular frequency (omega) in rad/s, not the phase velocity (m/s). 
			// The spatial-temporal phase is calculated as (k * x - omega * t). Using phase speed here would corrupt derivative calculations.
			var wave = new IWSWaveSettings
			{
				Direction  = dir,
				Wavelength = wavelength,
				Amplitude  = amplitude,
				Speed      = omega,
				Steepness  = steepness,
			};
			result.Add(wave);
		}

		if (result.Count > 0)
		{
			float peakWavelength = Mathf.Tau * g / (wp * wp) * PeakWavelengthScale;
			GD.Print($"[WaveSpectrumGenerator] Peak wavelength≈{peakWavelength:F1}m | wp={wp:F3}rad/s | A≈[{MinAmp(result):F3},{MaxAmp(result):F3}]m | Note: Speed=omega(rad/s)");
		}

		return result;
	}

	private static float MinAmp(List<IWSWaveSettings> w)
	{
		float m = float.MaxValue;
		foreach (var x in w) m = Mathf.Min(m, x?.Amplitude ?? m);
		return m == float.MaxValue ? 0f : m;
	}

	private static float MaxAmp(List<IWSWaveSettings> w)
	{
		float m = 0f;
		foreach (var x in w) m = Mathf.Max(m, x?.Amplitude ?? 0f);
		return m;
	}
}

// res://water/rendering/IWSWaterSharedLighting.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

using Godot;
using IWS.Water.Profile;

/// <summary>
/// Shared lighting parameters between the two rendering domains (Spatial Shader for the surface and Compute Shader for the underwater).
/// Updated per frame by IWSWaterBody._Process() to eliminate data silos maintained independently by both rendering sides.
///
/// Design principles:
///   - Contains only parameters required by both GPU sides, implementing zero business logic.
///   - Centralizes all derived calculations here, allowing both shaders to read the results directly.
///   - Treats IWSWaterProfile as the single source of truth.
/// </summary>
public sealed class IWSWaterSharedLighting
{
    // --- Caustics (Shared Domain) ----------------------------------------------------
    public Texture2D CausticsTexture;
    public float     CausticsWorldScale;
    public float     CausticsStrengthUnderwater; // Underwater strength.
    public float     CausticsStrengthSurface;    // Surface strength (slightly lower).
    public float     CausticsSpeed;
    public float     CausticsDistortion;
    public float     CausticsFadeDistance;
    public float     CausticsChromatic;

    // --- Absorption and Scattering (Shared Domain) -----------------------------------
    public Vector3 AbsorptionRGB;
    public float   ScatteringIntensity;
    public float   WaterClarity;

    // --- Colors (Shared Domain) ------------------------------------------------------
    public Color ColorShallow;
    public Color ColorDeep;

    // --- Sun (Shared Domain) ---------------------------------------------------------
    public Vector3 SunDirection;
    public Vector3 SunColor;
    public float   SunElevationRad;

    // --- Wave Nonlinearity Exponent (Required for Compute Shader Gerstner evaluation) -
    public float WaveNonlinearExp;

    private bool _firstUpdate = true;

    /// <summary>
    /// Invoked per frame by IWSWaterBody._Process() to derive all shared parameters from the Profile.
    /// </summary>
    public void Update(IWSWaterProfile profile, IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer renderer)
    {
        if (profile == null) return;

        DerivedOptics derived = profile.GetDerivedOptics();

        CausticsTexture              = profile.UnderwaterCausticsTexture;
        CausticsWorldScale           = profile.UnderwaterCausticsWorldScale;
        CausticsStrengthUnderwater   = profile.UnderwaterCausticsStrength
                                     * Mathf.Lerp(1.0f, 0.1f, profile.Turbidity);
        
        // The surface caustics strength is slightly lower than underwater to prevent overexposure.
        CausticsStrengthSurface      = CausticsStrengthUnderwater * 0.4f;
        
        CausticsSpeed                = profile.UnderwaterCausticsSpeed;
        CausticsDistortion           = profile.UnderwaterCausticsDistortion;
        CausticsFadeDistance         = profile.UnderwaterCausticsFadeDistance;
        CausticsChromatic            = profile.UnderwaterCausticsChromatic;

        AbsorptionRGB      = derived.AbsorptionRGB;
        ScatteringIntensity = derived.ScatteringIntensity;
        WaterClarity       = profile.WaterClarity;

        ColorShallow = profile.ColorShallow;
        ColorDeep    = profile.ColorDeep;

        WaveNonlinearExp = profile.WaveNonlinearExp;

        // Reads cached sun information from the Renderer to avoid redundant scene tree scanning.
        if (renderer != null)
        {
            SunDirection   = renderer.CachedSunDirection;
            SunColor       = renderer.CachedSunColor;
            SunElevationRad = renderer.CachedSunElevationRad;
        }

        if (_firstUpdate)
        {
            _firstUpdate = false;
            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterSharedLighting] First update | " +
                     $"causticsScale={CausticsWorldScale:F3} " +
                     $"strengthUnder={CausticsStrengthUnderwater:F3} " +
                     $"strengthSurface={CausticsStrengthSurface:F3} | " +
                     $"absorption=({AbsorptionRGB.X:F3},{AbsorptionRGB.Y:F3},{AbsorptionRGB.Z:F3}) | " +
                     $"causticsTexture={(CausticsTexture != null ? "OK" : "NULL <- Surface caustics will be invisible")}");
        }
    }
}

// res://water/rendering/mesh/IWSWaterMeshClimap.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

using Godot;
using System;

/// <summary>
/// LOD Clipmap mesh strategy, suitable for infinite ocean surfaces (IWSWaterZoneInfinitePlane).
///
/// Structure:
///   Level 0 (Center patch) : CenterPatchSize x CenterPatchSize, GridResolution x GridResolution cells.
///   Level 1 (First ring)   : Extends outward by 1x, cell size doubles, generating only the ring area.
///   Level N                : Continues similarly, each level covering twice the range of the previous one.
///
/// Material ownership:
///   WaterMaterial is not exported here. The owning IWSWaterBody injects an isolated ShaderMaterial
///   clone via SetMaterial() after the surface renderer has configured it.
///   Geometry is built unconditionally during _Ready(); material is applied upon injection.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterMeshClimap : Node3D, IWSWaterMeshStrategy
{
    [Export] public float CenterPatchSize = 32f;
    [Export] public int   GridResolution  = 16;
    [Export] public int   LodLevels       = 5;

    [ExportCategory("Debug")]
    [Export] public bool DrawDebugBounds = false;

    private ShaderMaterial _waterMaterial;
    private MeshInstance3D[] _lodInstances;
    private float            _baseCellSize;
    private bool             _ready = false;

    public override void _Ready()
    {
        if (LodLevels <= 0 || GridResolution <= 0 || CenterPatchSize <= 0f)
        {
            GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterMeshClimap] '{Name}' Invalid parameters " +
                           "(LodLevels/GridResolution/CenterPatchSize must be positive). Mesh not built.");
            return;
        }

        _baseCellSize = CenterPatchSize / GridResolution;
        _lodInstances = new MeshInstance3D[LodLevels];

        for (int l = 0; l < LodLevels; l++)
        {
            float scale     = Mathf.Pow(2f, l);
            float cellSize  = _baseCellSize * scale;
            float outerHalf = CenterPatchSize * scale * 0.5f;
            float innerHalf = (l == 0) ? 0f : outerHalf * 0.5f;

            ArrayMesh mesh = (l == 0)
                ? GenerateCenterMesh(outerHalf, cellSize)
                : GenerateRingMesh(innerHalf, outerHalf, cellSize);

            var instance = new MeshInstance3D
            {
                Name             = $"ClipLOD_{l}",
                Mesh             = mesh,
                MaterialOverride = _waterMaterial,
                CastShadow       = GeometryInstance3D.ShadowCastingSetting.Off,
            };

            AddChild(instance);
            _lodInstances[l] = instance;
        }

        _ready = true;

        float radius = CenterPatchSize * Mathf.Pow(2f, LodLevels - 1) * 0.5f;
        GD.Print($"[IWSWaterMeshClimap] '{Name}' Mesh built " +
                 $"| LOD={LodLevels} CenterCell={_baseCellSize:F2}m CoverageRadius={radius:F1}m " +
                 $"| Waiting for material injection.");
    }

    public void SetMaterial(ShaderMaterial material)
    {
        _waterMaterial = material;

        if (_lodInstances != null)
        {
            foreach (var inst in _lodInstances)
            {
                if (inst != null)
                    inst.MaterialOverride = _waterMaterial;
            }
        }

        GD.Print($"[IWSWaterMeshClimap] '{Name}' Material injected " +
                 $"| InstanceID={_waterMaterial?.GetInstanceId() ?? 0}");
    }

    public void SyncFrame(Vector3 cameraWorldPos, float waterY)
    {
        if (!_ready) return;

        float snappedX = Mathf.Floor(cameraWorldPos.X / _baseCellSize) * _baseCellSize;
        float snappedZ = Mathf.Floor(cameraWorldPos.Z / _baseCellSize) * _baseCellSize;
        GlobalPosition = new Vector3(snappedX, waterY, snappedZ);

        if (_waterMaterial == null) return;

        float outerHalf = CenterPatchSize * Mathf.Pow(2f, LodLevels - 1) * 0.5f;
        float cellSize  = _baseCellSize   * Mathf.Pow(2f, LodLevels - 1);

        _waterMaterial.SetShaderParameter("lod_outer_half", outerHalf);
        _waterMaterial.SetShaderParameter("lod_cell_size",  cellSize);
    }

    public void Cleanup()
    {
        if (_lodInstances == null) return;
        foreach (var inst in _lodInstances)
            inst?.QueueFree();
        _lodInstances  = null;
        _waterMaterial = null;
        _ready         = false;
    }

    public override void _ExitTree() => Cleanup();

    // ── Mesh Generation ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    private ArrayMesh GenerateCenterMesh(float halfSize, float cellSize)
    {
        var tool = new SurfaceTool();
        tool.Begin(Mesh.PrimitiveType.Triangles);
        AddQuadRect(tool, -halfSize, -halfSize, halfSize, halfSize, cellSize);
        return tool.Commit();
    }

    private ArrayMesh GenerateRingMesh(float innerHalf, float outerHalf, float cellSize)
    {
        var tool = new SurfaceTool();
        tool.Begin(Mesh.PrimitiveType.Triangles);
        AddQuadRect(tool, -outerHalf,  innerHalf,  outerHalf,  outerHalf,  cellSize);
        AddQuadRect(tool, -outerHalf, -outerHalf,  outerHalf, -innerHalf,  cellSize);
        AddQuadRect(tool, -outerHalf, -innerHalf, -innerHalf,  innerHalf,  cellSize);
        AddQuadRect(tool,  innerHalf, -innerHalf,  outerHalf,  innerHalf,  cellSize);
        return tool.Commit();
    }

    private static void AddQuadRect(SurfaceTool tool,
        float x0, float z0, float x1, float z1, float cellSize)
    {
        int nx = Mathf.Max(1, Mathf.RoundToInt((x1 - x0) / cellSize));
        int nz = Mathf.Max(1, Mathf.RoundToInt((z1 - z0) / cellSize));
        float dx = (x1 - x0) / nx;
        float dz = (z1 - z0) / nz;
        var normal = Vector3.Up;

        for (int zi = 0; zi < nz; zi++)
        for (int xi = 0; xi < nx; xi++)
        {
            float lx = x0 + xi * dx, lz = z0 + zi * dz;
            float rx = lx + dx,      rz = lz + dz;

            var v00 = new Vector3(lx, 0f, lz);
            var v10 = new Vector3(rx, 0f, lz);
            var v01 = new Vector3(lx, 0f, rz);
            var v11 = new Vector3(rx, 0f, rz);

            tool.SetNormal(normal); tool.SetUV(new Vector2(0f, 0f)); tool.AddVertex(v00);
            tool.SetNormal(normal); tool.SetUV(new Vector2(1f, 0f)); tool.AddVertex(v10);
            tool.SetNormal(normal); tool.SetUV(new Vector2(1f, 1f)); tool.AddVertex(v11);
            tool.SetNormal(normal); tool.SetUV(new Vector2(0f, 0f)); tool.AddVertex(v00);
            tool.SetNormal(normal); tool.SetUV(new Vector2(1f, 1f)); tool.AddVertex(v11);
            tool.SetNormal(normal); tool.SetUV(new Vector2(0f, 1f)); tool.AddVertex(v01);
        }
    }

#if TOOLS
    public override void _Process(double delta)
    {
        if (!DrawDebugBounds || !Engine.IsEditorHint() || _lodInstances == null) return;
        for (int l = 0; l < LodLevels; l++)
        {
            float outerHalf = CenterPatchSize * Mathf.Pow(2f, l) * 0.5f;
            Color col       = new Color(0f, 1f - l * 0.15f, 0.5f + l * 0.1f, 0.3f);
            Vector3 center  = GlobalPosition;
            Vector3 a = center + new Vector3(-outerHalf, 0f, -outerHalf);
            Vector3 b = center + new Vector3( outerHalf, 0f, -outerHalf);
            Vector3 c = center + new Vector3( outerHalf, 0f,  outerHalf);
            Vector3 d = center + new Vector3(-outerHalf, 0f,  outerHalf);
            DebugDraw3D.DrawLine(a, b, col); DebugDraw3D.DrawLine(b, c, col);
            DebugDraw3D.DrawLine(c, d, col); DebugDraw3D.DrawLine(d, a, col);
        }
    }
#endif
}

// res://water/rendering/mesh/IWSWaterMeshRibbon.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

using Godot;
using IWS.Water.Zone;

/// <summary>
/// Ribbon mesh strategy, dynamically generating geometry along a spline path,
/// suitable for river flows (IWSWaterZoneSpline).
/// Features automatic tangent calculation and corner miter compensation.
///
/// Material ownership:
///   WaterMaterial is not exported here. The owning IWSWaterBody injects an isolated ShaderMaterial
///   clone via SetMaterial(). Mesh geometry is built independently of material availability.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterMeshRibbon : Node3D, IWSWaterMeshStrategy
{
    [ExportGroup("References")]
    [Export] public IWSWaterZoneSpline SplineZone;

    [ExportGroup("Mesh Quality")]
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.2,10.0")] public float SegmentLength  = 2.0f;
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "1,16")]      public int   SubdivideWidth = 4;

    [ExportGroup("Debug")]
    [Export] public bool DrawDebugBounds = false;

    private ShaderMaterial _waterMaterial;
    private MeshInstance3D _meshInstance;
    private bool           _ready = false;

    public override void _Ready()
    {
        if (!ValidateExports()) return;
        BuildMesh();
    }

    public override void _ExitTree() => Cleanup();

    public void SetMaterial(ShaderMaterial material)
    {
        _waterMaterial = material;
        if (_meshInstance != null)
            _meshInstance.MaterialOverride = _waterMaterial;

        GD.Print($"[IWSWaterMeshRibbon] '{Name}' Material injected " +
                 $"| InstanceID={_waterMaterial?.GetInstanceId() ?? 0}");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ribbon meshes are statically generated along the spline and do not follow the camera.
    /// </summary>
    public void SyncFrame(Vector3 cameraWorldPos, float waterY) { }

    public void Cleanup()
    {
        _meshInstance?.QueueFree();
        _meshInstance  = null;
        _waterMaterial = null;
        _ready         = false;
    }

    public void Rebuild()
    {
        if (!ValidateExports()) return;
        Cleanup();
        BuildMesh();
    }

    // ── Internal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private void BuildMesh()
    {
        var   curve       = SplineZone.SplinePath.Curve;
        float totalLength = curve.GetBakedLength();

        if (totalLength < 0.001f)
        {
            GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterMeshRibbon] '{Name}' Spline total length is near zero, skipping mesh generation.");
            return;
        }

        float halfWidth  = SplineZone.Width * 0.5f;
        int   segCount   = Mathf.Max(1, Mathf.RoundToInt(totalLength / SegmentLength));
        int   crossCount = segCount + 1;

        var centers    = new Vector3[crossCount];
        var tangents   = new Vector3[crossCount];
        var arcLengths = new float  [crossCount];

        for (int i = 0; i < crossCount; i++)
        {
            float arcLen  = (float)i / segCount * totalLength;
            arcLengths[i] = arcLen;
            centers[i]    = SplineZone.SplinePath.ToGlobal(curve.SampleBaked(arcLen));
            tangents[i]   = SampleTangentWorld(curve, arcLen, totalLength);
        }

        var laterals = new Vector3[crossCount];
        for (int i = 0; i < crossCount; i++)
        {
            Vector3 perpCurr = Perp(tangents[i]);
            if (i == 0 || i == crossCount - 1)
            {
                laterals[i] = perpCurr * halfWidth;
            }
            else
            {
                Vector3 perpPrev = Perp(tangents[i - 1]);
                Vector3 miterDir = perpPrev + perpCurr;
                float   miterMag = miterDir.Length();
                if (miterMag < 1e-5f)
                {
                    laterals[i] = perpCurr * halfWidth;
                }
                else
                {
                    miterDir /= miterMag;
                    float dot            = miterDir.Dot(perpCurr);
                    float compensatedLen = halfWidth / Mathf.Max(dot, 0.5f);
                    laterals[i]          = miterDir * compensatedLen;
                }
            }
        }

        int vertsPerCross = SubdivideWidth + 1;
        var tool          = new SurfaceTool();
        tool.Begin(Mesh.PrimitiveType.Triangles);

        for (int i = 0; i < crossCount; i++)
        {
            float u = arcLengths[i] / totalLength;
            for (int j = 0; j <= SubdivideWidth; j++)
            {
                float   v        = (float)j / SubdivideWidth;
                float   lateralT = v * 2f - 1f;
                Vector3 worldPos = centers[i] + laterals[i] * lateralT;
                Vector3 localPos = ToLocal(worldPos);
                tool.SetNormal(Vector3.Up);
                tool.SetUV(new Vector2(u, v));
                tool.AddVertex(localPos);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < segCount; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < SubdivideWidth; j++)
        {
            int v00 = i       * vertsPerCross + j;
            int v01 = i       * vertsPerCross + j + 1;
            int v10 = (i + 1) * vertsPerCross + j;
            int v11 = (i + 1) * vertsPerCross + j + 1;
            tool.AddIndex(v00); tool.AddIndex(v10); tool.AddIndex(v11);
            tool.AddIndex(v00); tool.AddIndex(v11); tool.AddIndex(v01);
        }

        ArrayMesh mesh = tool.Commit();

        _meshInstance = new MeshInstance3D
        {
            Name             = "RibbonMesh",
            Mesh             = mesh,
            MaterialOverride = _waterMaterial,
            CastShadow       = GeometryInstance3D.ShadowCastingSetting.Off,
        };
        AddChild(_meshInstance);
        _ready = true;

        GD.Print($"[IWSWaterMeshRibbon] '{Name}' Mesh built " +
                 $"| Segments:{segCount} Width:{SubdivideWidth} " +
                 $"| Length:{totalLength:F1}m Width:{SplineZone.Width:F1}m");
    }

    private Vector3 SampleTangentWorld(Curve3D curve, float arcLen, float totalLength)
    {
        float   eps  = Mathf.Max(totalLength * 0.001f, 0.05f);
        float   fwd  = Mathf.Min(arcLen + eps, totalLength);
        float   bwd  = Mathf.Max(arcLen - eps, 0f);
        Vector3 pFwd = SplineZone.SplinePath.ToGlobal(curve.SampleBaked(fwd));
        Vector3 pBwd = SplineZone.SplinePath.ToGlobal(curve.SampleBaked(bwd));
        Vector3 tang = pFwd - pBwd;
        tang.Y = 0f;
        return tang.Length() > 1e-5f ? tang.Normalized() : Vector3.Forward;
    }

    private static Vector3 Perp(Vector3 tangent)
        => new Vector3(-tangent.Z, 0f, tangent.X);

    private bool ValidateExports()
    {
        if (SplineZone == null)
        {
            GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterMeshRibbon] '{Name}' SplineZone is not assigned.");
            return false;
        }
        if (SplineZone.SplinePath?.Curve == null)
        {
            GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterMeshRibbon] '{Name}' SplineZone lacks a valid Path3D or Curve.");
            return false;
        }
        if (SegmentLength <= 0f)
        {
            GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterMeshRibbon] '{Name}' SegmentLength must be positive.");
            return false;
        }
        if (SubdivideWidth <= 0)
        {
            GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterMeshRibbon] '{Name}' SubdivideWidth must be a positive integer.");
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

#if TOOLS
    public override void _Process(double delta)
    {
        if (!DrawDebugBounds || !Engine.IsEditorHint()) return;
        if (SplineZone?.SplinePath?.Curve == null) return;
        var   curve       = SplineZone.SplinePath.Curve;
        float totalLength = curve.GetBakedLength();
        float halfWidth   = SplineZone.Width * 0.5f;
        float step        = Mathf.Max(totalLength / 40f, SegmentLength);
        for (float t = 0f; t <= totalLength + 0.001f; t += step)
        {
            float   arcLen  = Mathf.Min(t, totalLength);
            Vector3 center  = SplineZone.SplinePath.ToGlobal(curve.SampleBaked(arcLen));
            Vector3 tangent = SampleTangentWorld(curve, arcLen, totalLength);
            Vector3 lateral = Perp(tangent) * halfWidth;
            DebugDraw3D.DrawLine(center - lateral, center + lateral, new Color(0.2f, 0.8f, 1.0f, 0.6f));
            DebugDraw3D.DrawSphere(center, 0.12f, new Color(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.5f, 0.7f));
        }
    }
#endif
}

// res://water/rendering/surface/IWSWaterMeshStatic.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

using Godot;

/// <summary>
/// Static mesh strategy, suitable for finite bounded water bodies (IWSWaterZoneBox).
///
/// Does not generate a mesh procedurally; instead, it references an existing MeshInstance3D in the scene.
/// The mesh remains fixed in the world space and does not track camera movement.
///
/// Usage workflow:
///   1. Place a MeshInstance3D under the IWSWaterBody node (e.g., named "WaterMesh").
///   2. Set a PlaneMesh on the MeshInstance3D (no material needed in scene — it will be injected at runtime).
///   3. Attach IWSWaterMeshStatic under the IWSWaterBody node.
///   4. Assign the TargetMesh property of IWSWaterMeshStatic to the MeshInstance3D.
///   5. Assign the MeshStrategyNode property of the IWSWaterBody to this IWSWaterMeshStatic node.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterMeshStatic : Node, IWSWaterMeshStrategy
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Reference to an existing structural water surface mesh node within the scene.
    /// </summary>
    [Export] public MeshInstance3D TargetMesh;

    public override void _Ready()
    {
        if (TargetMesh == null)
            GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterMeshStatic] '{Name}' TargetMesh is not assigned.");
    }

    public void SetMaterial(ShaderMaterial material)
    {
        if (TargetMesh == null)
        {
            GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterMeshStatic] '{Name}' SetMaterial called but TargetMesh is null.");
            return;
        }
        TargetMesh.MaterialOverride = material;
        GD.Print($"[IWSWaterMeshStatic] '{Name}' Material injected -> {material?.ResourcePath ?? "(cloned instance)"}");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Static meshes are stationary and do not require camera synchronization.
    /// </summary>
    public void SyncFrame(Vector3 cameraWorldPos, float waterY) { }

    /// <summary>
    /// TargetMesh is a native structural scene node and should not be destroyed here.
    /// </summary>
    public void Cleanup() { }
}

// res://water/rendering/mesh/IWSWaterMeshStrategy.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

using Godot;

/// <summary>
/// Defines the mesh generation and updating strategy for water bodies.
/// Implements the Strategy Pattern to decouple mesh geometry generation (Clipmap, Ribbon, Static) 
/// from the core water simulation logic.
/// </summary>
public interface IWSWaterMeshStrategy
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Injects a per-body isolated shader material instance.
    /// Must be called once after the surface renderer produces the OwnedMaterial.
    /// </summary>
    void SetMaterial(ShaderMaterial material);

    /// <summary>
    /// Synchronizes the mesh position and internal LOD state with the camera every frame.
    /// </summary>
    void SyncFrame(Vector3 cameraWorldPos, float waterY);

    /// <summary>
    /// Releases resources and instances held by the strategy.
    /// </summary>
    void Cleanup();

    /// <summary>
    /// [Reserved] Spawns a high-poly local detail mesh near the specified world coordinate.
    /// Automatically reclaimed after the given duration.
    /// Default implementation is a no-op to maintain compatibility across all strategies without forcing implementation.
    /// Typical use case: Stacking a dense 10x10m decal mesh at the impact point of a massive object.
    /// </summary>
    void SpawnLocalDetailMesh(Vector3 worldPos, float radius, float duration)
    {
        // Default no-op to avoid breaking existing strategies (Static / Clipmap / Ribbon).
    }
}

// res://water/rendering/reflection/IWSWaterReflectionPlanar.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

using Godot;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;

/// <summary>
/// Planar reflection strategy utilizing a SubViewport and mirrored camera.
/// Provides real-time, high-precision reflection geometry, suitable for calm lakes and confined water bodies.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterReflectionPlanar : Node3D, IWSWaterReflectionStrategy
{
    [ExportGroup("Viewport Settings")]
    [Export] public bool FlipY = true;

    [Export(PropertyHint.Enum, "128,256,512,1024")]
    public int ViewportResolution = 512;

    [Export(PropertyHint.Layers3DRender)]
    public uint ReflectionCullMask = 0b101u;

    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.0,0.1")]
    public float NormalDistortionStrength = 0.02f;

    /// <summary>
    /// Safe offset above the water surface to prevent the water mesh itself 
    /// from appearing in the reflection due to floating-point depth precision limits.
    /// </summary>
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.001,0.2")]
    public float ClipPlaneOffset = 0.02f;

    [ExportGroup("Debug")]
    [Export] public bool ShowDebugViewport = false;

    private SubViewport     _viewport;
    private Camera3D        _mirrorCam;
    private ViewportTexture _vpTexture;
    private IWSWaterBody    _owner;
    private bool            _initialized  = false;
    private bool            _firstSync    = false;

    // Stores the previous frame's Near value to limit debug printing to significant changes.
    private float _lastLoggedNear = -1f;

    public bool IsAvailable => _initialized
                            && _viewport != null
                            && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_viewport);

    public ReflectionMode GetMode() => ReflectionMode.Planar;

    public void Initialize(IWSWaterBody owner)
    {
        _owner = owner;
        BuildViewport();
    }

    public void SyncFrame(Camera3D mainCam, float waterY, uint cullMask)
    {
        if (!IsAvailable || mainCam == null) return;

        SyncViewportSize(mainCam);

        Transform3D camTrans = mainCam.GlobalTransform;
        Vector3     camPos   = camTrans.Origin;

        Vector3 mirrorPos     = new Vector3(camPos.X, 2f * waterY - camPos.Y, camPos.Z);
        Vector3 camForward    = -camTrans.Basis.Z;
        Vector3 camUp         =  camTrans.Basis.Y;
        Vector3 mirrorForward = new Vector3(camForward.X, -camForward.Y, camForward.Z);
        Vector3 mirrorUp      = new Vector3(camUp.X,      -camUp.Y,      camUp.Z);

        _mirrorCam.GlobalPosition = mirrorPos;
        _mirrorCam.LookAt(mirrorPos + mirrorForward, mirrorUp);

        _mirrorCam.Fov = mainCam.Fov;
        _mirrorCam.Far = mainCam.Far;

        // Dynamic Near Plane Clipping calculation.
        // The mirror camera is positioned below the water surface. The distance to the surface is (camPos.Y - waterY).
        // By setting the Near plane precisely to this distance minus an offset, the projection frustum aligns 
        // with the water surface, strictly clipping any physical objects existing beneath it.
        float distToWater = camPos.Y - waterY;
        float desiredNear = Mathf.Max(distToWater - ClipPlaneOffset, mainCam.Near);
        _mirrorCam.Near   = Mathf.Max(desiredNear, 0.01f);

        if (Mathf.Abs(_mirrorCam.Near - _lastLoggedNear) > 0.1f)
        {
            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterReflectionPlanar] '{_owner?.Name}' Near plane updated -> " +
                     $"{_mirrorCam.Near:F3}m | distToWater={distToWater:F3}m | waterY={waterY:F2}");
            _lastLoggedNear = _mirrorCam.Near;
        }

        if (_mirrorCam.CullMask != ReflectionCullMask)
            _mirrorCam.CullMask = ReflectionCullMask;

        _viewport.RenderTargetUpdateMode = SubViewport.UpdateMode.Once;

        if (!_firstSync)
        {
            _firstSync = true;
            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterReflectionPlanar] '{_owner?.Name}' First sync completed | " +
                     $"camPos={camPos:F2} | waterY={waterY:F2} | " +
                     $"mirrorPos={mirrorPos:F2} | Near={_mirrorCam.Near:F3} | " +
                     $"cullMask=0x{ReflectionCullMask:X} | VP={_viewport.Size}");
        }
    }

    public Texture2D GetReflectionTexture() => _vpTexture;

    public Projection GetMirrorViewProjection()
    {
        if (_mirrorCam == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_mirrorCam))
            return Projection.Identity;

        Projection  proj  = _mirrorCam.GetCameraProjection();
        Transform3D viewT = _mirrorCam.GlobalTransform.AffineInverse();
        Basis       b     = viewT.Basis;
        Vector3     o     = viewT.Origin;

        Projection view = new Projection(
            new Vector4(b.Column0.X, b.Column0.Y, b.Column0.Z, 0f),
            new Vector4(b.Column1.X, b.Column1.Y, b.Column1.Z, 0f),
            new Vector4(b.Column2.X, b.Column2.Y, b.Column2.Z, 0f),
            new Vector4(o.X,         o.Y,         o.Z,         1f));

        return proj * view;
    }

    public void Cleanup()
    {
        if (_viewport != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_viewport))
        {
            _viewport.QueueFree();
            _viewport = null;
        }
        _vpTexture      = null;
        _mirrorCam      = null;
        _initialized    = false;
        _firstSync      = false;
        _lastLoggedNear = -1f;
    }

    private void SyncViewportSize(Camera3D mainCam)
    {
        var mainVP = mainCam.GetViewport();
        if (mainVP == null) return;

        Vector2 mainSize = mainVP.GetVisibleRect().Size;
        if (mainSize.X <= 0 || mainSize.Y <= 0) return;

        float aspect  = mainSize.X / mainSize.Y;
        int   vpH     = ViewportResolution;
        int   vpW     = Mathf.Max(1, Mathf.RoundToInt(vpH * aspect));
        var   newSize = new Vector2I(vpW, vpH);

        if (_viewport.Size != newSize)
        {
            _viewport.Size = newSize;
            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterReflectionPlanar] SubViewport size updated -> {newSize}");
        }
    }

    private void BuildViewport()
    {
        _viewport = new SubViewport
        {
            Name                   = "PlanarReflectionViewport",
            Size                   = new Vector2I(ViewportResolution, ViewportResolution),
            RenderTargetUpdateMode = SubViewport.UpdateMode.Disabled,
            TransparentBg          = false,
            PhysicsObjectPicking   = false,
            GuiDisableInput        = true,
            Msaa3D                 = Viewport.Msaa.Disabled,
            OwnWorld3D             = false,
        };
        AddChild(_viewport);

        _mirrorCam = new Camera3D
        {
            Name     = "MirrorCamera",
            CullMask = ReflectionCullMask,
            Near     = 0.05f,
            Far      = 500f,
        };
        _viewport.AddChild(_mirrorCam);

        _vpTexture   = _viewport.GetTexture();
        _initialized = true;

        if (ShowDebugViewport)
            BuildDebugDisplay();

        GD.Print($"[IWSWaterReflectionPlanar] '{_owner?.Name}' SubViewport setup complete | " +
                 $"res={ViewportResolution} | cullMask=0x{ReflectionCullMask:X} | " +
                 $"clipOffset={ClipPlaneOffset:F3}m");
    }

    private void BuildDebugDisplay()
    {
        var canvas = new CanvasLayer { Layer = 98, Name = "PlanarDebugLayer" };
        AddChild(canvas);

        var label = new Label
        {
            Text     = "Planar Reflection RT",
            Position = new Vector2(8f, 380f),
        };
        label.AddThemeColorOverride("font_color", new Color(0.4f, 1f, 0.6f));
        canvas.AddChild(label);

        var rect = new TextureRect
        {
            Texture           = _vpTexture,
            ExpandMode        = TextureRect.ExpandModeEnum.IgnoreSize,
            CustomMinimumSize = new Vector2(240f, 135f),
            Position          = new Vector2(8f, 400f),
        };
        canvas.AddChild(rect);
    }
}

// res://water/rendering/reflection/IWSWaterReflectionProbe.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

using Godot;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;

/// <summary>
/// Reflection probe strategy. Recommended for oceans or massive-scale water bodies.
///
/// Work mechanism:
/// Dispatches a ReflectionProbe instance to the water surface center. The Godot rendering pipeline 
/// automatically contributes the baked cubemap to the RADIANCE sampler. The shader samples it via 
/// texture(RADIANCE, reflect_dir) when reflection_mode is 1, bypassing the need for manual screen-space UV offsets.
///
/// Performance traits:
/// Fixed resolution cubemap reduces precise pixel alignment compared to Planar, but costs significantly less on GPU bounds.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterReflectionProbe : Node3D, IWSWaterReflectionStrategy
{
	[ExportGroup("Probe Settings")]

	/// <summary>
	/// Probe coverage range in meters. Should seamlessly envelop the visible water bounds.
	/// </summary>
	[Export] public Vector3 ProbeSize = new Vector3(100f, 20f, 100f);

	/// <summary>
	/// Update frequency strategy.
	/// 'Always' guarantees dynamic coherence for localized active bodies. 
	/// 'Once' saves immense performance for distant background water zones.
	/// </summary>
	[Export] public ReflectionProbe.UpdateModeEnum UpdateMode = ReflectionProbe.UpdateModeEnum.Always;

	/// <summary>
	/// Quality resolution allocated per cubemap face.
	/// </summary>
	[Export(PropertyHint.Enum, "64,128,256,512")]
	public int Resolution = 128;

	private ReflectionProbe _probe;
	private IWSWaterBody    _owner;
	private bool            _initialized = false;

	public bool IsAvailable => _initialized && _probe != null
							&& GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_probe);

	public ReflectionMode GetMode() => ReflectionMode.Probe;

	public void Initialize(IWSWaterBody owner)
	{
		_owner = owner;

		_probe = new ReflectionProbe
		{
			Name           = "IWSWaterReflectionProbe",
			Size           = ProbeSize,
			OriginOffset   = Vector3.Zero,
			UpdateMode     = UpdateMode,
			ReflectionMask = IWSWaterBody.REFLECTION_CULL_MASK,
			BoxProjection  = false,
			AmbientMode    = ReflectionProbe.AmbientModeEnum.Environment,
		};

		AddChild(_probe);
		_initialized = true;

		GD.Print($"[IWSWaterReflectionProbe] '{owner.Name}' Initialization complete | " +
				 $"size={ProbeSize} | mode={UpdateMode} | " +
				 $"cullMask=0x{IWSWaterBody.REFLECTION_CULL_MASK:X}");
	}

	public void SyncFrame(Camera3D mainCam, float waterY, uint cullMask)
	{
		if (!IsAvailable) return;

		var zone = _owner.ZoneNode as WaterZoneShape;
		Vector2 center = zone?.GetRippleCenterWorld_Render()
						?? new Vector2(_owner.GlobalPosition.X, _owner.GlobalPosition.Z);

		_probe.GlobalPosition = new Vector3(center.X, waterY, center.Y);

		if (_probe.ReflectionMask != cullMask)
			_probe.ReflectionMask = cullMask;
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Probe mode does not distribute a specific texture handle manually to the shader.
	/// Radiance evaluation handles the cubemap fetch natively.
	/// </summary>
	public Texture2D GetReflectionTexture() => null;

	public void Cleanup()
	{
		if (_probe != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_probe))
		{
			_probe.QueueFree();
			_probe = null;
		}
		_initialized = false;
	}
}


// res://water/rendering/reflection/IWSWaterReflectionStrategy.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

using Godot;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;

/// <summary>
/// Protocol interface governing surface reflection logic (Strategy Pattern).
///
/// Architected Implementations:
///   IWSWaterReflectionProbe   -> ReflectionProbe environment routing (oceans / optimized dynamics).
///   IWSWaterReflectionPlanar  -> SubViewport near-plane clipped render target (lakes / precise mirroring).
///
/// Ensures the Surface Renderer acts independently of the specific reflection mechanism, 
/// resolving shader uniforms systematically without tight coupling.
/// </summary>
public interface IWSWaterReflectionStrategy
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Verifies if the underlying reflection components are mounted and ready.
    /// IWSWaterBody checks this to prevent uniform injection null references.
    /// </summary>
    bool IsAvailable { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the pipeline branch ID instructing the shader logic.
    /// </summary>
    ReflectionMode GetMode();

    /// <summary>
    /// Binds the strategy lifecycle to the owning context. Executed during IWSWaterBody._Ready().
    /// </summary>
    void Initialize(IWSWaterBody owner);

    /// <summary>
    /// Computes real-time positioning and projection matrices. Invoked by IWSWaterBody._Process().
    /// </summary>
    void SyncFrame(Camera3D mainCam, float waterY, uint cullMask);

    /// <summary>
    /// Supplies the targeted ViewportTexture for Planar mode, or null for Probe mode.
    /// </summary>
    Texture2D GetReflectionTexture();

    /// <summary>
    /// Unbinds dependencies and disposes spawned sub-nodes. Executed during IWSWaterBody._ExitTree().
    /// </summary>
    void Cleanup();
}

/// <summary>
/// Bitflag configurations mapping directly to the 'reflection_mode' shader uniform branch constraints.
/// </summary>
public enum ReflectionMode
{
    /// <summary>Screen-space reflection dependency (legacy baseline fallback).</summary>
    None = 0,

    /// <summary>Godot RADIANCE cubemap reliance.</summary>
    Probe = 1,

    /// <summary>Strict symmetric mirroring layout.</summary>
    Planar = 2,
}

// res://water/rendering/surface/IWaterAutoInteractor.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

using Godot;

/// <summary>
/// Interface for automatic water surface interaction capture.
/// 
/// Implementers are responsible for maintaining an orthographic camera within a SubViewport,
/// tracking the ripple center every physics frame, and providing the captured texture RID to the GPU RippleSimulator.
///
