/// Currently supported by: IWSWaterZoneBox / IWSWaterZoneInfinitePlane.
/// IWSWaterZoneSpline continues to use the standard Emitter pipeline due to its non-planar mapping.
/// </summary>
public interface IWaterAutoInteractor
{
    bool IsAvailable { get; }
    bool IsEnabled   { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Synchronizes per physics frame: moves the capture camera to the new ripple center 
    /// and triggers SubViewport rendering for the intersection mask.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="rippleCenterWorld">The ripple center in the physics frame (World XZ, derived from Zone.GetRippleCenterWorld_Physics).</param>
    /// <param name="visualSize">The ripple simulation coverage range in meters (derived from Zone.GetVisualSize).</param>
    /// <param name="waterY">The global Y-coordinate of the water surface.</param>
    void SyncPhysicsFrame(Vector2 rippleCenterWorld, float visualSize, float waterY);

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the RenderingServer RID of the SubViewport's color texture (Main-thread safe).
    /// An invalid RID indicates that the capture pipeline is not yet initialized.
    /// </summary>
    Rid GetCaptureRsRid();
}

// res://water/rendering/surface/IWSWaterRenderData.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

using Godot;

/// <summary>
/// Data Transfer Object (DTO) for water rendering textures.
///
/// Responsibilities: Encapsulates GPU texture handles and provides a unified interface for material injection.
/// The IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer acts as the consumer of this object and drives the ApplyToMaterial() method.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterRenderData : Resource
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Visual height field (Output of SmoothCompute, utilized for shader vertex displacement).
    /// </summary>
    [Export] public Texture2Drd VisualTexture       { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Normal field (Output of NormalCompute, RGBA16F format, W channel stores curvature/signal data).
    /// </summary>
    [Export] public Texture2Drd NormalTexture       { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Temporal foam field (Output of FoamCompute, R32F format).
    /// </summary>
    [Export] public Texture2Drd TemporalFoamTexture { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Velocity field (Output of RippleCompute, RGBA16F format).
    /// RG channels = vertical velocities.
    /// BA channels = surface flow XZ vectors (Drives Semi-Lagrangian foam advection and detail flow mapping).
    /// </summary>
    [Export] public Texture2Drd VelocityTexture     { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Injects all GPU simulation textures into the specified material.
    /// Called every frame by IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer.SyncFrame() to ensure the shader reads the latest Ping-Pong buffers.
    /// </summary>
    public void ApplyToMaterial(ShaderMaterial mat)
    {
        if (mat == null) return;

        if (VisualTexture       != null) mat.SetShaderParameter("visual_texture",          VisualTexture);
        if (NormalTexture       != null) mat.SetShaderParameter("ripple_normal_texture",   NormalTexture);
        if (TemporalFoamTexture != null) mat.SetShaderParameter("foam_texture",            TemporalFoamTexture);

        // Exposes the velocity texture (BA = surface flow field) to the spatial shader for dynamic advection.
        if (VelocityTexture     != null) mat.SetShaderParameter("ripple_velocity_texture", VelocityTexture);
    }
}

// res://water/rendering/surface/IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

using Godot;
using System;
using IWS.Water.Profile;
using IWS.Water.Simulation;

/// <summary>
/// Centralized material injector and uniform synchronizer for water surfaces.
/// Employs the Prototype pattern to clone the base ShaderMaterial, guaranteeing that 
/// multiple water bodies do not bleed uniform configurations into one another.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer : Node
{
	[ExportGroup("References")]
	/// <summary>
	/// Template ShaderMaterial assigned in the editor.
	/// At runtime, this is cloned into OwnedMaterial to ensure strict state isolation.
	/// </summary>
	[Export] public ShaderMaterial     WaterMaterial;
	[Export] public IWSRippleSimMgr    RippleSimulator;
	[Export] public DirectionalLight3D SunLight;

	[ExportGroup("LOD")]
	/// <summary>
	/// Level of Detail transition distances.
	/// X = LOD0 to LOD1 start distance (Full geometry -> Simplified).
	/// Y = LOD1 to LOD2 start distance (Simplified -> Minimal footprint).
	/// Unit: Meters. Recommended values: (25, 80).
	/// </summary>
	[Export] public Vector2 LodDistances = new Vector2(25f, 80f);

	// ── Per-body Isolated Material Instance ──────────────────────────
	// Each IWSWaterBody owns one unique cloned ShaderMaterial.
	// All uniform writes target _ownedMaterial to prevent cross-body parameter bleeding.
	private ShaderMaterial _ownedMaterial;

	/// <summary>
	/// The strictly isolated ShaderMaterial clone. IWSWaterBody._Ready() injects this into the mesh strategy.
	/// Null until _Ready() has executed successfully.
	/// </summary>
	public ShaderMaterial OwnedMaterial => _ownedMaterial;

	// ── Internal State ───────────────────────────────────────────────
	private Vector2[] _dirs        = Array.Empty<Vector2>();
	private float[]   _wavelengths = Array.Empty<float>();
	private float[]   _amplitudes  = Array.Empty<float>();
	private float[]   _speeds      = Array.Empty<float>();
	private float[]   _steepnesses = Array.Empty<float>();
	private int       _lastWaveCount = -1;

	private bool            _profileDirty    = true;
	private IWSWaterProfile _lastProfile     = null;
	private int             _lastProfileHash = 0;

	private Callable _profileChangedCallable;

	private Vector2   _lastFlowUVVelocity    = new Vector2(float.NaN, float.NaN);
	private float     _lastFlowFoamWeight    = float.NaN;
	private int       _lastReflectionMode    = -1;
	private float     _lastReflectionDistort = float.NaN;
	private Texture2D _lastMicroNormal1;
	private Texture2D _lastMicroNormal2;
	private Texture2D _lastFoamNormal;
	private Texture2D _lastCausticsTexture;

	private float _lastCausticsSurfaceDistortion   = float.NaN;
	private float _lastCausticsSurfaceFadeDistance = float.NaN;
	private bool  _warnedCausticsMissingTexture    = false;
	private bool  _debugCausticsSurfaceUploaded    = false;

	private float _lastDisplacementScale = float.NaN;
	private float _lastNormalScale       = float.NaN;

	public Vector3 CachedSunDirection    { get; private set; } = new Vector3(0.3f, 0.3f, 0.9f).Normalized();
	public Vector3 CachedSunColor        { get; private set; } = Vector3.One;
	public float   CachedSunElevationRad { get; private set; } = Mathf.Pi * 0.5f;

	private int       _sunScanCounter   = 0;
	private const int SUN_SCAN_INTERVAL = 60;

	private bool      _materialValidated  = false;
	private int       _validateRetryCount = 0;
	private const int MAX_VALIDATE_RETRIES = 5;

	private bool  _firstSyncDone        = false;
	private float _lastLoggedTurbidity  = -1f;
	private const float TURBIDITY_LOG_THRESHOLD = 0.1f;

	// ── Lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	public override void _Ready()
	{
		_profileChangedCallable = Callable.From(OnProfileChanged);

		if (WaterMaterial == null)
		{
			GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' WaterMaterial template is null. " +
						   "Assign a ShaderMaterial in the Inspector.");
			return;
		}

		if (WaterMaterial.Shader == null)
		{
			GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' WaterMaterial has no Shader assigned.");
			return;
		}

		// Clone the template. All localized uniform writes apply strictly to this clone (_ownedMaterial).
		// The [Export] WaterMaterial remains an untouched shared template.
		_ownedMaterial = (ShaderMaterial)WaterMaterial.Duplicate();

		// Architectural validation: verifies successful instantiation isolation.
		GD.Print($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' OwnedMaterial created " +
				 $"| instanceId={_ownedMaterial.GetInstanceId()} " +
				 $"| shader={WaterMaterial.Shader.ResourcePath}");
	}

	public override void _ExitTree()
	{
		UnsubscribeProfile(_lastProfile);
	}

	// ── Material Validation ────────────────────────────────────────────

	private bool TryValidateMaterial()
	{
		if (_ownedMaterial?.Shader == null) return false;

		bool ok =
			_ownedMaterial.GetShaderParameter("ripple_displacement_scale").VariantType != Variant.Type.Nil
			&& _ownedMaterial.GetShaderParameter("ripple_normal_scale").VariantType       != Variant.Type.Nil
			&& _ownedMaterial.GetShaderParameter("absorption_coeff").VariantType          != Variant.Type.Nil
			&& _ownedMaterial.GetShaderParameter("sun_elevation").VariantType             != Variant.Type.Nil
			&& _ownedMaterial.GetShaderParameter("turbidity").VariantType                 != Variant.Type.Nil
			// Foam detail flow mapping strictly requires the velocity texture.
			&& _ownedMaterial.GetShaderParameter("ripple_velocity_texture").VariantType   != Variant.Type.Nil;

		if (ok)
		{
			GD.Print($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' Shader uniform validation passed.");
			_materialValidated = true;
			return true;
		}

		_validateRetryCount++;
		if (_validateRetryCount >= MAX_VALIDATE_RETRIES)
		{
			GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' Shader uniform validation failed " +
						$"after {_validateRetryCount} retries. Check shader compilation or missing uniform bindings.");
			// Cease retry execution to prevent log spam.
			_materialValidated = true; 
		}
		return false;
	}

	// ── Profile Subscription ──────────────────────────────────────────

	private void OnProfileChanged() => _profileDirty = true;

	private void SubscribeProfile(IWSWaterProfile profile)
	{
		if (profile == null) return;
		if (!profile.IsConnected(Resource.SignalName.Changed, _profileChangedCallable))
			profile.Connect(Resource.SignalName.Changed, _profileChangedCallable);
	}

	private void UnsubscribeProfile(IWSWaterProfile profile)
	{
		if (profile == null) return;
		if (profile.IsConnected(Resource.SignalName.Changed, _profileChangedCallable))
			profile.Disconnect(Resource.SignalName.Changed, _profileChangedCallable);
	}

	private static int ComputeProfileHash(IWSWaterProfile p)
	{
		if (p == null) return 0;
		int h1 = HashCode.Combine(
			p.WindSpeed, p.WindDirection.X, p.WindDirection.Y,
			p.FoamIntensity, p.FoamSlopeThreshold,
			p.WaveNonlinearExp, p.SurfaceRoughness, p.WaterClarity);
		int h2a = HashCode.Combine(
			p.RippleDisplacementScale, p.RippleNormalScale,
			p.MicroNormalStrength, p.Stylization, p.ScatteringCoefficient,
			p.RefractionStrength, p.MicroNormalScale, p.RippleNormalStrength);
		int h2b = HashCode.Combine(
			p.FoamDecayRate, p.FoamEnergyInfluence, p.FoamNormalStrength,
			p.ShorelineWidth, p.ShorelineFoamIntensity, p.FoamDensity);
		int h3 = HashCode.Combine(
			p.AbsorptionCoefficient.X, p.AbsorptionCoefficient.Y, p.AbsorptionCoefficient.Z,
			p.SubsurfaceStrength, p.SubsurfaceExponent,
			p.GlintStrength, p.GlintSharpness, p.GlintDensity);
		int h4 = HashCode.Combine(
			p.UsePhysicalOptics, p.UsePhysicalGlint,
			p.ColorShallow, p.ColorDeep, p.SubsurfaceColor, p.IOR, p.FoamColor);
		int h5 = HashCode.Combine(
			p.JacobianFoamThreshold, p.JacobianFoamStrength,
			p.FlowSpeed, p.FlowTiling, p.JacobianFoamInjectRate,
			p.FoamBubbleTexture?.GetInstanceId() ?? 0);
		int h6 = HashCode.Combine(
			p.Turbidity, p.RefDepth, p.TransmittanceColor,
			p.SedimentTint, p.UseTransmittanceOverride, p.UseManualAbsorption);
		int h7 = HashCode.Combine(
			p.UnderwaterCausticsStrength, p.UnderwaterCausticsWorldScale,
			p.UnderwaterCausticsSpeed,
			p.UnderwaterCausticsTexture?.GetInstanceId() ?? 0);
		return HashCode.Combine(h1, h2a, h2b, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7);
	}

	// ── Sun Direction ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

	private void UpdateSunDirection()
	{
		if (SunLight != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(SunLight))
		{
			CachedSunDirection    = SunLight.GlobalTransform.Basis.Z;
			CachedSunColor        = new Vector3(
				SunLight.LightColor.R * SunLight.LightEnergy,
				SunLight.LightColor.G * SunLight.LightEnergy,
				SunLight.LightColor.B * SunLight.LightEnergy);
			CachedSunElevationRad = Mathf.Asin(Mathf.Clamp(CachedSunDirection.Y, -1f, 1f));
			return;
		}

		_sunScanCounter++;
		if (_sunScanCounter < SUN_SCAN_INTERVAL) return;
		_sunScanCounter = 0;

		var light = FindDirectionalLight(GetTree()?.Root);
		if (light != null)
		{
			SunLight              = light;
			CachedSunDirection    = light.GlobalTransform.Basis.Z;
			CachedSunColor        = new Vector3(
				light.LightColor.R * light.LightEnergy,
				light.LightColor.G * light.LightEnergy,
				light.LightColor.B * light.LightEnergy);
			CachedSunElevationRad = Mathf.Asin(Mathf.Clamp(CachedSunDirection.Y, -1f, 1f));
			GD.Print($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' Auto-found DirectionalLight '{light.Name}' " +
					 $"| Elevation={Mathf.RadToDeg(CachedSunElevationRad):F1}°");
		}
		else
		{
			CachedSunDirection    = new Vector3(0.3f, 0.3f, 0.9f).Normalized();
			CachedSunElevationRad = Mathf.Asin(CachedSunDirection.Y);
			CachedSunColor        = Vector3.One;
		}
	}

	private static DirectionalLight3D FindDirectionalLight(Node node)
	{
		if (node == null) return null;
		if (node is DirectionalLight3D dl) return dl;
		foreach (Node child in node.GetChildren())
		{
			var r = FindDirectionalLight(child);
			if (r != null) return r;
		}
		return null;
	}

	// ── Main Sync ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	public void SyncFrame(
		double                     time,
		Vector3                    worldPos,
		float                      waterSize,
		Vector2                    waterSizeXZ,
		IWSWaveSettings[]          waves,
		IWSWaterProfile            profile,
		IWSWaterSharedLighting     sharedLighting = null,
		IWSWaterReflectionStrategy reflection     = null)
	{
		if (_ownedMaterial == null) return;

		if (!_materialValidated)
			TryValidateMaterial();

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("sim_time",             (float)(time % 3600.0));
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("water_lod_distances", LodDistances);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("water_world_position", worldPos);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("water_size",           waterSize);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("water_size_xz",        waterSizeXZ); 

		if (RippleSimulator?.RenderData != null)
		{
			RippleSimulator.RenderData.ApplyToMaterial(_ownedMaterial);

			float dispScale = profile?.RippleDisplacementScale ?? 1.0f;
			if (!Mathf.IsEqualApprox(dispScale, _lastDisplacementScale))
			{
				_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("ripple_displacement_scale", dispScale);
				_lastDisplacementScale = dispScale;
			}
		}

		UpdateSunDirection();
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("sun_direction", CachedSunDirection);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("sun_color",     CachedSunColor);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("sun_elevation", CachedSunElevationRad);

		if (profile != _lastProfile)
		{
			UnsubscribeProfile(_lastProfile);
			SubscribeProfile(profile);
			_lastProfile     = profile;
			_profileDirty    = true;
			_lastProfileHash = 0;
		}
		else
		{
			int currentHash = ComputeProfileHash(profile);
			if (currentHash != _lastProfileHash)
			{
				_profileDirty    = true;
				_lastProfileHash = currentHash;
			}
		}

		if (_profileDirty)
		{
			UploadProfileFull(profile, waterSize, waterSizeXZ, sharedLighting);
			_profileDirty    = false;
			_lastProfileHash = ComputeProfileHash(profile);
		}
		else
		{
			SyncFlowUniforms(profile, waterSizeXZ);
			SyncCausticsUniforms(sharedLighting);
		}

		SyncWaveParameters(waves);
		SyncReflection(reflection, profile);

		if (!_firstSyncDone)
		{
			_firstSyncDone = true;
			bool velOk = RippleSimulator?.RenderData?.VelocityTexture != null;
			GD.Print($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' First SyncFrame completed " +
					 $"| waves={waves?.Length ?? 0} waterSize={waterSize:F1}m " +
					 $"| materialId={_ownedMaterial.GetInstanceId()} " +
					 $"| causticsTexture={(sharedLighting?.CausticsTexture != null ? "OK" : "NULL")} " +
					 $"| velocityTex={(velOk ? "OK" : "NULL (foam flow mapping fallback to static)")}");
		}
	}

	// ── Profile Upload ────────────────────────────────────────────────

	private void UploadProfileFull(
	IWSWaterProfile p,
	float waterSize,
	Vector2 waterSizeXZ,
	IWSWaterSharedLighting sharedLighting)
	{
		if (p == null) return;

		DerivedOptics derived = p.GetDerivedOptics();

		if (Mathf.Abs(p.Turbidity - _lastLoggedTurbidity) >= TURBIDITY_LOG_THRESHOLD)
		{
			_lastLoggedTurbidity = p.Turbidity;
			GD.Print($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' Turbidity -> {p.Turbidity:F2} " +
					 $"| reflAtten={derived.ReflectionAttenuation:F3}");
		}

		Vector2 windDir = p.WindDirection.Length() > 0.001f
			? p.WindDirection.Normalized() : Vector2.Right;

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("wind_direction",           windDir);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("wind_speed",               p.WindSpeed);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("micro_normal_speed1",      p.MicroNormalSpeedScale1);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("micro_normal_speed2",      p.MicroNormalSpeedScale2);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("micro_normal_layer_ratio", p.MicroNormalLayerRatio);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("wave_nonlinear_exp",       p.WaveNonlinearExp);

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("absorption_coeff",     derived.AbsorptionRGB);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("scattering_intensity", derived.ScatteringIntensity);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("visibility_distance",  p.WaterClarity);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("water_ior",            p.IOR);

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("turbidity",           p.Turbidity);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("radiance_tint",       derived.RadianceTint);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("radiance_blend",      derived.RadianceBlend);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("refraction_strength", derived.RefractionStrengthEffective);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("opacity_bias",        derived.OpacityBias);

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("reflection_attenuation",    derived.ReflectionAttenuation);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("normal_mip_bias",           derived.NormalMipBias);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("effective_foam_threshold",  derived.EffectiveFoamThreshold);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("effective_foam_multiplier", derived.EffectiveFoamMultiplier);

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("water_roughness",        p.SurfaceRoughness);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("ripple_normal_strength", p.RippleNormalStrength);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("micro_normal_strength",  p.MicroNormalStrength);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("micro_normal_scale",     p.MicroNormalScale);

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("ripple_displacement_scale", p.RippleDisplacementScale);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("ripple_normal_scale",       p.RippleNormalScale);

		_lastDisplacementScale = p.RippleDisplacementScale;
		_lastNormalScale       = p.RippleNormalScale;

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("color_shallow",       p.ColorShallow);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("color_deep",          p.ColorDeep);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("subsurface_color",    p.SubsurfaceColor);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("subsurface_strength", p.SubsurfaceStrength);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("subsurface_exponent", p.SubsurfaceExponent);

		var (gDensity, gSharpness, gStrength) = p.GetEffectiveGlintParams();
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("glint_strength",  gStrength);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("glint_sharpness", gSharpness);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("glint_density",   gDensity);

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("jacobian_foam_threshold",   p.JacobianFoamThreshold);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("jacobian_foam_strength",    p.JacobianFoamStrength);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("jacobian_foam_inject_rate", p.JacobianFoamInjectRate);

		if (p.FoamBubbleTexture != null)
			_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("foam_bubble_texture", p.FoamBubbleTexture);
		else
			GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' FoamBubbleTexture not assigned.");

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("flow_speed",  p.FlowSpeed);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("flow_tiling", p.FlowTiling);

		if (p.MicroNormalTexture1 != _lastMicroNormal1)
		{
			if (p.MicroNormalTexture1 != null)
				_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("micro_normal_1", p.MicroNormalTexture1);
			else
				GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' MicroNormalTexture1 not assigned.");
			_lastMicroNormal1 = p.MicroNormalTexture1;
		}
		if (p.MicroNormalTexture2 != _lastMicroNormal2)
		{
			if (p.MicroNormalTexture2 != null)
				_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("micro_normal_2", p.MicroNormalTexture2);
			else
				GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' MicroNormalTexture2 not assigned.");
			_lastMicroNormal2 = p.MicroNormalTexture2;
		}
		if (p.FoamNormalTexture != _lastFoamNormal)
		{
			if (p.FoamNormalTexture != null)
				_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("foam_normal_detail", p.FoamNormalTexture);
			else
				GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' FoamNormalTexture not assigned.");
			_lastFoamNormal = p.FoamNormalTexture;
		}

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("foam_color",               p.FoamColor);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("foam_intensity",           p.FoamIntensity);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("foam_energy_influence",    p.FoamEnergyInfluence);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("shoreline_width",          p.ShorelineWidth);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("shoreline_foam_intensity", p.ShorelineFoamIntensity);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("foam_density",             p.FoamDensity);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("foam_normal_strength",     p.FoamNormalStrength);

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("stylization",               p.Stylization);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("stylized_roughness",        p.StylizedRoughness);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("stylized_color_saturation", p.StylizedColorSaturation);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("stylized_foam_multiplier",  p.StylizedFoamMultiplier);

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("foam_camera_fade_near",     0.3f);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("foam_camera_fade_far",      1.5f);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("normal_distance_mip_scale", 0.015f);

		SyncFlowUniforms(p, waterSizeXZ);
		SyncCausticsUniforms(sharedLighting);
	}

	private void SyncCausticsUniforms(IWSWaterSharedLighting sharedLighting)
	{
		if (sharedLighting == null || _ownedMaterial == null) return;

		if (sharedLighting.CausticsTexture != _lastCausticsTexture)
		{
			_lastCausticsTexture = sharedLighting.CausticsTexture;
			if (_lastCausticsTexture != null)
			{
				_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("caustics_texture", _lastCausticsTexture);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!_warnedCausticsMissingTexture && sharedLighting.CausticsStrengthSurface > 0.01f)
				{
					_warnedCausticsMissingTexture = true;
					GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' CausticsStrengthSurface>0 but CausticsTexture is NULL. " +
								"Assign IWSWaterProfile.UnderwaterCausticsTexture (shared).");
				}
			}
		}

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("caustics_surface_strength", sharedLighting.CausticsStrengthSurface);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("caustics_surface_scale",    sharedLighting.CausticsWorldScale);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("caustics_surface_speed",    sharedLighting.CausticsSpeed);

		float distortion = sharedLighting.CausticsDistortion;
		if (!Mathf.IsEqualApprox(distortion, _lastCausticsSurfaceDistortion))
		{
			_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("caustics_surface_distortion", distortion);
			_lastCausticsSurfaceDistortion = distortion;
		}

		float fadeDist = sharedLighting.CausticsFadeDistance;
		if (!Mathf.IsEqualApprox(fadeDist, _lastCausticsSurfaceFadeDistance))
		{
			_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("caustics_surface_fade_distance", fadeDist);
			_lastCausticsSurfaceFadeDistance = fadeDist;
		}

		if (!_debugCausticsSurfaceUploaded)
		{
			_debugCausticsSurfaceUploaded = true;
			GD.Print($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' Caustics uniforms uploaded | " +
					$"strengthSurface={sharedLighting.CausticsStrengthSurface:F3} " +
					$"scale={sharedLighting.CausticsWorldScale:F3} speed={sharedLighting.CausticsSpeed:F3} " +
					$"distort={sharedLighting.CausticsDistortion:F3} fadeDist={sharedLighting.CausticsFadeDistance:F1}m");
		}
	}

	private void SyncFlowUniforms(IWSWaterProfile p, Vector2 waterSizeXZ)
	{
		if (p == null || _ownedMaterial == null) return;

		float sx = Mathf.Max(waterSizeXZ.X, 0.001f);
		float sz = Mathf.Max(waterSizeXZ.Y, 0.001f);

		// Convert world m/s to UV/s per-axis. Ensures precise flow mapping scale on non-square spatial zones.
		Vector2 flowUV = new Vector2(p.FlowVelocity.X / sx, p.FlowVelocity.Z / sz);

		if (!flowUV.IsEqualApprox(_lastFlowUVVelocity))
		{
			_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("flow_uv_velocity", flowUV);
			_lastFlowUVVelocity = flowUV;
		}
		if (!Mathf.IsEqualApprox(p.FlowFoamWeight, _lastFlowFoamWeight))
		{
			_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("flow_foam_weight", p.FlowFoamWeight);
			_lastFlowFoamWeight = p.FlowFoamWeight;
		}
	}

	private void SyncReflection(IWSWaterReflectionStrategy reflection, IWSWaterProfile profile)
	{
		if (_ownedMaterial == null) return;

		int mode = (reflection != null && reflection.IsAvailable &&
					reflection.GetMode() == ReflectionMode.Planar) ? 2 : 0;

		if (mode != _lastReflectionMode)
		{
			_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("reflection_mode", mode);
			_lastReflectionMode = mode;
			GD.Print($"[IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer] '{Name}' Reflection branch updated -> " +
					 $"{(mode == 2 ? "Planar (SubViewport)" : "Probe / SSR Fallback")}");
		}

		if (mode == 2 && reflection is IWSWaterReflectionPlanar planar)
		{
			var tex = planar.GetReflectionTexture();
			if (tex != null)
				_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("reflection_texture", tex);

			_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("mirror_vp_matrix",  Variant.From(planar.GetMirrorViewProjection()));
			_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("reflection_flip_y", planar.FlipY);

			float effectiveDist = planar.NormalDistortionStrength
								* Mathf.Lerp(1.0f, 4.0f, profile?.Turbidity ?? 0f);

			if (!Mathf.IsEqualApprox(effectiveDist, _lastReflectionDistort))
			{
				_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("reflection_distortion", effectiveDist);
				_lastReflectionDistort = effectiveDist;
			}
		}
	}

	private void SyncWaveParameters(IWSWaveSettings[] waves)
	{
		if (_ownedMaterial == null) return;

		int count = Math.Min(waves?.Length ?? 0, 16);
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("wave_count", count);
		if (count == 0) return;

		if (count != _lastWaveCount)
		{
			_dirs        = new Vector2[count];
			_wavelengths = new float[count];
			_amplitudes  = new float[count];
			_speeds      = new float[count];
			_steepnesses = new float[count];
			_lastWaveCount = count;
		}

		for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
		{
			_dirs[i]        = waves[i].GetNormalizedDirection();
			_wavelengths[i] = waves[i].Wavelength;
			_amplitudes[i]  = waves[i].Amplitude;
			_speeds[i]      = waves[i].Speed;
			_steepnesses[i] = waves[i].Steepness;
		}

		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("wave_directions",  Variant.From(_dirs));
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("wave_wavelengths", Variant.From(_wavelengths));
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("wave_amplitudes",  Variant.From(_amplitudes));
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("wave_speeds",      Variant.From(_speeds));
		_ownedMaterial.SetShaderParameter("wave_steepnesses", Variant.From(_steepnesses));
	}

	public void SetNormalBlendStrength(float v)
		=> _ownedMaterial?.SetShaderParameter("ripple_normal_strength", v);
}

// res://water/rendering/surface/WaterAutoInteractorCapture.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

using Godot;

/// <summary>
/// Orthographic camera capture component for automatic water surface interaction.
/// 
/// Renders a top-down black-and-white mask of rigidbodies intersecting the water surface 
/// within the active ripple bounds. The GPU compute shader directly utilizes this mask 
/// to generate dynamic physical ripples without requiring manual Emitter bindings on objects.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class WaterAutoInteractorCapture : Node3D, IWaterAutoInteractor
{
    [ExportGroup("Capture Settings")]
    
    /// <summary>
    /// The physics/rendering layers to capture. Only objects on these layers will generate automatic ripples.
    /// </summary>
    [Export(PropertyHint.Layers3DRender)]
    public uint InteractorLayers = 1 << 3;

    [Export] public float CaptureHeightAboveWater = 4.0f;
    [Export] public float CaptureDepthBelowWater  = 1.0f;

    [ExportGroup("Debug")]
    [Export] public bool ShowDebugViewport = false;

    public bool IsAvailable { get; private set; } = false;
    public bool IsEnabled   { get; set; }         = true;

    private SubViewport     _subViewport;
    private Camera3D        _camera;
    private ViewportTexture _vpTexture;
    private int             _captureResolution = 128;

    public override void _Ready()
    {
        // Initialization is intentionally deferred to IWSWaterBody._Ready via InitCapture().
        // No GPU operations or SubViewport allocations are performed here to ensure order of execution.
    }

    public void InitCapture(int resolution)
    {
        _captureResolution = resolution;
        BuildSubViewport();
    }

    public override void _ExitTree()
    {
        _vpTexture  = null;
        IsAvailable = false;
    }

    public void SyncPhysicsFrame(Vector2 rippleCenterWorld, float visualSize, float waterY)
    {
        if (!IsAvailable || !IsEnabled || _camera == null) return;

        float camY = waterY + CaptureHeightAboveWater;
        _camera.GlobalPosition = new Vector3(rippleCenterWorld.X, camY, rippleCenterWorld.Y);
        _camera.Size           = visualSize;

        _subViewport.RenderTargetUpdateMode = SubViewport.UpdateMode.Once;
    }

    public Rid GetCaptureRsRid()
    {
        if (!IsAvailable || _vpTexture == null) return default;
        return _vpTexture.GetRid();
    }

    private void BuildSubViewport()
    {
        _subViewport = new SubViewport
        {
            Name                   = "CaptureViewport",
            Size                   = new Vector2I(_captureResolution, _captureResolution),
            RenderTargetUpdateMode = SubViewport.UpdateMode.Disabled,
            TransparentBg          = false,
            PhysicsObjectPicking   = false,
            GuiDisableInput        = true,
            Msaa3D                 = Viewport.Msaa.Disabled,
        };

        // Disable HDR 2D as the capture map is strictly a low-precision intensity mask, saving memory bandwidth.
        _subViewport.SetUseHdr2D(false);

        AddChild(_subViewport);

        var env = new Godot.Environment
        {
            BackgroundMode     = Godot.Environment.BGMode.Color,
            BackgroundColor    = Colors.Black,
            AmbientLightSource = Godot.Environment.AmbientSource.Color,
            AmbientLightColor  = Colors.White,
            AmbientLightEnergy = 1.0f,
            FogEnabled         = false,
            GlowEnabled        = false,
            SsaoEnabled        = false,
        };
        var worldEnv = new WorldEnvironment { Environment = env };
        _subViewport.AddChild(worldEnv);

        _camera = new Camera3D
        {
            Name       = "CaptureCamera",
            Projection = Camera3D.ProjectionType.Orthogonal,
            Size       = 50f,
            CullMask   = InteractorLayers,
            Near       = 0.05f,
            Far        = CaptureHeightAboveWater + CaptureDepthBelowWater + 0.1f,
        };
        _camera.Rotation = new Vector3(Mathf.DegToRad(-90f), 0f, 0f);
        _subViewport.AddChild(_camera);

        if (ShowDebugViewport)
            BuildDebugDisplay();

        _vpTexture  = _subViewport.GetTexture();
        IsAvailable = true;

        GD.Print($"[WaterAutoInteractorCapture] '{Name}' Initialization complete | " +
                 $"resolution={_captureResolution} | layers=0x{InteractorLayers:X}");
    }

    private void BuildDebugDisplay()
    {
        var canvas = new CanvasLayer { Layer = 99, Name = "CaptureDebugLayer" };
        AddChild(canvas);

        var rect = new TextureRect
        {
            Texture           = _subViewport.GetTexture(),
            ExpandMode        = TextureRect.ExpandModeEnum.IgnoreSize,
            CustomMinimumSize = new Vector2(200f, 200f),
            Position          = new Vector2(8f, 400f),
        };
        canvas.AddChild(rect);
    }
}

// ── Varyings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

varying vec3  v_world_pos;

const float MIN_WAVE_LEN = 0.001;

// ── Optical Functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

vec3 beer_lambert(float path_length, vec3 absorption) {
    return exp(-max(path_length, 0.0) * absorption);
}

float scatter_phase(float cos_theta) {
    float t = cos_theta * 0.5 + 0.5;
    return t * t;
}

float fresnel_schlick(float cos_theta, float f0) {
    float f  = 1.0 - clamp(cos_theta, 0.0, 1.0);
    float f2 = f * f;
    float f0_effective = f0 * reflection_attenuation;
    return f0_effective + (1.0 - f0_effective) * f2 * f2 * f;
}

vec3 blend_normals_udn(vec3 n1, vec3 n2) {
    return normalize(n1 + vec3(n2.x, 0.0, n2.z));
}

// ── Gerstner Wave Evaluation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

vec2 gerstner_horiz_disp(vec2 pos_xz, float t) {
    vec2 disp = vec2(0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < wave_count && i < 16; i++) {
        float k     = TAU / max(wave_wavelengths[i], MIN_WAVE_LEN);
        vec2  d     = normalize(wave_directions[i]);
        float phase = k * dot(d, pos_xz) - wave_speeds[i] * t;
        disp += d * (wave_steepnesses[i] * wave_amplitudes[i] * cos(phase));
    }
    return disp;
}

float gerstner_evaluate(vec2 pos_xz, float t,
                         out vec3 normal_delta,
                         out vec2 horiz_disp,
                         out float jacobian) {
    float h = 0.0;
    normal_delta = vec3(0.0);
    horiz_disp   = vec2(0.0);
    jacobian     = 1.0;
    float nexp   = max(wave_nonlinear_exp, 1.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < wave_count && i < 16; i++) {
        float wl  = max(wave_wavelengths[i], MIN_WAVE_LEN);
        float k   = TAU / wl;
        vec2  d   = normalize(wave_directions[i]);
        float amp = wave_amplitudes[i];
        float spd = wave_speeds[i];
        float stp = wave_steepnesses[i];

        float phase  = k * dot(d, pos_xz) - spd * t;
        float sp     = sin(phase);
        float cp     = cos(phase);
        float abs_sp = abs(sp);

        h += amp * pow(abs_sp, nexp) * sign(sp);

        float pow_term = (abs_sp < 1e-5) ? 0.0
            : amp * nexp * pow(abs_sp, nexp - 1.0) * cp;

        normal_delta.x += pow_term * k * d.x;
        normal_delta.z += pow_term * k * d.y;

        horiz_disp += d * (stp * amp * cp);
        jacobian   -= stp * k * amp * cp;
    }
    return h;
}

// ── Vertex Shader ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void vertex() {
    vec3 world_pos = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz;

    vec2 ripple_uv = (world_pos.xz - water_world_position.xz) / water_size_xz + 0.5;
    v_ripple_uv    = ripple_uv;

    float t = sim_time;

    float ripple_h = 0.0;
    if (ripple_uv.x >= 0.0 && ripple_uv.x <= 1.0 &&
        ripple_uv.y >= 0.0 && ripple_uv.y <= 1.0) {

        float raw      = texture(visual_texture, ripple_uv).r;
        float abs_raw  = abs(raw);
        float sign_raw = sign(raw);
        float boosted  = pow(min(abs_raw, 1.0), 0.65) * sign_raw;
        float phys_h   = boosted * ripple_displacement_scale;

        float max_safe_disp = water_size * 0.05;
        phys_h = clamp(phys_h, -max_safe_disp, max_safe_disp);

        float dist_to_cam = length(world_pos - CAMERA_POSITION_WORLD);
        float lod_near    = water_size * 0.8;
        float lod_far     = water_size * 2.5;
        float lod_atten   = smoothstep(lod_far, lod_near, dist_to_cam);

        ripple_h = phys_h * lod_atten;
    }

    vec2 guess_xz = world_pos.xz;
    for (int iter = 0; iter < 4; iter++) {
        vec2  disp  = gerstner_horiz_disp(guess_xz, t);
        vec2  error = (guess_xz + disp) - world_pos.xz;
        float el    = length(error);
        if (el > 2.0) error = error / el * 2.0;
        guess_xz -= error;
        if (el < 0.0001) break;
    }

    vec3  normal_delta;
    vec2  horiz_disp;
    float jacobian;
    float wave_h = gerstner_evaluate(guess_xz, t, normal_delta, horiz_disp, jacobian);

    float jac_foam = clamp((jacobian_foam_threshold - jacobian)
                            / max(jacobian_foam_threshold, 0.001), 0.0, 1.0);
    v_jacobian_foam = jac_foam;

    vec3 displaced  = world_pos;
    displaced.y    += wave_h + ripple_h;
    displaced.xz   += horiz_disp;

    vec3 g_normal      = normalize(vec3(-normal_delta.x, 1.0, -normal_delta.z));
    v_gerstner_normal  = g_normal;
    v_world_pos        = displaced;
    v_vertex_displaced = displaced;

    VERTEX = (inverse(MODEL_MATRIX) * vec4(displaced, 1.0)).xyz;
    NORMAL = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(g_normal, 0.0)).xyz;

    v_wave_gradient_xz = normal_delta.xz;
}

// ── Depth Reconstruction ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

vec3 depth_to_world(vec2 screen_uv, float depth,
                     mat4 inv_proj, mat4 inv_view) {
    vec4 ndc  = vec4(screen_uv * 2.0 - 1.0, depth, 1.0);
    vec4 view = inv_proj * ndc;
    view.xyz /= view.w;
    return (inv_view * vec4(view.xyz, 1.0)).xyz;
}

// ── Utility Functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

vec2 hash2(vec2 p) {
    p = vec2(dot(p, vec2(127.1, 311.7)),
             dot(p, vec2(269.5, 183.3)));
    return fract(sin(p) * 43758.5453);
}

vec2 rotate2(vec2 uv, float angle) {
    float s = sin(angle);
    float c = cos(angle);
    return vec2(uv.x * c - uv.y * s,
                uv.x * s + uv.y * c);
}

float sample_stochastic(sampler2D tex, vec2 world_xz,
                         float density, float cell_size) {
    vec2 grid_pos  = world_xz / cell_size;
    vec2 grid_base = floor(grid_pos);
    vec2 grid_frac = fract(grid_pos);

    float weight_sum = 0.0;
    float result     = 0.0;

    for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
        for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
            vec2 cell = grid_base + vec2(float(dx), float(dy));
            vec2 rand = hash2(cell);

            float angle = floor(rand.x * 4.0) * (3.14159265 * 0.5);
            vec2 offset = rand;

            vec2 local_pos = grid_frac - vec2(float(dx), float(dy)) - vec2(0.5);

            float dist_sq = dot(local_pos, local_pos);
            float weight  = exp(-5.0 * dist_sq);

            vec2 sample_uv = rotate2(world_xz * density, angle) + offset;
            float val      = texture(tex, sample_uv).r;

            result     += val * weight;
            weight_sum += weight;
        }
    }

    return result / max(weight_sum, 1e-5);
}

// ── Caustics Helper Functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Evaluates the ripple displacement height at a given world XZ coordinate.
// Uses the same boosted curve and safety clamping as the vertex shader.
// Used to reconstruct total surface height for depth gating of projected caustics.
float ripple_height_at_world_xz(vec2 world_xz) {
    vec2 uv = (world_xz - water_world_position.xz) / water_size_xz + 0.5;
    if (uv.x < 0.0 || uv.x > 1.0 || uv.y < 0.0 || uv.y > 1.0) return 0.0;

    float raw      = texture(visual_texture, uv).r;
    float abs_raw  = abs(raw);
    float sign_raw = sign(raw);
    float boosted  = pow(min(abs_raw, 1.0), 0.65) * sign_raw;
    float h        = boosted * ripple_displacement_scale;

    float max_safe_disp = water_size * 0.05;
    return clamp(h, -max_safe_disp, max_safe_disp);
}

// Reconstructs the total water surface height (Gerstner + Ripple) at a given XZ coordinate.
// Applies the same Newton inverse mapping as the vertex shader to ensure physical/visual consistency.
// Exclusively used in the fragment shader for underwater depth gating, not for normal evaluation.
float surface_height_at_world_xz(vec2 world_xz, float t) {
    vec2 guess_xz = world_xz;
    for (int iter = 0; iter < 4; iter++) {
        vec2  disp  = gerstner_horiz_disp(guess_xz, t);
        vec2  error = (guess_xz + disp) - world_xz;
        float el    = length(error);
        if (el > 2.0) error = error / el * 2.0;
        guess_xz -= error;
        if (el < 0.0001) break;
    }

    vec3  _nd;
    vec2  _hd;
    float _jac;
    float wave_h   = gerstner_evaluate(guess_xz, t, _nd, _hd, _jac);
    float ripple_h = ripple_height_at_world_xz(world_xz);

    // Base water level derived from IWSWaterBody's GlobalPosition.Y.
    return water_world_position.y + wave_h + ripple_h;
}

// Projects caustics onto the background geometry using triplanar mapping to avoid stretching on vertical surfaces.
// 'geo_normal' is the reconstructed world-space normal of the background geometry.
// 'underwater_len' is the optical path length used for Beer-Lambert attenuation.
vec3 projected_caustics_triplanar(
    vec3  geo_world,
    vec3  geo_normal,
    float underwater_len,
    float t)
{
    if (caustics_surface_strength < 0.001) return vec3(0.0);

    // Perturb UVs using the wave gradient (consistent with underwater compute logic).
    vec2 grad = v_wave_gradient_xz;
    float gl  = length(grad);
    if (gl > 1.5) grad *= 1.5 / gl;
    vec2 distort = grad * caustics_surface_distortion;

    vec2 uv_xz = geo_world.xz * caustics_surface_scale + distort;
    vec2 uv_xy = geo_world.xy * caustics_surface_scale + distort;
    vec2 uv_zy = geo_world.zy * caustics_surface_scale + distort;

    vec2 flow1 = vec2( t * caustics_surface_speed * 0.12,
                       t * caustics_surface_speed * 0.08);
    vec2 flow2 = vec2(-t * caustics_surface_speed * 0.10,
                      -t * caustics_surface_speed * 0.14);

    // Triplanar blend weights based on the surface normal (power of 4 for sharp blending and reduced seams).
    vec3 n_abs  = max(abs(geo_normal), vec3(0.001));
    n_abs       = pow(n_abs, vec3(4.0));
    float n_sum = n_abs.x + n_abs.y + n_abs.z;
    vec3 blend  = n_abs / n_sum;

    // Increase mip level based on underwater distance to reduce distant aliasing/flickering.
    float lod = clamp(log2(1.0 + underwater_len * caustics_surface_scale), 0.0, 6.0);

    float c_xz = textureLod(caustics_texture, uv_xz + flow1,       lod).r
               * textureLod(caustics_texture, uv_xz * 1.7 + flow2, lod).r;
    float c_xy = textureLod(caustics_texture, uv_xy + flow1,       lod).r
               * textureLod(caustics_texture, uv_xy * 1.7 + flow2, lod).r;
    float c_zy = textureLod(caustics_texture, uv_zy + flow1,       lod).r
               * textureLod(caustics_texture, uv_zy * 1.7 + flow2, lod).r;

    float c = pow(clamp(c_xz * blend.y + c_xy * blend.z + c_zy * blend.x,
                        0.0, 1.0), 1.8);

    // Attenuate caustics based on depth to align with the Beer-Lambert framework.
    float fade_dist = max(caustics_surface_fade_distance, 0.5);
    float fade      = clamp(1.0 - underwater_len / fade_dist, 0.0, 1.0);

    // Tint caustics based on water absorption (adds a teal hue to deep caustics).
    vec3 tint = exp(-underwater_len * absorption_coeff * 0.5);

    // Sun elevation factor: strongest caustics at noon.
    float sun_factor = clamp(sun_elevation / 1.5708, 0.0, 1.0);

    return vec3(c) * caustics_surface_strength * fade * sun_factor * sun_color * tint;
}

// ── Dual-phase Semi-Lagrangian flow mapping ──────────────────────────────────

vec4 flowmap_sample(sampler2D tex, vec2 base_uv, vec2 vel_uv, float t)
{
    float t0    = fract(t);
    float t1    = fract(t + 0.5);
    float blend = abs(t0 * 2.0 - 1.0);

    vec2 uv0 = base_uv + vel_uv * t0;
    vec2 uv1 = base_uv + vel_uv * t1;

    return mix(texture(tex, uv0), texture(tex, uv1), blend);
}

// ── Fragment Shader ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void fragment() {
    vec3 world_pos = v_world_pos;

    float dist_to_cam_frag = length(world_pos - CAMERA_POSITION_WORLD);
    float lod0_end  = water_lod_distances.x;
    float lod1_end  = water_lod_distances.y;

    float lod_t = clamp((dist_to_cam_frag - lod0_end) / max(lod1_end - lod0_end, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)
                + clamp((dist_to_cam_frag - lod1_end) / max(lod1_end * 0.5, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0);
    bool is_lod0 = (lod_t < 0.5);
    bool is_lod2 = (lod_t > 1.5);

    vec3 ripple_n_shared = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
    if (!is_lod2 && v_ripple_uv.x >= 0.0 && v_ripple_uv.x <= 1.0 &&
        v_ripple_uv.y >= 0.0 && v_ripple_uv.y <= 1.0) {
        vec3 rn_ts  = texture(ripple_normal_texture, v_ripple_uv).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
        rn_ts       = normalize(mix(vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), rn_ts, ripple_normal_scale));
        ripple_n_shared = normalize(vec3(rn_ts.x, rn_ts.z, rn_ts.y));
    }

    if (!FRONT_FACING) {
        vec3 view_dir_world = normalize(CAMERA_POSITION_WORLD - v_world_pos);
        float face_dot = dot(view_dir_world, v_gerstner_normal);
        if (face_dot >= 0.05) { discard; }

        float cos_v = max(dot(-VIEW, vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)), 0.0);
        const float cos_critical = 0.6601;
        float tir_blend = smoothstep(cos_critical - 0.08, cos_critical + 0.05, cos_v);

        vec2 refract_tir    = clamp(SCREEN_UV + ripple_n_shared.xz * 0.03, vec2(0.001), vec2(0.999));
        vec3 transmit_color = texture(SCREEN_TEXTURE, refract_tir).rgb;
        transmit_color *= beer_lambert(0.3, absorption_coeff);

        vec3 tir_color = color_shallow.rgb * 0.35 + vec3(0.0, 0.05, 0.12);

        ALBEDO    = mix(transmit_color, tir_color, tir_blend);
        ALPHA     = mix(0.85, 1.0, tir_blend);
        ROUGHNESS = mix(0.1, 0.0, tir_blend);
        METALLIC  = 0.0;
        SPECULAR  = 0.3 + tir_blend * 0.4;
        NORMAL    = ripple_n_shared;

    } else {
        // ── 1. Normal Blending ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        vec3 normal_g = normalize(v_gerstner_normal);
        vec3 ripple_n = ripple_n_shared;

        float effective_mip_bias = normal_mip_bias + dist_to_cam_frag * normal_distance_mip_scale;
        vec2 wind_n   = normalize(wind_direction);
        float mn_spd1 = wind_speed * micro_normal_speed1;
        float mn_spd2 = wind_speed * micro_normal_speed2;

        vec3 n_combined;
        if (is_lod2) {
            n_combined = normal_g;
        } else {
            vec3 mn_combined;
            if (flow_speed > 0.001) {
                float phase_t  = fract(sim_time * flow_speed * 0.1);
                float blend_mn = abs(2.0 * phase_t - 1.0);
                vec2 flow_dir  = wind_n;
                vec2 flow_off1 = flow_dir * phase_t * flow_tiling;
                vec2 flow_off2 = flow_dir * fract(phase_t + 0.5) * flow_tiling;
                vec2 base_uv1  = world_pos.xz / micro_normal_scale + wind_n * mn_spd1 * sim_time;
                vec2 base_uv2  = world_pos.xz / (micro_normal_scale * micro_normal_layer_ratio)
                                 + wind_n * mn_spd2 * sim_time;
                vec3 mn1a = texture(micro_normal_1, base_uv1 + flow_off1, effective_mip_bias).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
                vec3 mn1b = texture(micro_normal_1, base_uv1 + flow_off2, effective_mip_bias).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
                vec3 mn2a = texture(micro_normal_2, base_uv2 + flow_off1, effective_mip_bias).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
                vec3 mn2b = texture(micro_normal_2, base_uv2 + flow_off2, effective_mip_bias).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
                mn_combined = normalize(mix(mix(mn1a, mn1b, blend_mn), mix(mn2a, mn2b, blend_mn), 0.5));
            } else {
                vec2 mn_uv1 = world_pos.xz / micro_normal_scale + wind_n * mn_spd1 * sim_time;
                vec2 mn_uv2 = world_pos.xz / (micro_normal_scale * micro_normal_layer_ratio)
                              + wind_n * mn_spd2 * sim_time;
                vec3 mn1 = texture(micro_normal_1, mn_uv1, effective_mip_bias).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
                vec3 mn2 = texture(micro_normal_2, mn_uv2, effective_mip_bias).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
                mn_combined = normalize(mn1 + mn2);
            }
            float mn_strength = is_lod0 ? micro_normal_strength
                                        : micro_normal_strength * (1.0 - (lod_t - 0.5) * 0.6);
            vec3 micro_n_ts = normalize(mix(vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), mn_combined, mn_strength));
            vec3 micro_n    = normalize(vec3(micro_n_ts.x, micro_n_ts.z, micro_n_ts.y));
            n_combined = blend_normals_udn(blend_normals_udn(normal_g, ripple_n), micro_n);
        }
        NORMAL = n_combined;

        // ── 2. Depth Reconstruction ───────────────────────────────────────────
        float raw_depth  = texture(DEPTH_TEXTURE, SCREEN_UV).r;
        vec3  geo_world  = depth_to_world(SCREEN_UV, raw_depth, INV_PROJECTION_MATRIX, INV_VIEW_MATRIX);
        bool  is_sky     = (raw_depth < 1e-6);
        float view_depth = is_sky ? visibility_distance : max(length(geo_world - world_pos), 0.0);

        // ── 3. Projected Caustics onto Refracted Background Geometry ──────────
        // Projects caustics accurately onto the underwater terrain rather than the water surface.
        // - Reconstructs background normals using hardware derivatives (dFdx/dFdy).
        // - Gates the projection using the reconstructed surface height.
        // - Applies triplanar mapping and evaluates caustics before Beer-Lambert absorption.
        vec3 projected_caustics = vec3(0.0);
        if (is_lod0 && !is_sky && caustics_surface_strength > 0.001 && view_depth > 0.02) {
            // Hardware derivatives for normal reconstruction.
            vec3 dx = dFdx(geo_world);
            vec3 dy = dFdy(geo_world);
            vec3 geo_n = normalize(cross(dx, dy));

            // Ensure the normal faces the camera in world space.
            vec3 view_dir_world = normalize(CAMERA_POSITION_WORLD - geo_world);
            if (dot(geo_n, view_dir_world) < 0.0) geo_n = -geo_n;

            // Depth gating: Ensure caustics are only projected onto geometry strictly below the water surface.
            float surf_h = surface_height_at_world_xz(geo_world.xz, sim_time);
            if (geo_world.y < surf_h - 0.02) {
                projected_caustics = projected_caustics_triplanar(
                    geo_world, geo_n, view_depth, sim_time);
            }
        }

        // ── 4. Optical Evaluation ─────────────────────────────────────────────
        vec3  final_albedo;
        float final_alpha;

        bool use_physical = (dot(absorption_coeff, absorption_coeff) > 0.0001);

        if (is_lod2) {
            float depth_t   = clamp(view_depth / max(visibility_distance, 0.1), 0.0, 1.0);
            final_albedo    = mix(color_shallow.rgb, color_deep.rgb, depth_t * depth_t);
            final_alpha     = clamp(depth_t * 0.8 + 0.3, 0.0, 1.0);
        } else if (use_physical) {
            vec3 transmittance = beer_lambert(view_depth, absorption_coeff);
            vec2 refract_offset = normal_g.xz * refraction_strength
                                  * clamp(view_depth * 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
            vec2 clean_uv   = SCREEN_UV;
            vec2 refract_uv = mix(SCREEN_UV + refract_offset, clean_uv, opacity_bias);
            refract_uv      = clamp(refract_uv, vec2(0.001), vec2(0.999));
            vec3 bg_color   = texture(SCREEN_TEXTURE, refract_uv).rgb;

            // Accumulate projected caustics into the background color before applying Beer-Lambert attenuation.
            vec3 absorbed_bg = (bg_color + projected_caustics) * transmittance;

            float cos_theta  = max(dot(-VIEW, sun_direction), 0.0);
            float phase      = scatter_phase(cos_theta);
            vec3  scatter_col = color_shallow.rgb * sun_color * scattering_intensity
                                * phase * (1.0 - transmittance);
            vec3 deep_contrib = color_deep.rgb * (1.0 - transmittance.g) * (1.0 - transmittance.g);
            final_albedo      = absorbed_bg + scatter_col + deep_contrib * 0.3;
            float opacity     = 1.0 - transmittance.g * 0.8;
            final_alpha       = clamp(opacity + 0.15 + opacity_bias * 0.35, 0.0, 1.0);
        } else {
            float depth_t    = clamp(view_depth / max(visibility_distance, 0.1), 0.0, 1.0);
            vec3  water_col  = mix(color_shallow.rgb, color_deep.rgb, depth_t * depth_t);
            vec2  refract_uv = clamp(SCREEN_UV + normal_g.xz * refraction_strength,
                                     vec2(0.001), vec2(0.999));
            vec3  bg_color   = texture(SCREEN_TEXTURE, refract_uv).rgb;

            // Accumulate projected caustics into the background color (Stylized Mode).
            final_albedo     = mix(bg_color + projected_caustics,
                                   water_col,
                                   clamp(depth_t + 0.2, 0.0, 1.0));
            final_alpha      = clamp(depth_t * 0.8 + 0.2 + opacity_bias * 0.3, 0.0, 1.0);
        }

        // ── 5. Subsurface Scattering ──────────────────────────────────────────
        float crest_weight = clamp((1.0 - normal_g.y) * 3.0, 0.0, 1.0);
        if (!is_lod2) {
            float sss_factor   = pow(max(dot(-VIEW, -sun_direction), 0.0), subsurface_exponent);
            float sss_scale    = is_lod0 ? 1.0 : (1.0 - (lod_t - 0.5) * 0.8);
            vec3  sss_contrib  = subsurface_color.rgb * subsurface_strength
                                 * sss_factor * crest_weight * sun_color * sss_scale;
            final_albedo += sss_contrib;
        }

        // ── 6. Foam Evaluation ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        float total_foam = 0.0;
        if (!is_lod2) {
            float sim_foam = 0.0;
            if (v_ripple_uv.x >= 0.0 && v_ripple_uv.x <= 1.0 &&
                v_ripple_uv.y >= 0.0 && v_ripple_uv.y <= 1.0) {
                sim_foam = texture(foam_texture, v_ripple_uv).r;
                float _dist_c = length(v_ripple_uv - vec2(0.5));
                sim_foam *= 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.48, _dist_c);
            }

            float slope      = clamp(1.0 - normal_g.y, 0.0, 1.0);
            float slope_foam = smoothstep(effective_foam_threshold,
                                          effective_foam_threshold + 0.15, slope);
            float energy_foam     = sim_foam * foam_energy_influence;
            float jac_foam_contrib = v_jacobian_foam * jacobian_foam_strength
                                     * jacobian_foam_inject_rate;

            float shoreline_foam = 0.0;
            if (is_lod0 && shoreline_width > 0.01 && !is_sky && view_depth < shoreline_width) {
                float shore_t     = 1.0 - clamp(view_depth / shoreline_width, 0.0, 1.0);
                vec2  shore_uv    = world_pos.xz * 0.8 + wind_n * sim_time * 0.015;
                float shore_noise = texture(foam_normal_detail, shore_uv).r;
                shore_noise       = clamp(shore_noise * 2.0 - 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
                shoreline_foam    = smoothstep(0.2, 0.7, shore_t * shore_noise);
            }

            float shore_final = shoreline_foam * shoreline_foam_intensity;
            float wave_final  = (sim_foam + slope_foam + energy_foam + jac_foam_contrib)
                              * foam_intensity * effective_foam_multiplier;
            total_foam        = clamp(shore_final + wave_final, 0.0, 1.0);

            {
                float foam_dist_xz   = length(world_pos.xz - CAMERA_POSITION_WORLD.xz);
                float fade_near_abs  = water_size * foam_camera_fade_near;
                float fade_far_abs   = water_size * foam_camera_fade_far;
                float foam_dist_fade = 1.0 - smoothstep(fade_near_abs, fade_far_abs, foam_dist_xz);
                total_foam *= clamp(foam_dist_fade, 0.0, 1.0);
            }

            if (total_foam > 0.01 && is_lod0) {
                vec2 local_flow = vec2(0.0);
                if (v_ripple_uv.x >= 0.0 && v_ripple_uv.x <= 1.0 &&
                    v_ripple_uv.y >= 0.0 && v_ripple_uv.y <= 1.0) {
                    local_flow = texture(ripple_velocity_texture, v_ripple_uv).ba;
                }
                float flow_mag = length(local_flow);
                if (flow_mag > 0.4) { local_flow *= 0.4 / flow_mag; flow_mag = 0.4; }
                float flow_mask = smoothstep(0.02, 0.08, flow_mag);

                vec2 foam_vel = local_flow + flow_uv_velocity * 0.4 + wind_n * 0.002;
                vec2 turb_pos = world_pos.xz * 0.6 + sim_time * 0.4;
                vec2 turbulence = vec2(sin(turb_pos.x) * cos(turb_pos.y),
                                       cos(turb_pos.x) * sin(turb_pos.y));
                foam_vel += turbulence * flow_mag * 0.25;

                float tile_scale   = max(foam_density * 0.08, 0.02);
                vec2  base_uv_foam = world_pos.xz * tile_scale;
                float t_flow       = sim_time * 0.4;

                float sym_break = sin(world_pos.x * 0.31 + world_pos.z * 0.57) * 0.5 + 0.5;
                float rot_blend = smoothstep(0.25, 0.75, sym_break);

                const float ROT_A = 0.0;
                const float ROT_B = 1.0472;

                vec2 uv_a   = rotate2(base_uv_foam,       ROT_A);
                vec2 vel_a  = rotate2(-foam_vel,           ROT_A);
                vec2 uv_a2  = rotate2(base_uv_foam * 1.4,  ROT_A);
                vec2 vel_a2 = rotate2(-foam_vel * 0.7,     ROT_A);
                vec2 uv_b   = rotate2(base_uv_foam,       ROT_B);
                vec2 vel_b  = rotate2(-foam_vel,           ROT_B);
                vec2 uv_b2  = rotate2(base_uv_foam * 1.4,  ROT_B);
                vec2 vel_b2 = rotate2(-foam_vel * 0.7,     ROT_B);

                float fa0 = flowmap_sample(foam_bubble_texture, uv_a,  vel_a,  t_flow).r;
                float fa1 = flowmap_sample(foam_bubble_texture, uv_a2, vel_a2, t_flow + 0.25).r;
                float fb0 = flowmap_sample(foam_bubble_texture, uv_b,  vel_b,  t_flow + 0.17).r;
                float fb1 = flowmap_sample(foam_bubble_texture, uv_b2, vel_b2, t_flow + 0.42).r;
                float sa0 = texture(foam_bubble_texture, uv_a ).r;
                float sa1 = texture(foam_bubble_texture, uv_a2).r;
                float sb0 = texture(foam_bubble_texture, uv_b ).r;
                float sb1 = texture(foam_bubble_texture, uv_b2).r;

                float da = mix(sa0, fa0, flow_mask) * 0.6 + mix(sa1, fa1, flow_mask) * 0.4;
                float db = mix(sb0, fb0, flow_mask) * 0.6 + mix(sb1, fb1, flow_mask) * 0.4;
                float foam_detail = mix(da, db, rot_blend);
                foam_detail = smoothstep(0.2, 0.78, foam_detail);
                foam_detail = mix(0.3, 1.0, foam_detail);
                total_foam *= foam_detail;

                vec2 nuv_a  = rotate2(base_uv_foam * 0.7, ROT_A);
                vec2 nvel_a = rotate2(-foam_vel,           ROT_A);
                vec2 nuv_b  = rotate2(base_uv_foam * 0.7, ROT_B);
                vec2 nvel_b = rotate2(-foam_vel,           ROT_B);

                vec3 fna   = flowmap_sample(foam_normal_detail, nuv_a, nvel_a, t_flow).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
                vec3 fna_s = texture(foam_normal_detail, nuv_a).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
                vec3 fnb   = flowmap_sample(foam_normal_detail, nuv_b, nvel_b, t_flow + 0.17).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
                vec3 fnb_s = texture(foam_normal_detail, nuv_b).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;

                vec3 fn_a   = mix(fna_s, fna, flow_mask);
                vec3 fn_b   = mix(fnb_s, fnb, flow_mask);
                vec3 foam_n = normalize(mix(fn_a, fn_b, rot_blend));
                foam_n = normalize(mix(vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), foam_n, foam_normal_strength));
                NORMAL = blend_normals_udn(NORMAL, vec3(foam_n.x, 0.0, foam_n.z) * total_foam);
            }
        }

        vec3 foam_tint = mix(final_albedo, foam_color.rgb, 0.7 + 0.3 * total_foam);
        final_albedo   = mix(final_albedo, foam_tint, total_foam);
        final_alpha    = max(final_alpha, total_foam * 0.85 + 0.05);

        // ── 7. Fresnel ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        float cos_view_n = max(dot(-VIEW, NORMAL), 0.0);
        float f0         = pow((1.0 - water_ior) / (1.0 + water_ior), 2.0);
        float fresnel    = fresnel_schlick(cos_view_n, f0);

        // ── 8. Glints (LOD0 Only) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
        float glint_roughness_mod = 0.0;
        if (is_lod0 && glint_strength > 0.001) {
            vec2  wind_n_g    = normalize(wind_direction);
            vec2  glint_drift = wind_n_g * sim_time * 0.04;
            vec2  glint_pos   = world_pos.xz * glint_density + glint_drift;
            vec2  glint_cell  = floor(glint_pos);
            vec2  glint_frac  = fract(glint_pos);
            float hx = fract(sin(dot(glint_cell, vec2(127.1, 311.7))) * 43758.5453);
            float hy = fract(sin(dot(glint_cell, vec2(269.5, 183.3))) * 43758.5453);
            float glint_dist = length(glint_frac - vec2(hx, hy));
            float glint_val  = pow(max(1.0 - glint_dist * 2.0, 0.0), glint_sharpness * 0.02 + 2.0);
            vec3  reflect_dir = reflect(-VIEW, NORMAL);
            float spec_align  = max(dot(reflect_dir, sun_direction), 0.0);
            float angle_exp   = clamp(glint_sharpness * 0.5, 4.0, 256.0);
            glint_val *= pow(spec_align, angle_exp) * mix(0.2, 1.0, fresnel);
            float norm_elev   = clamp(sun_elevation / 1.5708, 0.0, 1.0);
            glint_val        *= (1.0 - norm_elev * 0.6) * reflection_attenuation;
            glint_roughness_mod = clamp(glint_val * glint_strength, 0.0, 1.0);
        }

        // ── 9. Reflection ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        vec3 reflect_color = vec3(0.0);
        int  effective_reflection_mode = (is_lod0) ? reflection_mode : 0;
        if (effective_reflection_mode == 2) {
            vec4 mirror_clip = mirror_vp_matrix * vec4(world_pos, 1.0);
            vec2 mirror_uv   = mirror_clip.xy / mirror_clip.w * 0.5 + 0.5;
            if (reflection_flip_y) mirror_uv.y = 1.0 - mirror_uv.y;
            mirror_uv += NORMAL.xz * reflection_distortion;
            mirror_uv  = clamp(mirror_uv, vec2(0.001), vec2(0.999));
            reflect_color = texture(reflection_texture, mirror_uv).rgb;
        }

        // ── 10. Radiance Tinting ──────────────────────────────────────────────
        if (!is_lod2 && radiance_blend > 0.001) {
            RADIANCE = vec4(mix(RADIANCE.rgb, radiance_tint, radiance_blend), RADIANCE.a);
        }

        // ── 11. Composite Roughness ───────────────────────────────────────────
        float effective_roughness = mix(water_roughness, 0.9, turbidity);
        float lod_roughness_boost = is_lod2 ? 0.05 : (is_lod0 ? 0.0 : lod_t * 0.04);

        // ── 12. Final Output ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // Caustics are pre-accumulated into the final albedo via background refraction.
        ALBEDO = final_albedo;
        ALPHA  = final_alpha;

        float foam_roughness = mix(effective_roughness + lod_roughness_boost, 0.9, total_foam);
        ROUGHNESS = max(foam_roughness - glint_roughness_mod * foam_roughness * 0.92, 0.005);
        METALLIC  = 0.0;
        SPECULAR  = fresnel * 0.5 + glint_roughness_mod * 0.2;

        if (effective_reflection_mode == 2) {
            ALBEDO = mix(ALBEDO, reflect_color, fresnel * 0.85);
        }

        SSS_STRENGTH = is_lod2 ? 0.0 : (subsurface_strength * crest_weight * 0.3);
    }
}

// res://water/rendering/underwater/IWSCameraWaterState.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

/// <summary>
/// Three-state machine defining the camera's relationship with the water surface.
///
///   Above      -> Entirely above the water surface; no underwater effects.
///   Waterline  -> Entering the waterline transition zone; activates per-pixel boundary rendering.
///   Underwater -> Entirely submerged; full-screen underwater post-processing.
///
/// State transitions incorporate hysteresis to prevent high-frequency flickering (oscillation) 
/// when the camera is resting exactly at the wave crests.
/// </summary>
public enum IWSCameraWaterState
{
	Above,
	Waterline,
	Underwater
}

// res://water/rendering/underwater/IWSUnderwaterRenderer.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

/// <summary>
/// Interface for underwater rendering strategies (Allows for replaceable backend implementations).
/// 
/// Current implementations:
///   UnderwaterRendererCompute  -> Compositor Compute Shader (Forward+ / Vulkan)
///   UnderwaterRendererCanvas   -> CanvasLayer ColorRect (Fallback / Compatibility)
/// 
/// The IWSWaterCameraController depends strictly on this interface and does not manipulate rendering nodes directly.
/// </summary>
public interface IWSUnderwaterRenderer
{
	/// <summary>
	/// Indicates whether the current backend is available. If unavailable, the system will automatically fall back.
	/// </summary>
	bool IsAvailable { get; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Toggles the effect on or off. Should silently ignore if the renderer is unavailable.
	/// </summary>
	void SetEnabled(bool enabled);

	/// <summary>
	/// Submits the rendering data for the current frame to be consumed asynchronously by the render thread.
	/// </summary>
	void SubmitFrame(WaterUnderwaterFrame frame);
}

// res://water/rendering/underwater/IWSWaterCameraController.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;

using Godot;
using System;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Profile;
using IWS.Water.Runtime;
using IWS.Water.Debug;

/// <summary>
/// Controls the camera's underwater state machine (Above, Waterline, Underwater).
/// Smoothly blends activation weights and packages optical parameters into WaterUnderwaterFrame 
/// for the compute shader or canvas fallback. Ensures that ripple displacement scale 
/// is homologous with the vertex shader to eliminate systematic height deviations.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterCameraController : Node
{
	[ExportCategory("Effect Layer References")]
	[Export] public ColorRect UnderwaterRect;

	[ExportCategory("State Machine")]
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.01,0.5")] public float WaterlineBandTop    = 0.10f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.01,0.5")] public float WaterlineBandBottom = 0.08f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.02,0.5")] public float Hysteresis          = 0.12f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.5,10.0")] public float BlendSpeed          = 6.0f;
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.5,10.0")] public float SignedDistFilterHz  = 3.0f;

	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.5,10.0")] public float PrewarmRange = 3.0f;

	[ExportCategory("Waterline Visual")]
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.01,0.5")] public float WaterlineSoftness = 0.08f;

	[ExportCategory("Effect Activation")]
	[Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.5,10.0")] public float ExtraMargin = 1.0f;

	[ExportCategory("Debug")]
	[Export] public bool DrawDebug = true;

	public IWSCameraWaterState State          { get; private set; } = IWSCameraWaterState.Above;
	public float               SignedDistance { get; private set; } = float.MaxValue;
	public float               SmoothBlend    { get; private set; } = 0f;

	public bool IsComputeAvailable    => _computeRenderer?.IsAvailable ?? false;
	public bool IsUsingCanvasFallback => _computeRenderer == null || !_computeRenderer.IsAvailable;

	private IWSUnderwaterRenderer _computeRenderer;
	private IWSUnderwaterRenderer _canvasRenderer;

	private IWSWaterBody _currentWater;
	private IWSWaterBody _stickyBody;
	private IWSWaterBody _lockedWater;

	private readonly WaterUnderwaterFrame _activeFrame = new WaterUnderwaterFrame();
	private readonly WaterUnderwaterFrame _nullFrame   = new WaterUnderwaterFrame();

	private float _smoothedDist          = float.MaxValue;
	private bool  _firstActivation       = true;
	private bool  _wasComputeActive      = false;
	private bool  _bandTopExpandedLogged = false;

	private int       _timeAlignCounter   = 0;
	private const int TIME_ALIGN_INTERVAL = 300;

	private bool _loggedStickyFallback = false;

	public override void _Ready()
	{
		_canvasRenderer = new UnderwaterRendererCanvas(UnderwaterRect);
		if (UnderwaterRect != null) UnderwaterRect.Visible = false;

		InitNullFrame();
		CallDeferred(MethodName.InitRenderers);
	}

	private void InitNullFrame()
	{
		_nullFrame.CameraBlend         = 0f;
		_nullFrame.RenderTime          = 0.0;
		_nullFrame.Waves               = Array.Empty<IWSWaveSettings>();
		_nullFrame.WaveNonlinearExp    = 1.3f;
		_nullFrame.WaterClarity        = 12.0f;
		_nullFrame.AbsorptionRGB       = new Vector3(0.45f, 0.08f, 0.02f);
		_nullFrame.ScatteringIntensity = 0.4f;
		_nullFrame.CausticsChromatic   = 0.004f;
		_nullFrame.Turbidity           = 0f;
		_nullFrame.WaveSearchRange     = 3.0f;
		_nullFrame.WaterSize           = 50f;
	}

	private void InitRenderers()
	{
		var effect = FindUnderEffect(GetTree().Root);
		if (effect != null)
		{
			_computeRenderer = new UnderwaterRendererCompute(effect);
			GD.Print("[IWSWaterCameraController] Compute strategy ready | Per-pixel GPU waterline enabled.");
		}
		else
		{
			GD.PushWarning("[IWSWaterCameraController] WaterUnderEffect not found, falling back to Canvas.");
		}
		SubmitNullFrame();
	}

	public override void _ExitTree() => SubmitNullFrame();

	public override void _Process(double delta)
	{
		Camera3D cam = GetViewport()?.GetCamera3D();
		if (cam == null) return;

		float   fDelta = (float)delta;
		Vector3 camPos = cam.GlobalPosition;

		_currentWater = PickCameraBody(camPos);

		if (_currentWater == null)
		{
			if (State != IWSCameraWaterState.Above)
			{
				State = IWSCameraWaterState.Above;
				GD.Print("[IWSWaterCameraController] No water body in XZ bounds, forcing state -> Above.");
			}
			_smoothedDist     = float.MaxValue;
			_timeAlignCounter = 0;
			ShutdownCompute(fDelta);
			return;
		}

		WaterSample surfaceSample = _currentWater.SampleWaterRender(camPos);
		float surfaceH = surfaceSample.Height;

		if (_firstActivation && surfaceSample.IsValid &&
			Mathf.Abs(camPos.Y - surfaceH) < 1.0f)
		{
			GD.Print($"[IWSWaterCameraController] Full sampling near waterline | " +
					 $"height={surfaceH:F4} camY={camPos.Y:F4} " +
					 $"energy={surfaceSample.Energy:F4}");
		}

		SignedDistance = camPos.Y - surfaceH;

		if (_smoothedDist > 1e6f)
		{
			_smoothedDist = SignedDistance;
			GD.Print($"[IWSWaterCameraController] Filter initialized | dist={SignedDistance:F3}m body='{_currentWater.Name}'");
		}
		_smoothedDist = Mathf.Lerp(_smoothedDist, SignedDistance, fDelta * SignedDistFilterHz);

		float maxAmp           = ComputeMaxWaveAmplitude();
		float effectiveBandTop = Mathf.Max(WaterlineBandTop, maxAmp * 1.5f);

		if (!_bandTopExpandedLogged && effectiveBandTop > WaterlineBandTop + 0.01f)
		{
			_bandTopExpandedLogged = true;
			GD.Print($"[IWSWaterCameraController] Waterline band expanded | maxAmp={maxAmp:F2}m -> bandTop={effectiveBandTop:F3}m");
		}

		UpdateStateMachine(_smoothedDist, effectiveBandTop);
		UpdateWaterBodyLock(camPos);

		float activationTarget = State switch
		{
			IWSCameraWaterState.Above      => 0f,
			IWSCameraWaterState.Underwater => 1f,
			IWSCameraWaterState.Waterline  => Mathf.Clamp(
				(-_smoothedDist) / Mathf.Max(WaterlineBandBottom, 0.01f), 0f, 1f),
			_                              => 0f,
		};
		SmoothBlend = Mathf.Lerp(SmoothBlend, activationTarget, fDelta * BlendSpeed);

		bool computeActive = (_smoothedDist < PrewarmRange)
						  || (State != IWSCameraWaterState.Above);
		bool useCanvas     = _computeRenderer == null || !_computeRenderer.IsAvailable;

		if (computeActive)
		{
			if (_firstActivation && _smoothedDist < effectiveBandTop)
			{
				_firstActivation = false;
				GD.Print($"[IWSWaterCameraController] First activation | body='{_currentWater.Name}' | " +
						 $"raw={SignedDistance:F3}m smooth={_smoothedDist:F3}m state={State}");
			}

			_wasComputeActive = true;
			BuildFrame();

			_activeFrame.CameraBlend = 1.0f;

			_computeRenderer?.SubmitFrame(_activeFrame);
			_canvasRenderer.SetEnabled(useCanvas);
			if (useCanvas) _canvasRenderer.SubmitFrame(_activeFrame);

			_timeAlignCounter++;
			if (_timeAlignCounter >= TIME_ALIGN_INTERVAL)
			{
				_timeAlignCounter = 0;
				double wbRenderTime = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.RenderTime ?? 0.0;
				double diff = Math.Abs(_activeFrame.RenderTime - wbRenderTime);
				if (diff > 0.005)
					GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterCameraController] RenderTime drift | " +
								   $"frame={_activeFrame.RenderTime:F4} wb={wbRenderTime:F4} diff={diff:F4}s");
			}
		}
		else
		{
			if (_wasComputeActive)
			{
				_wasComputeActive = false;
				_timeAlignCounter = 0;
				GD.Print($"[IWSWaterCameraController] Compute pass disabled | " +
						 $"smoothed={_smoothedDist:F2}m > PrewarmRange={PrewarmRange:F2}m");
			}
			ShutdownCompute(fDelta);
		}

		if (WaterDebugHub.Instance != null && _currentWater != null)
		{
			WaterDebugHub.Instance.RenderSnap.UnderwaterFrameNonlinearExp =
				_currentWater.GetProfile()?.WaveNonlinearExp ?? 1.3f;
		}

		if (DrawDebug) DrawDebugInfo(cam, surfaceH);
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Selects the water body the camera should use for underwater state evaluation.
	///
	/// Selection rules (in order):
	/// 1. Fast Path: Returns immediately if the camera is inside the current sticky body's exact XZ bounds.
	/// 2. Boundary Hysteresis: Retains the sticky body if the camera is just outside exact bounds (within STICKY_MARGIN)
	///    AND the state machine is in an active transition (Waterline/Underwater). This prevents single-frame flickering
	///    at boundaries. Hysteresis does not apply in the Above state.
	/// 3. Full XZ Scan: Finds the highest-priority body whose exact bounds contain the camera XZ.
	/// 4. Global Fallback Strictness: If no body is found, returns null and forces the state to Above.
	///    This strict spatial rejection prevents the camera from incorrectly inheriting the active body 
	///    when entirely outside any valid physical boundary.
	/// </summary>
	private IWSWaterBody PickCameraBody(Vector3 camPos)
	{
		var bodies = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.Bodies;
		if (bodies == null || bodies.Count == 0) return null;

		const float STICKY_MARGIN = 1.0f;
		Vector2 camPosXZ = new Vector2(camPos.X, camPos.Z);

		if (_stickyBody != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_stickyBody))
		{
			Rect2 exactBounds = _stickyBody.GetBoundsXZ();

			if (exactBounds.HasPoint(camPosXZ))
				return _stickyBody;

			if ((State == IWSCameraWaterState.Waterline || State == IWSCameraWaterState.Underwater)
				&& exactBounds.Grow(STICKY_MARGIN).HasPoint(camPosXZ))
			{
				if (!_loggedStickyFallback)
				{
					_loggedStickyFallback = true;
					GD.Print($"[IWSWaterCameraController] Boundary hysteresis: '{_stickyBody.Name}' " +
							 $"(within {STICKY_MARGIN}m margin, state={State})");
				}
				return _stickyBody;
			}
		}

		IWSWaterBody best    = null;
		float        bestPri = float.MinValue;
		foreach (var q in bodies)
		{
			if (q is not IWSWaterBody wb || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(wb)) continue;
			if (!wb.GetBoundsXZ().HasPoint(camPosXZ)) continue;
			if (wb.Priority > bestPri) { bestPri = wb.Priority; best = wb; }
		}

		if (best != _stickyBody)
		{
			GD.Print($"[IWSWaterCameraController] CameraBody: '{_stickyBody?.Name ?? "null"}' -> '{best?.Name ?? "null"}'");
			_stickyBody            = best;
			_smoothedDist          = float.MaxValue;
			_bandTopExpandedLogged = false;
			_loggedStickyFallback  = false;
		}

		return best;
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Builds the frame data.
	/// Reads optical parameters exclusively from SharedLighting to ensure that 
	/// the Compute Shader and Spatial Shader use the exact same derived values.
	/// </summary>
	private void BuildFrame()
	{
		IWSWaterProfile        profile  = _currentWater.GetProfile();
		IWSWaterSharedLighting lighting = _currentWater.SharedLighting;

		if (lighting == null)
		{
			GD.PushWarning("[IWSWaterCameraController] SharedLighting is null, BuildFrame using fallback path.");
			BuildFrameFallback(profile);
			return;
		}

		float waterY = _currentWater.GlobalPosition.Y + _currentWater.BaseWaterLevel;
		_activeFrame.WaterPos   = new Vector3(
			_currentWater.GlobalPosition.X, waterY, _currentWater.GlobalPosition.Z);
		_activeFrame.WaterBaseY = waterY;

		_activeFrame.ColorShallow        = lighting.ColorShallow;
		_activeFrame.ColorDeep           = lighting.ColorDeep;
		_activeFrame.AbsorptionRGB       = lighting.AbsorptionRGB;
		_activeFrame.ScatteringIntensity = lighting.ScatteringIntensity;
		_activeFrame.WaterClarity        = lighting.WaterClarity;

		_activeFrame.CausticsTextureRid   = lighting.CausticsTexture != null
										  ? lighting.CausticsTexture.GetRid() : default;
		_activeFrame.CausticsWorldScale   = lighting.CausticsWorldScale;
		_activeFrame.CausticsStrength     = lighting.CausticsStrengthUnderwater;
		_activeFrame.CausticsSpeed        = lighting.CausticsSpeed;
		_activeFrame.CausticsDistortion   = lighting.CausticsDistortion;
		_activeFrame.CausticsFadeDistance = lighting.CausticsFadeDistance;
		_activeFrame.CausticsChromatic    = lighting.CausticsChromatic;

		_activeFrame.WaveNonlinearExp = lighting.WaveNonlinearExp;

		_activeFrame.Turbidity = profile.Turbidity;

		_activeFrame.RenderTime = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.RenderTime ?? 0.0;

		_activeFrame.WaterlineSoftness           = WaterlineSoftness;
		_activeFrame.BlurStrength                = profile.UnderwaterBlurStrength
												 * Mathf.Lerp(1.0f, 2.5f, profile.Turbidity);
		_activeFrame.AberrationStrength          = profile.UnderwaterAberrationStrength;
		_activeFrame.ScatterStart                = profile.UnderwaterScatterStart;
