		_activeFrame.UnderwaterMaxDistance       = profile.UnderwaterMaxDistance;
		_activeFrame.UnderwaterBlurDistance      = profile.UnderwaterBlurDistance;
		_activeFrame.UnderwaterBlurStartDistance = profile.UnderwaterBlurStartDistance;

		_activeFrame.Waves           = _currentWater.GetWavesCached();
		_activeFrame.WaveSearchRange = ComputeMaxWaveAmplitude() + ExtraMargin;

		var zone = _currentWater.ZoneNode as WaterZoneShape;

		Vector2 waterSizeXZ   = zone?.GetVisualSizeXZ()
							?? new Vector2(50f, 50f);
		float   waterSizeMax  = zone != null
							? Mathf.Max(waterSizeXZ.X, waterSizeXZ.Y)
							: 50f;

		_activeFrame.WaterSize    = waterSizeMax;
		_activeFrame.WaterSizeXZ  = waterSizeXZ;

		_activeFrame.RippleCenterXZ = zone?.GetRippleCenterWorld_Render()
			?? new Vector2(_currentWater.GlobalPosition.X, _currentWater.GlobalPosition.Z);

		_activeFrame.RippleVisualStrength = profile.RippleDisplacementScale;

		var renderData = _currentWater.RippleManager?.RenderData;
		_activeFrame.RippleVisualRdRid = renderData?.VisualTexture?.TextureRdRid ?? default;

		Camera3D cam = GetViewport()?.GetCamera3D();
		_activeFrame.CameraNear = cam != null ? cam.Near : 0.05f;
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Fallback path when SharedLighting is not ready, deriving directly from Profile.
	/// Should not be entered during normal execution.
	/// </summary>
	private void BuildFrameFallback(IWSWaterProfile profile)
	{
		DerivedOptics derived = profile.GetDerivedOptics();

		float waterY = _currentWater.GlobalPosition.Y + _currentWater.BaseWaterLevel;
		_activeFrame.WaterPos   = new Vector3(
			_currentWater.GlobalPosition.X, waterY, _currentWater.GlobalPosition.Z);
		_activeFrame.WaterBaseY = waterY;

		_activeFrame.ColorShallow        = profile.ColorShallow;
		_activeFrame.ColorDeep           = profile.ColorDeep;
		_activeFrame.AbsorptionRGB       = derived.AbsorptionRGB;
		_activeFrame.ScatteringIntensity = derived.ScatteringIntensity;
		_activeFrame.WaterClarity        = profile.WaterClarity;
		_activeFrame.Turbidity           = profile.Turbidity;
		_activeFrame.WaveNonlinearExp    = profile.WaveNonlinearExp;

		_activeFrame.RenderTime      = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.RenderTime ?? 0.0;
		_activeFrame.WaveSearchRange = ComputeMaxWaveAmplitude() + ExtraMargin;

		_activeFrame.CausticsTextureRid   = profile.UnderwaterCausticsTexture != null
										  ? profile.UnderwaterCausticsTexture.GetRid() : default;
		_activeFrame.CausticsWorldScale   = profile.UnderwaterCausticsWorldScale;
		_activeFrame.CausticsStrength     = profile.UnderwaterCausticsStrength
										  * Mathf.Lerp(1.0f, 0.1f, profile.Turbidity);
		_activeFrame.CausticsSpeed        = profile.UnderwaterCausticsSpeed;
		_activeFrame.CausticsDistortion   = profile.UnderwaterCausticsDistortion;
		_activeFrame.CausticsFadeDistance = profile.UnderwaterCausticsFadeDistance;
		_activeFrame.CausticsChromatic    = profile.UnderwaterCausticsChromatic;

		Camera3D cam = GetViewport()?.GetCamera3D();
		_activeFrame.CameraNear = cam != null ? cam.Near : 0.05f;

		var zone = _currentWater.ZoneNode as WaterZoneShape;
		Vector2 fbSizeXZ          = zone?.GetVisualSizeXZ() ?? new Vector2(50f, 50f);
		_activeFrame.WaterSize    = Mathf.Max(fbSizeXZ.X, fbSizeXZ.Y);
		_activeFrame.WaterSizeXZ  = fbSizeXZ;
		_activeFrame.RippleCenterXZ = zone?.GetRippleCenterWorld_Render()
			?? new Vector2(_currentWater.GlobalPosition.X, _currentWater.GlobalPosition.Z);
		_activeFrame.RippleVisualStrength = profile.RippleDisplacementScale;
		_activeFrame.Waves                = _currentWater.GetWavesCached();

		var renderData = _currentWater.RippleManager?.RenderData;
		_activeFrame.RippleVisualRdRid = renderData?.VisualTexture?.TextureRdRid ?? default;
	}

	private float ComputeMaxWaveAmplitude()
	{
		if (_currentWater == null) return 1.0f;
		var   waves  = _currentWater.GetWavesCached();
		float maxAmp = 0.5f;
		foreach (var w in waves)
			if (w != null) maxAmp = Mathf.Max(maxAmp, w.Amplitude);
		return maxAmp;
	}

	private void UpdateStateMachine(float smoothedDist, float bandTop)
	{
		var prev = State;
		switch (State)
		{
			case IWSCameraWaterState.Above:
				if (smoothedDist < bandTop) State = IWSCameraWaterState.Waterline; break;
			case IWSCameraWaterState.Waterline:
				if (smoothedDist > bandTop + Hysteresis)      State = IWSCameraWaterState.Above;
				else if (smoothedDist < -WaterlineBandBottom) State = IWSCameraWaterState.Underwater;
				break;
			case IWSCameraWaterState.Underwater:
				if (smoothedDist > -WaterlineBandBottom + Hysteresis) State = IWSCameraWaterState.Waterline;
				break;
		}
		if (State != prev)
			GD.Print($"[IWSWaterCameraController] {prev} -> {State} | " +
					 $"smooth={smoothedDist:F3}m raw={SignedDistance:F3}m body='{_currentWater?.Name}'");
	}

	private void UpdateWaterBodyLock(Vector3 camPos)
	{
		bool near = State == IWSCameraWaterState.Waterline || State == IWSCameraWaterState.Underwater;
		if (!near) { _lockedWater = null; return; }

		if (_lockedWater == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_lockedWater))
		{ _lockedWater = _currentWater; return; }

		const float LOCK_MARGIN = 0.5f;
		Vector2 camPosXZ     = new Vector2(camPos.X, camPos.Z);
		bool    inLocked     = _lockedWater.GetBoundsXZ().Grow(LOCK_MARGIN).HasPoint(camPosXZ);

		if (inLocked)
		{
			if (_currentWater != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_currentWater) &&
				_currentWater != _lockedWater && _currentWater.Priority > _lockedWater.Priority)
			{
				GD.Print($"[IWSWaterCameraController] Spatial lock priority override: '{_lockedWater.Name}' -> '{_currentWater.Name}'");
				_lockedWater = _currentWater;
			}
			else _currentWater = _lockedWater;
		}
		else
		{
			if (_lockedWater != _currentWater)
				GD.Print($"[IWSWaterCameraController] Spatial lock released -> '{_currentWater?.Name ?? "null"}'");
			_lockedWater = _currentWater;
		}
	}

	private void ShutdownCompute(float delta)
	{
		SmoothBlend            = Mathf.Lerp(SmoothBlend, 0f, delta * BlendSpeed);
		_nullFrame.CameraBlend = 0f;
		_nullFrame.RenderTime  = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.RenderTime ?? 0.0;
		_computeRenderer?.SubmitFrame(_nullFrame);
		_canvasRenderer.SetEnabled(false);
	}

	private void SubmitNullFrame()
	{
		_nullFrame.CameraBlend = 0f;
		_computeRenderer?.SubmitFrame(_nullFrame);
		_canvasRenderer.SetEnabled(false);
		_canvasRenderer.SubmitFrame(_nullFrame);
	}

	private WaterUnderEffect FindUnderEffect(Node node)
	{
		if (node is WorldEnvironment we)
		{
			var compositor = we.Compositor;
			if (compositor?.CompositorEffects != null)
				foreach (var effect in compositor.CompositorEffects)
					if (effect is WaterUnderEffect wu) return wu;
		}
		foreach (Node child in node.GetChildren())
		{
			var r = FindUnderEffect(child);
			if (r != null) return r;
		}
		return null;
	}

	private void DrawDebugInfo(Camera3D cam, float surfaceHeight)
	{
		Vector3 camPos     = cam.GlobalPosition;
		Vector3 surfacePos = new Vector3(camPos.X, surfaceHeight, camPos.Z);
		Color col = State switch
		{
			IWSCameraWaterState.Above      => new Color(0f, 1f, 0f, 0.6f),
			IWSCameraWaterState.Waterline  => new Color(1f, 1f, 0f, 0.6f),
			IWSCameraWaterState.Underwater => new Color(0f, 0.5f, 1f, 0.6f),
			_                              => Colors.White,
		};
		WaterDebugHub.DrawSphere(surfacePos, 0.15f, col, 0f, DebugCategory.Underwater);
		WaterDebugHub.DrawLine(camPos, surfacePos, col, DebugCategory.Underwater);
	}
}

// res://water/rendering/underwater/UnderwaterRendererCanvas.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;
using Godot;

/// <summary>
/// Canvas Shader underwater rendering strategy serving as the fallback path.
/// Activated when the Compatibility renderer is used or the Compute backend is unavailable.
/// Provides basic underwater visual effects via a simple ColorRect post-processing node.
/// </summary>
public sealed class UnderwaterRendererCanvas : IWSUnderwaterRenderer
{
	private readonly ColorRect _rect;
	private ShaderMaterial _mat;

	/// <summary>
	/// Determines if the underlying ColorRect is valid and available.
	/// </summary>
	public bool IsAvailable => _rect != null;

	public UnderwaterRendererCanvas(ColorRect rect)
	{
		_rect = rect;
		if (_rect?.Material is ShaderMaterial sm)
		{
			_mat = sm;
		}
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Toggles the visibility of the internal ColorRect.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="enabled">The target state for the underwater effect.</param>
	public void SetEnabled(bool enabled)
	{
		if (_rect == null) return;
		_rect.Visible = enabled;
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Submits the state machine's optical parameters and smooth blend weights to the shader.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="frame">The data payload containing camera states and blend metrics.</param>
	public void SubmitFrame(WaterUnderwaterFrame frame)
	{
		if (!IsAvailable || _mat == null) return;

		// Drives the overall effect strength based on the smooth camera blend state (Above / Waterline / Underwater).
		// Detailed optical properties and fallback calculations are handled internally by GLSL parameters.
		_mat.SetShaderParameter("effect_strength", frame.CameraBlend);
	}
}

// res://water/rendering/underwater/UnderwaterRendererCompute.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;
using Godot;

/// <summary>
/// Compute Shader underwater rendering strategy.
/// 
/// Wraps the WaterUnderEffect, hiding Godot's Compositor details from the IWSWaterCameraController.
/// IsAvailable returns false if the RenderingDevice is unavailable or the Effect node is not found.
/// </summary>
public sealed class UnderwaterRendererCompute : IWSUnderwaterRenderer
{
	private readonly WaterUnderEffect _effect;

	public bool IsAvailable => _effect != null && _effect.IsInitializedSuccessfully;

	public UnderwaterRendererCompute(WaterUnderEffect effect)
	{
		_effect = effect;
	}

	public void SetEnabled(bool enabled)
	{
		// The compute path's activation is implicitly controlled by whether SubmitFrame is called.
		// No explicit enable/disable toggle is required.
	}

	public void SubmitFrame(WaterUnderwaterFrame frame)
	{
		if (!IsAvailable) return;
		_effect.UpdatePayload(frame);
	}
}

// res://water/rendering/underwater/underwater_post.gdshader
// CanvasItem shader for underwater post-processing in the fallback and compatibility path.
// Evaluates basic underwater visual effects such as caustics, godrays, particles, and vignette via a simple ColorRect.

shader_type canvas_item;
render_mode unshaded, blend_mix;

uniform sampler2D screen_texture : hint_screen_texture, filter_linear_mipmap;

uniform float effect_strength : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 1.0;

uniform bool enable_vignette   = true;
uniform bool enable_godray     = false;
uniform bool enable_particles  = false;
uniform bool enable_caustics   = false;

uniform sampler2D caustics_texture : repeat_enable;
uniform float caustics_strength : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.4;
uniform float caustics_scale    : hint_range(1.0, 20.0) = 6.0;

uniform float godray_strength   : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.2;
uniform float vignette_strength : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.5;
uniform float particle_strength : hint_range(0.0, 0.1) = 0.015;

// Generates a pseudo-random value based on UV coordinates.
float rand(vec2 co) { 
    return fract(sin(dot(co, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453); 
}

void fragment() {
    vec3 original = texture(screen_texture, SCREEN_UV).rgb;
    vec3 scene    = original;

    if (effect_strength > 0.001) {

        // Applies projected caustics.
        if (enable_caustics) {
            vec2 cuv1 = SCREEN_UV * caustics_scale + vec2(TIME * 0.10, TIME * 0.07);
            vec2 cuv2 = SCREEN_UV * caustics_scale - vec2(TIME * 0.08, TIME * 0.11);
            float c   = texture(caustics_texture, cuv1).r * texture(caustics_texture, cuv2).r;
            scene += clamp(c * caustics_strength * effect_strength, 0.0, 0.25);
        }

        // Applies simulated godrays (light shafts).
        if (enable_godray) {
            vec2 light_pos = vec2(0.5, 0.0);
            vec2 ray_dir   = (light_pos - SCREEN_UV) * 0.015;
            float ray = 0.0;
            vec2 ray_uv = SCREEN_UV;
            for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
                ray_uv += ray_dir;
                ray    += texture(screen_texture, clamp(ray_uv, vec2(0.001), vec2(0.999))).r;
            }
            ray /= 6.0;
            scene += clamp(ray * godray_strength * effect_strength * 0.1, 0.0, 0.15);
        }

        // Applies suspended underwater particles.
        if (enable_particles) {
            float p = rand(SCREEN_UV + fract(TIME * 0.5)) * particle_strength * effect_strength;
            scene += vec3(p);
        }

        // Applies screen vignette.
        if (enable_vignette) {
            vec2  vig      = SCREEN_UV * 2.0 - 1.0;
            float vignette = pow(clamp(1.0 - dot(vig * 0.5, vig * 0.5), 0.0, 1.0), 1.2);
            float vig_mix  = mix(1.0 - vignette_strength * effect_strength, 1.0, vignette);
            scene *= vig_mix;
        }

        scene = clamp(scene, vec3(0.0), vec3(1.0));
    }

    COLOR = vec4(mix(original, scene, effect_strength), 1.0);
}

// res://water/rendering/underwater/WaterUnderEffect.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;
using Godot;
using System;

/// <summary>
/// CompositorEffect wrapper for underwater compute shader post-processing.
/// Manages the Compute Shader lifecycle, uniform buffers (UBO), and textures.
/// Executes raymarching and Newton iteration to calculate volume absorption, 
/// scattering, caustics, and meniscus.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class WaterUnderEffect : CompositorEffect
{
    [Export] public RDShaderFile ComputeShader;
    [Export] public Texture2D    DefaultCausticsTexture;

    // GPU pipeline resources
    private RenderingDevice _rd;
    private Rid _shader;
    private Rid _pipeline;

    // Samplers
    private Rid _samplerDepthNearest;
    private Rid _samplerTempLinear;
    private Rid _samplerCausticsRepeatLinear;
    private Rid _samplerRippleClampLinear;

    // Buffers and Textures
    private Rid _tempColorBuffer;
    private Rid _fallbackRippleTex;
    private Rid _uboRid;

    private Vector2I _lastSize;
    private bool     _isInitialized = false;

    // UBO payload definition
    private const int  UBO_FLOAT_COUNT = 204;
    private const uint UBO_BYTES       = UBO_FLOAT_COUNT * 4;

    private readonly float[] _uboFloats = new float[UBO_FLOAT_COUNT];
    private readonly byte[]  _uboBytes  = new byte[UBO_BYTES];

    // Frame synchronization
    private volatile WaterUnderwaterFrame _pendingFrame;
    private          WaterUnderwaterFrame _renderFrame;

    private Rid _cachedCausticsRsRid;
    private Rid _cachedCausticsRdRid;

    // Performance control
    private int  _renderSkipCounter  = 0;
    private int  _renderSkipInterval = 1;

    // Debug tracking
    private bool  _debugFirstActiveLogged    = false;
    private float _lastLoggedMeniscusRange   = -1f;

    public bool IsInitializedSuccessfully => _isInitialized && _pipeline.IsValid;

    public WaterUnderEffect()
    {
        EffectCallbackType = EffectCallbackTypeEnum.PostSky;
    }

    public override void _Notification(int what)
    {
        if (what == NotificationPredelete)
            ReleaseGpuResources();
    }

    private void ReleaseGpuResources()
    {
        if (_rd == null) return;
        
        void F(Rid r) { if (r.IsValid) _rd.FreeRid(r); }
        
        F(_samplerDepthNearest);
        F(_samplerTempLinear);
        F(_samplerCausticsRepeatLinear);
        F(_samplerRippleClampLinear);
        F(_fallbackRippleTex);
        F(_tempColorBuffer);
        F(_uboRid);
        F(_pipeline);
        F(_shader);
        
        _cachedCausticsRsRid = default;
        _cachedCausticsRdRid = default;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Thread-safe injection of the latest optical and transformation data 
    /// generated by the state machine in the _Process loop.
    /// </summary>
    public void UpdatePayload(WaterUnderwaterFrame frame) => _pendingFrame = frame;

    private void EnsureInitialized()
    {
        if (_isInitialized) return;

        _rd = RenderingServer.GetRenderingDevice();
        if (_rd == null)
        {
            GD.PushWarning("[WaterUnderEffect] RenderingDevice is unavailable (Compatibility renderer).");
            return;
        }

        if (ComputeShader?.GetSpirV() == null)
        {
            GD.PushError("[WaterUnderEffect] ComputeShader is invalid. Please reimport the .glsl file.");
            return;
        }

        _shader   = _rd.ShaderCreateFromSpirV(ComputeShader.GetSpirV());
        _pipeline = _rd.ComputePipelineCreate(_shader);
        if (!_pipeline.IsValid)
        {
            GD.PushError("[WaterUnderEffect] Failed to create ComputePipeline.");
            return;
        }

        _samplerDepthNearest = _rd.SamplerCreate(new RDSamplerState
        {
            MinFilter = RenderingDevice.SamplerFilter.Nearest,
            MagFilter = RenderingDevice.SamplerFilter.Nearest,
            RepeatU   = RenderingDevice.SamplerRepeatMode.ClampToEdge,
            RepeatV   = RenderingDevice.SamplerRepeatMode.ClampToEdge,
        });
        
        _samplerTempLinear = _rd.SamplerCreate(new RDSamplerState
        {
            MinFilter = RenderingDevice.SamplerFilter.Linear,
            MagFilter = RenderingDevice.SamplerFilter.Linear,
            RepeatU   = RenderingDevice.SamplerRepeatMode.ClampToEdge,
            RepeatV   = RenderingDevice.SamplerRepeatMode.ClampToEdge,
        });
        
        _samplerCausticsRepeatLinear = _rd.SamplerCreate(new RDSamplerState
        {
            MinFilter = RenderingDevice.SamplerFilter.Linear,
            MagFilter = RenderingDevice.SamplerFilter.Linear,
            MipFilter = RenderingDevice.SamplerFilter.Linear,
            RepeatU   = RenderingDevice.SamplerRepeatMode.Repeat,
            RepeatV   = RenderingDevice.SamplerRepeatMode.Repeat,
        });
        
        _samplerRippleClampLinear = _rd.SamplerCreate(new RDSamplerState
        {
            MinFilter = RenderingDevice.SamplerFilter.Linear,
            MagFilter = RenderingDevice.SamplerFilter.Linear,
            RepeatU   = RenderingDevice.SamplerRepeatMode.ClampToEdge,
            RepeatV   = RenderingDevice.SamplerRepeatMode.ClampToEdge,
        });

        var fmt1x1 = new RDTextureFormat
        {
            Width     = 1, Height = 1,
            Format    = RenderingDevice.DataFormat.R32Sfloat,
            UsageBits = RenderingDevice.TextureUsageBits.SamplingBit
                      | RenderingDevice.TextureUsageBits.CanUpdateBit,
        };
        _fallbackRippleTex = _rd.TextureCreate(fmt1x1, new RDTextureView(),
            new Godot.Collections.Array<byte[]> { new byte[4] });
            
        if (!_fallbackRippleTex.IsValid)
            GD.PushError("[WaterUnderEffect] Failed to create fallback ripple texture.");

        _uboRid = _rd.UniformBufferCreate(UBO_BYTES, _uboBytes);
        if (!_uboRid.IsValid)
        {
            GD.PushError("[WaterUnderEffect] Failed to create UBO.");
            return;
        }

        _isInitialized = true;
        GD.Print($"[WaterUnderEffect] Initialization successful | PostSky | UBO={UBO_BYTES}B");
    }

    public override void _RenderCallback(int callbackType, RenderData renderData)
    {
        if ((EffectCallbackTypeEnum)callbackType != EffectCallbackType) return;

        EnsureInitialized();
        if (!IsInitializedSuccessfully) return;

        _renderFrame = _pendingFrame;
        if (_renderFrame == null) return;
        if (_renderFrame.CameraBlend < 0.004f) return;

        // Dynamic frame skipping: Reduce execution frequency at low blend weights to save GPU overhead.
        _renderSkipInterval = _renderFrame.CameraBlend > 0.5f ? 1
                            : _renderFrame.CameraBlend > 0.1f ? 2
                            : 3;
                            
        _renderSkipCounter = (_renderSkipCounter + 1) % _renderSkipInterval;
        if (_renderSkipCounter != 0) return;

        if (!_debugFirstActiveLogged)
        {
            _debugFirstActiveLogged = true;
            float meniscusRange = Mathf.Clamp(_renderFrame.WaterSizeXZ.X * 0.003f, 0.05f, 0.15f);
            GD.Print($"[WaterUnderEffect] First activation | " +
                     $"blend={_renderFrame.CameraBlend:F3} " +
                     $"waterBaseY={_renderFrame.WaterBaseY:F2} " +
                     $"waterSizeXZ=({_renderFrame.WaterSizeXZ.X:F1},{_renderFrame.WaterSizeXZ.Y:F1})m | " +
                     $"meniscusRange={meniscusRange:F4}m | " +
                     $"cameraNear={_renderFrame.CameraNear:F4}m | " +
                     $"waves={_renderFrame.Waves?.Length ?? 0} | " +
                     $"rippleRid={_renderFrame.RippleVisualRdRid.IsValid}");
        }

        var sceneBuffers = renderData.GetRenderSceneBuffers() as RenderSceneBuffersRD;
        if (sceneBuffers == null) return;

        Rid colorRid = sceneBuffers.GetColorLayer(0);
        Rid depthRid = sceneBuffers.GetDepthLayer(0);
        if (!colorRid.IsValid || !depthRid.IsValid) return;

        var sceneData = renderData.GetRenderSceneData();
        if (sceneData == null) return;

        Vector2I size = sceneBuffers.GetInternalSize();
        EnsureTempBuffer(size);
        if (!_tempColorBuffer.IsValid) return;

        bool hasCaustics;
        Rid  causticsRdRid = ResolveCausticsRdTexture(_renderFrame, out hasCaustics);
        Rid  rippleRdRid   = ResolveRippleRdTexture(_renderFrame);

        FillUbo(_renderFrame, sceneData, hasCaustics);
        _rd.BufferUpdate(_uboRid, 0, UBO_BYTES, _uboBytes);

        var uColor  = MakeImageUniform  (colorRid,                                            0);
        var uTempI  = MakeImageUniform  (_tempColorBuffer,                                    1);
        var uDepth  = MakeSamplerUniform(_samplerDepthNearest,         depthRid,              2);
        var uUbo    = MakeUboUniform    (_uboRid,                                             3);
        var uTempS  = MakeSamplerUniform(_samplerTempLinear,           _tempColorBuffer,      4);
        var uCausS  = MakeSamplerUniform(_samplerCausticsRepeatLinear, causticsRdRid,         5);
        var uRipple = MakeSamplerUniform(_samplerRippleClampLinear,    rippleRdRid,           6);

        var uniforms = new Godot.Collections.Array<RDUniform>
                       { uColor, uTempI, uDepth, uUbo, uTempS, uCausS, uRipple };

        // Utilize UniformSetCacheRD to prevent per-frame GPU object allocation and deallocation.
        Rid uniformSet = UniformSetCacheRD.GetCache(_shader, 0, uniforms);
        if (!uniformSet.IsValid)
        {
            GD.PushWarning("[WaterUnderEffect] UniformSetCacheRD returned invalid set; skipping frame.");
            return;
        }

        uint groupsX = (uint)((size.X + 7) / 8);
        uint groupsY = (uint)((size.Y + 7) / 8);
        byte[] push  = new byte[16];

        long cl = _rd.ComputeListBegin();
        _rd.ComputeListBindComputePipeline(cl, _pipeline);
        _rd.ComputeListBindUniformSet(cl, uniformSet, 0);

        // Pass 0: Copy original color buffer to temporary working buffer.
        BitConverter.GetBytes(0).CopyTo(push, 0);
        _rd.ComputeListSetPushConstant(cl, push, (uint)push.Length);
        _rd.ComputeListDispatch(cl, groupsX, groupsY, 1);
        _rd.ComputeListAddBarrier(cl);

        // Pass 1: Execute underwater volumetric rendering (Raymarching compute).
        BitConverter.GetBytes(1).CopyTo(push, 0);
        _rd.ComputeListSetPushConstant(cl, push, (uint)push.Length);
        _rd.ComputeListDispatch(cl, groupsX, groupsY, 1);

        _rd.ComputeListEnd();
        
        // Manual FreeRid is intentionally omitted here; UniformSetCacheRD handles the lifecycle.
    }

    private Rid ResolveRippleRdTexture(WaterUnderwaterFrame frame)
    {
        if (!frame.RippleVisualRdRid.IsValid || frame.RippleVisualStrength < 0.001f)
            return _fallbackRippleTex;
        return frame.RippleVisualRdRid;
    }

    private Rid ResolveCausticsRdTexture(WaterUnderwaterFrame frame, out bool hasCaustics)
    {
        Rid rsRid = frame.CausticsTextureRid;
        if (!rsRid.IsValid && DefaultCausticsTexture != null)
            rsRid = DefaultCausticsTexture.GetRid();

        if (!rsRid.IsValid) { hasCaustics = false; return _tempColorBuffer; }

        if (rsRid == _cachedCausticsRsRid && _cachedCausticsRdRid.IsValid)
        {
            hasCaustics = true;
            return _cachedCausticsRdRid;
        }

        _cachedCausticsRsRid = rsRid;
        _cachedCausticsRdRid = RenderingServer.TextureGetRdTexture(rsRid, false);

        if (!_cachedCausticsRdRid.IsValid)
        {
            GD.PushWarning("[WaterUnderEffect] Failed to convert Caustics RD texture. Caustics disabled.");
            hasCaustics = false;
            return _tempColorBuffer;
        }

        hasCaustics = true;
        GD.Print("[WaterUnderEffect] Caustics RD texture cached successfully.");
        return _cachedCausticsRdRid;
    }

    private void EnsureTempBuffer(Vector2I size)
    {
        if (_lastSize == size && _tempColorBuffer.IsValid) return;
        if (_tempColorBuffer.IsValid) _rd.FreeRid(_tempColorBuffer);

        var fmt = new RDTextureFormat
        {
            Format    = RenderingDevice.DataFormat.R16G16B16A16Sfloat,
            Width     = (uint)size.X,
            Height    = (uint)size.Y,
            UsageBits = RenderingDevice.TextureUsageBits.StorageBit
                      | RenderingDevice.TextureUsageBits.SamplingBit
                      | RenderingDevice.TextureUsageBits.CanUpdateBit,
        };
        
        _tempColorBuffer = _rd.TextureCreate(fmt, new RDTextureView());
        _lastSize        = size;
        
        GD.Print($"[WaterUnderEffect] TempBuffer rebuilt -> {size.X}x{size.Y} " +
                 $"(VRAM≈{size.X * size.Y * 8 / 1024 / 1024}MB RGBA16F)");
    }

    private void FillUbo(WaterUnderwaterFrame frame, RenderSceneData sceneData, bool hasCaustics)
    {
        Projection invP = sceneData.GetCamProjection().Inverse();
        _uboFloats[ 0] = invP.X.X; _uboFloats[ 1] = invP.X.Y;
        _uboFloats[ 2] = invP.X.Z; _uboFloats[ 3] = invP.X.W;
        _uboFloats[ 4] = invP.Y.X; _uboFloats[ 5] = invP.Y.Y;
        _uboFloats[ 6] = invP.Y.Z; _uboFloats[ 7] = invP.Y.W;
        _uboFloats[ 8] = invP.Z.X; _uboFloats[ 9] = invP.Z.Y;
        _uboFloats[10] = invP.Z.Z; _uboFloats[11] = invP.Z.W;
        _uboFloats[12] = invP.W.X; _uboFloats[13] = invP.W.Y;
        _uboFloats[14] = invP.W.Z; _uboFloats[15] = invP.W.W;

        Transform3D ct = sceneData.GetCamTransform();
        _uboFloats[16] = ct.Basis.X.X; _uboFloats[17] = ct.Basis.X.Y;
        _uboFloats[18] = ct.Basis.X.Z; _uboFloats[19] = 0f;
        _uboFloats[20] = ct.Basis.Y.X; _uboFloats[21] = ct.Basis.Y.Y;
        _uboFloats[22] = ct.Basis.Y.Z; _uboFloats[23] = 0f;
        _uboFloats[24] = ct.Basis.Z.X; _uboFloats[25] = ct.Basis.Z.Y;
        _uboFloats[26] = ct.Basis.Z.Z; _uboFloats[27] = 0f;
        _uboFloats[28] = ct.Origin.X;  _uboFloats[29] = ct.Origin.Y;
        _uboFloats[30] = ct.Origin.Z;  _uboFloats[31] = 1f;

        _uboFloats[32] = ct.Origin.X;
        _uboFloats[33] = ct.Origin.Y;
        _uboFloats[34] = ct.Origin.Z;
        _uboFloats[35] = (float)(frame.RenderTime % 3600.0);

        _uboFloats[36] = frame.ColorShallow.R;
        _uboFloats[37] = frame.ColorShallow.G;
        _uboFloats[38] = frame.ColorShallow.B;
        _uboFloats[39] = 1f;

        _uboFloats[40] = frame.ColorDeep.R;
        _uboFloats[41] = frame.ColorDeep.G;
        _uboFloats[42] = frame.ColorDeep.B;
        _uboFloats[43] = 1f;

        _uboFloats[44] = frame.AbsorptionRGB.X;
        _uboFloats[45] = frame.AbsorptionRGB.Y;
        _uboFloats[46] = frame.AbsorptionRGB.Z;
        _uboFloats[47] = frame.ScatteringIntensity;

        int waveCount  = Math.Min(frame.Waves?.Length ?? 0, 16);
        _uboFloats[48] = frame.WaterPos.X;
        _uboFloats[49] = frame.WaterPos.Y;
        _uboFloats[50] = frame.WaterPos.Z;
        _uboFloats[51] = waveCount;

        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
        {
            int ofs = 52 + i * 8;
            if (i < waveCount && frame.Waves != null)
            {
                var     w   = frame.Waves[i];
                Vector2 dir = w.GetNormalizedDirection();
                _uboFloats[ofs + 0] = dir.X;
                _uboFloats[ofs + 1] = dir.Y;
                _uboFloats[ofs + 2] = w.Wavelength;
                _uboFloats[ofs + 3] = w.Amplitude;
                _uboFloats[ofs + 4] = w.Speed;
                _uboFloats[ofs + 5] = w.Steepness;
                _uboFloats[ofs + 6] = 0f;
                _uboFloats[ofs + 7] = 0f;
            }
            else
            {
                for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) _uboFloats[ofs + j] = 0f;
            }
        }

        _uboFloats[180] = frame.CameraNear;
        _uboFloats[181] = frame.WaterlineSoftness;
        _uboFloats[182] = frame.BlurStrength;
        _uboFloats[183] = frame.AberrationStrength;

        _uboFloats[184] = frame.ScatterStart;
        _uboFloats[185] = frame.UnderwaterMaxDistance;
        _uboFloats[186] = frame.UnderwaterBlurDistance;
        _uboFloats[187] = frame.UnderwaterBlurStartDistance;

        _uboFloats[188] = frame.CausticsWorldScale;
        _uboFloats[189] = hasCaustics ? frame.CausticsStrength : 0f;
        _uboFloats[190] = frame.CausticsSpeed;
        _uboFloats[191] = frame.CausticsDistortion;

        _uboFloats[192] = frame.CausticsFadeDistance;
        _uboFloats[193] = Math.Max(frame.WaveNonlinearExp, 1.0f);
        _uboFloats[194] = frame.CausticsChromatic;
        _uboFloats[195] = 0f;

        _uboFloats[196] = frame.WaterBaseY;
        _uboFloats[197] = Math.Max(frame.WaveSearchRange, 0.5f);
        _uboFloats[198] = Math.Max(frame.WaterSizeXZ.X, 1f);
        _uboFloats[199] = (frame.RippleVisualRdRid.IsValid && frame.RippleVisualStrength > 0.001f)
                          ? frame.RippleVisualStrength : 0f;

        _uboFloats[200] = frame.RippleCenterXZ.X;
        _uboFloats[201] = frame.RippleCenterXZ.Y;
        _uboFloats[202] = Mathf.Max(frame.WaterSizeXZ.Y, 1f);
        _uboFloats[203] = 0f;

        float meniscusRange = Mathf.Clamp(frame.WaterSize * 0.003f, 0.05f, 0.15f);
        if (Mathf.Abs(meniscusRange - _lastLoggedMeniscusRange) > 0.005f)
        {
            _lastLoggedMeniscusRange = meniscusRange;
            GD.Print($"[WaterUnderEffect] meniscusRange={meniscusRange:F4}m " +
                     $"(waterSize={frame.WaterSize:F1}m) cameraNear={frame.CameraNear:F4}m");
        }

        Buffer.BlockCopy(_uboFloats, 0, _uboBytes, 0, (int)UBO_BYTES);
    }

    private static RDUniform MakeImageUniform(Rid rid, int binding)
    {
        var u = new RDUniform
            { UniformType = RenderingDevice.UniformType.Image, Binding = binding };
        u.AddId(rid);
        return u;
    }

    private static RDUniform MakeUboUniform(Rid rid, int binding)
    {
        var u = new RDUniform
            { UniformType = RenderingDevice.UniformType.UniformBuffer, Binding = binding };
        u.AddId(rid);
        return u;
    }

    private static RDUniform MakeSamplerUniform(Rid sampler, Rid tex, int binding)
    {
        var u = new RDUniform
            { UniformType = RenderingDevice.UniformType.SamplerWithTexture, Binding = binding };
        u.AddId(sampler);
        u.AddId(tex);
        return u;
    }
}

// res://water/rendering/underwater/WaterUnderwaterFrame.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Rendering;
using Godot;
using IWS.Water.Profile;

public sealed class WaterUnderwaterFrame
{
    public Vector3 WaterPos;
    public Color   ColorShallow;
    public Color   ColorDeep;

    public Vector3 AbsorptionRGB;
    public float   ScatteringIntensity;
    public float   WaterClarity;

    /// <summary>
    /// The value of RenderTime % 3600.0, truncated to a safe float precision range before passing to the Shader.
    /// </summary>
    public double RenderTime;

    /// <summary>
    /// Scheduling gate: skips the entire compute pass when the blend value is less than 0.004f.
    /// </summary>
    public float CameraBlend;

    public float WaterlineSoftness;
    public float BlurStrength;
    public float AberrationStrength;
    public float ScatterStart;

    public IWSWaveSettings[] Waves;
    public float             WaveNonlinearExp;

    public float UnderwaterMaxDistance;
    public float UnderwaterBlurDistance;
    public float UnderwaterBlurStartDistance;

    // Caustics
    public Rid   CausticsTextureRid;
    public float CausticsWorldScale;
    public float CausticsStrength;
    public float CausticsSpeed;
    public float CausticsDistortion;
    public float CausticsFadeDistance;
    public float CausticsChromatic;

    // Turbidity
    public float Turbidity;

    // Water surface evaluation parameters
    public float   WaterBaseY;
    public float   WaveSearchRange;
    public float   WaterSize;       // Scalar (max of X, Z), used for meniscus evaluation, search range, etc.
    public Vector2 WaterSizeXZ;     // Dual-axis size, utilized by the Compute Shader for ripple UV evaluation.
    public Vector2 RippleCenterXZ;
    public Rid     RippleVisualRdRid;

    /// <summary>
    /// Ripple displacement scale, corresponding to IWSWaterProfile.RippleDisplacementScale.
    /// </summary>
    public float RippleVisualStrength;

    /// <summary>
    /// Camera Near plane distance in meters.
    /// Used in the Compute Shader to compensate for sub-pixel jitter caused by Reverse-Z depth precision near the waterline.
    /// Read from the current Camera3D.Near by IWSWaterCameraController.BuildFrame().
    /// </summary>
    public float CameraNear;
}

// res://water/runtime/IWSWaterBody.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Runtime;

using Godot;
using System;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Profile;
using IWS.Water.Rendering;
using IWS.Water.Simulation;
using IWS.Water.Zone;
using IWS.Water.Field;

/// <summary>
/// The specific water body entity acting as the Component Aggregator (Facade pattern).
/// Implements the highest-level contract <see cref="WaterQuery"/> for external physical and visual interactions.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterBody : Node3D, WaterQuery
{
    [ExportGroup("Water Body Settings")]
    [Export] public float           BaseWaterLevel = 0.0f;
    [Export] public float           Priority       { get; set; } = 0f;
    [Export] public IWSWaterProfile Profile;

    [ExportGroup("Sub-Systems")]
    [Export] public Node3D                                   ZoneNode;
    [Export] public IWSTextureFlowField                      FlowFieldData;
    [Export] public Godot.Collections.Array<IWSWaveSettings> Waves = new();

    [ExportGroup("Components")]
    [Export] public IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer    Renderer;
    [Export] public IWSRippleSimMgr            RippleManager;
    [Export] public Node                       MeshStrategyNode;
    [Export] public Node                       ReflectionStrategyNode;
    [Export] public IWSWaterQuerySampler       PhysicsSampler;
    [Export] public IWSWaterSimSettings        SimSettings;
    [Export] public Node                       AutoInteractorNode;

    public WaterZoneShape ZoneShape => _zoneShape;

    private WaterZoneShape             _zoneShape;
    private IWSWaterFieldComposite     _baseComposite;
    private IWSRippleField             _rippleField;
    private IWSWaterMeshStrategy       _meshStrategy;
    private IWSWaterReflectionStrategy _reflectionStrategy;
    private IWaterAutoInteractor       _autoInteractor;
    private bool                       _registered = false;
    private bool                       _impulseRadiusWarnLogged = false;

    private double RenderTime  => IWSWaterManager.Instance?.RenderTime  ?? 0.0;
    private double PhysicsTime => IWSWaterManager.Instance?.PhysicsTime ?? 0.0;

    // Zero-GC wave cache fields
    private IWSWaveSettings[]      _wavesCache           = Array.Empty<IWSWaveSettings>();
    private int                    _wavesVersion         = -1;
    private int                    _wavesNormalizedVersion = -2;

    private IWSWaterSharedLighting _sharedLighting;

    public const uint WATER_RENDER_LAYER   = 1 << 1;
    public const uint REFLECTION_CULL_MASK = (1 << 0) | (1 << 2) | (1 << 3);

    public bool IsAutoInteractionActive
        => _autoInteractor is { IsEnabled: true, IsAvailable: true };

    private IWSRippleSimMgr.BoundaryModeType _lastAppliedBoundaryMode = (IWSRippleSimMgr.BoundaryModeType)(-1);
    private float _lastAppliedDispStiffness = float.NaN;

    public override void _Ready()
    {
        ProcessPhysicsPriority = -1;

        _zoneShape = ZoneNode as WaterZoneShape;
        if (_zoneShape == null)
        {
            GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' lacks a ZoneNode. Creating default IWSWaterZoneBox.");
            var box = new IWSWaterZoneBox { Size = new Vector2(50f, 50f) };
            AddChild(box);
            _zoneShape = box;
            ZoneNode   = box;
        }

        _meshStrategy = MeshStrategyNode as IWSWaterMeshStrategy;
        if (MeshStrategyNode != null && _meshStrategy == null)
            GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' MeshStrategyNode does not implement IWSWaterMeshStrategy.");

        _reflectionStrategy = ReflectionStrategyNode as IWSWaterReflectionStrategy;
        if (ReflectionStrategyNode != null && _reflectionStrategy == null)
            GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' ReflectionStrategyNode does not implement IWSWaterReflectionStrategy.");

        _reflectionStrategy?.Initialize(this);

        _baseComposite = new IWSWaterFieldComposite();
        _baseComposite.AddField(new IWSGerstnerField(this));
        
        if (FlowFieldData != null)
        {
            FlowFieldData.Initialize(_zoneShape);
            _baseComposite.AddField(FlowFieldData);
        }
        
        if (RippleManager != null)
            _rippleField = new IWSRippleField(RippleManager, _zoneShape, this);

        if (PhysicsSampler != null)
        {
            PhysicsSampler.ZoneShape = _zoneShape;
            PhysicsSampler.Simulator = RippleManager;
        }

        _autoInteractor = AutoInteractorNode as IWaterAutoInteractor;
        if (_autoInteractor != null && SimSettings != null && SimSettings.EnableAutoInteraction)
        {
            if (_zoneShape is IWSWaterZoneSpline)
            {
                GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' Spline zone does not support AutoInteraction. Disabled.");
                _autoInteractor.IsEnabled = false;
            }
            else if (AutoInteractorNode is WaterAutoInteractorCapture capture)
            {
                capture.InitCapture(SimSettings.CaptureResolution);
            }
        }
        else if (_autoInteractor != null)
        {
            _autoInteractor.IsEnabled = false;
        }

        var specGen = GetNodeOrNull<WaveSpectrumGenerator>("WaveSpectrumGenerator");
        if (specGen != null)
        {
            specGen.Regenerate();
            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' WaveSpectrumGenerator done | {Waves.Count} waves.");
        }

        ValidateAndNormalizeWaves();

        ApplySimSettings();
        ApplyQuality(true);

        if (Renderer != null && Renderer.OwnedMaterial != null)
        {
            _meshStrategy?.SetMaterial(Renderer.OwnedMaterial);
        }
        else
        {
            if (_meshStrategy != null)
                GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' Cannot inject material: " +
                            "Renderer is null or OwnedMaterial failed to clone. " +
                            "Check that IWSWaterSurfaceRenderer.WaterMaterial is assigned.");
        }

        TryRegisterOnce();

        GD.Print($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' Ready | per-fragment backface culling active.");

        _sharedLighting = new IWSWaterSharedLighting();

        CallDeferred(MethodName.ConnectActiveBodySignal);
    }

    private void TryRegisterOnce()
    {
        if (_registered) return;
        if (IWSWaterManager.Instance == null) return;
        IWSWaterManager.Instance.Register(this);
        _registered = true;
    }

    private void ValidateAndNormalizeWaves()
    {
        if (Waves == null || Waves.Count == 0) return;

        float steepnessSum = 0f;
        foreach (var w in Waves)
        {
            if (w == null) continue;
            float k = Mathf.Tau / Mathf.Max(w.Wavelength, 0.001f);
            steepnessSum += w.Steepness * w.Amplitude * k;
        }

        if (steepnessSum > 0.95f)
        {
            float scale = 0.95f / steepnessSum;
            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' Total steepness {steepnessSum:F3} exceeded safe bounds. Auto-scaled by x{scale:F3}.");
            foreach (var w in Waves) { if (w != null) w.Steepness *= scale; }
        }
    }

    private void ConnectActiveBodySignal()
    {
        var wm = IWSWaterManager.Instance;
        if (wm == null) return;
        if (!wm.IsConnected(IWSWaterManager.SignalName.ActiveBodyChanged,
                Callable.From<IWSWaterBody>(OnActiveBodyChanged)))
        {
            wm.Connect(IWSWaterManager.SignalName.ActiveBodyChanged,
                Callable.From<IWSWaterBody>(OnActiveBodyChanged));
        }
        OnActiveBodyChanged(wm.ActiveBody);
    }

    private void OnActiveBodyChanged(IWSWaterBody newActive)
        => ApplyQuality(newActive == this);

    /// <summary>
    /// Adjusts computational overhead and feature availability based on camera proximity and LOD priority.
    /// </summary>
    public void ApplyQuality(bool isPriority)
    {
        if (SimSettings == null) return;

        if (RippleManager != null)
        {
            RippleManager.FoamEnabled = isPriority || SimSettings.EnableFoam;

            bool wantReadback = SimSettings.EnableFullReadback;
            if (RippleManager.ForceFullReadback != wantReadback)
            {
                RippleManager.ForceFullReadback = wantReadback;
                GD.Print($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' ForceFullReadback -> {wantReadback}");
            }
        }

        if (PhysicsSampler != null)
            PhysicsSampler.IsEnabled = isPriority || SimSettings.EnableGather;

        if (_autoInteractor != null)
        {
            _autoInteractor.IsEnabled = isPriority
                                    && SimSettings.EnableAutoInteraction
                                    && !(_zoneShape is IWSWaterZoneSpline);
        }

        GD.Print($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' ApplyQuality | isPriority={isPriority} | " +
                $"skipFrames={RippleManager?.SimSkipFrames ?? 0} | " +
                $"foam={RippleManager?.FoamEnabled ?? false} | " +
                $"gather={PhysicsSampler?.IsEnabled ?? false} | " +
                $"readback={RippleManager?.ForceFullReadback ?? false}");
    }

    public void SetDynamicSimSkipFrames(int skipFrames)
    {
        if (RippleManager == null) return;
        if (RippleManager.SimSkipFrames == skipFrames) return;
        RippleManager.SimSkipFrames = skipFrames;
    }

    private void ApplySimSettings()
    {
        if (SimSettings == null || RippleManager == null) return;

        if (SimSettings.AdaptiveResolution && _zoneShape != null)
        {
            float sz      = _zoneShape.GetVisualSize();
            int   autoRes = sz < 10f ? 256 : sz < 50f ? 512 : 1024;
            if (autoRes != RippleManager.TextureSize)
            {
                GD.Print($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' AdaptiveResolution: " +
                         $"visualSize={sz:F1}m -> TextureSize {RippleManager.TextureSize} -> {autoRes}");
                RippleManager.TextureSize = autoRes;
            }
        }

        RippleManager.DampingLow            = SimSettings.DampingLow;
        RippleManager.DampingHigh           = SimSettings.DampingHigh;
        RippleManager.WaveSpeedCoeff        = SimSettings.WaveSpeedCoeff;
        RippleManager.FoamEnabled           = SimSettings.EnableFoam;
        RippleManager.ForceFullReadback     = SimSettings.EnableFullReadback;
        RippleManager.BoundaryMode          = SimSettings.BoundaryMode;
        RippleManager.DisplacementStiffness = SimSettings.DisplacementStiffness;

        if (Profile != null)
        {
            RippleManager.FoamDiffusionStrength = Profile.FoamDiffusionStrength;
            RippleManager.FoamDecayRate         = Profile.FoamDecayRate > 0f
                                                ? Profile.FoamDecayRate
                                                : RippleManager.FoamDecayRate;

            float energyScale = Mathf.Clamp(Profile.RippleEnergyScale, 0.1f, 3.0f);
            if (!Mathf.IsEqualApprox(RippleManager.RippleStrengthMultiplier, energyScale))
            {
                RippleManager.RippleStrengthMultiplier = energyScale;
                GD.Print($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' RippleEnergyScale -> " +
                         $"RippleStrengthMultiplier={energyScale:F2}");
            }
        }

        bool modeChanged = _lastAppliedBoundaryMode != RippleManager.BoundaryMode;
        bool stiffChanged = float.IsNaN(_lastAppliedDispStiffness) ||
                            !Mathf.IsEqualApprox(_lastAppliedDispStiffness,
                                                  RippleManager.DisplacementStiffness);

        if (modeChanged || stiffChanged)
        {
            _lastAppliedBoundaryMode  = RippleManager.BoundaryMode;
            _lastAppliedDispStiffness = RippleManager.DisplacementStiffness;

            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' ApplySimSettings | " +
                     $"BoundaryMode={RippleManager.BoundaryMode} | " +
                     $"DispStiffness={RippleManager.DisplacementStiffness:F4} | " +
                     $"ForceFullReadback={RippleManager.ForceFullReadback} | " +
                     $"FoamDiffusion={RippleManager.FoamDiffusionStrength:F3}");
        }

        if (RippleManager.SimSkipFrames != SimSettings.SimSkipFrames)
        {
            RippleManager.SimSkipFrames = SimSettings.SimSkipFrames;
            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' Initial SimSkipFrames={SimSettings.SimSkipFrames} (Will be dynamically overridden by Manager)");
        }
    }

    public override void _EnterTree() { }

    public override void _ExitTree()
    {
        var wm = IWSWaterManager.Instance;
        if (wm != null && wm.IsConnected(IWSWaterManager.SignalName.ActiveBodyChanged,
                Callable.From<IWSWaterBody>(OnActiveBodyChanged)))
        {
            wm.Disconnect(IWSWaterManager.SignalName.ActiveBodyChanged,
                Callable.From<IWSWaterBody>(OnActiveBodyChanged));
        }
        if (_registered)
        {
            IWSWaterManager.Instance?.Unregister(this);
            _registered = false;
        }
        _meshStrategy?.Cleanup();
        _reflectionStrategy?.Cleanup();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Render domain execution. Synchronizes visual components, materials, and optical parameters to the current frame.
    /// </summary>
    public override void _Process(double delta)
    {
        Vector3 followerPos = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.FollowerPosRender ?? GlobalPosition;
        _zoneShape?.UpdateRenderFrame(followerPos);

        float   waterY       = GlobalPosition.Y + BaseWaterLevel;
        Vector2 visualSizeXZ = _zoneShape?.GetVisualSizeXZ() ?? new Vector2(50f, 50f);
        float   visualSize   = _zoneShape != null
                            ? Mathf.Max(visualSizeXZ.X, visualSizeXZ.Y)
                            : 50f;

        Vector2 rippleCenterXZ = _zoneShape?.GetRippleCenterWorld_Render()
                                ?? new Vector2(GlobalPosition.X, GlobalPosition.Z);
        Vector3 rippleCenter3D = new Vector3(rippleCenterXZ.X, waterY, rippleCenterXZ.Y);

        _meshStrategy?.SyncFrame(followerPos, waterY);
        _reflectionStrategy?.SyncFrame(
            IWSWaterManager.Instance?.MainCamera, waterY, REFLECTION_CULL_MASK);

        IWSWaveSettings[] waves = GetWavesCached();

        _sharedLighting.Update(GetProfile(), Renderer);

        Renderer?.SyncFrame(RenderTime, rippleCenter3D, visualSize, visualSizeXZ,
            waves, GetProfile(), _sharedLighting, _reflectionStrategy);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Physics domain execution. Synchronizes GPU readback mechanisms and physical simulations at a fixed time step.
    /// </summary>
    public override void _PhysicsProcess(double delta)
    {
        Vector3 followerPos = IWSWaterManager.Instance?.FollowerPosPhysics ?? GlobalPosition;
        _zoneShape?.UpdatePhysicsFrame(followerPos);

        PhysicsSampler?.BeginFrame();

        if (_autoInteractor is { IsAvailable: true, IsEnabled: true } && RippleManager != null)
        {
            float   waterY       = GlobalPosition.Y + BaseWaterLevel;
            Vector2 rippleCenter = _zoneShape?.GetRippleCenterWorld_Physics()
                                   ?? new Vector2(GlobalPosition.X, GlobalPosition.Z);
            float   visualSize   = _zoneShape?.GetVisualSize() ?? 50f;
            _autoInteractor.SyncPhysicsFrame(rippleCenter, visualSize, waterY);
            float strength = SimSettings?.AutoInteractionStrength ?? 0.3f;
            RippleManager.SetCaptureTexture(_autoInteractor.GetCaptureRsRid(), strength);
        }
        else if (RippleManager != null)
        {
            RippleManager.SetCaptureTexture(default, 0f);
        }
    }

    // --- Sampling Interfaces -----------------------------------------------------

    public float SampleGerstnerHeightRender(Vector3 worldPos)
    {
        var s = MakeBaseSample();
        _baseComposite?.Evaluate(worldPos, RenderTime, ref s);
        return s.Height;
    }

    private WaterSample MakeBaseSample() => new WaterSample
    {
        Height         = GlobalPosition.Y + BaseWaterLevel,
        Normal         = Vector3.Up,
        Velocity       = Vector3.Zero,
        FlowVelocity   = Profile?.FlowVelocity ?? Vector3.Zero,
        WaveGradientXZ = Vector2.Zero,
        Energy         = 0f,
        Foam           = 0f,
        IsValid        = true,
    };

    public WaterSample SampleWater(Vector3 worldPos)
    {
        var s = MakeBaseSample();
        _baseComposite?.EvaluatePhysics(worldPos, PhysicsTime, ref s);
        return s;
    }

    public WaterSample SampleWaterBase(Vector3 worldPos)
    {
        var s = MakeBaseSample();
        _baseComposite?.EvaluatePhysics(worldPos, PhysicsTime, ref s);
        return s;
    }

    public WaterSample SampleWaterFull(Vector3 worldPos)
    {
        var s = MakeBaseSample();
        _baseComposite?.EvaluatePhysics(worldPos, PhysicsTime, ref s);
        if (_rippleField is { IsActive: true })
            _rippleField.EvaluatePhysics(worldPos, PhysicsTime, ref s);
        return s;
    }

    public WaterSample SampleWaterRender(Vector3 worldPos)
    {
        var s = MakeBaseSample();
        _baseComposite?.Evaluate(worldPos, RenderTime, ref s);
        if (_rippleField is { IsActive: true })
            _rippleField.Evaluate(worldPos, RenderTime, ref s);
        return s;
    }

    public bool ContainsWorldPoint(Vector3 worldPos)
    {
        float waterY = GlobalPosition.Y + BaseWaterLevel;
        return _zoneShape?.ContainsWorldPoint(worldPos, waterY) ?? false;
    }

    public void AddImpulse(in WaterImpulse impulse)
    {
        if (RippleManager == null || _zoneShape == null) return;

        Vector2 uv = _zoneShape.WorldToUV_Physics(impulse.WorldPosition);
        if (uv.X < 0f || uv.X > 1f || uv.Y < 0f || uv.Y > 1f) return;

        float visualSize = _zoneShape.GetVisualSize();
        if (visualSize <= 0f) return;

        float uvOuterRadius = impulse.WorldRadius / visualSize;
        float uvInnerRadius = impulse.InnerRadius  / visualSize;

        // Clamps UV radii based on brush mode to prevent GPU budget saturation and artifacts.
        if (impulse.BrushMode == BrushMode.Velocity)
        {
            bool  isAnnular = impulse.InnerRadius > 0.001f;
            float maxUv     = isAnnular ? 0.35f : 0.25f;

            if (uvOuterRadius > maxUv)
            {
                if (!_impulseRadiusWarnLogged)
                {
                    _impulseRadiusWarnLogged = true;
                    GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' brush UV radius clamped: " +
                                $"{uvOuterRadius:F3} -> {maxUv:F3} | " +
                                $"worldRadius={impulse.WorldRadius:F2}m visualSize={visualSize:F1}m");
                }
                uvInnerRadius *= maxUv / uvOuterRadius;
                uvOuterRadius  = maxUv;
            }
        }
        else if (impulse.BrushMode == BrushMode.Displacement)
        {
            const float MAX_UV_RADIUS_DISP = 0.5f;
            if (uvOuterRadius > MAX_UV_RADIUS_DISP)
                uvOuterRadius = MAX_UV_RADIUS_DISP;
        }
        else if (impulse.BrushMode == BrushMode.SurfaceFlow)
        {
            const float MAX_UV_RADIUS_FLOW = 0.6f;
            if (uvOuterRadius > MAX_UV_RADIUS_FLOW)
                uvOuterRadius = MAX_UV_RADIUS_FLOW;
        }

        Vector2 flowUV = impulse.FlowVelocityXZ;
        if (flowUV != Vector2.Zero)
        {
            Vector2 sizeXZ = _zoneShape.GetVisualSizeXZ();
            float sx = Mathf.Max(sizeXZ.X, 0.001f);
            float sz = Mathf.Max(sizeXZ.Y, 0.001f);
            flowUV = new Vector2(flowUV.X / sx, flowUV.Y / sz);
        }

        RippleManager.AddRippleAtUV(
            uv, uvOuterRadius, impulse.Strength,
            uvInnerRadius, impulse.BrushMode,
            flowUV);
    }

    public Rect2 GetBoundsXZ()
        => _zoneShape?.GetBoundsXZ() ?? new Rect2(-25f, -25f, 50f, 50f);

    public IWSWaterProfile GetProfile()
        => Profile ?? (Profile = new IWSWaterProfile());

    public float GetSunElevationRad()
        => Renderer?.CachedSunElevationRad ?? (Mathf.Pi * 0.5f);

    public IWSWaterSharedLighting SharedLighting => _sharedLighting;

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a cached array of up to 16 active wave settings.
    /// Implements a Zero-GC approach by only rebuilding the array upon hash mismatch.
    /// Validations are isolated to prevent re-evaluations during subsequent frames.
    /// </summary>
    public IWSWaveSettings[] GetWavesCached()
    {
        int effectiveCount = Waves != null ? Math.Min(Waves.Count, 16) : 0;

        // Computes hash strictly via iteration to prevent LINQ allocation overhead.
        int hash = effectiveCount;
        if (Waves != null)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < effectiveCount; i++)
            {
                var w = Waves[i];
                if (w == null) continue;
                hash = HashCode.Combine(hash,
                    w.Direction.X, w.Direction.Y,
                    w.Wavelength, w.Amplitude,
                    w.Speed, w.Steepness);
            }
        }

        if (hash == _wavesVersion)
            return _wavesCache;

        if (_wavesCache.Length != effectiveCount)
            _wavesCache = effectiveCount > 0 ? new IWSWaveSettings[effectiveCount] : Array.Empty<IWSWaveSettings>();

        for (int i = 0; i < effectiveCount; i++)
            _wavesCache[i] = Waves![i];

        _wavesVersion = hash;

        // Evaluates structural changes requiring parameter normalization to maintain physical stability.
        if (_wavesNormalizedVersion != hash)
        {
            _wavesNormalizedVersion = hash;
            ValidateAndNormalizeWaves();
            
            // Recomputes hash post-normalization as wave steepness may have been modified.
            int postNormHash = effectiveCount;
            if (Waves != null)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < effectiveCount; i++)
                {
                    var w = Waves[i];
                    if (w == null) continue;
                    postNormHash = HashCode.Combine(postNormHash,
                        w.Direction.X, w.Direction.Y,
                        w.Wavelength, w.Amplitude,
                        w.Speed, w.Steepness);
                }
            }
            
            _wavesVersion         = postNormHash;
            _wavesNormalizedVersion = postNormHash;

            // Synchronizes the cache array with the normalized values.
            for (int i = 0; i < effectiveCount; i++)
                _wavesCache[i] = Waves![i];

            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterBody] '{Name}' Wave cache rebuilt & normalized | count={effectiveCount}");
        }

        return _wavesCache;
    }
}

// res://water/runtime/IWSWaterManager.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Runtime;

using Godot;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Threading;
using IWS.Water.Core;
using IWS.Water.Interaction;
using IWS.Water.Event;
using IWS.Water.Debug;

/// <summary>
/// The core global scheduler for the IWS architecture (Singleton Node).
/// Responsibilities:
/// 1. Acts as the central dispatcher: collects, sorts, and budgets physical disturbance 
///    commands (Impulses) from all registered Emitters during _PhysicsProcess to prevent GPU overload.
/// 2. Manages dynamic Level of Detail (LOD) and hardware execution frequencies via frustum culling 
///    and distance-based hibernation.
/// 3. Maintains the global lock-free event queues for propagating physical effects (Splashes, Wakes).
/// </summary>
public partial class IWSWaterManager : Node
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Global singleton instance.
    /// </summary>
    public static IWSWaterManager Instance { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// The global elapsed time for water rendering updates.
    /// </summary>
    public double WaterTime { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// The global elapsed time for water physics updates.
    /// </summary>
    public double PhysicsTime { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// The fixed duration of a single physics step. Defaults to 1/60 seconds.
    /// </summary>
    public double PhysicsStepDuration { get; private set; } = 1.0 / 60.0;

    /// <summary>
    /// The current position of the target camera used for rendering logic.
    /// </summary>
    public Vector3 FollowerPosRender { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// The current position of the target camera synchronized for the physics domain.
    /// </summary>
    public Vector3 FollowerPosPhysics { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// The primary camera driving the visual calculations and frustum culling.
    /// </summary>
    public Camera3D MainCamera { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// The most relevant water body based on camera position and priority.
    /// </summary>
    public IWSWaterBody ActiveBody { get; private set; }

    [Signal]
    public delegate void ActiveBodyChangedEventHandler(IWSWaterBody newBody);

    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0.01,0.5")]
    public float DistanceAttenuationFactor = IWSDisturbanceCompiler.DEFAULT_DISTANCE_ATTENUATION;

    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "10,200")]
    public float BodyLodDistance1 = 40f;

    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "20,500")]
    public float BodyLodDistance2 = 120f;

    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "4,30")]
    public int OffScreenSkipFrames = 9;

    /// <summary>
    /// Distance threshold (in meters) for deep hibernation outside the camera frustum.
    /// When a water body is outside the frustum and exceeds this distance, it enters deep hibernation (skip = -1).
    /// Set to 0 to disable hibernation. It is recommended to keep this consistent with BodyLodDistance1.
    /// </summary>
    [Export(PropertyHint.Range, "0,500")]
    public float HibernationDistance = 40f;

    private readonly Dictionary<IWSWaterBody, int> _bodyLodCache = new(8);

    private double _bodyLodTimer = BODY_LOD_INTERVAL;
    private const double BODY_LOD_INTERVAL = 0.5;
    private bool _bodyLodFirstDone = false;

    private readonly List<WaterQuery> _bodies = new(8);
    private readonly List<IWSWaterDisturbanceEmitter> _emitters = new(16);
    private readonly List<IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand> _collectedCommands = new(128);
    private readonly List<WaterImpulse> _tempImpulses = new(INTERACTION_BUDGET);
    private readonly List<IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand> _sortBuffer = new(64);
    private readonly Dictionary<WaterQuery, List<IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand>> _buckets = new(8);
    private readonly Stack<List<IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand>> _bucketPool = new(8);
    private readonly Dictionary<WaterQuery, int> _budgetTable = new(8);
    private readonly List<WaterQuery> _bodyOrder = new(8);

    public const int INTERACTION_BUDGET = 64;
    public const int PER_BODY_MIN_BUDGET = 4;

    private const double ACTIVE_BODY_MIN_HOLD_SEC = 0.3;
    private const double ACTIVE_BODY_INTERVAL = 0.5;
    private const double CLEANUP_INTERVAL = 1.0;

    private double _activeBodyTimer;
    private double _activeBodyHoldTimer;
    private double _cleanupTimer;

    public int LastCollectedCount { get; private set; }
    public int LastValidCommandCount { get; private set; }
    public int LastCompiledCount { get; private set; }
    public int LastDroppedCount { get; private set; }
    public int LastGpuBrushCount { get; private set; }
    public int LastBudgetRemaining { get; private set; }
    public bool WasBudgetSaturated { get; private set; }
    public int TotalSaturationCount { get; private set; }

    public readonly List<(string BodyName, int Compiled, int Budget)> LastPerBodyStats = new(8);

    private WaterQuery _lastHitBody;
    private Camera3D _cachedCamera;
    private bool _cameraDirty = true;

    #region Global Event Bus

    internal readonly ConcurrentQueue<WaterSplashEvent> _splashQueue = new();
    internal readonly ConcurrentQueue<WaterWakeEvent> _wakeQueue = new();
    internal int _totalSplashEnqueued;
    internal int _totalWakeEnqueued;

    private event Action<WaterSplashEvent> _onSplash;
    private event Action<WaterWakeEvent> _onWake;

    internal static void SubscribeOnSplash(Action<WaterSplashEvent> h) { if (Instance != null) Instance._onSplash += h; }
    internal static void UnsubscribeOnSplash(Action<WaterSplashEvent> h) { if (Instance != null) Instance._onSplash -= h; }
    internal static void SubscribeOnWake(Action<WaterWakeEvent> h) { if (Instance != null) Instance._onWake += h; }
    internal static void UnsubscribeOnWake(Action<WaterWakeEvent> h) { if (Instance != null) Instance._onWake -= h; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Queues a splash event safely across thread boundaries.
    /// </summary>
    public void EnqueueSplash(in WaterSplashEvent e)
    {
        _splashQueue.Enqueue(e);
        Interlocked.Increment(ref _totalSplashEnqueued);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Queues a wake event safely across thread boundaries.
    /// </summary>
    public void EnqueueWake(in WaterWakeEvent e)
    {
        _wakeQueue.Enqueue(e);
        Interlocked.Increment(ref _totalWakeEnqueued);
    }

    private void FlushEventBus()
    {
        while (_splashQueue.TryDequeue(out var splash)) _onSplash?.Invoke(splash);
        while (_wakeQueue.TryDequeue(out var wake)) _onWake?.Invoke(wake);
    }

    private void ClearEventBus()
    {
        while (_splashQueue.TryDequeue(out _)) { }
        while (_wakeQueue.TryDequeue(out _)) { }
        _onSplash = null;
        _onWake = null;
    }

    #endregion

    /// <summary>
    /// Calculated render time interpolated within the current physics frame boundary.
    /// </summary>
    public double RenderTime
    {
        get
        {
            double frac = Engine.GetPhysicsInterpolationFraction();
            return PhysicsTime + frac * PhysicsStepDuration;
        }
    }

    #region Lifecycle Methods

    public override void _Ready()
    {
        Instance = this;
        ProcessPhysicsPriority = -2;

        double ticksPerSec = ProjectSettings
            .GetSetting("physics/common/physics_ticks_per_second").AsDouble();
        PhysicsStepDuration = ticksPerSec > 0.0 ? 1.0 / ticksPerSec : 1.0 / 60.0;

        GD.Print($"[IWSWaterManager] Physics step duration = {PhysicsStepDuration:F6}s " +
                 $"(ticks={ticksPerSec:F1}) | PhysicsPriority={ProcessPhysicsPriority}");

        ProcessMode = ProcessModeEnum.Always;

        GetTree().NodeAdded += OnSceneNodeAdded;
        GetTree().NodeRemoved += OnSceneNodeRemoved;

        GetTree().Root.Connect(
            Window.SignalName.SizeChanged,
            Callable.From(() => _cameraDirty = true));

        CallDeferred(MethodName.ScanAndRegisterExistingBodies);

        GD.Print("[IWSWaterManager] Initialization complete.");
    }

    private void OnSceneNodeAdded(Node node)
    {
        if (node is IWSWaterBody wb) Register(wb);
    }

    private void OnSceneNodeRemoved(Node node)
    {
        if (node is IWSWaterBody wb) Unregister(wb);
    }

    private void ScanAndRegisterExistingBodies()
    {
        int found = 0;
        ScanNodeRecursive(GetTree().Root, ref found);
        if (found > 0)
            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterManager] Deferred scan registered {found} existing IWSWaterBody instance(s).");
    }

    private void ScanNodeRecursive(Node node, ref int count)
    {
        if (node is IWSWaterBody wb && !_bodies.Contains(wb))
        {
            Register(wb);
            count++;
        }
        foreach (Node child in node.GetChildren())
            ScanNodeRecursive(child, ref count);
    }

    public override void _ExitTree()
    {
        GetTree().NodeAdded -= OnSceneNodeAdded;
        GetTree().NodeRemoved -= OnSceneNodeRemoved;
        ClearEventBus();
        if (Instance == this) Instance = null;
    }

    public override void _Process(double delta)
    {
        WaterTime += delta;
        RefreshCamera();

        _cleanupTimer += delta;
        if (_cleanupTimer >= CLEANUP_INTERVAL)
        {
            _cleanupTimer = 0.0;
            CleanupInvalidBodies();
        }

        _activeBodyHoldTimer += delta;
        _activeBodyTimer += delta;
        if (_activeBodyTimer >= ACTIVE_BODY_INTERVAL)
        {
            _activeBodyTimer = 0.0;
            UpdateActiveBody();
        }

        _bodyLodTimer += delta;
        if (_bodyLodTimer >= BODY_LOD_INTERVAL)
        {
            _bodyLodTimer = 0.0;
            UpdateBodyLodLevels();
        }

        FlushEventBus();
    }

    public override void _PhysicsProcess(double delta)
    {
        PhysicsTime += delta;

        if (MainCamera != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(MainCamera))
            FollowerPosPhysics = MainCamera.GlobalPosition;
        else
            FollowerPosPhysics = FollowerPosRender;

        RunInteractionPipeline((float)delta);
    }

    private void RefreshCamera()
    {
        var vp = GetViewport();
        var cam = vp?.GetCamera3D();
        if (cam != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(cam))
        {
            MainCamera = cam;
            FollowerPosRender = cam.GlobalPosition;
            _cameraDirty = false;
        }
    }

    #endregion

    #region Registration & Queries

    /// <summary>
    /// Registers a water body interface to the global evaluation context.
    /// </summary>
    public void Register(WaterQuery body)
    {
        if (body == null || _bodies.Contains(body)) return;
        _bodies.Add(body);
        _bodies.Sort((a, b) => b.Priority.CompareTo(a.Priority));
        _lastHitBody = null;
        GD.Print($"[IWSWaterManager] Registered body '{(body as Node)?.Name}' " +
                 $"Priority={body.Priority} Total={_bodies.Count}");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Safely unregisters and removes a water body interface.
    /// </summary>
    public void Unregister(WaterQuery body)
    {
        if (_bodies.Remove(body))
        {
            if (_lastHitBody == body) _lastHitBody = null;
            if (ActiveBody == body as IWSWaterBody)
            {
                ActiveBody = null;
                EmitSignal(SignalName.ActiveBodyChanged, (GodotObject)null);
            }
            GD.Print($"[IWSWaterManager] Unregistered body '{(body as Node)?.Name}' Total={_bodies.Count}");
        }

        if (body is IWSWaterBody wbToRemove)
            _bodyLodCache.Remove(wbToRemove);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Performs an exact boundaries and inclusion test to find the specified water body at the given coordinates.
    /// </summary>
    public WaterQuery FindWaterAt(Vector3 worldPos)
    {
        if (_lastHitBody != null)
        {
            if (_lastHitBody is Node n && !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(n))
                _lastHitBody = null;
            else
            {
                Rect2 b = _lastHitBody.GetBoundsXZ();
                float x = worldPos.X, z = worldPos.Z;
                if (x >= b.Position.X && x <= b.Position.X + b.Size.X &&
                    z >= b.Position.Y && z <= b.Position.Y + b.Size.Y &&
                    _lastHitBody.ContainsWorldPoint(worldPos))
                    return _lastHitBody;
            }
        }

        float px = worldPos.X, pz = worldPos.Z;
        foreach (var body in _bodies)
        {
            if (body == null) continue;
            Rect2 b = body.GetBoundsXZ();
            if (px < b.Position.X || px > b.Position.X + b.Size.X) continue;
            if (pz < b.Position.Y || pz > b.Position.Y + b.Size.Y) continue;
            if (body.ContainsWorldPoint(worldPos))
            {
                _lastHitBody = body;
                return body;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Optimized variant focusing only on bounding box containment across the XZ plane.
    /// </summary>
    public WaterQuery FindWaterAtXZ(Vector3 worldPos)
    {
        float x = worldPos.X, z = worldPos.Z;
        foreach (var body in _bodies)
        {
            if (body == null) continue;
            Rect2 b = body.GetBoundsXZ();
            if (x >= b.Position.X && x <= b.Position.X + b.Size.X &&
                z >= b.Position.Y && z <= b.Position.Y + b.Size.Y)
                return body;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Queries the dynamic height, flow, and displacement context from the relevant water field.
    /// </summary>
    public WaterSample SampleWater(Vector3 worldPos)
    {
        var body = FindWaterAt(worldPos);
        return body != null ? body.SampleWater(worldPos) : WaterSample.Invalid;
    }

    public int BodyCount => _bodies.Count;
    public IReadOnlyList<WaterQuery> Bodies => _bodies;

    public void RegisterEmitter(IWSWaterDisturbanceEmitter e)
    {
        if (e != null && !_emitters.Contains(e)) _emitters.Add(e);
    }

    public void UnregisterEmitter(IWSWaterDisturbanceEmitter e) => _emitters.Remove(e);

    /// <summary>
    /// Injects a targeted physical impulse command into the collection buffer for subsequent GPU compilation.
    /// </summary>
    public void SubmitImpulse(in WaterImpulse impulse)
    {
        _collectedCommands.Add(IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand.MakeImpact(
            impulse.WorldPosition, impulse.WorldRadius, impulse.Strength,
            impulse.SourceId, impulse.InnerRadius, impulse.BrushMode, impulse.FlowVelocityXZ));
    }

    #endregion

    #region Interaction Pipeline & Budgeting

    /// <summary>
    /// Drives the physics accumulation flow, enforces performance budgeting, and limits maximum simultaneous GPU disturbances.
    /// </summary>
    private void RunInteractionPipeline(float delta)
    {
        double physTime = PhysicsTime;

        foreach (var e in _emitters)
        {
            if (e == null || !e.IsActive) continue;
            e.CollectDisturbances(physTime, delta, _collectedCommands);
        }
        LastCollectedCount = _collectedCommands.Count;

        ReturnAllBuckets();
        int validCount = 0;
        foreach (var cmd in _collectedCommands)
        {
            var body = FindWaterAt(cmd.Center);
            if (body == null) continue;
            validCount++;
            if (!_buckets.TryGetValue(body, out var bucket))
            {
                bucket = GetBucketFromPool();
                _buckets[body] = bucket;
            }
            bucket.Add(cmd);
        }
        LastValidCommandCount = validCount;

        int activeBodies = _buckets.Count;
        int remaining = INTERACTION_BUDGET;
        int guarantee = activeBodies > 0
            ? Math.Min(PER_BODY_MIN_BUDGET, INTERACTION_BUDGET / activeBodies)
            : 0;

        _budgetTable.Clear();
        
        // Guarantee base processing budgets across all active entities to prevent total starvation.
        foreach (var kv in _buckets)
        {
            int alloc = Math.Min(guarantee, remaining);
            _budgetTable[kv.Key] = alloc;
            remaining -= alloc;
        }

        // Fill remaining budget allocation ranked by total volume of disturbance submissions.
        if (remaining > 0 && activeBodies > 0)
        {
            _bodyOrder.Clear();
            foreach (var kv in _buckets) _bodyOrder.Add(kv.Key);
            _bodyOrder.Sort((a, b) => _buckets[b].Count.CompareTo(_buckets[a].Count));
            int idx = 0;
            while (remaining > 0)
            {
                var body = _bodyOrder[idx % _bodyOrder.Count];
                _budgetTable[body]++;
                remaining--;
                idx++;
            }
        }

        LastPerBodyStats.Clear();
        int totalCompiled = 0;
        Vector3 camPos = FollowerPosPhysics;

        foreach (var kv in _buckets)
        {
            int budget = _budgetTable.TryGetValue(kv.Key, out int b) ? b : 0;
            string bodyName = (kv.Key as Node)?.Name ?? "?";
            if (budget <= 0) { LastPerBodyStats.Add((bodyName, 0, 0)); continue; }

            _tempImpulses.Clear();

            IWSDisturbanceCompiler.Compile(
                kv.Value, budget, _tempImpulses, _sortBuffer,
                camPos, DistanceAttenuationFactor,
                physicsTime: physTime,
                drawDebug: WaterDebugHub.Instance?.Flags.Disturbances ?? false);

            int compiled = _tempImpulses.Count;
            totalCompiled += compiled;

            foreach (var impulse in _tempImpulses)
                kv.Key.AddImpulse(impulse);

            LastPerBodyStats.Add((bodyName, compiled, budget));
        }

        LastCompiledCount = totalCompiled;
        LastGpuBrushCount = totalCompiled;
        LastBudgetRemaining = INTERACTION_BUDGET - totalCompiled;
        LastDroppedCount = Math.Max(0, LastValidCommandCount - totalCompiled);
        WasBudgetSaturated = totalCompiled >= INTERACTION_BUDGET
                              && LastValidCommandCount > totalCompiled;
        if (WasBudgetSaturated) TotalSaturationCount++;

        _collectedCommands.Clear();
        _tempImpulses.Clear();
        ReturnAllBuckets();
        _budgetTable.Clear();
    }

    private void UpdateActiveBody()
    {
        Vector3 pos = FollowerPosRender;

        IWSWaterBody best = null;
        float bestScore = float.MinValue;

        foreach (var q in _bodies)
        {
            if (q is not IWSWaterBody wb || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(wb)) continue;
            Rect2 b = wb.GetBoundsXZ();
            if (pos.X < b.Position.X || pos.X > b.Position.X + b.Size.X) continue;
            if (pos.Z < b.Position.Y || pos.Z > b.Position.Y + b.Size.Y) continue;

            float waterY = wb.GlobalPosition.Y + wb.BaseWaterLevel;
            float yOffset = Mathf.Abs(pos.Y - waterY);
            float yPenalty = Mathf.Clamp(1.0f - (yOffset - 50f) / 100f, 0.1f, 1.0f);
            float score = wb.Priority + yPenalty * 0.01f;
            if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = wb; }
        }

        if (best == null)
            best = FindWaterAtXZ(pos) as IWSWaterBody;

        if (best == null)
        {
            if (ActiveBody != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(ActiveBody)) return;
            return;
        }

        if (best == ActiveBody) return;

        if (ActiveBody != null &&
            GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(ActiveBody) &&
            _activeBodyHoldTimer < ACTIVE_BODY_MIN_HOLD_SEC)
            return;

        GD.Print($"[IWSWaterManager] ActiveBody: '{ActiveBody?.Name ?? "null"}' -> '{best?.Name ?? "null"}'");
        ActiveBody = best;
        _activeBodyHoldTimer = 0.0;
        EmitSignal(SignalName.ActiveBodyChanged, (GodotObject)best);
    }

    #endregion

    #region LOD & Visibility Scheduling

    /// <summary>
    /// Dynamic Level of Detail (LOD) scheduling policy (Executed every 0.5s):
    ///   - ActiveBody                    -> skip = 0 (Full frequency)
    ///   - Inside Frustum + Near         -> skip = 0
    ///   - Inside Frustum + Medium       -> skip = 1 (~30Hz)
    ///   - Inside Frustum + Far          -> skip = 3 (~15Hz)
    ///   - Outside Frustum + Distance <= HibernationDistance -> skip = OffScreenSkipFrames (Preserves physical validity)
    ///   - Outside Frustum + Distance >  HibernationDistance -> skip = -1 (Deep hibernation, Zero GPU cost)
    ///
    /// Utilizes camera frustum AABB intersection testing to evaluate visibility securely.
    /// </summary>
    private void UpdateBodyLodLevels()
    {
        if (MainCamera == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(MainCamera)) return;

        Vector3 camPos = FollowerPosRender;
        Godot.Collections.Array<Plane> frustum = MainCamera.GetFrustum();

        int changed = 0;

        foreach (var q in _bodies)
        {
            if (q is not IWSWaterBody wb || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(wb)) continue;
            if (wb.RippleManager == null) continue;
