            int targetSkip;

            if (wb == ActiveBody)
            {
                targetSkip = 0;
            }
            else
            {
                Rect2 bounds = wb.GetBoundsXZ();
                float centerX = bounds.Position.X + bounds.Size.X * 0.5f;
                float centerZ = bounds.Position.Y + bounds.Size.Y * 0.5f;
                float distXZ = new Vector2(camPos.X - centerX, camPos.Z - centerZ).Length();

                bool inFrustum = IsBodyVisibleInFrustum(wb, bounds, frustum);

                if (!inFrustum && HibernationDistance > 0f && distXZ > HibernationDistance)
                {
                    targetSkip = -1;
                }
                else if (!inFrustum)
                {
                    targetSkip = OffScreenSkipFrames;
                }
                else if (distXZ > BodyLodDistance2)
                {
                    targetSkip = 3;
                }
                else if (distXZ > BodyLodDistance1)
                {
                    targetSkip = 1;
                }
                else
                {
                    targetSkip = 0;
                }
            }

            if (!_bodyLodCache.TryGetValue(wb, out int lastSkip) || lastSkip != targetSkip)
            {
                wb.SetDynamicSimSkipFrames(targetSkip);
                _bodyLodCache[wb] = targetSkip;
                changed++;
            }
        }

        if (!_bodyLodFirstDone && changed > 0)
        {
            _bodyLodFirstDone = true;
            var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
            sb.Append($"[IWSWaterManager] Body LOD first pass | active='{ActiveBody?.Name ?? "null"}' | ");
            foreach (var kv in _bodyLodCache)
            {
                string label = kv.Value < 0 ? "hibernate" : $"skip{kv.Value}";
                sb.Append($"'{kv.Key.Name}'->{label} ");
            }
            GD.Print(sb.ToString());
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Performs a visibility test to determine if the water body's AABB intersects with the camera frustum.
    /// Algorithm: Evaluates the most positive vertex of the AABB against each of the 6 frustum planes.
    /// If the most positive vertex lies behind a plane, the entire AABB is outside the frustum.
    /// </summary>
    private static bool IsBodyVisibleInFrustum(
        IWSWaterBody wb,
        Rect2 boundsXZ,
        Godot.Collections.Array<Plane> frustum)
    {
        float waterY = wb.GlobalPosition.Y + wb.BaseWaterLevel;
        const float MARGIN = 5f;

        Vector3 min = new Vector3(
            boundsXZ.Position.X - MARGIN,
            waterY - 8f,
            boundsXZ.Position.Y - MARGIN);
        
        Vector3 max = new Vector3(
            boundsXZ.Position.X + boundsXZ.Size.X + MARGIN,
            waterY + 3f,
            boundsXZ.Position.Y + boundsXZ.Size.Y + MARGIN);

        foreach (Plane plane in frustum)
        {
            Vector3 positive = new Vector3(
                plane.Normal.X >= 0f ? max.X : min.X,
                plane.Normal.Y >= 0f ? max.Y : min.Y,
                plane.Normal.Z >= 0f ? max.Z : min.Z);

            if (!plane.IsPointOver(positive))
                return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private void CleanupInvalidBodies()
    {
        bool removed = false;
        for (int i = _bodies.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            var b = _bodies[i];
            if (b == null || (b is Node n && !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(n)))
            {
                _bodies.RemoveAt(i);
                removed = true;
            }
        }
        if (removed) _lastHitBody = null;
    }

    #endregion

    #region Object Pooling Helpers

    private List<IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand> GetBucketFromPool()
    {
        if (_bucketPool.Count > 0) { var b = _bucketPool.Pop(); b.Clear(); return b; }
        return new List<IWSWaterDisturbanceCommand>(16);
    }

    private void ReturnAllBuckets()
    {
        foreach (var kv in _buckets) _bucketPool.Push(kv.Value);
        _buckets.Clear();
    }

    #endregion
}

/// <summary>
/// GPU Compute Shader pipeline controller for physical fluid simulation.
/// Manages the Ping-Pong texture rotation (R16F/RGBA16F) for the wave equation solver,
/// micro-normal evaluation, and foam advection.
/// Handles asynchronous readback via SSBO ring buffers to prevent CPU-GPU pipeline stalls,
/// and implements dynamic LOD hibernation to reduce GPU compute load.
///
/// Zero-GC Dispatch Architecture:
/// Pre-allocates Godot.Collections.Array<RDUniform> and RDUniform objects upon GPU initialization.
/// Per-frame dispatch operations only execute ClearIds() and AddId() on the minimal subset
/// of dynamic uniforms (Ping-Pong / Ring-Slot bindings), completely eliminating managed allocations.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]

    public override void _Ready()
    {
        ProcessPhysicsPriority = -1;

        _rd = RenderingServer.GetRenderingDevice();
        if (_rd == null)
        {
            GD.PushWarning("[IWSRippleSimMgr] RenderingDevice unavailable. Compute disabled.");
            SetPhysicsProcess(false);
            return;
        }

        _simRenderCallable  = new Callable(this, MethodName.ExecuteSimulationOnRenderThread);
        _initGpuCallable    = new Callable(this, MethodName.InitGpuResourcesOnRenderThread);
        _releaseGpuCallable = new Callable(this, MethodName.ReleaseGpuResourcesOnRenderThread);

        int cacheSize    = TextureSize * TextureSize;
        _stagingByteSize = cacheSize * 4;

        _ssboBytes    = new byte[SSBO_TOTAL_BYTES];
        _ssboSnapshot = new byte[SSBO_TOTAL_BYTES];

        _cpuCacheFront_Height = new float[cacheSize];
        _cpuCacheFront_Foam   = new float[cacheSize];
        _cpuCacheBack_Height  = new float[cacheSize];
        _cpuCacheBack_Foam    = new float[cacheSize];

        RenderingServer.CallOnRenderThread(_initGpuCallable);
    }

    public override void _ExitTree()
        => RenderingServer.CallOnRenderThread(_releaseGpuCallable);

    /// <summary>
    /// Injects physical disturbances into the simulation field.
    /// Incorporates a budget saturation mechanism to prevent GPU stall under excessive collision scenarios.
    /// </summary>
    public void AddRippleAtUV(Vector2 uv, float uvRadius, float strength,
                               float innerUvRadius = 0f,
                               BrushMode brushMode = BrushMode.Velocity,
                               Vector2 flowUV = default)
    {
        if (_brushes.Count / 2 >= MAX_BRUSHES) return;

        float effectiveStrength = brushMode == BrushMode.Velocity
            ? strength * RippleStrengthMultiplier
            : strength;

        _brushes.Add(new Vector4(uv.X, uv.Y, uvRadius, innerUvRadius));
        _brushes.Add(new Vector4(effectiveStrength, (float)(int)brushMode, flowUV.X, flowUV.Y));

        if (!_debugFirstBrushInjected)
        {
            _debugFirstBrushInjected = true;
            string typeStr = brushMode == BrushMode.Displacement ? "displacement"
                        : brushMode == BrushMode.SurfaceFlow  ? "surfaceFlow"
                        : innerUvRadius > 0.001f              ? "annular"
                                                                : "point";
            GD.Print($"[IWSRippleSimMgr] ★ First brush | type={typeStr} mode={brushMode} " +
                    $"uv=({uv.X:F3},{uv.Y:F3}) outerR={uvRadius:F3} innerR={innerUvRadius:F3} " +
                    $"strength={effectiveStrength:F4} flow=({flowUV.X:F3},{flowUV.Y:F3})");
        }

        if (brushMode == BrushMode.SurfaceFlow && !_debugFirstFlowInjected)
        {
            _debugFirstFlowInjected = true;
            GD.Print($"[IWSRippleSimMgr] ★ First SurfaceFlow brush | " +
                    $"uv=({uv.X:F3},{uv.Y:F3}) outerR={uvRadius:F3} strength={effectiveStrength:F4} " +
                    $"flow=({flowUV.X:F3},{flowUV.Y:F3}) [zero=radial-auto]");
        }

        _debugTotalBrushesInjected++;
    }

    public void SetCaptureTexture(Rid rsRid, float strength)
    {
        _captureRsRid    = rsRid;
        _captureStrength = strength;
    }

    public float SampleHeightAtUV(Vector2 uv) => SampleBilinear(_cpuCacheFront_Height, uv);
    public float SampleEnergyAtUV(Vector2 uv) => Mathf.Abs(SampleBilinear(_cpuCacheFront_Height, uv));
    public float SampleFoamAtUV  (Vector2 uv) => SampleBilinear(_cpuCacheFront_Foam, uv);

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the fixed-step physics logic, handling LOD hibernation and
    /// initiating the rendering thread dispatch payload.
    /// </summary>
    public override void _PhysicsProcess(double delta)
    {
        if (_rd == null) return;

        if (SimSkipFrames < 0)
        {
            SimulatedThisFrame = false;
            if (!_wasHibernating)
            {
                _wasHibernating = true;
                GD.Print($"[IWSRippleSimMgr] '{Name}' entering deep hibernation");
            }
            return;
        }

        if (_wasHibernating)
        {
            _wasHibernating = false;
            _skipCounter    = 0;
            GD.Print($"[IWSRippleSimMgr] '{Name}' waking up from hibernation, executing simulation immediately");
        }

        _skipCounter = (_skipCounter + 1) % (SimSkipFrames + 1);
        if (_skipCounter != 0)
        {
            SimulatedThisFrame = false;
            return;
        }

        SimulatedThisFrame = true;
        TrySwapCaches();
        PrepareRenderThreadSnapshot();
        RenderingServer.CallOnRenderThread(_simRenderCallable);
    }

    private void TrySwapCaches()
    {
        if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _backCacheReady, 0, 1) == 1)
        {
            (_cpuCacheFront_Height, _cpuCacheBack_Height) =
                (_cpuCacheBack_Height, _cpuCacheFront_Height);
            (_cpuCacheFront_Foam, _cpuCacheBack_Foam) =
                (_cpuCacheBack_Foam, _cpuCacheFront_Foam);
            CachePhysicsFrame = _snapPhysicsFrame;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Captures the current physics state into a snapshot (Memento Pattern)
    /// to safely marshal parameters to the render thread without risking data race conditions.
    /// </summary>
    private void PrepareRenderThreadSnapshot()
    {
        _snapDampingLow           = DampingLow;
        _snapDampingHigh          = DampingHigh;
        _snapWaveSpeedLow         = WaveSpeedLow  * WaveSpeedCoeff;
        _snapWaveSpeedHigh        = WaveSpeedHigh * WaveSpeedCoeff;
        _snapBorderWidth          = BorderWidth;
        _snapNormalStrength       = NormalStrength;
        _snapNormalTexelStep      = NormalTexelStep;
        _snapFoamEnergyScale      = FoamEnergyScale;
        _snapFoamDecayRate        = FoamDecayRate;
        _snapFoamThreshold        = FoamThreshold;
        _snapFoamMultiplier       = FoamMultiplier;
        _snapFoamMax              = FoamMax;
        _snapSmoothSigmaScale     = SmoothSigmaScale;
        _snapTextureSize          = TextureSize;
        _snapPhysicsFrame         = Engine.GetPhysicsFrames();
        _snapHeightClamp          = HeightClamp;
        _snapCaptureRsRid         = _captureRsRid;
        _snapCaptureStrength      = _captureStrength;
        _snapFoamDiffusionStrength= FoamDiffusionStrength;
        _snapFoamAdvectScale      = FoamAdvectScale;
        _snapInjectionWeightLow   = InjectionWeightLow;
        _snapInjectionWeightHigh  = InjectionWeightHigh;
        _snapBoundaryMode         = BoundaryMode;
        _snapPhysicsStepDuration  = (float)(IWSWaterManager.Instance?.PhysicsStepDuration ?? (1.0 / 60.0));
        _snapDisplacementStiffness= DisplacementStiffness;
        _snapWaveSpeedNorm        = Mathf.Max(_snapWaveSpeedLow + _snapWaveSpeedHigh, 0.05f);

        if (!_debugSimParamsLogged)
        {
            _debugSimParamsLogged = true;
            GD.Print($"[IWSRippleSimMgr] Sim params | " +
                     $"speedLow={_snapWaveSpeedLow:F3} speedHigh={_snapWaveSpeedHigh:F3} | " +
                     $"waveSpeedNorm={_snapWaveSpeedNorm:F3} | " +
                     $"dispStiffness={_snapDisplacementStiffness:F4} | " +
                     $"dampLow={_snapDampingLow:F4} dampHigh={_snapDampingHigh:F4} | " +
                     $"maxBrushes={MAX_BRUSHES}");
        }

        int logicalCount = _brushes.Count / 2;
        int count = System.Math.Min(logicalCount, MAX_BRUSHES);

        Array.Clear(_ssboBytes, 0, _ssboBytes.Length);
        WriteInt(_ssboBytes, 0, count);

        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            int o       = SSBO_HEADER_BYTES + i * BRUSH_STRIDE;
            var posRad  = _brushes[i * 2];
            var strMode = _brushes[i * 2 + 1];

            WriteFloat(_ssboBytes, o + 0,  posRad.X);
            WriteFloat(_ssboBytes, o + 4,  posRad.Y);
            WriteFloat(_ssboBytes, o + 8,  posRad.Z);
            WriteFloat(_ssboBytes, o + 12, posRad.W);
            WriteFloat(_ssboBytes, o + 16, strMode.X);
            WriteFloat(_ssboBytes, o + 20, strMode.Y);
            WriteFloat(_ssboBytes, o + 24, strMode.Z);
            WriteFloat(_ssboBytes, o + 28, strMode.W);
        }

        Buffer.BlockCopy(_ssboBytes, 0, _ssboSnapshot, 0, SSBO_TOTAL_BYTES);
        _brushes.Clear();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the Compute Shader pipeline.
    /// Manages Ping-Pong target synchronization and orchestrates the SSBO write operations.
    /// </summary>
    private void ExecuteSimulationOnRenderThread()
    {
        if (!_pipelineRipple.IsValid || !_pipelineSmooth.IsValid || !_pipelineNormal.IsValid)
            return;

        if (!_uniformCacheBuilt)
        {
            GD.PushWarning("[IWSRippleSimMgr] ExecuteSimulation called before uniform cache was built. Skipping frame.");
            return;
        }

        if (!_debugPipelineLogged)
        {
            _debugPipelineLogged = true;
            GD.Print($"[IWSRippleSimMgr] Pipeline active | ripple={_pipelineRipple.IsValid} " +
                     $"normal={_pipelineNormal.IsValid} foam={_pipelineFoam.IsValid} " +
                     $"gather={_pipelineGather.IsValid} visualCopy={_pipelineVisualCopy.IsValid} " +
                     $"[Zero-GC dispatch: uniformCacheBuilt=true]");
        }

        bool needFullReadback = ForceFullReadback || !_pipelineGather.IsValid;
        bool canWriteStaging  = true;

        if (needFullReadback)
        {
            if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _stagingReady[_writeSlot], 0, 0) == 1)
                canWriteStaging = false;
            TryReadbackFromMatureSlot();
        }

        uint groups = (uint)((_snapTextureSize + 7) / 8);

        _rd.BufferUpdate(_brushSsbo, 0, (uint)SSBO_TOTAL_BYTES, _ssboSnapshot);

        // UBO Updates utilizing pre-allocated byte arrays to maintain Zero-GC compliance.
        WriteFloat(_uboRippleBytes, 0,  _snapDampingLow);
        WriteFloat(_uboRippleBytes, 4,  _snapDampingHigh);
        WriteFloat(_uboRippleBytes, 8,  _snapBorderWidth);
        WriteFloat(_uboRippleBytes, 12, _snapCaptureStrength);
        WriteFloat(_uboRippleBytes, 16, _snapWaveSpeedLow);
        WriteFloat(_uboRippleBytes, 20, _snapWaveSpeedHigh);
        WriteFloat(_uboRippleBytes, 24, _snapHeightClamp);
        WriteFloat(_uboRippleBytes, 28, (float)_snapBoundaryMode);
        WriteFloat(_uboRippleBytes, 32, _snapInjectionWeightLow);
        WriteFloat(_uboRippleBytes, 36, _snapInjectionWeightHigh);
        WriteFloat(_uboRippleBytes, 40, _snapDisplacementStiffness);
        WriteFloat(_uboRippleBytes, 44, 0f);
        _rd.BufferUpdate(_uboRipple, 0, UBO_RIPPLE_BYTES, _uboRippleBytes);

        WriteFloat(_uboSmoothHBytes, 0, 0f);
        WriteFloat(_uboSmoothHBytes, 4, _snapSmoothSigmaScale);
        WriteFloat(_uboSmoothHBytes, 8, 0f);
        WriteFloat(_uboSmoothHBytes, 12, 0f);
        _rd.BufferUpdate(_uboSmoothH, 0, 16, _uboSmoothHBytes);

        WriteFloat(_uboSmoothVBytes, 0, 1f);
        WriteFloat(_uboSmoothVBytes, 4, _snapSmoothSigmaScale);
        WriteFloat(_uboSmoothVBytes, 8, 0f);
        WriteFloat(_uboSmoothVBytes, 12, 0f);
        _rd.BufferUpdate(_uboSmoothV, 0, 16, _uboSmoothVBytes);

        WriteFloat(_uboNormalBytes, 0, _snapNormalStrength);
        WriteFloat(_uboNormalBytes, 4, _snapNormalTexelStep);
        WriteFloat(_uboNormalBytes, 8, _snapFoamEnergyScale);
        WriteFloat(_uboNormalBytes, 12, _snapWaveSpeedNorm);
        _rd.BufferUpdate(_uboNormal, 0, 16, _uboNormalBytes);

        WriteFloat(_uboFoamBytes, 0,  _snapFoamDecayRate);
        WriteFloat(_uboFoamBytes, 4,  _snapFoamThreshold);
        WriteFloat(_uboFoamBytes, 8,  _snapFoamMultiplier);
        WriteFloat(_uboFoamBytes, 12, _snapFoamDiffusionStrength);
        WriteFloat(_uboFoamBytes, 16, _snapFoamAdvectScale);
        WriteFloat(_uboFoamBytes, 20, 0f);
        WriteFloat(_uboFoamBytes, 24, _snapFoamMax);
        WriteFloat(_uboFoamBytes, 28, _snapPhysicsStepDuration);
        _rd.BufferUpdate(_uboFoam, 0, 32, _uboFoamBytes);

        long cl = _rd.ComputeListBegin();

        DispatchRipple(cl, groups);
        _rd.ComputeListAddBarrier(cl);

        if (_pipelineCaptureCopy.IsValid)
        {
            DispatchCaptureCopy(cl, groups);
            _rd.ComputeListAddBarrier(cl);
        }

        if (needFullReadback && canWriteStaging)
        {
            DispatchStagingCopy(cl, groups);
            _rd.ComputeListAddBarrier(cl);
        }

        if (_pipelineVisualCopy.IsValid)
        {
            DispatchVisualCopy(cl, groups);
            _rd.ComputeListAddBarrier(cl);
        }

        DispatchSmoothH(cl, groups);
        _rd.ComputeListAddBarrier(cl);

        DispatchSmoothV(cl, groups);
        _rd.ComputeListAddBarrier(cl);

        DispatchNormal(cl, groups);
        _rd.ComputeListAddBarrier(cl);

        if (FoamEnabled && _pipelineFoam.IsValid)
        {
            DispatchFoam(cl, groups);
            _rd.ComputeListAddBarrier(cl);
        }

        _rd.ComputeListEnd();

        _heightPingIsInput = !_heightPingIsInput;
        (_texFoamRead, _texFoamWrite) = (_texFoamWrite, _texFoamRead);
        if (RenderData?.TemporalFoamTexture != null)
            RenderData.TemporalFoamTexture.TextureRdRid = _texFoamRead;

        if (needFullReadback && canWriteStaging)
        {
            Interlocked.Exchange(ref _stagingReady[_writeSlot], 1);
            _writeSlot = (_writeSlot + 1) % READBACK_RING_DEPTH;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Processes delayed SSBO readbacks via ring buffer indices.
    /// This implementation intrinsically resolves GPU-CPU pipeline stalling.
    /// </summary>
    private void TryReadbackFromMatureSlot()
    {
        int slot = _readSlot;
        if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _stagingReady[slot], 0, 1) != 1) return;

        int    cacheSize = _snapTextureSize * _snapTextureSize;
        byte[] hBytes    = _rd.BufferGetData(_stagingHeight[slot]);
        byte[] fBytes    = _rd.BufferGetData(_stagingFoam[slot]);

        if (hBytes != null && hBytes.Length >= cacheSize * 4)
        {
            Buffer.BlockCopy(hBytes, 0, _cpuCacheBack_Height, 0, cacheSize * 4);

            if (!_debugFirstReadbackDone)
            {
                _debugFirstReadbackDone = true;
                float hMax = 0f, hMin = 0f;
                for (int i = 0; i < cacheSize; i++)
                {
                    float v = _cpuCacheBack_Height[i];
                    if (v > hMax) hMax = v;
                    if (v < hMin) hMin = v;
                }
                GD.Print($"[IWSRippleSimMgr] First CPU readback | slot={slot} hMax={hMax:F5} hMin={hMin:F5}");
            }

            if (_debugTotalBrushesInjected > 0 && !_shaderVersionVerified)
            {
                float hMaxCheck = 0f, hMinCheck = 0f;
                for (int i = 0; i < cacheSize; i++)
                {
                    float v = _cpuCacheBack_Height[i];
                    if (v > hMaxCheck) hMaxCheck = v;
                    if (v < hMinCheck) hMinCheck = v;
                }
                if (hMinCheck < -0.001f)
                {
                    _shaderVersionVerified = true;
                    GD.Print($"[IWSRippleSimMgr] ✓ Shader oscillation verified | hMax={hMaxCheck:F4} hMin={hMinCheck:F4}");
                }
                else if (_debugTotalBrushesInjected > 10)
                {
                    _shaderVersionVerified = true;
                    GD.PushWarning($"[IWSRippleSimMgr] ✗ Shader oscillation not detected | " +
                                   "Please right-click the .glsl file in the editor and Reimport.");
                }
            }
        }

        if (fBytes != null && fBytes.Length >= cacheSize * 4)
            Buffer.BlockCopy(fBytes, 0, _cpuCacheBack_Foam, 0, cacheSize * 4);

        Interlocked.Exchange(ref _backCacheReady, 1);
        _readSlot = (slot + 1) % READBACK_RING_DEPTH;
    }

    private void InitGpuResourcesOnRenderThread()
    {
        _samplerCaptureLinear = _rd.SamplerCreate(new RDSamplerState
        {
            MinFilter = RenderingDevice.SamplerFilter.Linear,
            MagFilter = RenderingDevice.SamplerFilter.Linear,
            RepeatU   = RenderingDevice.SamplerRepeatMode.ClampToEdge,
            RepeatV   = RenderingDevice.SamplerRepeatMode.ClampToEdge,
        });

        var fmt1x1 = new RDTextureFormat
        {
            Width = 1, Height = 1,
            Format = RenderingDevice.DataFormat.R8G8B8A8Unorm,
            UsageBits = RenderingDevice.TextureUsageBits.SamplingBit | RenderingDevice.TextureUsageBits.CanUpdateBit,
        };
        _texCaptureBlack = _rd.TextureCreate(fmt1x1, new RDTextureView(),
            new Godot.Collections.Array<byte[]> { new byte[] { 0, 0, 0, 255 } });

        var fmtR16 = new RDTextureFormat
        {
            Width = (uint)TextureSize, Height = (uint)TextureSize,
            Format = RenderingDevice.DataFormat.R16Sfloat,
            UsageBits = RenderingDevice.TextureUsageBits.StorageBit
                      | RenderingDevice.TextureUsageBits.SamplingBit
                      | RenderingDevice.TextureUsageBits.CanCopyFromBit
                      | RenderingDevice.TextureUsageBits.CanUpdateBit,
        };

        var fmtRGBA16 = new RDTextureFormat
        {
            Width = (uint)TextureSize, Height = (uint)TextureSize,
            Format = RenderingDevice.DataFormat.R16G16B16A16Sfloat,
            UsageBits = RenderingDevice.TextureUsageBits.StorageBit
                      | RenderingDevice.TextureUsageBits.SamplingBit
                      | RenderingDevice.TextureUsageBits.CanUpdateBit,
        };

        _texHeightA        = CreateTex(fmtR16);
        _texHeightB        = CreateTex(fmtR16);
        _texVelocity       = CreateTex(fmtRGBA16);
        _texVisualIn       = CreateTex(fmtR16);
        _texSmoothTemp     = CreateTex(fmtR16);
        _texVisual         = CreateTex(fmtR16);
        _texNormal         = CreateTex(fmtRGBA16);
        _texFoamRead       = CreateTex(fmtR16);
        _texFoamWrite      = CreateTex(fmtR16);
        _texCaptureHistory = CreateTex(fmtR16);

        ClearTextureR16(_texHeightA);
        ClearTextureR16(_texHeightB);
        ClearTextureRGBA16(_texVelocity);
        ClearTextureR16(_texVisualIn);
        ClearTextureR16(_texSmoothTemp);
        ClearTextureR16(_texVisual);
        ClearTextureR16(_texFoamRead);
        ClearTextureR16(_texFoamWrite);
        ClearTextureR16(_texCaptureHistory);
        ClearTextureBytes(_texNormal, TextureSize * TextureSize * 8);

        var emptyStaging = new byte[_stagingByteSize];
        for (int i = 0; i < READBACK_RING_DEPTH; i++)
        {
            _stagingHeight[i] = _rd.StorageBufferCreate((uint)_stagingByteSize, emptyStaging);
            _stagingFoam[i]   = _rd.StorageBufferCreate((uint)_stagingByteSize, emptyStaging);
        }
        _brushSsbo = _rd.StorageBufferCreate((uint)SSBO_TOTAL_BYTES, _ssboBytes);

        var empty16 = new byte[16];
        var empty32 = new byte[32];
        var empty48 = new byte[UBO_RIPPLE_BYTES];

        _uboRipple  = _rd.UniformBufferCreate(UBO_RIPPLE_BYTES, empty48);
        _uboSmoothH = _rd.UniformBufferCreate(16, empty16);
        _uboSmoothV = _rd.UniformBufferCreate(16, empty16);
        _uboNormal  = _rd.UniformBufferCreate(16, empty16);
        _uboFoam    = _rd.UniformBufferCreate(32, empty32);

        _shaderRipple  = CreateShader(RippleComputeShader,  "RippleCompute");
        _shaderSmooth  = CreateShader(SmoothComputeShader,  "SmoothCompute");
        _shaderNormal  = CreateShader(NormalComputeShader,  "NormalCompute");
        _shaderFoam    = CreateShader(FoamComputeShader,    "FoamCompute");

        _pipelineRipple = CreatePipeline(_shaderRipple, "RippleCompute");
        _pipelineSmooth = CreatePipeline(_shaderSmooth, "SmoothCompute");
        _pipelineNormal = CreatePipeline(_shaderNormal, "NormalCompute");
        _pipelineFoam   = CreatePipeline(_shaderFoam,   "FoamCompute");

        if (StagingCopyComputeShader != null)
        {
            _shaderStagingCopy   = CreateShader(StagingCopyComputeShader, "StagingCopy");
            _pipelineStagingCopy = CreatePipeline(_shaderStagingCopy,     "StagingCopy");
        }
        if (GatherComputeShader != null)
        {
            _shaderGather   = CreateShader(GatherComputeShader, "Gather");
            _pipelineGather = CreatePipeline(_shaderGather,     "Gather");
        }
        if (CaptureCopyComputeShader != null)
        {
            _shaderCaptureCopy   = CreateShader(CaptureCopyComputeShader, "CaptureCopy");
            _pipelineCaptureCopy = CreatePipeline(_shaderCaptureCopy,     "CaptureCopy");
        }
        if (VisualCopyComputeShader != null)
        {
            _shaderVisualCopy   = CreateShader(VisualCopyComputeShader, "VisualCopy");
            _pipelineVisualCopy = CreatePipeline(_shaderVisualCopy,     "VisualCopy");
        }

        BuildCachedUniformArrays();

        GD.Print($"[IWSRippleSimMgr] GPU resources initialized | Format R16Sfloat | " +
                 $"Height/Foam VRAM ≈ {TextureSize * TextureSize * 2 * 9 / 1024}KB per body | " +
                 $"Zero-GC dispatch: uniform arrays pre-allocated");

        CallDeferred(MethodName.BuildRenderDataDeferred);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Constructs the pre-allocated Godot.Collections.Array instances required for compute dispatching.
    /// Static RIDs are injected permanently. Dynamic RIDs are updated independently during the dispatch sequence.
    /// Must be invoked strictly on the rendering thread.
    /// </summary>
    private void BuildCachedUniformArrays()
    {
        static void Set(RDUniform u, Rid id) { u.ClearIds(); u.AddId(id); }

        // Ripple pass construction
        Set(_urVelocity, _texVelocity);
        Set(_urBrush,    _brushSsbo);
        Set(_urCapHist,  _texCaptureHistory);
        Set(_urUbo,      _uboRipple);
        _uaRipple.Clear();
        _uaRipple.Add(_urHeightIn); _uaRipple.Add(_urHeightOut); _uaRipple.Add(_urVelocity);
        _uaRipple.Add(_urBrush);    _uaRipple.Add(_urCapture);   _uaRipple.Add(_urCapHist);
        _uaRipple.Add(_urUbo);

        // VisualCopy pass construction
        Set(_uvcVisualIn, _texVisualIn);
        _uaVisualCopy.Clear();
        _uaVisualCopy.Add(_uvcHeightOut); _uaVisualCopy.Add(_uvcVisualIn);

        // CaptureCopy pass construction
        Set(_uccHistory, _texCaptureHistory);
        _uaCaptureCopy.Clear();
        _uaCaptureCopy.Add(_uccHistory); _uaCaptureCopy.Add(_uccCapture);

        // Smooth Horizontal pass construction
        Set(_ushH_Input,  _texVisualIn);
        Set(_ushH_Output, _texSmoothTemp);
        Set(_ushH_Ubo,    _uboSmoothH);
        _uaSmoothH.Clear();
        _uaSmoothH.Add(_ushH_Input); _uaSmoothH.Add(_ushH_Output); _uaSmoothH.Add(_ushH_Ubo);

        // Smooth Vertical pass construction
        Set(_ushV_Input,  _texSmoothTemp);
        Set(_ushV_Output, _texVisual);
        Set(_ushV_Ubo,    _uboSmoothV);
        _uaSmoothV.Clear();
        _uaSmoothV.Add(_ushV_Input); _uaSmoothV.Add(_ushV_Output); _uaSmoothV.Add(_ushV_Ubo);

        // Normal pass construction
        Set(_unVisual,   _texVisual);
        Set(_unNormal,   _texNormal);
        Set(_unVelocity, _texVelocity);
        Set(_unUbo,      _uboNormal);
        _uaNormal.Clear();
        _uaNormal.Add(_unVisual); _uaNormal.Add(_unNormal);
        _uaNormal.Add(_unVelocity); _uaNormal.Add(_unUbo);

        // Foam pass construction
        Set(_ufNormal,   _texNormal);
        Set(_ufUbo,      _uboFoam);
        Set(_ufVelocity, _texVelocity);
        _uaFoam.Clear();
        _uaFoam.Add(_ufFoamRead); _uaFoam.Add(_ufNormal);    _uaFoam.Add(_ufFoamWrite);
        _uaFoam.Add(_ufUbo);      _uaFoam.Add(_ufVelocity);  _uaFoam.Add(_ufHeightOut);

        // StagingCopy pass construction
        _uaStaging.Clear();
        _uaStaging.Add(_usHeightOut); _uaStaging.Add(_usFoamRead);
        _uaStaging.Add(_usHeightBuf); _uaStaging.Add(_usFoamBuf);

        _uniformCacheBuilt = true;
        GD.Print("[IWSRippleSimMgr] Zero-GC uniform cache built — per-frame dispatch allocates 0 objects");
    }

    private void BuildRenderDataDeferred()
    {
        RenderData = new IWSWaterRenderData
        {
            VisualTexture       = new Texture2Drd { TextureRdRid = _texVisual   },
            NormalTexture       = new Texture2Drd { TextureRdRid = _texNormal   },
            TemporalFoamTexture = new Texture2Drd { TextureRdRid = _texFoamRead },
            VelocityTexture     = new Texture2Drd { TextureRdRid = _texVelocity },
        };
    }

    private void ReleaseGpuResourcesOnRenderThread()
    {
        if (_rd == null) return;
        void F(Rid r) { if (r.IsValid) _rd.FreeRid(r); }

        F(_texHeightA); F(_texHeightB);
        F(_texVelocity);
        F(_texVisualIn); F(_texSmoothTemp); F(_texVisual);
        F(_texNormal);
        F(_texFoamRead); F(_texFoamWrite);
        F(_texCaptureHistory); F(_texCaptureBlack);
        F(_brushSsbo);
        F(_uboRipple); F(_uboSmoothH); F(_uboSmoothV);
        F(_uboNormal); F(_uboFoam);
        for (int i = 0; i < READBACK_RING_DEPTH; i++)
        {
            F(_stagingHeight[i]);
            F(_stagingFoam[i]);
        }
        F(_pipelineRipple);      F(_shaderRipple);
        F(_pipelineSmooth);      F(_shaderSmooth);
        F(_pipelineNormal);      F(_shaderNormal);
        F(_pipelineFoam);        F(_shaderFoam);
        F(_pipelineStagingCopy); F(_shaderStagingCopy);
        F(_pipelineGather);      F(_shaderGather);
        F(_pipelineCaptureCopy); F(_shaderCaptureCopy);
        F(_pipelineVisualCopy);  F(_shaderVisualCopy);
        F(_samplerCaptureLinear);

        _uniformCacheBuilt = false;
    }

    private void DispatchRipple(long cl, uint groups)
    {
        if (!_pipelineRipple.IsValid) return;
        Rid captureRdRid = ResolveCaptureRdRid();
        if (!captureRdRid.IsValid) return;

        _urHeightIn.ClearIds();  _urHeightIn.AddId(HeightInTex);
        _urHeightOut.ClearIds(); _urHeightOut.AddId(HeightOutTex);

        _urCapture.ClearIds();
        _urCapture.AddId(_samplerCaptureLinear);
        _urCapture.AddId(captureRdRid);

        Rid set = UniformSetCacheRD.GetCache(_shaderRipple, 0, _uaRipple);
        if (!set.IsValid)
        {
            GD.PushWarning("[IWSRippleSimMgr] DispatchRipple: UniformSet invalid, skipping.");
            return;
        }
        _rd.ComputeListBindComputePipeline(cl, _pipelineRipple);
        _rd.ComputeListBindUniformSet(cl, set, 0);
        _rd.ComputeListDispatch(cl, groups, groups, 1);
    }

    private void DispatchVisualCopy(long cl, uint groups)
    {
        if (!_pipelineVisualCopy.IsValid) return;

        _uvcHeightOut.ClearIds(); _uvcHeightOut.AddId(HeightOutTex);

        Rid set = UniformSetCacheRD.GetCache(_shaderVisualCopy, 0, _uaVisualCopy);
        if (!set.IsValid) return;
        _rd.ComputeListBindComputePipeline(cl, _pipelineVisualCopy);
        _rd.ComputeListBindUniformSet(cl, set, 0);
        _rd.ComputeListDispatch(cl, groups, groups, 1);
    }

    private void DispatchCaptureCopy(long cl, uint groups)
    {
        if (!_pipelineCaptureCopy.IsValid) return;
        Rid captureRdRid = ResolveCaptureRdRid();
        if (!captureRdRid.IsValid) return;

        _uccCapture.ClearIds();
        _uccCapture.AddId(_samplerCaptureLinear);
        _uccCapture.AddId(captureRdRid);

        Rid set = UniformSetCacheRD.GetCache(_shaderCaptureCopy, 0, _uaCaptureCopy);
        if (!set.IsValid) return;
        _rd.ComputeListBindComputePipeline(cl, _pipelineCaptureCopy);
        _rd.ComputeListBindUniformSet(cl, set, 0);
        _rd.ComputeListDispatch(cl, groups, groups, 1);
    }

    private void DispatchSmoothH(long cl, uint groups)
    {
        if (!_pipelineSmooth.IsValid) return;

        Rid set = UniformSetCacheRD.GetCache(_shaderSmooth, 0, _uaSmoothH);
        if (!set.IsValid) return;
        _rd.ComputeListBindComputePipeline(cl, _pipelineSmooth);
        _rd.ComputeListBindUniformSet(cl, set, 0);
        _rd.ComputeListDispatch(cl, groups, groups, 1);
    }

    private void DispatchSmoothV(long cl, uint groups)
    {
        if (!_pipelineSmooth.IsValid) return;

        Rid set = UniformSetCacheRD.GetCache(_shaderSmooth, 0, _uaSmoothV);
        if (!set.IsValid) return;
        _rd.ComputeListBindComputePipeline(cl, _pipelineSmooth);
        _rd.ComputeListBindUniformSet(cl, set, 0);
        _rd.ComputeListDispatch(cl, groups, groups, 1);
    }

    private void DispatchNormal(long cl, uint groups)
    {
        if (!_pipelineNormal.IsValid) return;

        Rid set = UniformSetCacheRD.GetCache(_shaderNormal, 0, _uaNormal);
        if (!set.IsValid) return;
        _rd.ComputeListBindComputePipeline(cl, _pipelineNormal);
        _rd.ComputeListBindUniformSet(cl, set, 0);
        _rd.ComputeListDispatch(cl, groups, groups, 1);
    }

    private void DispatchFoam(long cl, uint groups)
    {
        if (!_pipelineFoam.IsValid) return;

        _ufFoamRead.ClearIds();  _ufFoamRead.AddId(_texFoamRead);
        _ufFoamWrite.ClearIds(); _ufFoamWrite.AddId(_texFoamWrite);
        _ufHeightOut.ClearIds(); _ufHeightOut.AddId(HeightOutTex);

        Rid set = UniformSetCacheRD.GetCache(_shaderFoam, 0, _uaFoam);
        if (!set.IsValid) return;
        _rd.ComputeListBindComputePipeline(cl, _pipelineFoam);
        _rd.ComputeListBindUniformSet(cl, set, 0);
        _rd.ComputeListDispatch(cl, groups, groups, 1);
    }

    private void DispatchStagingCopy(long cl, uint groups)
    {
        if (!_pipelineStagingCopy.IsValid) return;

        _usHeightOut.ClearIds(); _usHeightOut.AddId(HeightOutTex);
        _usFoamRead.ClearIds();  _usFoamRead.AddId(_texFoamRead);
        _usHeightBuf.ClearIds(); _usHeightBuf.AddId(_stagingHeight[_writeSlot]);
        _usFoamBuf.ClearIds();   _usFoamBuf.AddId(_stagingFoam[_writeSlot]);

        Rid set = UniformSetCacheRD.GetCache(_shaderStagingCopy, 0, _uaStaging);
        if (!set.IsValid) return;
        _rd.ComputeListBindComputePipeline(cl, _pipelineStagingCopy);
        _rd.ComputeListBindUniformSet(cl, set, 0);
        _rd.ComputeListDispatch(cl, groups, groups, 1);
    }

    private Rid ResolveCaptureRdRid()
    {
        if (!_texCaptureBlack.IsValid) return default;
        if (!_snapCaptureRsRid.IsValid || _snapCaptureStrength < 0.001f)
            return _texCaptureBlack;
        if (_snapCaptureRsRid == _cachedCaptureRsRid && _cachedCaptureRdRid.IsValid)
            return _cachedCaptureRdRid;
        _cachedCaptureRsRid = _snapCaptureRsRid;
        _cachedCaptureRdRid = RenderingServer.TextureGetRdTexture(_snapCaptureRsRid, false);
        return _cachedCaptureRdRid.IsValid ? _cachedCaptureRdRid : _texCaptureBlack;
    }

    private float SampleBilinear(float[] buf, Vector2 uv)
    {
        if (buf == null) return 0f;
        float fx = Mathf.Clamp(uv.X * _snapTextureSize - 0.5f, 0f, _snapTextureSize - 1.001f);
        float fy = Mathf.Clamp(uv.Y * _snapTextureSize - 0.5f, 0f, _snapTextureSize - 1.001f);
        int x0 = (int)fx, y0 = (int)fy;
        int x1 = Mathf.Min(x0 + 1, _snapTextureSize - 1);
        int y1 = Mathf.Min(y0 + 1, _snapTextureSize - 1);
        float tx = fx - x0, ty = fy - y0;
        int ts = _snapTextureSize;
        return Mathf.Lerp(
            Mathf.Lerp(buf[y0 * ts + x0], buf[y0 * ts + x1], tx),
            Mathf.Lerp(buf[y1 * ts + x0], buf[y1 * ts + x1], tx),
            ty);
    }

    private Rid CreateShader(RDShaderFile file, string name)
    {
        if (file == null) return default;
        var spirv = file.GetSpirV();
        if (spirv == null)
        {
            GD.PushWarning($"[IWSRippleSimMgr] Shader '{name}' SPIR-V is null. Reimport the .glsl file.");
            return default;
        }
        return _rd.ShaderCreateFromSpirV(spirv);
    }

    private Rid CreatePipeline(Rid shader, string name)
    {
        if (!shader.IsValid) return default;
        Rid pipeline = _rd.ComputePipelineCreate(shader);
        if (!pipeline.IsValid)
            GD.PushWarning($"[IWSRippleSimMgr] Failed to create pipeline for '{name}'.");
        return pipeline;
    }

    private Rid CreateTex(RDTextureFormat fmt)
        => _rd.TextureCreate(fmt, new RDTextureView(), new Godot.Collections.Array<byte[]>());

    private void ClearTextureR16  (Rid tex) => ClearTextureBytes(tex, TextureSize * TextureSize * 2);
    private void ClearTextureRGBA16(Rid tex) => ClearTextureBytes(tex, TextureSize * TextureSize * 8);

    private void ClearTextureBytes(Rid tex, int bytes)
    {
        if (tex.IsValid) _rd.TextureUpdate(tex, 0, new byte[bytes]);
    }

    private static void WriteFloat(byte[] buf, int o, float v)
        => Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(v), 0, buf, o, 4);

    private static void WriteInt(byte[] buf, int o, int v)
        => Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(v), 0, buf, o, 4);
}

// res://water/simulation/IWSWaterQuerySampler.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Simulation;

using Godot;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using IWS.Water.Core;

/// <summary>
/// GPU asynchronous gathering pipeline for physics readback.
/// Resolves the CPU-bound bottleneck of traversing large textures by maintaining a Shader Storage Buffer Object (SSBO) ring buffer.
/// Gathers bilinear-sampled height, vertical velocity, and foam data on the GPU and reads it back to the CPU 
/// with a 1-to-2 frame delay, completely avoiding GPU stalls and pipeline synchronization issues.
/// </summary>
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterQuerySampler : Node
{
	public const int MAX_POI_COUNT       = 256;
	public const int READBACK_RING_DEPTH = 3;

	private const int REQUEST_SSBO_HEADER = 16;
	private const int REQUEST_STRIDE      = 16;
	private const int RESULT_STRIDE       = 16;

	private static readonly int REQUEST_SSBO_BYTES =
		REQUEST_SSBO_HEADER + MAX_POI_COUNT * REQUEST_STRIDE;
	private static readonly int RESULT_SSBO_BYTES =
		MAX_POI_COUNT * RESULT_STRIDE;

	private const int SLOT_FREE         = 0;
	private const int SLOT_INFLIGHT     = 1;
	private const int SLOT_RESULT_READY = 2;

	[Export] public IWSRippleSimMgr Simulator;
	public WaterZoneShape ZoneShape { get; set; }
	public bool IsEnabled { get; set; } = true;

	public readonly struct SampleRequest
	{
		public readonly int     Id;
		public readonly Vector2 UV;
		public SampleRequest(int id, Vector2 uv) { Id = id; UV = uv; }
	}

	private readonly List<SampleRequest> _requests = new(MAX_POI_COUNT);

	// Result semantics:
	//   Height   : Physical ripple height sample (pre-smooth).
	//   VelYStep : Vertical velocity step sample from velocity_tex.rg (per sim-step).
	//   Foam     : Physical foam density sample.
	private readonly Dictionary<int, (float Height, float VelYStep, float Foam)>
		_resultFront = new(MAX_POI_COUNT);
	private readonly Dictionary<int, (float Height, float VelYStep, float Foam)>
		_resultBack  = new(MAX_POI_COUNT);
	private int _backResultReady = 0;

	private RenderingDevice _rd;
	private Rid[] _requestSsbo = new Rid[READBACK_RING_DEPTH];
	private Rid[] _resultSsbo  = new Rid[READBACK_RING_DEPTH];

	private readonly int[] _slotState = new int[READBACK_RING_DEPTH];

	private int _writeSlotMain = 0;
	private int _readSlot      = 0;

	private byte[][] _requestSnapshots;
	private int[]    _requestCounts;

	private readonly ConcurrentQueue<int> _pendingGatherSlots = new();

	private Callable _gatherCallable;
	private Callable _initGpuCallable;
	private Callable _releaseGpuCallable;

	private bool _debugFirstNonZeroLogged = false;
	private int  _debugSkippedFrames      = 0;

	public override void _Ready()
	{
		ProcessPhysicsPriority = +1;

		_rd = RenderingServer.GetRenderingDevice();
		if (_rd == null)
		{
			GD.PushWarning("[IWSWaterQuerySampler] RenderingDevice unavailable. Gather disabled.");
			IsEnabled = false;
			return;
		}

		_requestSnapshots = new byte[READBACK_RING_DEPTH][];
		_requestCounts    = new int[READBACK_RING_DEPTH];
		for (int i = 0; i < READBACK_RING_DEPTH; i++)
			_requestSnapshots[i] = new byte[REQUEST_SSBO_BYTES];

		_gatherCallable     = new Callable(this, MethodName.ProcessGatherQueueOnRenderThread);
		_initGpuCallable    = new Callable(this, MethodName.InitGpuResourcesOnRenderThread);
		_releaseGpuCallable = new Callable(this, MethodName.ReleaseGpuResourcesOnRenderThread);

		RenderingServer.CallOnRenderThread(_initGpuCallable);
		GD.Print($"[IWSWaterQuerySampler] Initialization complete | priority=+1 | ring_depth={READBACK_RING_DEPTH} | " +
				 $"writeSlot={_writeSlotMain} readSlot={_readSlot}");
	}

	public override void _ExitTree()
	{
		RenderingServer.CallOnRenderThread(_releaseGpuCallable);
	}

	public void BeginFrame()
	{
		_requests.Clear();
		if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _backResultReady, 0, 1) == 1)
		{
			_resultFront.Clear();
			foreach (var kv in _resultBack)
				_resultFront[kv.Key] = kv.Value;
			_resultBack.Clear();
		}
	}

	public void RequestSample(int id, Vector3 worldPos)
	{
		if (!IsEnabled || _requests.Count >= MAX_POI_COUNT || ZoneShape == null) return;
		Vector2 uv = ZoneShape.WorldToUV_Physics(worldPos);
		_requests.Add(new SampleRequest(id, uv));
	}

	public bool GetResult(int id, out float height, out float velYStep, out float foam)
	{
		if (_resultFront.TryGetValue(id, out var r))
		{
			height   = r.Height;
			velYStep = r.VelYStep;
			foam     = r.Foam;
			return true;
		}
		height = velYStep = foam = 0f;
		return false;
	}

	public void EndFrame()
	{
		if (!IsEnabled || _rd == null || Simulator == null || _requests.Count == 0) return;

		int slot = _writeSlotMain;

		if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _slotState[slot], SLOT_INFLIGHT, SLOT_FREE) != SLOT_FREE)
		{
			_debugSkippedFrames++;
			if (_debugSkippedFrames % 60 == 1)
				GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterQuerySampler] Gather slot {slot} busy, skipping frame " +
							   $"(Total skipped: {_debugSkippedFrames}). Ring depth might be insufficient.");
			return;
		}

		int count = Math.Min(_requests.Count, MAX_POI_COUNT);

		byte[] snapshot = _requestSnapshots[slot];
		Array.Clear(snapshot, 0, REQUEST_SSBO_HEADER);
		WriteInt(snapshot, 0, count);

		for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
		{
			int o   = REQUEST_SSBO_HEADER + i * REQUEST_STRIDE;
			var req = _requests[i];
			WriteFloat(snapshot, o + 0,  req.UV.X);
			WriteFloat(snapshot, o + 4,  req.UV.Y);
			WriteFloat(snapshot, o + 8,  (float)req.Id);
			WriteFloat(snapshot, o + 12, 0f);
		}

		_requestCounts[slot] = count;
		_writeSlotMain       = (_writeSlotMain + 1) % READBACK_RING_DEPTH;

		_pendingGatherSlots.Enqueue(slot);
		RenderingServer.CallOnRenderThread(_gatherCallable);
	}

	public override void _PhysicsProcess(double delta)
	{
		// If the associated simulator is skipping the current frame, do not submit a Gather request.
		// Avoids reading stale data when simulation textures haven't been updated, saving GPU bandwidth.
		if (Simulator != null && !Simulator.SimulatedThisFrame)
			return;

		EndFrame();
	}

	private void ProcessGatherQueueOnRenderThread()
	{
		while (_pendingGatherSlots.TryDequeue(out int slot))
			ExecuteGatherOnRenderThread(slot);
	}

	private void ExecuteGatherOnRenderThread(int slot)
	{
		if (Simulator == null ||
			!Simulator.GatherPipelineRid.IsValid ||
			!Simulator.GatherShaderRid.IsValid)
		{
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref _slotState[slot], SLOT_FREE);
			return;
		}

		// Read back mature results first (ensures a 1-frame gap minimum).
		DoReadbackOnRenderThread();

		int    count    = _requestCounts[slot];
		byte[] snapshot = _requestSnapshots[slot];

		if (count <= 0)
		{
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref _slotState[slot], SLOT_FREE);
			return;
		}

		_rd.BufferUpdate(_requestSsbo[slot], 0, (uint)REQUEST_SSBO_BYTES, snapshot);

		Rid heightRid = Simulator.HeightPhysTexRid;
		Rid foamRid   = Simulator.FoamReadTexRid;
		Rid velRid    = Simulator.VelocityTexRid;

		if (!heightRid.IsValid || !foamRid.IsValid || !velRid.IsValid)
		{
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref _slotState[slot], SLOT_FREE);
			return;
		}

		var uniforms = new Godot.Collections.Array<RDUniform>
		{
			MakeImageUniform(heightRid,              0),
			MakeImageUniform(foamRid,                1),
			MakeStorageUniform(_requestSsbo[slot],   2),
			MakeStorageUniform(_resultSsbo[slot],    3),
			MakeImageUniform(velRid,                 4),
		};

		Rid  set    = UniformSetCacheRD.GetCache(Simulator.GatherShaderRid, 0, uniforms);
		uint groups = (uint)Math.Max((count + 63) / 64, 1);

		long cl = _rd.ComputeListBegin();
		_rd.ComputeListBindComputePipeline(cl, Simulator.GatherPipelineRid);
		_rd.ComputeListBindUniformSet(cl, set, 0);
		_rd.ComputeListDispatch(cl, groups, 1, 1);
		_rd.ComputeListEnd();

		Interlocked.Exchange(ref _slotState[slot], SLOT_RESULT_READY);
	}

	private void DoReadbackOnRenderThread()
	{
		int slot = _readSlot;

		if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(
				ref _slotState[slot], SLOT_FREE, SLOT_RESULT_READY) != SLOT_RESULT_READY)
			return;

		int    readCount = _requestCounts[slot];
		byte[] data      = _rd.BufferGetData(_resultSsbo[slot]);

		if (data == null || data.Length < readCount * RESULT_STRIDE)
		{
			GD.PushWarning($"[IWSWaterQuerySampler] Gather readback failed for slot={slot} " +
						   $"expected={readCount * RESULT_STRIDE}B " +
						   $"got={(data == null ? "null" : $"{data.Length}B")}");
			_readSlot = (slot + 1) % READBACK_RING_DEPTH;
			return;
		}

		_resultBack.Clear();
		bool anyNonZero = false;

		for (int i = 0; i < readCount; i++)
		{
			int   o      = i * RESULT_STRIDE;
			float h      = BitConverter.ToSingle(data, o + 0);
			float vyStep = BitConverter.ToSingle(data, o + 4);
			float foam   = BitConverter.ToSingle(data, o + 8);
			int   id     = (int)BitConverter.ToSingle(data, o + 12);

			_resultBack[id] = (h, vyStep, foam);

			if (!anyNonZero && (Math.Abs(h) > 0.001f || Math.Abs(vyStep) > 0.001f))
				anyNonZero = true;
		}

		if (anyNonZero && !_debugFirstNonZeroLogged)
		{
			_debugFirstNonZeroLogged = true;
			GD.Print($"[IWSWaterQuerySampler] ✓ First non-zero gather result received | slot={slot} count={readCount}");
		}

		Interlocked.Exchange(ref _backResultReady, 1);
		_readSlot = (slot + 1) % READBACK_RING_DEPTH;
	}

	private void InitGpuResourcesOnRenderThread()
	{
		var emptyReq = new byte[REQUEST_SSBO_BYTES];
		var emptyRes = new byte[RESULT_SSBO_BYTES];
		for (int i = 0; i < READBACK_RING_DEPTH; i++)
		{
			_requestSsbo[i] = _rd.StorageBufferCreate((uint)REQUEST_SSBO_BYTES, emptyReq);
			_resultSsbo[i]  = _rd.StorageBufferCreate((uint)RESULT_SSBO_BYTES,  emptyRes);
		}
		GD.Print("[IWSWaterQuerySampler] GPU resource initialization complete (Render Thread)");
	}

	private void ReleaseGpuResourcesOnRenderThread()
	{
		if (_rd == null) return;
		for (int i = 0; i < READBACK_RING_DEPTH; i++)
		{
			if (_requestSsbo[i].IsValid) _rd.FreeRid(_requestSsbo[i]);
			if (_resultSsbo[i].IsValid)  _rd.FreeRid(_resultSsbo[i]);
		}
		GD.Print("[IWSWaterQuerySampler] GPU resources released (Render Thread)");
	}

	private static RDUniform MakeImageUniform(Rid tex, int binding)
	{
		var u = new RDUniform
			{ UniformType = RenderingDevice.UniformType.Image, Binding = binding };
		u.AddId(tex);
		return u;
	}

	private static RDUniform MakeStorageUniform(Rid buf, int binding)
	{
		var u = new RDUniform
			{ UniformType = RenderingDevice.UniformType.StorageBuffer, Binding = binding };
		u.AddId(buf);
		return u;
	}

	private static void WriteFloat(byte[] buf, int o, float v)
		=> Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(v), 0, buf, o, 4);

	private static void WriteInt(byte[] buf, int o, int v)
		=> Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(v), 0, buf, o, 4);
}

// res://water/zones/IWSWaterZoneBox.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Zone;

using Godot;
using IWS.Water.Core;

/// <summary>
/// Box-shaped water zone.
/// Implements WaterZoneShape to define physical boundaries and map local coordinates 
/// to the GPU Ripple simulation UV space ([0,1]^2).
/// </summary>
[Tool]
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterZoneBox : Node3D, WaterZoneShape
{
	private Vector2 _size       = new Vector2(50f, 50f);
	private float   _downExtent = 20f;
	private float   _upExtent   = 0.5f;

	[Export]
	public Vector2 Size
	{
		get => _size;
		set { _size = value; _vizDirty = true; _boundsDirty = true; }
	}

	[Export]
	public float DownExtent
	{
		get => _downExtent;
		set { _downExtent = value; _vizDirty = true; }
	}

	[Export]
	public float UpExtent
	{
		get => _upExtent;
		set { _upExtent = value; _vizDirty = true; }
	}

	// --- Runtime Bounds Cache ---
	private Rect2 _cachedBoundsXZ;
	private bool  _boundsDirty = true;

	// --- Editor Visualization ---
	private MeshInstance3D _editorViz;
	private ImmediateMesh  _editorMesh;
	private bool           _vizDirty = true;

	public override void _Ready()
	{
		SetNotifyTransform(true);
		RebuildBounds();

		if (Engine.IsEditorHint())
		{
			BuildEditorVisualization();
		}
	}

	public override void _Notification(int what)
	{
		if (what == NotificationTransformChanged)
		{
			_boundsDirty = true;
			_vizDirty    = true;
		}
	}

	public override void _Process(double delta)
	{
		if (!Engine.IsEditorHint()) return;

		if (_vizDirty)
		{
			_vizDirty = false;
			RebuildEditorMesh();
		}
	}

	// --- Editor Visualization Builder ---

	private void BuildEditorVisualization()
	{
		if (_editorViz != null && IsInstanceValid(_editorViz))
			return;

		_editorMesh = new ImmediateMesh();

		var mat = new StandardMaterial3D
		{
			ShadingMode              = BaseMaterial3D.ShadingModeEnum.Unshaded,
			VertexColorUseAsAlbedo   = true,
			Transparency             = BaseMaterial3D.TransparencyEnum.Alpha,
			NoDepthTest              = false,
			CullMode                 = BaseMaterial3D.CullModeEnum.Disabled,
		};

		_editorViz = new MeshInstance3D
		{
			Name             = "__IWSEditorViz__",
			Mesh             = _editorMesh,
			MaterialOverride = mat,
			CastShadow       = GeometryInstance3D.ShadowCastingSetting.Off,
		};

		AddChild(_editorViz);
		GD.Print($"[IWSWaterZoneBox] '{Name}' editor visualization created.");

		RebuildEditorMesh();
	}

	private void RebuildEditorMesh()
	{
		if (_editorMesh == null) return;

		float hx = Size.X * 0.5f;
		float hz = Size.Y * 0.5f;

		var cTop   = new Color(0.2f, 0.75f, 1.0f, 0.9f);
		var cBot   = new Color(0.1f, 0.40f, 0.8f, 0.45f);
		var cCross = new Color(1.0f, 1.0f,  0.3f, 0.6f);

		_editorMesh.ClearSurfaces();
		_editorMesh.SurfaceBegin(Mesh.PrimitiveType.Lines);

		// Top face (horizontal plane)
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3(-hx, 0, -hz), new Vector3( hx, 0, -hz), cTop);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3( hx, 0, -hz), new Vector3( hx, 0,  hz), cTop);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3( hx, 0,  hz), new Vector3(-hx, 0,  hz), cTop);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3(-hx, 0,  hz), new Vector3(-hx, 0, -hz), cTop);

		// Bottom face (DownExtent limit)
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3(-hx, -DownExtent, -hz), new Vector3( hx, -DownExtent, -hz), cBot);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3( hx, -DownExtent, -hz), new Vector3( hx, -DownExtent,  hz), cBot);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3( hx, -DownExtent,  hz), new Vector3(-hx, -DownExtent,  hz), cBot);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3(-hx, -DownExtent,  hz), new Vector3(-hx, -DownExtent, -hz), cBot);

		// Four vertical edges
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3(-hx, 0, -hz), new Vector3(-hx, -DownExtent, -hz), cBot);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3( hx, 0, -hz), new Vector3( hx, -DownExtent, -hz), cBot);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3( hx, 0,  hz), new Vector3( hx, -DownExtent,  hz), cBot);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3(-hx, 0,  hz), new Vector3(-hx, -DownExtent,  hz), cBot);

		// Crosshair helper lines
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3(-hx, 0,   0), new Vector3( hx, 0,   0), cCross);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3(  0, 0, -hz), new Vector3(  0, 0,  hz), cCross);

		_editorMesh.SurfaceEnd();
	}

	private static void Line(ImmediateMesh m, Vector3 a, Vector3 b, Color c)
	{
		m.SurfaceSetColor(c); m.SurfaceAddVertex(a);
		m.SurfaceSetColor(c); m.SurfaceAddVertex(b);
	}

	// --- WaterZoneShape Implementation ---

	public bool ContainsWorldPoint(Vector3 worldPos, float waterY)
	{
		Vector3 local = ToLocal(worldPos);
		float halfX = Size.X * 0.5f;
		float halfZ = Size.Y * 0.5f;
		float dy    = worldPos.Y - waterY;
		
		return local.X >= -halfX && local.X <= halfX
			&& local.Z >= -halfZ && local.Z <= halfZ
			&& dy >= -DownExtent && dy <= UpExtent;
	}

	public Vector2 WorldToUV(Vector3 worldPos)
	{
		Vector3 local = ToLocal(worldPos);
		return new Vector2(local.X / Size.X + 0.5f, local.Z / Size.Y + 0.5f);
	}

	public Vector2 WorldToUV_Physics(Vector3 worldPos) => WorldToUV(worldPos);

	/// <summary>
	/// Returns the larger axis dimension. Used for scalar evaluations such as brush radiuses and foam distance attenuation.
	/// </summary>
	public float GetVisualSize() => Mathf.Max(Size.X, Size.Y);
	
	/// <summary>
	/// Returns the exact dual-axis dimensions. Used exclusively by the Compute Shader to map ripple UV space.
	/// </summary>
	public Vector2 GetVisualSizeXZ() => new Vector2(Size.X, Size.Y);
	
	public Vector2 GetRippleCenterWorld_Render()    => new Vector2(GlobalPosition.X, GlobalPosition.Z);
	public Vector2 GetRippleCenterWorld_Physics()   => new Vector2(GlobalPosition.X, GlobalPosition.Z);

	public Rect2 GetBoundsXZ()
	{
		if (_boundsDirty) RebuildBounds();
		return _cachedBoundsXZ;
	}

	public void UpdateRenderFrame(Vector3 followerWorldPos)  { }
	public void UpdatePhysicsFrame(Vector3 followerWorldPos) { }

	private void RebuildBounds()
	{
		float halfX = Size.X * 0.5f;
		float halfZ = Size.Y * 0.5f;
		Vector3 w0 = ToGlobal(new Vector3(-halfX, 0f, -halfZ));
		Vector3 w1 = ToGlobal(new Vector3( halfX, 0f, -halfZ));
		Vector3 w2 = ToGlobal(new Vector3( halfX, 0f,  halfZ));
		Vector3 w3 = ToGlobal(new Vector3(-halfX, 0f,  halfZ));
		
		float minX = Mathf.Min(Mathf.Min(w0.X, w1.X), Mathf.Min(w2.X, w3.X));
		float maxX = Mathf.Max(Mathf.Max(w0.X, w1.X), Mathf.Max(w2.X, w3.X));
		float minZ = Mathf.Min(Mathf.Min(w0.Z, w1.Z), Mathf.Min(w2.Z, w3.Z));
		float maxZ = Mathf.Max(Mathf.Max(w0.Z, w1.Z), Mathf.Max(w2.Z, w3.Z));
		
		_cachedBoundsXZ = new Rect2(minX, minZ, maxX - minX, maxZ - minZ);
		_boundsDirty    = false;
	}
}


// res://water/zones/IWSWaterZoneInfinitePlane.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Zone;

using Godot;
using IWS.Water.Core;

/// <summary>
/// Infinite plane water zone (ocean). Always contains the camera.
/// Implements WaterZoneShape to define physical boundaries and map world coordinates 
/// to the GPU Ripple simulation UV space ([0,1]^2).
/// Separates render center and physics center to prevent simulation tearing.
/// </summary>
[Tool]
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterZoneInfinitePlane : Node3D, WaterZoneShape
{
	private float _rippleVisibleRange = 100f;
	private float _downExtent         = 50f;
	private float _upExtent           = 0.5f;

	[Export]
	public float RippleVisibleRange
	{
		get => _rippleVisibleRange;
		set { _rippleVisibleRange = value; _vizDirty = true; }
	}

	[Export]
	public float DownExtent
	{
		get => _downExtent;
		set { _downExtent = value; _vizDirty = true; }
	}

	[Export]
	public float UpExtent
	{
		get => _upExtent;
		set { _upExtent = value; _vizDirty = true; }
	}

	private Vector2 _renderCenter;
	private Vector2 _physicsCenter;

	private MeshInstance3D _editorViz;
	private ImmediateMesh  _editorMesh;
	private bool           _vizDirty = true;

	public override void _Ready()
	{
		if (Engine.IsEditorHint())
			BuildEditorVisualization();
	}

	public override void _Process(double delta)
	{
		if (!Engine.IsEditorHint()) return;

		if (_vizDirty)
		{
			_vizDirty = false;
			RebuildEditorMesh();
		}
	}

	private void BuildEditorVisualization()
	{
		if (_editorViz != null && IsInstanceValid(_editorViz)) return;

		_editorMesh = new ImmediateMesh();

		var mat = new StandardMaterial3D
		{
			ShadingMode            = BaseMaterial3D.ShadingModeEnum.Unshaded,
			VertexColorUseAsAlbedo = true,
			Transparency           = BaseMaterial3D.TransparencyEnum.Alpha,
			CullMode               = BaseMaterial3D.CullModeEnum.Disabled,
		};

		_editorViz = new MeshInstance3D
		{
			Name             = "__IWSEditorViz__",
			Mesh             = _editorMesh,
			MaterialOverride = mat,
			CastShadow       = GeometryInstance3D.ShadowCastingSetting.Off,
		};

		AddChild(_editorViz);
		GD.Print($"[IWSWaterZoneInfinitePlane] '{Name}' editor visualization created.");

		RebuildEditorMesh();
	}

	private void RebuildEditorMesh()
	{
		if (_editorMesh == null) return;

		float h   = RippleVisibleRange;
		var   cEdge  = new Color(0.3f, 0.85f, 1.0f, 0.8f);
		var   cCross = new Color(1.0f, 1.0f,  0.3f, 0.5f);
		var   cInner = new Color(0.3f, 0.85f, 1.0f, 0.3f);

		_editorMesh.ClearSurfaces();
		_editorMesh.SurfaceBegin(Mesh.PrimitiveType.Lines);

		// Outer frame
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3(-h, 0, -h), new Vector3( h, 0, -h), cEdge);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3( h, 0, -h), new Vector3( h, 0,  h), cEdge);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3( h, 0,  h), new Vector3(-h, 0,  h), cEdge);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3(-h, 0,  h), new Vector3(-h, 0, -h), cEdge);

		// Cross
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3(-h, 0,  0), new Vector3(h, 0,  0), cCross);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3( 0, 0, -h), new Vector3(0, 0,  h), cCross);

		// Inner circle (1/4 size, helps determine central area)
		float q = h * 0.5f;
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3(-q, 0, -q), new Vector3( q, 0, -q), cInner);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3( q, 0, -q), new Vector3( q, 0,  q), cInner);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3( q, 0,  q), new Vector3(-q, 0,  q), cInner);
		Line(_editorMesh, new Vector3(-q, 0,  q), new Vector3(-q, 0, -q), cInner);

		_editorMesh.SurfaceEnd();
	}

	private static void Line(ImmediateMesh m, Vector3 a, Vector3 b, Color c)
	{
		m.SurfaceSetColor(c); m.SurfaceAddVertex(a);
		m.SurfaceSetColor(c); m.SurfaceAddVertex(b);
	}

	// --- WaterZoneShape Implementation ---

	public bool ContainsWorldPoint(Vector3 worldPos, float waterY)
	{
		float dy = worldPos.Y - waterY;
		return dy <= UpExtent && dy >= -DownExtent;
	}

	public Vector2 WorldToUV(Vector3 worldPos)       => CalcUV(worldPos, _renderCenter);
	public Vector2 WorldToUV_Physics(Vector3 worldPos) => CalcUV(worldPos, _physicsCenter);

	private Vector2 CalcUV(Vector3 worldPos, Vector2 center)
	{
		float u = (worldPos.X - center.X) / (RippleVisibleRange * 2f) + 0.5f;
		float v = (worldPos.Z - center.Y) / (RippleVisibleRange * 2f) + 0.5f;
		return new Vector2(u, v);
	}

	public float   GetVisualSize()                  => RippleVisibleRange * 2f;
	public Vector2 GetRippleCenterWorld_Render()    => _renderCenter;
	public Vector2 GetRippleCenterWorld_Physics()   => _physicsCenter;
	public Rect2   GetBoundsXZ()                    => new Rect2(-1e6f, -1e6f, 2e6f, 2e6f);

	public void UpdateRenderFrame(Vector3 followerWorldPos)
		=> _renderCenter = new Vector2(followerWorldPos.X, followerWorldPos.Z);

	public void UpdatePhysicsFrame(Vector3 followerWorldPos)
		=> _physicsCenter = new Vector2(followerWorldPos.X, followerWorldPos.Z);
}


// res://water/zones/IWSWaterZoneSpline.cs
namespace IWS.Water.Zone;

using Godot;
using IWS.Water.Core;

/// <summary>
/// Spline-based river water zone.
/// Uses distance queries on Godot Path3D to perform UV mapping and collision detection.
/// Implements WaterZoneShape to map world coordinates to the GPU Ripple simulation UV space.
/// </summary>
[Tool]
[GlobalClass]
public partial class IWSWaterZoneSpline : Node3D, WaterZoneShape
{
	private Path3D _splinePath;
	private float  _width                = 10f;
	private float  _downExtent           = 5f;
	private float  _upExtent             = 0.5f;
	private float  _rippleCoverageLength = 100f;

	[Export]
	public Path3D SplinePath
	{
		get => _splinePath;
		set { _splinePath = value; _vizDirty = true; RebuildBounds(); }
	}

	[Export]
	public float Width
	{
		get => _width;
		set { _width = value; _vizDirty = true; RebuildBounds(); }
	}

	[Export]
	public float DownExtent
	{
		get => _downExtent;
		set { _downExtent = value; _vizDirty = true; }
	}

	[Export]
	public float UpExtent
	{
		get => _upExtent;
		set { _upExtent = value; _vizDirty = true; }
	}

	[Export]
	public float RippleCoverageLength
	{
		get => _rippleCoverageLength;
		set { _rippleCoverageLength = value; _vizDirty = true; }
	}

	// --- Runtime State ---
	private Vector3 _renderClosestWorld;
	private float   _renderClosestOffset;
	private Vector3 _physicsClosestWorld;
	private float   _physicsClosestOffset;
	private Vector3 _cacheQueryWorld;
	private float   _cacheOffset;
	private Vector3 _cacheClosestWorld;
	private ulong   _cachePhysicsFrame = ulong.MaxValue;
	private const float CACHE_RADIUS_SQ = 0.25f;
	private Rect2 _cachedBoundsXZ;
	private float _cachedTotalLength = 0f;

	// --- Editor Visualization ---
	private MeshInstance3D _editorViz;
	private ImmediateMesh  _editorMesh;
	private bool           _vizDirty = true;

	public override void _Ready()
	{
		SetNotifyTransform(true);
		RebuildBounds();

		if (Engine.IsEditorHint())
			BuildEditorVisualization();
	}

	public override void _Notification(int what)
	{
		if (what == NotificationTransformChanged)
			_vizDirty = true;
	}

	public override void _Process(double delta)
	{
		if (!Engine.IsEditorHint()) return;

		if (_vizDirty)
		{
			_vizDirty = false;
			RebuildEditorMesh();
		}
	}

	private void BuildEditorVisualization()
	{
		if (_editorViz != null && IsInstanceValid(_editorViz)) return;

		_editorMesh = new ImmediateMesh();

		var mat = new StandardMaterial3D
		{
			ShadingMode            = BaseMaterial3D.ShadingModeEnum.Unshaded,
			VertexColorUseAsAlbedo = true,
			Transparency           = BaseMaterial3D.TransparencyEnum.Alpha,
			CullMode               = BaseMaterial3D.CullModeEnum.Disabled,
		};

		_editorViz = new MeshInstance3D
		{
			Name             = "__IWSEditorViz__",
			Mesh             = _editorMesh,
			MaterialOverride = mat,
			CastShadow       = GeometryInstance3D.ShadowCastingSetting.Off,
		};

		AddChild(_editorViz);
		GD.Print($"[IWSWaterZoneSpline] '{Name}' editor visualization created.");

		RebuildEditorMesh();
	}

	private void RebuildEditorMesh()
	{
		if (_editorMesh == null) return;
		if (SplinePath?.Curve == null || _cachedTotalLength < 0.01f)
		{
			_editorMesh.ClearSurfaces();
			return;
		}

		float totalLength = _cachedTotalLength;
		float halfW  = Width * 0.5f;
		
		// Steps: Max 80 segments, min 0.3m per segment
		float step   = Mathf.Max(totalLength / 80f, 0.3f);
		int   steps  = Mathf.Max(Mathf.CeilToInt(totalLength / step), 2);

		var cCenter = new Color(0.2f, 0.95f, 0.5f, 0.9f);
		var cEdge   = new Color(0.2f, 0.70f, 1.0f, 0.65f);
		var cCross  = new Color(0.9f, 0.9f,  0.3f, 0.4f);

		_editorMesh.ClearSurfaces();
		_editorMesh.SurfaceBegin(Mesh.PrimitiveType.Lines);

		Vector3? prevCp    = null;
		Vector3? prevLeft  = null;
		Vector3? prevRight = null;

		for (int si = 0; si <= steps; si++)
		{
			float   at  = Mathf.Min((float)si / steps * totalLength, totalLength);
			Vector3 cp  = SplinePath.ToGlobal(SplinePath.Curve.SampleBaked(at));

			// Tangent (world space, horizontal projection)
			float   eps  = Mathf.Max(totalLength * 0.002f, 0.05f);
			Vector3 pFwd = SplinePath.ToGlobal(SplinePath.Curve.SampleBaked(Mathf.Min(at + eps, totalLength)));
			Vector3 pBwd = SplinePath.ToGlobal(SplinePath.Curve.SampleBaked(Mathf.Max(at - eps, 0f)));
			Vector3 tg   = pFwd - pBwd; tg.Y = 0f;
			Vector3 tn   = tg.Length() > 1e-5f ? tg.Normalized() : Vector3.Forward;
			Vector3 perp = new Vector3(-tn.Z, 0f, tn.X);

			Vector3 left  = cp - perp * halfW;
			Vector3 right = cp + perp * halfW;

			// Convert to local space of this node (ImmediateMesh vertices are in MeshInstance3D local space)
			Vector3 lcp    = ToLocal(cp);
			Vector3 lleft  = ToLocal(left);
			Vector3 lright = ToLocal(right);

			// Center line
			if (prevCp.HasValue)
				Line(_editorMesh, prevCp.Value,    lcp,    cCenter);
			// Left edge
			if (prevLeft.HasValue)
				Line(_editorMesh, prevLeft.Value,  lleft,  cEdge);
			// Right edge
			if (prevRight.HasValue)
				Line(_editorMesh, prevRight.Value, lright, cEdge);

			// Draw a cross-section line every 8 steps
			if (si % 8 == 0)
				Line(_editorMesh, lleft, lright, cCross);

			prevCp    = lcp;
			prevLeft  = lleft;
			prevRight = lright;
		}

		_editorMesh.SurfaceEnd();
	}

	private static void Line(ImmediateMesh m, Vector3 a, Vector3 b, Color c)
	{
		m.SurfaceSetColor(c); m.SurfaceAddVertex(a);
		m.SurfaceSetColor(c); m.SurfaceAddVertex(b);
	}

	// --- WaterZoneShape Implementation ---

	public void RebuildBounds()
	{
		if (SplinePath?.Curve == null)
		{
			_cachedTotalLength = 0f;
			_cachedBoundsXZ    = new Rect2(
				GlobalPosition.X - Width, GlobalPosition.Z - Width,
				Width * 2f, Width * 2f);
			return;
		}
		_cachedTotalLength = SplinePath.Curve.GetBakedLength();
		Vector3[] points   = SplinePath.Curve.GetBakedPoints();
		if (points.Length == 0)
		{
			_cachedBoundsXZ = new Rect2(
				GlobalPosition.X - Width, GlobalPosition.Z - Width,
				Width * 2f, Width * 2f);
			return;
		}
		float minX = float.MaxValue, minZ = float.MaxValue;
		float maxX = float.MinValue, maxZ = float.MinValue;
		foreach (Vector3 lp in points)
		{
			Vector3 wp = SplinePath.ToGlobal(lp);
			if (wp.X < minX) minX = wp.X;
			if (wp.Z < minZ) minZ = wp.Z;
			if (wp.X > maxX) maxX = wp.X;
			if (wp.Z > maxZ) maxZ = wp.Z;
		}
		float halfW = Width * 0.5f;
		_cachedBoundsXZ = new Rect2(
			minX - halfW, minZ - halfW,
			(maxX - minX) + Width, (maxZ - minZ) + Width);
	}

	public bool ContainsWorldPoint(Vector3 worldPos, float waterY)
	{
		if (SplinePath?.Curve == null) return false;
		float dy = worldPos.Y - waterY;
		if (dy > UpExtent || dy < -DownExtent) return false;
		GetPhysicsClosestCached(worldPos, out _, out Vector3 closestWorld);
		float distXZ = new Vector2(worldPos.X - closestWorld.X,
								   worldPos.Z - closestWorld.Z).Length();
		return distXZ <= Width * 0.5f;
	}

	public Vector2 WorldToUV(Vector3 worldPos)
		=> CalcUV(worldPos, _renderClosestWorld, _renderClosestOffset);

	public Vector2 WorldToUV_Physics(Vector3 worldPos)
	{
		GetPhysicsClosestCached(worldPos, out float offset, out Vector3 closestWorld);
		return CalcUV(worldPos, closestWorld, offset);
	}

	private Vector2 CalcUV(Vector3 worldPos, Vector3 closestWorld, float offset)
	{
		if (SplinePath?.Curve == null) return new Vector2(0.5f, 0.5f);
		float totalLength = _cachedTotalLength;
		float u = totalLength > 0f ? offset / totalLength : 0.5f;
		float eps    = Mathf.Max(totalLength * 0.001f, 0.05f);
		float fwd    = Mathf.Min(offset + eps, totalLength);
		float bwd    = Mathf.Max(offset - eps, 0f);
		Vector3 pFwd = SplinePath.ToGlobal(SplinePath.Curve.SampleBaked(fwd));
		Vector3 pBwd = SplinePath.ToGlobal(SplinePath.Curve.SampleBaked(bwd));
		Vector3 tang = pFwd - pBwd; tang.Y = 0f;
		Vector3 tangN = tang.Length() > 1e-5f ? tang.Normalized() : Vector3.Forward;
		Vector3 perp  = new Vector3(-tangN.Z, 0f, tangN.X);
		Vector3 delta = worldPos - closestWorld; delta.Y = 0f;
		float signed  = delta.Dot(perp);
		float halfW   = Width * 0.5f;
		float v       = halfW > 0f
			? Mathf.Clamp(0.5f + signed / halfW * 0.5f, 0f, 1f)
			: 0.5f;
		return new Vector2(u, v);
	}

	public float   GetVisualSize()                  => RippleCoverageLength;
	public Vector2 GetRippleCenterWorld_Render()    => new Vector2(_renderClosestWorld.X,  _renderClosestWorld.Z);
	public Vector2 GetRippleCenterWorld_Physics()   => new Vector2(_physicsClosestWorld.X, _physicsClosestWorld.Z);
	public Rect2   GetBoundsXZ()                    => _cachedBoundsXZ;

	public void UpdateRenderFrame(Vector3 followerWorldPos)
	{
		if (SplinePath?.Curve == null) return;
		QueryClosest(followerWorldPos, out _renderClosestOffset, out _renderClosestWorld);
	}

	public void UpdatePhysicsFrame(Vector3 followerWorldPos)
	{
		if (SplinePath?.Curve == null) return;
		QueryClosest(followerWorldPos, out _physicsClosestOffset, out _physicsClosestWorld);
	}

	private void GetPhysicsClosestCached(Vector3 worldPos, out float offset, out Vector3 closestWorld)
	{
		ulong frame = Engine.GetPhysicsFrames();
		if (frame == _cachePhysicsFrame &&
			worldPos.DistanceSquaredTo(_cacheQueryWorld) < CACHE_RADIUS_SQ)
		{
			offset = _cacheOffset; closestWorld = _cacheClosestWorld; return;
		}
		QueryClosest(worldPos, out offset, out closestWorld);
		_cachePhysicsFrame = frame;
		_cacheQueryWorld   = worldPos;
		_cacheOffset       = offset;
		_cacheClosestWorld = closestWorld;
	}

	private void QueryClosest(Vector3 worldPos, out float offset, out Vector3 closestWorld)
	{
		Vector3 localPos = SplinePath.ToLocal(worldPos);
		offset       = SplinePath.Curve.GetClosestOffset(localPos);
		Vector3 cp   = SplinePath.Curve.SampleBaked(offset);
		closestWorld = SplinePath.ToGlobal(cp);
	}
}


## A free-look camera script with raycast interaction and target teleportation capabilities.
extends Camera3D

@export_category("Camera Movement")
@export var base_speed := 8.0
@export var sprint_multiplier := 2.5
@export var accel := 15.0
@export var mouse_sensitivity := 0.25
@export var mouse_smoothing := 18.0
@export var move_damping := 6.0

@export_category("Interaction")
# The object that will be teleported when left-clicking with mouse visible.
@export var target_object: Node3D
@export var ray_length: float = 1000.0

var velocity := Vector3.ZERO
var target_rotation := Vector3.ZERO

var current_aim_position := Vector3.ZERO
var is_aiming_at_ground := false

# Records the object currently pointed to by the raycast.
var current_collider: Node3D = null 

func _ready() -> void:
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED
	target_rotation = rotation

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	# Mouse look
	if event is InputEventMouseMotion and Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
		var sens = mouse_sensitivity * 0.01
		target_rotation.y -= event.relative.x * sens
		target_rotation.x -= event.relative.y * sens
		target_rotation.x = clamp(target_rotation.x, -PI/2 + 0.01, PI/2 - 0.01)
	
	# Toggle mouse capture
	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
		Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE if Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED else Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED
	
	# Speed adjustment with mouse wheel & Clicking
	if event is InputEventMouseButton:
		if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
			base_speed *= 1.18
		elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
			base_speed /= 1.18
		
		if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and event.pressed:
			if Input.mouse_mode != Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
				if is_instance_valid(current_collider):
					print("Mouse clicked on object: ", current_collider.name)
					if current_collider.has_method("press"):
						print("[Interaction] This is a button! Preparing to trigger...")
						current_collider.press()
					else:
						print("[Interaction] This is a standard object, no 'press' method found. Executing teleport.")
						_teleport_target()
				else:
					print("[Interaction] Mouse did not click any collider!")

func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	_update_raycast()

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	# Smooth camera rotation
	rotation.x = lerp_angle(rotation.x, target_rotation.x, 1.0 - exp(-mouse_smoothing * delta))
	rotation.y = lerp_angle(rotation.y, target_rotation.y, 1.0 - exp(-mouse_smoothing * delta))
	
	# Movement
	var input_dir := Vector3.ZERO
	if Input.is_action_pressed("forward"):   input_dir.z -= 1
	if Input.is_action_pressed("backward"):  input_dir.z += 1
	if Input.is_action_pressed("left"):      input_dir.x -= 1
	if Input.is_action_pressed("right"):     input_dir.x += 1
	if Input.is_action_pressed("fly_up"):    input_dir.y += 1
	if Input.is_action_pressed("fly_down"):  input_dir.y -= 1
	
	input_dir = input_dir.normalized()
	var direction = (transform.basis * input_dir).normalized()
	
	var current_speed = base_speed * (sprint_multiplier if Input.is_action_pressed("sprint") else 1.0)
	
	var target_velocity = direction * current_speed
	velocity = velocity.lerp(target_velocity, accel * delta)
	
	if input_dir.length() < 0.1:
		velocity = velocity.lerp(Vector3.ZERO, move_damping * delta)
	
	position += velocity * delta

func _update_raycast() -> void:
	if Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
		is_aiming_at_ground = false
		current_collider = null
		return
	
	var viewport = get_viewport()
	var mouse_pos = viewport.get_mouse_position()
	var ray_origin = project_ray_origin(mouse_pos)
	var ray_target = ray_origin + project_ray_normal(mouse_pos) * ray_length
	var query = PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(ray_origin, ray_target)
	var result = get_world_3d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(query)
	
	if result:
		is_aiming_at_ground = true
		current_aim_position = result.position
		current_collider = result.collider
		# print("Raycast currently pointing at: ", current_collider.name)
	else:
		is_aiming_at_ground = false
		current_collider = null

func _teleport_target() -> void:
	if is_aiming_at_ground and is_instance_valid(target_object):
		target_object.global_position = current_aim_position
		print("Target teleported to: ", current_aim_position)
